summary.en: This is an old or short address. It opens /sales/orders straight away.
summary.hi: यह पुराना या छोटा पता है। यह सीधे /sales/orders खोल देता है।

purpose.en: The Sales home is the order list. Opening /sales sends you to Sales Orders, where every open order is listed by age and stage.
purpose.hi: Sales का मुख्य page order list है। /sales खोलने पर आप Sales Orders पर पहुँचते हैं, जहाँ हर खुला order उम्र और stage के हिसाब से दिखता है।

prerequisites.en: Your role must be allowed to open the target page.
prerequisites.hi: आपके role को आगे वाला page खोलने की अनुमति होनी चाहिए।

keyActions.en: Open the link or bookmark. The browser moves to /sales/orders by itself.
keyActions.hi: link या bookmark खोलें। browser अपने-आप /sales/orders पर चला जाता है।

keyActions.en: Update your bookmark to /sales/orders so the extra hop is skipped.
keyActions.hi: अपना bookmark /sales/orders पर बदल लें, ताकि बीच का कदम न लगे।

error.en: Page keeps loading or shows "not found"
error.hi: page लोड होता रहता है या "not found" दिखता है

reason.en: The order id in the link is wrong or the order was removed. Open the Orders list and search the SO number.
reason.hi: link में order id गलत है या order हटाया गया है। Orders list खोलकर SO number से search करें।

recoverySteps.en: Open "Orders" from the Sales menu and find the order there.
recoverySteps.hi: Sales menu से "Orders" खोलें और वहाँ order ढूँढें।

summary.en: The customer master: code, legal name, GST, contacts, billing and extra addresses, credit terms and status. Orders, quotations and dispatch slips read from here.
summary.hi: ग्राहकों की master list: code, नाम, GST, contact, पता, अतिरिक्त पते, credit की शर्तें और status। Order, quotation और dispatch slip यहीं से जानकारी लेते हैं।

purpose.en: Open it before the first order for a new customer, or when a customer's address, GST, contact or credit terms change. The saved address becomes the default ship address in the order composer and prints on dispatch slips.
purpose.hi: नए ग्राहक का पहला order डालने से पहले, या जब ग्राहक का पता, GST, contact या credit शर्त बदले, यह page खोलें। यहाँ save किया पता order composer में default ship address बनता है और dispatch slip पर छपता है।

prerequisites.en: Permission to manage sales (sales.manage). Read-only sales users do not see this page in the menu.
prerequisites.hi: sales.manage की अनुमति चाहिए। सिर्फ देखने वाले sales users को यह page menu में नहीं दिखता।

keyActions.en: Press "Register New Account" to open the "Account Registration" form.
keyActions.hi: "Register New Account" दबाएँ, "Account Registration" form खुलेगा।

keyActions.en: Fill "Identity Code" (e.g. CUST-001) and "Legal Entity Name". Both are required.
keyActions.hi: "Identity Code" (जैसे CUST-001) और "Legal Entity Name" भरें। दोनों ज़रूरी हैं।

keyActions.en: Add contact person, email, phone, "Tax Protocol ID (GST)" and "PAN No.".
keyActions.hi: contact person, email, phone, "Tax Protocol ID (GST)" और "PAN No." भरें।

keyActions.en: Fill the "Primary Mailing Address" block (Mailing Name, Primary Address, State, Country, Pincode).
keyActions.hi: "Primary Mailing Address" वाला हिस्सा भरें (Mailing Name, Primary Address, State, Country, Pincode)।

keyActions.en: Press "Add Address" for each extra delivery point (label such as "Surat DC", address, contact, phone).
keyActions.hi: हर अतिरिक्त delivery जगह के लिए "Add Address" दबाएँ (label जैसे "Surat DC", पता, contact, phone)।

keyActions.en: Set "Credit Period (Days)", "Credit Limit", TDS/TCS switches and "Status" (Active / Inactive).
keyActions.hi: "Credit Period (Days)", "Credit Limit", TDS/TCS switch और "Status" (Active / Inactive) सेट करें।

keyActions.en: Press "Commit Master Data" to save. To change a customer later, use the edit icon on its row ("Modify Account Topology").
keyActions.hi: save करने के लिए "Commit Master Data" दबाएँ। बाद में बदलाव के लिए row पर edit icon दबाएँ ("Modify Account Topology")।

help.en: Short unique customer code. Shown in the composer next to the name and in exports.
help.hi: ग्राहक का छोटा unique code। composer में नाम के साथ और export में दिखता है।

help.en: The customer name used on orders, quotations and slips.
help.hi: order, quotation और slip पर यही नाम छपता है।

help.en: Accounts group, e.g. Sundry Debtors.
help.hi: accounts group, जैसे Sundry Debtors।

help.en: GST number shows in the composer header line as "GST …".
help.hi: GST number composer में ग्राहक के नीचे "GST …" के रूप में दिखता है।

help.en: The billing address. When no separate shipping address is saved, the composer uses it as the ship address.
help.hi: यह billing पता है। अलग shipping पता न हो तो composer इसी को ship address मानता है।

help.en: Extra delivery points with their own contact. Empty rows are dropped on save.
help.hi: अतिरिक्त delivery पते, अपने contact के साथ। खाली rows save पर हट जाती हैं।

help.en: Credit days show in the composer as "N d credit" and in the quotation customer panel. The ERP does not block orders on credit.
help.hi: credit days composer में "N d credit" के रूप में और quotation के customer panel में दिखते हैं। ERP credit के आधार पर order नहीं रोकता।

help.en: Switch on if tax is deducted / collected for this customer ledger.
help.hi: अगर इस ग्राहक के ledger पर tax कटता / वसूला जाता है तो switch चालू करें।

help.en: Active or Inactive. Keep old customers Inactive instead of deleting them.
help.hi: Active या Inactive। पुराने ग्राहक को delete करने के बजाय Inactive रखें।

help.en: Client Code, Corporate Entity, Tax Identity, Account Status, Credit Exposure, Address Book, plus edit and delete icons. The search box filters by name.
help.hi: Client Code, Corporate Entity, Tax Identity, Account Status, Credit Exposure, Address Book, साथ में edit और delete icon। search box नाम से छाँटता है।

error.en: Code is required / Name is required
error.hi: Code is required / Name is required

reason.en: The form will not save without "Identity Code" and "Legal Entity Name". Fill both.
reason.hi: "Identity Code" और "Legal Entity Name" के बिना form save नहीं होता। दोनों भरें।

error.en: Invalid email
error.hi: Invalid email

reason.en: Email fields (main and in each extra address) must be a real email or left empty.
reason.hi: email वाले खाने (मुख्य और हर अतिरिक्त पते में) सही email हों या खाली छोड़ें।

error.en: "Error" toast after save or delete
error.hi: save या delete के बाद "Error" toast

reason.en: The server refused, often because the code already exists or the customer is used on orders. Change the code, or set Status to Inactive instead of deleting.
reason.hi: server ने मना किया, अक्सर code पहले से मौजूद होने या ग्राहक के orders में इस्तेमाल होने से। code बदलें, या delete के बजाय Status Inactive करें।

recoverySteps.en: If a new customer is missing in the order composer, refresh the composer page; the customer list is cached for about a minute.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर नया ग्राहक composer में नहीं दिख रहा, composer page refresh करें; ग्राहक list करीब एक मिनट cache रहती है।

recoverySteps.en: To undo half-typed changes in the form, press "Reset".
recoverySteps.hi: form में अधूरे बदलाव हटाने के लिए "Reset" दबाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: Delete asks for confirmation ("Protocol Purge Warning" → "Execute Purge"); press "Abort Operation" to back out.
recoverySteps.hi: delete से पहले पुष्टि माँगी जाती है ("Protocol Purge Warning" → "Execute Purge"); रुकने के लिए "Abort Operation" दबाएँ।

summary.en: Orders grouped by the job name typed when the order was placed, with ordered, dispatched and open kg and the on-time rate.
summary.hi: order डालते समय लिखे गए job name के हिसाब से orders का समूह, साथ में ordered, dispatched और open kg और समय पर पूरे होने का %।

purpose.en: Use it to answer "how much of the ABC May job is still open?" or to find all orders of one job. Click a job name to open the order list filtered by it.
purpose.hi: जब पूछना हो कि "ABC May job का कितना माल बाकी है?" या एक job के सारे orders ढूँढने हों, तब इसे खोलें। job name पर click करने से उसी नाम से छँटी order list खुलती है।

prerequisites.en: Orders placed with a "Job name" in the order composer. Orders without one are counted as unnamed.
prerequisites.hi: order composer में "Job name" के साथ डाले गए orders। बिना नाम वाले orders unnamed गिने जाते हैं।

keyActions.en: Read the tiles: "Job names", "Orders with a job name" (%), "Ordered", "Dispatched", "Open".
keyActions.hi: ऊपर के tiles देखें: "Job names", "Orders with a job name" (%), "Ordered", "Dispatched", "Open"।

keyActions.en: Type in "Search job name or customer" to narrow the table.
keyActions.hi: "Search job name or customer" में लिखकर table छोटी करें।

keyActions.en: Pick "Sort": Open kg, Ordered kg, Orders or Last ordered.
keyActions.hi: "Sort" चुनें: Open kg, Ordered kg, Orders या Last ordered।

keyActions.en: Click a job name to open Sales Orders filtered by that name.
keyActions.hi: job name पर click करें, उसी नाम से छँटे Sales Orders खुलेंगे।

keyActions.en: Press "New order" to start an order (type the job name there).
keyActions.hi: नया order शुरू करने के लिए "New order" दबाएँ (वहाँ job name लिखें)।

help.en: The name typed in the composer, with the number of lines under it.
help.hi: composer में लिखा नाम, नीचे lines की गिनती।

help.en: Orders with this name; "N open" counts those not completed or cancelled.
help.hi: इस नाम वाले orders; "N open" वे हैं जो completed या cancelled नहीं।

help.en: Customers who used this job name.
help.hi: जिन ग्राहकों के orders में यह नाम है।

help.en: Total kg (and pcs) ordered. Cancelled lines are left out.
help.hi: कुल ordered kg (और pcs)। cancelled lines नहीं गिनी जातीं।

help.en: Dispatched bar against ordered; Open kg = ordered minus dispatched.
help.hi: ordered के सामने dispatched की पट्टी; Open kg = ordered माइनस dispatched।

help.en: Share of completed orders finished on or before their promised date. "—" means none completed yet.
help.hi: पूरे हुए orders में से कितने % वादे की तारीख तक पूरे हुए। "—" मतलब अभी कोई पूरा नहीं।

help.en: Date of the newest order with this name.
help.hi: इस नाम के सबसे नए order की तारीख।

error.en: Could not load job names. Refresh to try again.
error.hi: Could not load job names. Refresh to try again.

reason.en: The report call failed (network or server). Refresh the page.
reason.hi: report लोड नहीं हुई (network या server)। page refresh करें।

error.en: No job names yet.
error.hi: No job names yet.

reason.en: No order has a job name. Type one in the composer's "Job name" box when placing orders.
reason.hi: किसी order में job name नहीं है। order डालते समय composer के "Job name" खाने में नाम लिखें।

recoverySteps.en: A job is missing: check the exact spelling used on the order; names are grouped as typed.
recoverySteps.hi: कोई job नहीं दिख रहा: order में लिखी सही spelling देखें; नाम जैसे लिखे गए वैसे ही समूह बनते हैं।

recoverySteps.en: Old orders that only had an automatic name like "Order 2026-05-01" are not shown as job names.
recoverySteps.hi: पुराने orders जिनमें सिर्फ अपने-आप बना नाम जैसे "Order 2026-05-01" था, job name में नहीं दिखते।

summary.en: Every open sales order by age and stage, with filters, saved views, CSV export and cancel before planner release.
summary.hi: हर खुला sales order उम्र और stage के हिसाब से; filter, saved view, CSV export और planner release से पहले cancel की सुविधा।

purpose.en: Start the day here: find orders waiting for planning, orders older than 5 days (shown in red) and what is ready or dispatched. Open an order to see its tracker, or start a new one.
purpose.hi: दिन की शुरुआत यहीं से करें: planning के इंतज़ार वाले orders, 5 दिन से पुराने orders (लाल रंग में) और क्या ready या dispatch हुआ, यह देखें। order खोलकर उसका tracker देखें या नया order बनाएँ।

prerequisites.en: Orders placed from the order composer or converted from a quotation.
prerequisites.hi: order composer से डाले गए या quotation से convert हुए orders।

keyActions.en: Read the tiles: "Open", "Awaiting planning", "Aged 6+ days", "Created today", "Value in flight", "Avg age".
keyActions.hi: tiles देखें: "Open", "Awaiting planning", "Aged 6+ days", "Created today", "Value in flight", "Avg age"।

keyActions.en: Search "Search SO #, customer, product master, variant…" or click a status pill (Planning, Planned, Released, Packing, Dispatch) or age pill (Fresh 0-2d, Watch 3-5d, Aged 6+d).
keyActions.hi: "Search SO #, customer, product master, variant…" में खोजें या status pill (Planning, Planned, Released, Packing, Dispatch) या उम्र pill (Fresh 0-2d, Watch 3-5d, Aged 6+d) दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Narrow further with "Any customer", "Any master" and "Advanced" (product type POUCH/ROLL/POD/PACKAGING, size, pouch style).
keyActions.hi: "Any customer", "Any master" और "Advanced" (product type POUCH/ROLL/POD/PACKAGING, size, pouch style) से और छाँटें।

keyActions.en: Switch the table tab: "Order queue", "History" or "Cancelled".
keyActions.hi: table का tab बदलें: "Order queue", "History" या "Cancelled"।

keyActions.en: Click a row or its open icon ("Open order tracker") to open the order.
keyActions.hi: order खोलने के लिए row या उसका open icon ("Open order tracker") दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: To keep a filter set, save it as a view (you are asked "Name this saved view"). Views are kept in this browser.
keyActions.hi: filter बचाने के लिए उसे view के रूप में save करें ("Name this saved view" पूछा जाएगा)। views इसी browser में रहते हैं।

keyActions.en: Tick rows and use "Export" for a CSV, or press "Export · N" for all visible rows.
keyActions.hi: rows पर tick करके "Export" से CSV लें, या सारी दिखती rows के लिए "Export · N" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: To cancel, press the cancel icon on a row, pick "Full order" or selected lines, choose a reason, add a note and confirm.
keyActions.hi: cancel करने के लिए row पर cancel icon दबाएँ, "Full order" या चुनी lines चुनें, कारण चुनें, note लिखें और पुष्टि करें।

keyActions.en: Press "New order" to open the order composer.
keyActions.hi: order composer खोलने के लिए "New order" दबाएँ।

help.en: Customer name and SO number; job name shows beside the number when set.
help.hi: ग्राहक का नाम और SO number; job name हो तो number के पास दिखता है।

help.en: Product master, size in mm, layer chips, print colours (F/B) and artwork thumbnail.
help.hi: product master, mm में size, layer chips, print रंग (F/B) और artwork का छोटा चित्र।

help.en: Order date and age in days. 6+ days is red.
help.hi: order की तारीख और दिनों में उम्र। 6+ दिन लाल।

help.en: Ordered qty with a bar of ready, dispatched, WIP and open kg per line ("Line-wise fulfillment").
help.hi: ordered qty और हर line के ready, dispatched, WIP और open kg की पट्टी ("Line-wise fulfillment")।

help.en: Planning = waiting for planner; Planned; Released = on the floor; Packing; Dispatch.
help.hi: Planning = planner के इंतज़ार में; Planned; Released = floor पर; Packing; Dispatch।

help.en: "All flow", "Ready" (finished goods waiting), "Dispatched".
help.hi: "All flow", "Ready" (तैयार माल रखा है), "Dispatched"।

help.en: Customer cancelled, Spec error, Credit hold, Duplicate, Other.
help.hi: Customer cancelled, Spec error, Credit hold, Duplicate, Other।

field.en: Showing the N newest of M open orders
field.hi: Showing the N newest of M open orders

help.en: Only the newest orders are loaded; search to reach older ones.
help.hi: सिर्फ नए orders लोड होते हैं; पुराने orders के लिए search करें।

error.en: Cancel icon missing on an order
error.hi: किसी order पर cancel icon नहीं है

reason.en: Sales can cancel only Draft, Confirmed, Planning or Planned orders. Once the planner has released lines, ask the planner to cancel or short-close them.
reason.hi: Sales सिर्फ Draft, Confirmed, Planning या Planned orders cancel कर सकता है। planner ने lines release कर दी हों तो planner से cancel या short-close करवाएँ।

error.en: Could not cancel order — Released orders must be changed from Planner, not Sales.
error.hi: Could not cancel order — Released orders must be changed from Planner, not Sales.

reason.en: A line was released while the dialog was open. Use the Planner.
reason.hi: dialog खुला रहते line release हो गई। Planner से करें।

error.en: Order already has released, executing, paused, or completed production jobs and cannot be cancelled from Sales.
error.hi: Order already has released, executing, paused, or completed production jobs and cannot be cancelled from Sales.

reason.en: Production has started on the order. Short-close the rest from the Planner.
reason.hi: order पर production शुरू हो चुका है। बाकी को Planner से short-close करें।

error.en: Reason is required to cancel sales order lines.
error.hi: Reason is required to cancel sales order lines.

reason.en: Pick a reason (and a note) before confirming.
reason.hi: पुष्टि से पहले कारण (और note) चुनें।

error.en: Select at least one sales order line to cancel.
error.hi: Select at least one sales order line to cancel.

reason.en: In line scope, tick at least one line.
reason.hi: line वाले विकल्प में कम से कम एक line पर tick करें।

recoverySteps.en: An order is not in the list: clear filters ("Reset"), check the "History" and "Cancelled" tabs, then search the SO number.
recoverySteps.hi: order list में नहीं: filters हटाएँ ("Reset"), "History" और "Cancelled" tab देखें, फिर SO number search करें।

recoverySteps.en: Saved views disappeared: they live only in this browser; save them again.
recoverySteps.hi: saved views गायब: वे सिर्फ इसी browser में रहते हैं; दोबारा save करें।

summary.en: One page per order: lines, live route progress, technical spec and BOM, documents, dispatch slips and a material audit with timeline.
summary.hi: हर order का एक page: lines, route पर चल रहा काम, technical spec और BOM, documents, dispatch slips और material audit व timeline।

purpose.en: Open it when a customer asks "where is my order?" or before promising a date. It shows how much is ready, dispatched, in WIP and still open, and where each line is on the floor.
purpose.hi: जब ग्राहक पूछे "मेरा order कहाँ है?" या तारीख बताने से पहले, यह page खोलें। इसमें दिखता है कितना ready है, कितना dispatch हुआ, कितना WIP में है और कितना बाकी, और हर line floor पर कहाँ है।

prerequisites.en: A placed sales order (from the composer or a converted quotation).
prerequisites.hi: डाला गया sales order (composer से या convert हुई quotation से)।

keyActions.en: Read the spine at the top: Master → Quote → Order → Plan → Floor → Yard → Dispatch. Each station shows its state and opens the matching page.
keyActions.hi: ऊपर की spine देखें: Master → Quote → Order → Plan → Floor → Yard → Dispatch। हर station अपनी स्थिति दिखाता है और उससे जुड़ा page खोलता है।

keyActions.en: Check the header: SO number, job name, status, "Placed" and "Due" dates, line chips and the "Fulfillment truth" % complete.
keyActions.hi: header देखें: SO number, job name, status, "Placed" और "Due" तारीख, line chips और "Fulfillment truth" में % complete।

keyActions.en: If the order is still Draft, press "Confirm commercial".
keyActions.hi: अगर order अभी Draft है तो "Confirm commercial" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Open "Commercial head" to see bill to, ship to, payment/delivery terms and the client note ("note prints on slip").
keyActions.hi: "Commercial head" खोलकर bill to, ship to, payment/delivery terms और client note ("note prints on slip") देखें।

keyActions.en: Tab "Line items + live route": per line ordered / ready / WIP / dispatched / open / scrap and each route step.
keyActions.hi: Tab "Line items + live route": हर line का ordered / ready / WIP / dispatched / open / scrap और हर route step।

keyActions.en: Tab "Technical + BOM": size, layers, print, packing and the frozen BOM rows of each line.
keyActions.hi: Tab "Technical + BOM": हर line का size, layers, print, packing और frozen BOM rows।

keyActions.en: Tab "Documents": "Dispatch ledger", "New dispatch", and "Slips in Dispatch Bay · reprint, proof of delivery".
keyActions.hi: Tab "Documents": "Dispatch ledger", "New dispatch" और "Slips in Dispatch Bay · reprint, proof of delivery"।

keyActions.en: Tab "Material audit + timeline": target, output, WIP, consumed, scrap, mass gap and every event.
keyActions.hi: Tab "Material audit + timeline": target, output, WIP, consumed, scrap, mass gap और हर घटना।

field.en: Ordered / Ready (FG) / Dispatched / WIP / Scrap / Open
field.hi: Ordered / Ready (FG) / Dispatched / WIP / Scrap / Open

help.en: Order totals in kg. Ready = made but not dispatched; WIP = active route work only; Open = target − ready − dispatched − WIP.
help.hi: order का कुल kg। Ready = बना पर dispatch नहीं; WIP = सिर्फ चल रहा route काम; Open = target − ready − dispatched − WIP।

help.en: (Ready + dispatched) ÷ ordered.
help.hi: (Ready + dispatched) ÷ ordered।

help.en: Order status, e.g. Planning, Released, Packing, Dispatch, Completed.
help.hi: order की स्थिति, जैसे Planning, Released, Packing, Dispatch, Completed।

help.en: Bill to, Ship to, Payment terms, Delivery terms, Client note.
help.hi: Bill to, Ship to, Payment terms, Delivery terms, Client note।

help.en: Width, height, gusset or roll web in mm (with inches), unit weight, pcs/kg, inner pack, pcs/pack, POD.
help.hi: width, height, gusset या roll web mm में (inch भी), unit weight, pcs/kg, inner pack, pcs/pack, POD।

help.en: Ordered target → Final output + Ready FG + Dispatched + Live WIP + Open gap.
help.hi: Ordered target → Final output + Ready FG + Dispatched + Live WIP + Open gap।

help.en: Tracking data reloads every minute.
help.hi: tracking हर मिनट अपने-आप ताज़ा होता है।

error.en: Sales order not found
error.hi: Sales order not found

reason.en: Wrong link or no access. Press "Go back" and open the order from the list.
reason.hi: गलत link या अनुमति नहीं। "Go back" दबाएँ और list से order खोलें।

error.en: Order cannot be confirmed from status …
error.hi: Order cannot be confirmed from status …

reason.en: "Confirm commercial" works only on Draft orders; the order has already moved on.
reason.hi: "Confirm commercial" सिर्फ Draft order पर चलता है; order आगे बढ़ चुका है।

error.en: No layer/BOM snapshot on this line.
error.hi: No layer/BOM snapshot on this line.

reason.en: The line was saved without a frozen BOM. Ask the planner to check the line before release.
reason.hi: line बिना frozen BOM के save हुई। release से पहले planner से line जाँचवाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: Numbers look old: wait for the refresh or reload the page.
recoverySteps.hi: आँकड़े पुराने लगें: refresh का इंतज़ार करें या page reload करें।

recoverySteps.en: To cancel or short-close a released line, go to the Planner; this page has no cancel button.
recoverySteps.hi: release हुई line cancel या short-close करनी हो तो Planner पर जाएँ; इस page पर cancel button नहीं है।

recoverySteps.en: To reprint a slip or record proof of delivery, use the Dispatch Bay link in "Documents".
recoverySteps.hi: slip दोबारा छापने या proof of delivery के लिए "Documents" में Dispatch Bay link इस्तेमाल करें।

summary.en: The list of customer dispatch records raised against one sales order, with confirm, cancel, QR sticker and line details.
summary.hi: एक sales order पर बने customer dispatch records की list, confirm, cancel, QR sticker और line details के साथ।

purpose.en: Use it to see what has been shipped on this order and to confirm draft dispatches. Each confirmed dispatch uses up open qty on the order lines; when every line is fully dispatched the order turns COMPLETED. Day-to-day slips are made in Dispatch Bay; an order shipped on Dispatch Bay slips completes only when proof of delivery (POD) is confirmed for every line.
purpose.hi: इस order पर क्या भेजा गया यह देखने और draft dispatch confirm करने के लिए। हर confirm हुआ dispatch order lines की open qty घटाता है; सारी lines पूरी dispatch होने पर order COMPLETED हो जाता है। रोज़ की slips Dispatch Bay में बनती हैं; Dispatch Bay की slips से गया order हर line का proof of delivery (POD) confirm होने पर ही COMPLETED होता है।

prerequisites.en: Lines must be packing-ready or dispatch-ready (released from the Packing Yard).
prerequisites.hi: lines packing-ready या dispatch-ready होनी चाहिए (Packing Yard से release)।

keyActions.en: Check the tiles "Total dispatches", "Confirmed / shipped", "Drafts in progress".
keyActions.hi: tiles देखें: "Total dispatches", "Confirmed / shipped", "Drafts in progress"।

keyActions.en: In "Dispatch ledger" press "Details" on a row to see plant, driver, invoice and each order line with quantity.
keyActions.hi: "Dispatch ledger" में row पर "Details" दबाकर plant, driver, invoice और हर order line की quantity देखें।

keyActions.en: For a DRAFT row press "Confirm" to book it, or "Cancel" to drop it.
keyActions.hi: DRAFT row पर बुक करने के लिए "Confirm" या हटाने के लिए "Cancel" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Print the gate QR sticker with the QR button (stick it on the Tally bill or slip; the gate scans it).
keyActions.hi: QR button से gate QR sticker छापें (Tally bill या slip पर चिपकाएँ; gate इसे scan करता है)।

keyActions.en: Press "New dispatch" to raise another one.
keyActions.hi: नया dispatch बनाने के लिए "New dispatch" दबाएँ।

help.en: DRAFT (saved, not booked), CONFIRMED (qty booked against lines), DISPATCHED, CANCELLED.
help.hi: DRAFT (save, बुक नहीं), CONFIRMED (lines पर qty बुक), DISPATCHED, CANCELLED।

help.en: Header facts typed when the dispatch was made.
help.hi: dispatch बनाते समय भरी जानकारी।

help.en: Inside "Details": how much of each line went in this dispatch.
help.hi: "Details" के अंदर: इस dispatch में हर line से कितना गया।

error.en: Cannot confirm a dispatch in status …
error.hi: Cannot confirm a dispatch in status …

reason.en: Only DRAFT can be confirmed.
reason.hi: सिर्फ DRAFT confirm हो सकता है।

error.en: Line exceeds dispatchable qty: requested X, dispatchable Y.
error.hi: Line exceeds dispatchable qty: requested X, dispatchable Y.

reason.en: Another dispatch already used the qty. Cancel this draft and make a new one with the smaller qty.
reason.hi: किसी और dispatch ने qty ले ली। यह draft cancel करें और कम qty के साथ नया बनाएँ।

error.en: Line is not ready for dispatch / Line has no completed final output ready to dispatch
error.hi: Line is not ready for dispatch / Line has no completed final output ready to dispatch

reason.en: Goods are not released from the yard yet, or a partial line has no finished output. Resolve in Planner / Packing Yard first.
reason.hi: माल अभी yard से release नहीं हुआ, या partial line का तैयार माल नहीं है। पहले Planner / Packing Yard में सुलझाएँ।

error.en: Cannot cancel a dispatch in status DISPATCHED
error.hi: Cannot cancel a dispatch in status DISPATCHED

reason.en: A dispatched record cannot be cancelled.
reason.hi: dispatched record cancel नहीं हो सकता।

recoverySteps.en: Empty ledger ("No dispatches yet."): slips made in Dispatch Bay are listed there, not always here; open Dispatch Bay history for this SO.
recoverySteps.hi: ledger खाली ("No dispatches yet."): Dispatch Bay में बनी slips वहीं दिखती हैं, हमेशा यहाँ नहीं; इस SO के लिए Dispatch Bay history खोलें।

recoverySteps.en: Press "Back to order" to return to the tracker.
recoverySteps.hi: tracker पर लौटने के लिए "Back to order" दबाएँ।

summary.en: Form to raise a customer dispatch record for one sales order: header (date, vehicle, driver, LR, invoice, notes) and quantity per line.
summary.hi: एक sales order के लिए customer dispatch record बनाने का form: header (तारीख, गाड़ी, driver, LR, invoice, notes) और हर line की quantity।

purpose.en: Use it when goods of this order leave and you need a dispatch record against the order lines. Each row pre-fills only the qty dispatchable now; for partial final output the unproduced balance stays with the Planner.
purpose.hi: जब इस order का माल जाए और order lines पर dispatch record चाहिए, तब इस्तेमाल करें। हर row में सिर्फ अभी भेजी जा सकने वाली qty पहले से भरी होती है; partial output में बाकी बचा planner के पास रहता है।

prerequisites.en: At least one line packing-ready / dispatch-ready, or a partial line with finished output.
prerequisites.hi: कम से कम एक line packing-ready / dispatch-ready हो, या partial line का तैयार माल हो।

keyActions.en: Check "Dispatch date" (today by default).
keyActions.hi: "Dispatch date" देखें (default आज)।

keyActions.en: Fill "Vehicle no", "Driver", "LR no", "Customer invoice" and "Notes" (optional but recommended).
keyActions.hi: "Vehicle no", "Driver", "LR no", "Customer invoice" और "Notes" भरें (ज़रूरी नहीं पर अच्छा है)।

keyActions.en: In "Lines", check "Dispatch now" for each line; lower it for a part load. Lines not ready are locked.
keyActions.hi: "Lines" में हर line का "Dispatch now" देखें; आंशिक माल हो तो कम करें। जो lines ready नहीं वे बंद रहती हैं।

keyActions.en: Watch "Total qty" at the top.
keyActions.hi: ऊपर "Total qty" देखें।

keyActions.en: Press "Save draft" to keep it as DRAFT, or "Save & confirm" to book it now.
keyActions.hi: DRAFT रखने के लिए "Save draft", या अभी बुक करने के लिए "Save & confirm" दबाएँ।

help.en: Line qty, qty already dispatched, and what is left.
help.hi: line की qty, पहले भेजी गई qty, और बाकी।

help.en: What may go now (finished and released). Dispatch now cannot be more.
help.hi: अभी कितना जा सकता है (तैयार और release)। Dispatch now इससे ज़्यादा नहीं हो सकता।

field.en: Final output: dispatch X now · planner replan Y
field.hi: Final output: dispatch X now · planner replan Y

help.en: Partial line: X can ship, Y stays for the planner to re-release or short-close.
help.hi: partial line: X जा सकता है, Y planner के पास दोबारा release या short-close के लिए रहता है।

help.en: Line unit, KG or PCS.
help.hi: line की unit, KG या PCS।

error.en: Enter qty against at least one line.
error.hi: Enter qty against at least one line.

reason.en: All "Dispatch now" boxes are zero. Enter qty on a ready line.
reason.hi: सारे "Dispatch now" खाने शून्य हैं। ready line पर qty भरें।

error.en: … is not ready for dispatch. Resolve it in Planner first.
error.hi: … is not ready for dispatch. Resolve it in Planner first.

reason.en: The line is not released from packing. Release it in the Packing Yard first.
reason.hi: line packing से release नहीं हुई। पहले Packing Yard में release करें।

error.en: … exceeds dispatchable quantity N.
error.hi: … exceeds dispatchable quantity N.

reason.en: Lower the qty to the dispatchable figure.
reason.hi: qty को dispatchable तक कम करें।

error.en: … has no completed final output ready to dispatch. Re-release or short-close it in Planner.
error.hi: … has no completed final output ready to dispatch. Re-release or short-close it in Planner.

reason.en: Partial line with nothing finished; the planner must act.
reason.hi: partial line जिसमें कुछ तैयार नहीं; planner को कदम उठाना होगा।

error.en: Dispatch quantity must be greater than zero.
error.hi: Dispatch quantity must be greater than zero.

reason.en: Remove the zero or negative qty.
reason.hi: शून्य या ऋण qty हटाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: All inputs locked: no line is ready yet; check the order tracker's spine (Yard station).
recoverySteps.hi: सारे खाने बंद: अभी कोई line ready नहीं; order tracker की spine (Yard station) देखें।

recoverySteps.en: Draft saved by mistake: open the ledger and press "Cancel" on it.
recoverySteps.hi: गलती से draft save हुआ: ledger खोलें और उस पर "Cancel" दबाएँ।

summary.en: This is an old or short address. It opens /sales/orders/[id] straight away.
summary.hi: यह पुराना या छोटा पता है। यह सीधे /sales/orders/[id] खोल देता है।

purpose.en: Tracking used to be a separate page. It is now part of the single order tracker, so this address shows "Opening unified order tracker..." and moves to the order page.
purpose.hi: पहले tracking अलग page था। अब यह एक ही order tracker में है, इसलिए यह पता "Opening unified order tracker..." दिखाकर order page पर ले जाता है।

prerequisites.en: Your role must be allowed to open the target page.
prerequisites.hi: आपके role को आगे वाला page खोलने की अनुमति होनी चाहिए।

keyActions.en: Open the link or bookmark. The browser moves to /sales/orders/[id] by itself.
keyActions.hi: link या bookmark खोलें। browser अपने-आप /sales/orders/[id] पर चला जाता है।

keyActions.en: Update your bookmark to /sales/orders/[id] so the extra hop is skipped.
keyActions.hi: अपना bookmark /sales/orders/[id] पर बदल लें, ताकि बीच का कदम न लगे।

error.en: Page keeps loading or shows "not found"
error.hi: page लोड होता रहता है या "not found" दिखता है

reason.en: The order id in the link is wrong or the order was removed. Open the Orders list and search the SO number.
reason.hi: link में order id गलत है या order हटाया गया है। Orders list खोलकर SO number से search करें।

recoverySteps.en: Open "Orders" from the Sales menu and find the order there.
recoverySteps.hi: Sales menu से "Orders" खोलें और वहाँ order ढूँढें।

summary.en: The sales order composer: pick the customer, set order facts, add lines from the Product Master (size, layers, print, packing, qty, rate) and place the order to the planner.
summary.hi: sales order composer: ग्राहक चुनें, order की जानकारी भरें, Product Master से lines जोड़ें (size, layers, print, packing, qty, rate) और order planner को भेजें।

purpose.en: Open it whenever a customer gives an order. When placed, the order goes to the planning queue; the planner picks the plant and releases each line. Drafts autosave in this browser.
purpose.hi: जब भी ग्राहक order दे, यह page खोलें। order डालते ही वह planning queue में जाता है; planner plant चुनता है और हर line release करता है। draft इसी browser में अपने-आप save होता है।

prerequisites.en: Customer exists in Customers (active).
prerequisites.hi: ग्राहक Customers में मौजूद हो (active)।

prerequisites.en: An order-ready Product Master with saved sizes; for printed items an approved artwork (or choose "Defer to planner").
prerequisites.hi: order के लिए तैयार Product Master, saved sizes के साथ; printed item के लिए approved artwork (या "Defer to planner" चुनें)।

prerequisites.en: Permission to create orders (page.sales.order_create).
prerequisites.hi: order बनाने की अनुमति (page.sales.order_create)।

keyActions.en: Answer "Who is this order for?": type 2 letters, use ↑/↓ and Enter, click a "Recent" customer, or pick from the full list. If offered, choose "Resume draft" or "Start fresh".
keyActions.hi: "Who is this order for?" का जवाब दें: 2 अक्षर लिखें, ↑/↓ और Enter से चुनें, "Recent" ग्राहक दबाएँ, या पूरी list से चुनें। पुराना draft दिखे तो "Resume draft" या "Start fresh" चुनें।

keyActions.en: In the order facts row set "Ship to", "Promised dispatch", "Job name" (optional), "Ship address" and "Note for dispatch". "Plant" stays "Auto · planner".
keyActions.hi: order facts वाली row में "Ship to", "Promised dispatch", "Job name" (ज़रूरी नहीं), "Ship address" और "Note for dispatch" भरें। "Plant" "Auto · planner" ही रहता है।

keyActions.en: Add lines in the quick-add row: product (⌘K) → size → qty → unit → rate → Enter. Or press "Editor" / Shift+Enter, or "Add line" (Alt N) for the full editor. "Quick Start" cards repeat the last order or saved items.
keyActions.hi: quick-add row में line जोड़ें: product (⌘K) → size → qty → unit → rate → Enter। पूरा editor चाहिए तो "Editor" / Shift+Enter, या "Add line" (Alt N) दबाएँ। "Quick Start" cards से पिछला order या saved items दोहराएँ।

keyActions.en: Open a line (Enter on the row) and work through the steps: Product, Size, Layers, "Qty & rate", "Print & artwork", "Packing", "Add-ons", "More options". Press "Done with this line" or "Save & add another".
keyActions.hi: line खोलें (row पर Enter) और steps भरें: Product, Size, Layers, "Qty & rate", "Print & artwork", "Packing", "Add-ons", "More options"। फिर "Done with this line" या "Save & add another" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Check each row's status ("Ready" or the first missing thing, e.g. "Needs rate", "Needs artwork", "Check the line").
keyActions.hi: हर row का status देखें ("Ready" या पहली कमी, जैसे "Needs rate", "Needs artwork", "Check the line")।

keyActions.en: Open "Before you place" and press "Fix →" on each item until it says "all clear".
keyActions.hi: "Before you place" खोलें और हर कमी पर "Fix →" दबाएँ, जब तक "all clear" न दिखे।

keyActions.en: Press "Place order" (⌘↵). The button works only when every line is ready.
keyActions.hi: "Place order" (⌘↵) दबाएँ। सारी lines तैयार होने पर ही button चालू होता है।

keyActions.en: On "Sales order sent to planner" use "Open order", "Open in planner", "New order for …" or "New order".
keyActions.hi: "Sales order sent to planner" दिखने पर "Open order", "Open in planner", "New order for …" या "New order" चुनें।

help.en: Bill-to customer. Click it to change. The line under it shows code, GST, credit days and "price basis kg by default".
help.hi: bill-to ग्राहक। बदलने के लिए click करें। नीचे code, GST, credit days और "price basis kg by default" दिखता है।

help.en: "Same as customer" or another customer receiving the goods.
help.hi: "Same as customer" या माल लेने वाला कोई दूसरा ग्राहक।

help.en: Date promised to the customer, shown with "in N days". Defaults to 7 days ahead. Required.
help.hi: ग्राहक को बताई तारीख, "in N days" के साथ। default 7 दिन बाद। ज़रूरी।

help.en: "Auto · planner" — picked when the order is planned.
help.hi: "Auto · planner" — planning के समय चुना जाता है।

help.en: Optional name like "ABC May order"; shows beside the SO number everywhere and groups orders on Job names.
help.hi: ज़रूरी नहीं, जैसे "ABC May order"; हर जगह SO number के पास दिखता है और Job names page पर orders को समूह में रखता है।

help.en: Blank means the saved address (shown as "Saved · …"). Type to override for this order only.
help.hi: खाली = saved पता ("Saved · …" दिखता है)। सिर्फ इस order के लिए बदलना हो तो लिखें।

help.en: Client note, e.g. delivery time; shown on the order page and printed on the dispatch slip.
help.hi: ग्राहक की बात, जैसे delivery का समय; order page पर दिखती है और dispatch slip पर छपती है।

help.en: Product · line label, Size (mm with inches), Layers · gauge, Print (Roto/Flexo, colours, "artwork later" or "Plain"), Qty, Rate, Value, Status. Totals row: lines, kg + pcs, ₹.
help.hi: Product · line label, Size (mm और inch), Layers · gauge, Print (Roto/Flexo, रंग, "artwork later" या "Plain"), Qty, Rate, Value, Status। totals row: lines, kg + pcs, ₹।

help.en: Enter opens, D duplicates, Alt ↑/↓ moves, Delete removes (Undo in the toast).
help.hi: Enter खोलता है, D duplicate, Alt ↑/↓ ऊपर-नीचे, Delete हटाता है (toast में Undo)।

help.en: Pouch products start in pcs, others in kg. The rate is per that unit.
help.hi: pouch product pcs में, बाकी kg में शुरू होते हैं। rate उसी unit के हिसाब से।

help.en: A printed or pouch product added from quick-add must be opened once to confirm print and packing.
help.hi: quick-add से जोड़ा printed या pouch product एक बार खोलकर print और packing पक्का करना होता है।

help.en: Roto or Flexo, film form, and artwork mode: "Pick approved artwork", "Use customer overlay" or "Defer to planner" (planner must assign before print release; cylinders checked only for ROTO).
help.hi: Roto या Flexo, film form, और artwork तरीका: "Pick approved artwork", "Use customer overlay" या "Defer to planner" (print release से पहले planner को artwork देना होगा; cylinder सिर्फ ROTO पर जाँचा जाता है)।

help.en: Inner pouch, "Pieces per inner pouch" (override) and "Packing note". Inner pouches are never ticked at packing: in-house ones come off stock at the machine's last pouching step, bought ones by the evening packing count.
help.hi: inner pouch, "Pieces per inner pouch" (बदलाव) और "Packing note"। Inner pouch packing पर tick नहीं होते: घर के inner pouch मशीन के आखिरी pouching step पर stock से घटते हैं, खरीदे हुए शाम की packing गिनती से।

help.en: Lane, add-ons and wastage: production lane (n-up), trim, wastage / issue policy with a reason.
help.hi: lane, add-ons और wastage: production lane (n-up), trim, wastage / issue policy कारण के साथ।

help.en: The draft autosaves in this browser while you type. Placing the order clears it.
help.hi: लिखते समय draft इसी browser में save होता है। order डालने पर हट जाता है।

field.en: Make for stock / Save as quotation
field.hi: Make for stock / Save as quotation

help.en: Side exits: open the planner's stock launcher, or a new quotation for this customer.
help.hi: दूसरे रास्ते: planner का stock launcher, या इस ग्राहक के लिए नई quotation।

error.en: Packing: set pieces per inner pouch (this inner pouch has no default).
error.hi: Packing: set pieces per inner pouch (this inner pouch has no default).

reason.en: A pouch line has an inner pouch but nobody said how many pouches go in one. Open the line → Packing → "Pieces per inner pouch" and type it, or set a default on the inner pouch in Masters → Packaging. Then the last machine step can count the inner pouches it fills.
reason.hi: पाउच लाइन में inner pouch है पर एक inner pouch में कितने पाउच जाते हैं यह नहीं लिखा। लाइन खोलें → Packing → "Pieces per inner pouch" भरें, या Masters → Packaging में उस inner pouch का default भरें। तब आखिरी मशीन स्टेप भरे गए inner pouch गिन सकेगा।

error.en: Line N: set unit price
error.hi: Line N: set unit price

reason.en: Rate is zero. Enter the rate in the row or in "Qty & rate".
reason.hi: rate शून्य है। row में या "Qty & rate" में rate भरें।

error.en: Line N: pick a size / pick a product master / quantity must be > 0
error.hi: Line N: pick a size / pick a product master / quantity must be > 0

reason.en: Open the line with "Fix →" and fill the missing box.
reason.hi: "Fix →" से line खोलें और खाली खाना भरें।

error.en: Line N: Open the line to confirm print and packing
error.hi: Line N: Open the line to confirm print and packing

reason.en: Added through quick-add. Open the line once, check print and packing, press "Done with this line".
reason.hi: quick-add से जुड़ी। line एक बार खोलें, print और packing देखें, "Done with this line" दबाएँ।

error.en: Artwork: pick an approved artwork.
error.hi: Artwork: pick an approved artwork.

reason.en: Printed line without artwork. Choose one, or select "Defer to planner".
reason.hi: printed line बिना artwork। artwork चुनें, या "Defer to planner" चुनें।

error.en: Artwork: selected artwork does not match the selected print method or SHEET/TUBING form.
error.hi: Artwork: selected artwork does not match the selected print method or SHEET/TUBING form.

reason.en: Change Roto/Flexo or film form to match, or pick another artwork.
reason.hi: Roto/Flexo या film form मिलाएँ, या दूसरा artwork चुनें।

error.en: Packing: pcs per inner pouch must be greater than zero.
error.hi: Packing: pcs per inner pouch must be greater than zero.

reason.en: Fix or clear the override.
reason.hi: override ठीक करें या खाली करें।

error.en: Set a promised dispatch date / Pick a customer / Cart is empty — add at least one line
error.hi: Set a promised dispatch date / Pick a customer / Cart is empty — add at least one line

reason.en: Fill the order facts or add a line.
reason.hi: order की जानकारी भरें या line जोड़ें।

error.en: Product master unavailable
error.hi: Product master unavailable

reason.en: A link pointed to a master that is not order-ready (inactive or old revision). Pick a current one.
reason.hi: link ऐसे master का था जो order के लिए तैयार नहीं (inactive या पुराना revision)। नया वाला चुनें।

error.en: Could not create order — product_master is invalid, inactive, or not the current revision.
error.hi: Could not create order — product_master is invalid, inactive, or not the current revision.

reason.en: The master changed after you added the line. Remove the line and add it again.
reason.hi: line जोड़ने के बाद master बदला। line हटाकर दोबारा जोड़ें।

error.en: Could not create order — Item …: approved artwork is required when printing is enabled.
error.hi: Could not create order — Item …: approved artwork is required when printing is enabled.

reason.en: Server check: assign approved artwork or defer to planner.
reason.hi: server की जाँच: approved artwork दें या planner पर छोड़ें।

recoverySteps.en: Lost work after closing the tab: reopen New order and press "Resume draft" (same browser only).
recoverySteps.hi: tab बंद होने से काम खोया: New order फिर खोलें और "Resume draft" दबाएँ (सिर्फ उसी browser में)।

recoverySteps.en: "Place order" stays grey: click the warning pill in the place bar to see what is left.
recoverySteps.hi: "Place order" grey रहे: place bar में चेतावनी pill दबाकर बाकी कमी देखें।

recoverySteps.en: Wrong line removed: press "Undo" in the toast right away.
recoverySteps.hi: गलत line हट गई: toast में तुरंत "Undo" दबाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: Customer not in the list: add it in Customers, then refresh this page.
recoverySteps.hi: ग्राहक list में नहीं: Customers में जोड़ें, फिर यह page refresh करें।

summary.en: This is an old or short address. It opens /sales/orders/create straight away.
summary.hi: यह पुराना या छोटा पता है। यह सीधे /sales/orders/create खोल देता है।

purpose.en: Old links to /sales/orders/new open the order composer. Any extra settings in the link (such as customer or product master) are carried over.
purpose.hi: /sales/orders/new वाले पुराने links order composer खोलते हैं। link में दी जानकारी (जैसे customer या product master) साथ चली जाती है।

prerequisites.en: Your role must be allowed to open the target page.
prerequisites.hi: आपके role को आगे वाला page खोलने की अनुमति होनी चाहिए।

keyActions.en: Open the link or bookmark. The browser moves to /sales/orders/create by itself.
keyActions.hi: link या bookmark खोलें। browser अपने-आप /sales/orders/create पर चला जाता है।

keyActions.en: Update your bookmark to /sales/orders/create so the extra hop is skipped.
keyActions.hi: अपना bookmark /sales/orders/create पर बदल लें, ताकि बीच का कदम न लगे।

error.en: Page keeps loading or shows "not found"
error.hi: page लोड होता रहता है या "not found" दिखता है

reason.en: The order id in the link is wrong or the order was removed. Open the Orders list and search the SO number.
reason.hi: link में order id गलत है या order हटाया गया है। Orders list खोलकर SO number से search करें।

recoverySteps.en: Open "Orders" from the Sales menu and find the order there.
recoverySteps.hi: Sales menu से "Orders" खोलें और वहाँ order ढूँढें।

summary.en: List of all quotations with status, date and search filters, bulk duplicate and bulk expire, and PDF preview.
summary.hi: सभी quotations की list: status, तारीख और search filter, एक साथ duplicate या expire, और PDF preview।

purpose.en: Open it to follow up quotes: which are waiting approval, sent, accepted or expired. Open a quote to work on it, or start a new one. An accepted quote is converted to a sales order from its page.
purpose.hi: quotes की follow-up के लिए खोलें: कौन approval में है, भेजी गई, accept हुई या expire। quote खोलकर उस पर काम करें, या नई बनाएँ। accept हुई quote उसके page से sales order में convert होती है।

prerequisites.en: Permission sales.manage.
prerequisites.hi: sales.manage की अनुमति।

keyActions.en: Search "Search by QT number or customer…".
keyActions.hi: "Search by QT number or customer…" में खोजें।

keyActions.en: Filter by status pill (Draft, Pending approval, Sent, Approved, Accepted, Rejected, Expired, Cancelled, Void, Converted) and "Date" (All time, This month, Last month).
keyActions.hi: status pill (Draft, Pending approval, Sent, Approved, Accepted, Rejected, Expired, Cancelled, Void, Converted) और "Date" (All time, This month, Last month) से छाँटें।

keyActions.en: Click a row to open the quotation; the eye icon ("Preview PDF") opens the PDF.
keyActions.hi: quotation खोलने के लिए row दबाएँ; eye icon ("Preview PDF") PDF खोलता है।

keyActions.en: Tick rows and press "Duplicate" or "Mark expired"; "Clear" removes the selection.
keyActions.hi: rows पर tick करके "Duplicate" या "Mark expired" दबाएँ; "Clear" selection हटाता है।

keyActions.en: Press "New Quotation" to start one.
keyActions.hi: नई quote के लिए "New Quotation" दबाएँ।

help.en: Draft → Pending approval → Approved → Sent → Accepted/Rejected/Expired → Converted. Cancelled and Void are closed.
help.hi: Draft → Pending approval → Approved → Sent → Accepted/Rejected/Expired → Converted। Cancelled और Void बंद हैं।

help.en: Quote validity date and last change.
help.hi: quote की वैधता तारीख और आखिरी बदलाव।

help.en: Grand total of the quote in ₹.
help.hi: quote का कुल ₹।

error.en: Duplicate failed / Bulk expire failed
error.hi: Duplicate failed / Bulk expire failed

reason.en: The server refused for one of the selected quotes (for example already converted). Retry with fewer rows.
reason.hi: चुनी quotes में से किसी पर server ने मना किया (जैसे पहले से converted)। कम rows के साथ फिर करें।

error.en: No quotations match these filters.
error.hi: No quotations match these filters.

reason.en: Press "Clear filters".
reason.hi: "Clear filters" दबाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: List failed to load: press "Retry".
recoverySteps.hi: list लोड नहीं हुई: "Retry" दबाएँ।

summary.en: One quotation: client context, quote lines, Cost Build, commercials, approval, sending, customer outcome and conversion to a sales order.
summary.hi: एक quotation: ग्राहक की जानकारी, quote lines, Cost Build, commercials, approval, भेजना, ग्राहक का जवाब और sales order में convert।

purpose.en: Use it to price an enquiry, get it approved, send the frozen PDF and, once the customer accepts, convert it into a sales order for planning.
purpose.hi: enquiry का भाव बनाने, approve करवाने, frozen PDF भेजने और ग्राहक के accept करने पर planning के लिए sales order बनाने में इस्तेमाल करें।

prerequisites.en: Customer in Customers; current Base Product Master (and LIVE template) for each line; an approver who is not the submitter.
prerequisites.hi: ग्राहक Customers में; हर line के लिए current Base Product Master (और LIVE template); submit करने वाले से अलग approver।

keyActions.en: Fill "Client and enquiry context" (contact, email, validity, terms, addresses).
keyActions.hi: "Client and enquiry context" भरें (contact, email, validity, terms, पते)।

keyActions.en: Add lines with "Catalog line" (ready product/size) or "Ad-hoc pouch" (quote-only build from a Base Product Master); press "Save line".
keyActions.hi: "Catalog line" (तैयार product/size) या "Ad-hoc pouch" (Base Product Master से सिर्फ इस quote की बनावट) से lines जोड़ें; "Save line" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Open Cost Build, check sources and conversion cost, press "Save Cost Build".
keyActions.hi: Cost Build खोलें, sources और conversion cost देखें, "Save Cost Build" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Set commercials and terms, then press "Save draft".
keyActions.hi: commercials और शर्तें भरें, फिर "Save draft" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Press "Submit for approval" — the revision and Cost Build freeze.
keyActions.hi: "Submit for approval" दबाएँ — revision और Cost Build freeze हो जाते हैं।

keyActions.en: An approver (not the submitter) presses "Approve …" for each pending gate, or rejects with a reason.
keyActions.hi: approver (submit करने वाला नहीं) हर pending gate पर "Approve …" दबाता है, या कारण के साथ reject करता है।

keyActions.en: When Approved, press "Send frozen revision" → "Send to customer" (needs contact email). Preview, download, print or share the PDF from the header icons.
keyActions.hi: Approved होने पर "Send frozen revision" → "Send to customer" दबाएँ (contact email चाहिए)। header icons से PDF देखें, download, print या share करें।

keyActions.en: After the customer replies press "Record acceptance" (PO / email reference) or "Record rejection" (reason), or "Mark expired".
keyActions.hi: ग्राहक के जवाब के बाद "Record acceptance" (PO / email reference) या "Record rejection" (कारण), या "Mark expired" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: On an Accepted quote press "Convert to Sales Order" → "Convert". The quote becomes CONVERTED and a new SO goes to planning.
keyActions.hi: Accepted quote पर "Convert to Sales Order" → "Convert" दबाएँ। quote CONVERTED हो जाती है और नया SO planning में जाता है।

field.en: Customer / Plant / Currency / Status / Valid until
field.hi: Customer / Plant / Currency / Status / Valid until

help.en: Quote header facts shown in the top strip.
help.hi: ऊपर की पट्टी में quote की मुख्य जानकारी।

help.en: Enquiry / RFQ reference, Contact name*, Contact email*, Contact phone, Valid until*, Requested delivery, Place of supply, Payment terms*, Delivery terms*, Bill-to address*, Ship-to address*. Editable only in Draft ("Frozen revision" after).
help.hi: Enquiry / RFQ reference, Contact name*, Contact email*, Contact phone, Valid until*, Requested delivery, Place of supply, Payment terms*, Delivery terms*, Bill-to address*, Ship-to address*। सिर्फ Draft में बदल सकते हैं (उसके बाद "Frozen revision")।

help.en: "Catalog line" = a ready product/size; "Ad-hoc pouch" = a quote-only configuration built on a Base Product Master. Each line shows Pouch GSM, Weight / pc, Rate ₹/kg, Line total.
help.hi: "Catalog line" = तैयार product/size; "Ad-hoc pouch" = Base Product Master पर बनी सिर्फ इस quote की configuration। हर line में Pouch GSM, Weight / pc, Rate ₹/kg, Line total दिखता है।

help.en: Quote-level costing: raw materials (master/FIFO baseline vs quote assumption), Conversion Cost, pricing method; shows Target price, RM cost, Total cost, Contribution, Markup, Gross margin. Press "Save Cost Build".
help.hi: quote स्तर की costing: raw material (master/FIFO baseline बनाम quote अनुमान), Conversion Cost, pricing method; Target price, RM cost, Total cost, Contribution, Markup, Gross margin दिखाता है। "Save Cost Build" दबाएँ।

help.en: Freight included toggle, other charges (tooling, samples, dies), Subtotal, Discount, Taxable, GST %, Grand total, "Terms preset" and custom terms.
help.hi: freight शामिल toggle, अन्य charges (tooling, samples, dies), Subtotal, Discount, Taxable, GST %, Grand total, "Terms preset" और अपनी शर्तें।

help.en: Credit limit, credit days, last order. Outstanding shows "AR not yet wired".
help.hi: Credit limit, credit days, last order। Outstanding में "AR not yet wired" दिखता है।

help.en: Created, Sent, Approved, outcome and "Converted → SO…".
help.hi: Created, Sent, Approved, नतीजा और "Converted → SO…"।

error.en: Submission blocked — At least one quote line is required.
error.hi: Submission blocked — At least one quote line is required.

reason.en: Add a line and save before "Submit for approval".
reason.hi: "Submit for approval" से पहले line जोड़कर save करें।

error.en: Every line needs qty > 0 and rate > 0.
error.hi: Every line needs qty > 0 and rate > 0.

reason.en: Fix quantity and rate on each line.
reason.hi: हर line की quantity और rate ठीक करें।

error.en: The quotation submitter cannot approve the same revision.
error.hi: The quotation submitter cannot approve the same revision.

reason.en: Another authorised user must approve.
reason.hi: किसी दूसरे अधिकृत user को approve करना होगा।

error.en: Override entry and approval must be performed by different users.
error.hi: Override entry and approval must be performed by different users.

reason.en: Cost overrides need a second person to approve.
reason.hi: cost override के लिए दूसरा व्यक्ति approve करे।

error.en: Only an unfrozen draft quotation revision can be edited.
error.hi: Only an unfrozen draft quotation revision can be edited.

reason.en: After submit the revision is frozen. Use "Duplicate quotation" to make a new draft.
reason.hi: submit के बाद revision freeze हो जाता है। नया draft बनाने के लिए "Duplicate quotation" दबाएँ।

error.en: Customer acceptance reference is required. / Customer rejection reason is required.
error.hi: Customer acceptance reference is required. / Customer rejection reason is required.

reason.en: Type the PO / email reference or the reason before "Record outcome".
reason.hi: "Record outcome" से पहले PO / email reference या कारण लिखें।

error.en: Only an accepted customer quotation revision can be converted.
error.hi: Only an accepted customer quotation revision can be converted.

reason.en: Record acceptance first; "Convert to Sales Order" shows only for Accepted.
reason.hi: पहले acceptance दर्ज करें; "Convert to Sales Order" सिर्फ Accepted पर दिखता है।

error.en: The exact approved cost build must be frozen before conversion.
error.hi: The exact approved cost build must be frozen before conversion.

reason.en: Save and approve the Cost Build before converting.
reason.hi: convert से पहले Cost Build save और approve करें।

error.en: Approval request expired; clone a fresh revision.
error.hi: Approval request expired; clone a fresh revision.

reason.en: Use "Duplicate quotation" and submit again.
reason.hi: "Duplicate quotation" से नई बनाकर फिर submit करें।

error.en: A converted quotation cannot be cancelled or voided; use the Sales Order cancellation flow.
error.hi: A converted quotation cannot be cancelled or voided; use the Sales Order cancellation flow.

reason.en: Cancel the sales order from Sales Orders instead.
reason.hi: इसके बजाय Sales Orders से order cancel करें।

recoverySteps.en: Unsure what is next: read the status card (e.g. "Draft ready — Complete Cost Build and submit this revision for approval.").
recoverySteps.hi: आगे क्या करना है पता न हो: status card पढ़ें (जैसे "Draft ready — Complete Cost Build and submit this revision for approval.")।

recoverySteps.en: Need to change a frozen quote: "Duplicate quotation" makes a new draft revision.
recoverySteps.hi: freeze quote बदलनी हो: "Duplicate quotation" नया draft बनाता है।

recoverySteps.en: Unsaved changes banner: press "Save draft" before leaving.
recoverySteps.hi: "Unsaved changes" दिखे: जाने से पहले "Save draft" दबाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: "Quotation not found.": press "Back to list".
recoverySteps.hi: "Quotation not found.": "Back to list" दबाएँ।

summary.en: Start a quotation: pick the customer, then the full quotation workspace opens.
summary.hi: quotation शुरू करें: ग्राहक चुनें, फिर पूरा quotation workspace खुलता है।

purpose.en: Open it when a customer asks for a price. It is also reached from the order composer ("Save as quotation" or the QT switch), which passes the customer along.
purpose.hi: जब ग्राहक भाव माँगे तब खोलें। order composer के "Save as quotation" या QT switch से भी यहाँ आते हैं, ग्राहक साथ आता है।

prerequisites.en: Customer exists in Customers.
prerequisites.hi: ग्राहक Customers में हो।

keyActions.en: Under "Start a new quotation", search "Search customer by name or code…" or pick from "Or pick from recent customers".
keyActions.hi: "Start a new quotation" में "Search customer by name or code…" से खोजें या "Or pick from recent customers" से चुनें।

keyActions.en: Press "Start quotation".
keyActions.hi: "Start quotation" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Fill "Client and enquiry context" (contact, email, validity, terms, addresses).
keyActions.hi: "Client and enquiry context" भरें (contact, email, validity, terms, पते)।

keyActions.en: Add lines with "Catalog line" (ready product/size) or "Ad-hoc pouch" (quote-only build from a Base Product Master); press "Save line".
keyActions.hi: "Catalog line" (तैयार product/size) या "Ad-hoc pouch" (Base Product Master से सिर्फ इस quote की बनावट) से lines जोड़ें; "Save line" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Open Cost Build, check sources and conversion cost, press "Save Cost Build".
keyActions.hi: Cost Build खोलें, sources और conversion cost देखें, "Save Cost Build" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Set commercials and terms, then press "Save draft".
keyActions.hi: commercials और शर्तें भरें, फिर "Save draft" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Press "Submit for approval" — the revision and Cost Build freeze.
keyActions.hi: "Submit for approval" दबाएँ — revision और Cost Build freeze हो जाते हैं।

help.en: Required to begin; their pricing rules and credit profile load.
help.hi: शुरू करने के लिए ज़रूरी; उनके भाव नियम और credit जानकारी आती है।

help.en: Enquiry / RFQ reference, Contact name*, Contact email*, Contact phone, Valid until*, Requested delivery, Place of supply, Payment terms*, Delivery terms*, Bill-to address*, Ship-to address*. Editable only in Draft ("Frozen revision" after).
help.hi: Enquiry / RFQ reference, Contact name*, Contact email*, Contact phone, Valid until*, Requested delivery, Place of supply, Payment terms*, Delivery terms*, Bill-to address*, Ship-to address*। सिर्फ Draft में बदल सकते हैं (उसके बाद "Frozen revision")।

help.en: "Catalog line" = a ready product/size; "Ad-hoc pouch" = a quote-only configuration built on a Base Product Master. Each line shows Pouch GSM, Weight / pc, Rate ₹/kg, Line total.
help.hi: "Catalog line" = तैयार product/size; "Ad-hoc pouch" = Base Product Master पर बनी सिर्फ इस quote की configuration। हर line में Pouch GSM, Weight / pc, Rate ₹/kg, Line total दिखता है।

help.en: Quote-level costing: raw materials (master/FIFO baseline vs quote assumption), Conversion Cost, pricing method; shows Target price, RM cost, Total cost, Contribution, Markup, Gross margin. Press "Save Cost Build".
help.hi: quote स्तर की costing: raw material (master/FIFO baseline बनाम quote अनुमान), Conversion Cost, pricing method; Target price, RM cost, Total cost, Contribution, Markup, Gross margin दिखाता है। "Save Cost Build" दबाएँ।

recoverySteps.hi: Sales menu से "Orders" खोलें और वहाँ order ढूँढें।

summary.en: This address has no screen of its own. It sends you to the home page "/", which opens the right dashboard for your role.
summary.hi: इस पते की अपनी कोई स्क्रीन नहीं है। यह आपको होम पेज "/" पर भेजता है, जहाँ आपके role का dashboard खुलता है।

purpose.en: Old links and bookmarks to /dashboard still work. Each role has its own landing page: Admin and Super Admin go to System Admin Console, Owner to the Owner dashboard, Sales to the Sales dashboard, Planner to the Planner dashboard, Work Center Manager to the WC terminal, Operator to the Machine terminal, Store to Rolls, Dispatch to the Logistics hub, Plant Manager to KPIs and Watchman to the Gate terminal.
purpose.hi: /dashboard के पुराने link और bookmark अब भी चलते हैं। हर role का अपना पहला पेज है: Admin और Super Admin को System Admin Console, Owner को Owner dashboard, Sales को Sales dashboard, Planner को Planner dashboard, Work Center Manager को WC terminal, Operator को Machine terminal, Store को Rolls, Dispatch को Logistics hub, Plant Manager को KPIs और Watchman को Gate terminal मिलता है।

prerequisites.en: You must be signed in.
prerequisites.hi: आपका login होना चाहिए।

keyActions.en: Open /dashboard or an old bookmark.
keyActions.hi: /dashboard या पुराना bookmark खोलें।

keyActions.en: The app sends you to "/" at once.
keyActions.hi: ऐप तुरंत "/" पर भेज देता है।

keyActions.en: From there your role's home page opens. Use the workspace bar at the top to move to other screens.
keyActions.hi: वहाँ से आपके role का home page खुलता है। दूसरी स्क्रीन के लिए ऊपर की workspace bar इस्तेमाल करें।

help.en: Decided by your current role. If you hold more than one role, switch role from your profile menu to land on another dashboard.
help.hi: आपके चालू role से तय होता है। एक से ज़्यादा role हों तो profile menu से role बदलें, दूसरा dashboard खुलेगा।

error.en: You land on a page you did not expect
error.hi: उम्मीद से अलग पेज खुल गया

reason.en: The redirect follows your current role. Check the role shown in the top bar and switch it if needed.
reason.hi: रीडायरेक्ट आपके चालू role के हिसाब से होता है। ऊपर bar में role देखें और ज़रूरत हो तो बदलें।

recoverySteps.en: Update bookmarks to your role's real page so you skip the redirect.
recoverySteps.hi: bookmark को अपने role के असली पेज पर बदल लें, ताकि रीडायरेक्ट न हो।

summary.en: Server vitals, database health, access sign-off and safe maintenance for the whole ERP, in one place.
summary.hi: पूरे ERP के server की हालत, database health, access sign-off और सुरक्षित maintenance एक जगह।

purpose.en: Admin's landing page. Open it at the start of the day or when users say the ERP is slow: check CPU, memory, disk, database latency and the error rate, see which department sign-offs are pending, and run housekeeping. Links lead to Users, Role matrix, Audit centre, Company profile, Shift timing and Report centre.
purpose.hi: Admin का पहला पेज। दिन की शुरुआत में या जब लोग कहें कि ERP धीमा है, तब खोलें: CPU, memory, disk, database latency और error rate देखें, कौन-से department sign-off बाकी हैं देखें, और सफ़ाई के काम चलाएँ। यहाँ से Users, Role matrix, Audit centre, Company profile, Shift timing और Report centre के link हैं।

prerequisites.en: ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
prerequisites.hi: ADMIN या SUPER_ADMIN role।

keyActions.en: Read the top tiles: "Active users" (signed in, last 24 h), "Error rate" (failed requests), "Database latency" and "Database size".
keyActions.hi: ऊपर के tile पढ़ें: "Active users" (पिछले 24 घंटे में login), "Error rate" (fail हुई requests), "Database latency" और "Database size"।

keyActions.en: Check "Server resources" for CPU, Memory and Disk. If it shows "Telemetry stale", press "Refresh vitals".
keyActions.hi: "Server resources" में CPU, Memory और Disk देखें। "Telemetry stale" दिखे तो "Refresh vitals" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: In "Department sign-off" see Approved and Pending counts. Press "Open Governance Console" to approve pending role or module visibility.
keyActions.hi: "Department sign-off" में Approved और Pending गिनती देखें। बाकी role/module visibility मंज़ूर करने के लिए "Open Governance Console" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Under "Maintenance", press "Clear application cache" if reports or dashboards show old numbers. Cached reports rebuild on the next view.
keyActions.hi: "Maintenance" में, अगर report या dashboard पुराने आँकड़े दिखाएँ तो "Clear application cache" दबाएँ। अगली बार खोलने पर report फिर से बनते हैं।

keyActions.en: To reclaim database space, press "Vacuum…", then "Run vacuum now" to confirm (or "Cancel"). Run it off-shift.
keyActions.hi: database की जगह खाली करने के लिए "Vacuum…" दबाएँ, फिर पक्का करने के लिए "Run vacuum now" (या "Cancel")। इसे shift के बाहर चलाएँ।

keyActions.en: Read "System event stream" for the latest platform activity.
keyActions.hi: "System event stream" में platform की ताज़ा गतिविधि पढ़ें।

keyActions.en: Use "Administration" links to jump to Users, Role matrix, Audit centre, Company profile, Shift timing or Report centre.
keyActions.hi: "Administration" के link से Users, Role matrix, Audit centre, Company profile, Shift timing या Report centre पर जाएँ।

help.en: People signed in during the last 24 hours.
help.hi: पिछले 24 घंटे में login करने वाले लोग।

help.en: Share of failed requests. A rise means something is breaking; check the event stream and Audit centre.
help.hi: fail हुई requests का हिस्सा। बढ़े तो कुछ टूट रहा है; event stream और Audit centre देखें।

help.en: How fast the database answers, its size and open connections.
help.hi: database कितनी जल्दी जवाब देता है, उसका आकार और खुले connections।

help.en: Live use of the server. Disk near full needs action before backups fail.
help.hi: server का चालू उपयोग। Disk भरने के पास हो तो backup fail होने से पहले कदम उठाएँ।

help.en: Approved vs pending role and module visibility approvals. "Every role is signed off." means nothing is pending.
help.hi: role और module visibility की मंज़ूरी: Approved बनाम Pending। "Every role is signed off." का मतलब कुछ बाकी नहीं।

help.en: Drops cached reports and dashboards. Safe at any time.
help.hi: cache में रखे report और dashboard हटाता है। कभी भी सुरक्षित।

help.en: Reclaims space and refreshes planner statistics. Asks for a second click to confirm.
help.hi: जगह खाली करता है और planner statistics ताज़ा करता है। पक्का करने के लिए दूसरा click माँगता है।

error.en: System health did not respond. The rest of the ERP is unaffected.
error.hi: System health did not respond. The rest of the ERP is unaffected.

reason.en: The health endpoint timed out. Press "Retry". Other screens keep working.
reason.hi: health endpoint ने समय पर जवाब नहीं दिया। "Retry" दबाएँ। बाकी स्क्रीन चलती रहती हैं।

error.en: Telemetry stale
error.hi: Telemetry stale

reason.en: Vitals are old. Press "Refresh vitals".
reason.hi: आँकड़े पुराने हैं। "Refresh vitals" दबाएँ।

error.en: Could not clear cache / Vacuum failed
error.hi: Could not clear cache / Vacuum failed

reason.en: The maintenance call failed; the toast shows the server reason. Try again off-shift or check server logs.
reason.hi: maintenance call fail हुई; toast में server का कारण दिखता है। shift के बाहर फिर कोशिश करें या server log देखें।

recoverySteps.en: If tiles show "—", press "Retry"; the server may be busy.
recoverySteps.hi: tile में "—" दिखे तो "Retry" दबाएँ; server व्यस्त हो सकता है।

recoverySteps.en: If users report wrong report numbers, use "Clear application cache" first.
recoverySteps.hi: report के आँकड़े गलत लगें तो पहले "Clear application cache" चलाएँ।

summary.en: A short view of engineering work: artworks waiting for approval, cylinders in maintenance or re-chrome, templates not yet live, and route coverage.
summary.hi: engineering के काम का छोटा नज़ारा: approval के इंतज़ार में artwork, maintenance या re-chrome में cylinder, जो template अभी live नहीं हैं, और route coverage।

purpose.en: Open it to see what blocks new jobs from engineering's side. Artwork must be APPROVED before the planner can assign it, and only LIVE templates with a route can be planned. Each item links to the Artworks, Cylinders or Templates page where the work is actually done.
purpose.hi: engineering की तरफ़ से नए job किस वजह से रुके हैं, यह देखने के लिए खोलें। planner artwork तभी लगा सकता है जब वह APPROVED हो, और सिर्फ़ route वाले LIVE template ही plan होते हैं। हर item Artworks, Cylinders या Templates पेज पर ले जाता है, जहाँ असली काम होता है।

prerequisites.en: Artwork, cylinder and template records exist.
prerequisites.hi: artwork, cylinder और template के record मौजूद हों।

keyActions.en: Read the four tiles: "Pending Artworks" (draft / approval), "Cylinder Attention" (maintenance / rechrome), "Templates To Finish" (not live) and "Live Templates" (with active routes).
keyActions.hi: चार tile पढ़ें: "Pending Artworks" (draft / approval), "Cylinder Attention" (maintenance / rechrome), "Templates To Finish" (live नहीं) और "Live Templates" (active route के साथ)।

keyActions.en: In "Approvals Queue" press "Review" on an item to open its artwork or template.
keyActions.hi: "Approvals Queue" में किसी item पर "Review" दबाकर उसका artwork या template खोलें।

keyActions.en: Check "Catalog Health": share of current artworks that are cylinder-ready and share of templates that have a route.
keyActions.hi: "Catalog Health" देखें: कितने artwork cylinder-ready हैं और कितने template का route है।

keyActions.en: Press "New Artwork" or "New Cylinder" to go to the Artworks or Cylinders list and add the record there.
keyActions.hi: "New Artwork" या "New Cylinder" दबाकर Artworks या Cylinders सूची पर जाएँ और वहीं record जोड़ें।

help.en: Artworks in DRAFT or PENDING_APPROVAL. These cannot be assigned to orders yet.
help.hi: DRAFT या PENDING_APPROVAL वाले artwork। ये अभी order पर नहीं लग सकते।

help.en: Cylinders in MAINTENANCE or RE_CHROME status.
help.hi: MAINTENANCE या RE_CHROME status वाले cylinder।

help.en: Templates in DRAFT, ENGINEERING or APPROVED, not yet LIVE.
help.hi: DRAFT, ENGINEERING या APPROVED template, जो अभी LIVE नहीं।

help.en: LIVE templates; the note shows how many active routes exist.
help.hi: LIVE template; नीचे लिखा है कितने active route हैं।

help.en: Up to a few pending artworks and unfinished templates, with design code, status and linked route.
help.hi: कुछ pending artwork और अधूरे template, design code, status और जुड़े route के साथ।

help.en: Artworks: share cylinder-ready. Routes: share of templates with a routing rule.
help.hi: Artworks: कितने cylinder-ready। Routes: कितने template पर routing rule है।

error.en: Tile shows "—" and "Unavailable"
error.hi: tile में "—" और "Unavailable"

reason.en: That list could not be loaded (for example no permission or a server error). The other tiles still work. Reload the page.
reason.hi: वह सूची load नहीं हुई (जैसे permission नहीं या server error)। बाकी tile चलते हैं। पेज reload करें।

error.en: No engineering queue
error.hi: No engineering queue

reason.en: No artwork or template is waiting for a decision. Nothing to do.
reason.hi: कोई artwork या template फ़ैसले के इंतज़ार में नहीं। कुछ करना नहीं है।

recoverySteps.en: Approve the artwork on the Artworks page, then the planner can assign it from Plan queue.
recoverySteps.hi: Artworks पेज पर artwork approve करें, फिर planner Plan queue से उसे लगा सकता है।

recoverySteps.en: Make a template LIVE with a route on the Templates page before orders can be planned on it.
recoverySteps.hi: Templates पेज पर template को route के साथ LIVE करें, तभी उस पर order plan होंगे।

summary.en: What is on hand, where it sits, how old it is and what needs attention, across every plant.
summary.hi: हर plant में क्या stock है, कहाँ रखा है, कितना पुराना है और किस पर ध्यान चाहिए।

purpose.en: Store and planner open it to judge stock before planning or buying: free vs reserved rolls, aged stock over 90 days, stock by stage, location and plant, and unresolved stock alerts. Real work (GRN, moving, counting) happens on the Stock pages it links to.
purpose.hi: Store और planner इसे plan करने या खरीदने से पहले stock समझने के लिए खोलते हैं: free बनाम reserved roll, 90 दिन से पुराना stock, stage, location और plant के हिसाब से stock, और खुले stock alert। असली काम (GRN, movement, गिनती) जुड़े हुए Stock पेजों पर होता है।

prerequisites.en: Stock received through GRN; locations and plants set up.
prerequisites.hi: GRN से stock आया हो; location और plant बने हों।

keyActions.en: Read the hero figures: "Bulk stock", "Rolls on hand", "Finished goods" and "Open alerts".
keyActions.hi: ऊपर के आँकड़े पढ़ें: "Bulk stock", "Rolls on hand", "Finished goods" और "Open alerts"।

keyActions.en: Check "Available rolls" (free to plan) against "Reserved rolls" (held for orders).
keyActions.hi: "Available rolls" (plan के लिए free) को "Reserved rolls" (order के लिए रुके) से मिलाएँ।

keyActions.en: Look at "Aged stock (90d+)" and the "Stock aging" panel; plan old rolls first.
keyActions.hi: "Aged stock (90d+)" और "Stock aging" पैनल देखें; पुराने roll पहले plan करें।

keyActions.en: Use "By stage", "By location" and "By plant" to see where roll stock sits.
keyActions.hi: "By stage", "By location" और "By plant" से देखें roll stock कहाँ है।

keyActions.en: Work through "Critical action centre", most severe alert first; press "All alerts" for the full list.
keyActions.hi: "Critical action centre" में सबसे गंभीर alert से शुरू करें; पूरी सूची के लिए "All alerts" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Press "Create GRN" to receive material, or "Health diagnostics" for the deeper inventory health report.
keyActions.hi: माल लेने के लिए "Create GRN", या गहरी जाँच के लिए "Health diagnostics" दबाएँ।

help.en: Roll weight free for the planner to allocate; the hint gives the count.
help.hi: planner के लिए free roll वज़न; नीचे गिनती लिखी है।

help.en: Roll weight held for orders, and its share of all roll stock.
help.hi: order के लिए रुका roll वज़न और कुल में उसका हिस्सा।

help.en: Stock older than 90 days.
help.hi: 90 दिन से पुराना stock।

help.en: Value of stock at its rates.
help.hi: rate के हिसाब से stock की कीमत।

help.en: Roll weight by age band.
help.hi: उम्र के हिसाब से roll वज़न।

help.en: Unresolved alerts by type.
help.hi: खुले alert, प्रकार के हिसाब से।

help.en: Weight on hand and the oldest item age per family.
help.hi: हर family का वज़न और सबसे पुराने item की उम्र।

error.en: No aging data / No stage data / No location data
error.hi: No aging data / No stage data / No location data

reason.en: The report returned nothing for that panel, often because no roll stock is recorded yet or the report is still loading.
reason.hi: उस पैनल के लिए report खाली आई; अक्सर roll stock दर्ज नहीं या report अभी load हो रही है।

error.en: All clear
error.hi: All clear

reason.en: No unresolved stock alerts.
reason.hi: कोई खुला stock alert नहीं।

recoverySteps.en: Reload the page if panels stay empty; each panel loads separately.
recoverySteps.hi: पैनल खाली रहें तो पेज reload करें; हर पैनल अलग load होता है।

recoverySteps.en: Open the alert on Alerts and fix the cause (count, adjust, move) on the matching Stock page.
recoverySteps.hi: Alerts पर alert खोलें और कारण (गिनती, adjustment, movement) उसी Stock पेज पर ठीक करें।

summary.en: Dispatch staff's landing page: counts of draft challans, orders with finished goods, vehicles in transit and trucks shipped today, plus the latest slips.
summary.hi: Dispatch staff का पहला पेज: draft challan, finished goods वाले order, रास्ते में गाड़ियाँ और आज भेजे truck की गिनती, साथ में ताज़ा slip।

purpose.en: Open it at the start of a shift to see the dispatch load, then press "Open Dispatch Bay" to build loads, print slips and mark dispatch. Counts come from the same paged slip history as Dispatch Bay.
purpose.hi: shift की शुरुआत में dispatch का काम देखने के लिए खोलें, फिर load बनाने, slip छापने और dispatch mark करने के लिए "Open Dispatch Bay" दबाएँ। गिनती उसी slip history से आती है जो Dispatch Bay में है।

prerequisites.en: Lines released from the Packing Yard; slips created in Dispatch Bay.
prerequisites.hi: Packing Yard से line release हुई हों; Dispatch Bay में slip बनी हों।

keyActions.en: Read the four tiles: "Pending Challans" (drafts), "Dispatch Ready" (orders with FG), "Vehicles Loading/Transit" and "Shipped Today".
keyActions.hi: चार tile पढ़ें: "Pending Challans" (draft), "Dispatch Ready" (FG वाले order), "Vehicles Loading/Transit" और "Shipped Today"।

keyActions.en: Check "Challan Flow Distribution" for slips by state.
keyActions.hi: "Challan Flow Distribution" में state के हिसाब से slip देखें।

keyActions.en: Scan "Latest Validated DCs" in the Execution Ledger.
keyActions.hi: Execution Ledger में "Latest Validated DCs" देखें।

keyActions.en: Press "Open Dispatch Bay" to load, print and dispatch.
keyActions.hi: load, print और dispatch के लिए "Open Dispatch Bay" दबाएँ।

help.en: Draft slips not yet dispatched.
help.hi: draft slip जो अभी dispatch नहीं हुईं।

help.en: Sales orders that have finished goods waiting.
help.hi: वे sales order जिनका finished goods तैयार है।

help.en: Slips dispatched and not yet delivered.
help.hi: dispatch हुई slip जिनकी delivery अभी बाकी है।

help.en: Slips dispatched today.
help.hi: आज dispatch हुई slip।

error.en: Logistics data feed is unavailable. Dispatch KPIs are paused instead of showing fallback zeros.
error.hi: Logistics data feed is unavailable. Dispatch KPIs are paused instead of showing fallback zeros.

reason.en: The slip history or orders feed did not load. Press "Retry". Tiles show "Unavailable" until it loads.
reason.hi: slip history या order feed load नहीं हुई। "Retry" दबाएँ। तब तक tile "Unavailable" दिखाते हैं।

error.en: Challan flow is unavailable until the logistics API syncs again.
error.hi: Challan flow is unavailable until the logistics API syncs again.

reason.en: Same cause; retry, or work directly in Dispatch Bay.
reason.hi: कारण वही; retry करें या सीधे Dispatch Bay में काम करें।

recoverySteps.en: If counts look wrong, open Dispatch Bay "Challans & history" which shows the exact slips.
recoverySteps.hi: गिनती गलत लगे तो Dispatch Bay का "Challans & history" खोलें, वहाँ हर slip दिखती है।

summary.en: Old address kept for old links. It sends you straight to the Machine terminal (/production/machine-selector).
summary.hi: पुराने link के लिए रखा पता। यह सीधे Machine terminal (/production/machine-selector) पर भेजता है।

purpose.en: Operators work only on the Machine terminal: pick the machine, start the released job, log output and close. This page itself has nothing to do.
purpose.hi: Operator सिर्फ़ Machine terminal पर काम करते हैं: machine चुनें, release हुआ job शुरू करें, output दर्ज करें और close करें। इस पेज पर खुद कुछ नहीं है।

prerequisites.en: A job released to the machine by the WC terminal.
prerequisites.hi: WC terminal से machine पर job release हुआ हो।

keyActions.en: Open /dashboard/operator or an old bookmark.
keyActions.hi: /dashboard/operator या पुराना bookmark खोलें।

keyActions.en: You land on the Machine terminal. Pick your machine there.
keyActions.hi: Machine terminal खुलता है। वहाँ अपनी machine चुनें।

help.en: /production/machine-selector, the Machine terminal.
help.hi: /production/machine-selector, यानी Machine terminal।

error.en: Machine shows no job
error.hi: Machine पर कोई job नहीं

reason.en: The WC manager has not released a job to that machine yet. Ask the WC manager to release it from the WC terminal.
