reason.hi: WC manager ने उस machine पर अभी job release नहीं किया। WC manager से WC terminal से release करवाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: Bookmark /production/machine-selector directly.
recoverySteps.hi: सीधे /production/machine-selector bookmark करें।

summary.en: Money, output, stock and risk across every plant, live from sales, production, inventory and costing.
summary.hi: हर plant का पैसा, उत्पादन, stock और जोखिम, sales, production, inventory और costing से live।

purpose.en: Owner's landing page. Open it to see how the business is doing for a chosen period (Day, Week, Month, Year) and where to look next. Each panel links to its full report: Costing centre, Dispatch Bay, Inventory, Purchase orders, Trading report, Live production and the Reports Hub.
purpose.hi: Owner का पहला पेज। चुने हुए समय (Day, Week, Month, Year) में कारोबार कैसा चल रहा है और आगे कहाँ देखना है, यह जानने के लिए खोलें। हर पैनल अपनी पूरी report पर ले जाता है: Costing centre, Dispatch Bay, Inventory, Purchase orders, Trading report, Live production और Reports Hub।

prerequisites.en: Orders, machine logs and costing entered in the ERP.
prerequisites.hi: ERP में order, machine log और costing दर्ज हों।

keyActions.en: Pick the period with the Timeframe buttons: day, week, month or year.
keyActions.hi: Timeframe बटन से समय चुनें: day, week, month या year।

keyActions.en: Read the headline tiles: "Booked order value", "Gross margin", "Production output", "Overdue orders", "Inventory on hand", "Scrap", "Machine utilisation" and "Actual-cost coverage".
keyActions.hi: मुख्य tile पढ़ें: "Booked order value", "Gross margin", "Production output", "Overdue orders", "Inventory on hand", "Scrap", "Machine utilisation" और "Actual-cost coverage"।

keyActions.en: Check "Profit & loss" (revenue, material, conversion, overhead, gross and net profit) and "Six-month financials". Press "Costing centre" for detail.
keyActions.hi: "Profit & loss" (revenue, material, conversion, overhead, gross और net profit) और "Six-month financials" देखें। विस्तार के लिए "Costing centre" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Check "Order book health" (Draft, Needs planning, Packing ready, Dispatch ready), "Top customers" and "SKU Performance".
keyActions.hi: "Order book health" (Draft, Needs planning, Packing ready, Dispatch ready), "Top customers" और "SKU Performance" देखें।

keyActions.en: Check "Stock position", "Job status", "Material discipline" and "Ink control".
keyActions.hi: "Stock position", "Job status", "Material discipline" और "Ink control" देखें।

keyActions.en: Read "Alerts & risk signals" last; "All clear" means nothing needs you.
keyActions.hi: आख़िर में "Alerts & risk signals" पढ़ें; "All clear" का मतलब आपकी ज़रूरत नहीं।

keyActions.en: Press "Refresh" for fresh numbers or "Full report" for the Reports Hub.
keyActions.hi: ताज़ा आँकड़ों के लिए "Refresh" या Reports Hub के लिए "Full report" दबाएँ।

help.en: Value of orders booked in the period.
help.hi: समय में बुक हुए order की कीमत।

help.en: Revenue minus cost of goods, as a share.
help.hi: revenue में से माल की लागत घटाकर, प्रतिशत में।

help.en: How much of output is costed from actual postings rather than estimates.
help.hi: कितना output असली posting से costed है, अंदाज़े से नहीं।

help.en: Issued vs theoretical material: issue discipline, return efficiency and variance.
help.hi: जारी बनाम सैद्धांतिक material: issue discipline, return efficiency और variance।

help.en: Ink consumed, returned and remix ratio.
help.hi: ink खपत, वापसी और remix ratio।

help.en: Print-on-demand programme: active SKUs, variants, bulk orders and bulk target.
help.hi: Print-on-demand: active SKU, variant, bulk order और bulk target।

help.en: Roll stock available for reuse: final roll, invariant and upstream pools.
help.hi: दोबारा इस्तेमाल के लिए roll stock: final roll, invariant और upstream pool।

help.en: Open and overdue POs, spend this month; trading revenue and tradeable stock value.
help.hi: खुले और देर वाले PO, इस महीने का खर्च; trading revenue और बिकने लायक stock की कीमत।

field.en: Live floor activity / Shift output & quality
field.hi: Live floor activity / Shift output & quality

help.en: Jobs running now and output per shift.
help.hi: अभी चल रहे job और हर shift का output।

error.en: Data unavailable
error.hi: Data unavailable

reason.en: The owner dashboard feed failed. Press "Refresh".
reason.hi: owner dashboard feed fail हुई। "Refresh" दबाएँ।

error.en: Waiting for material postings / Waiting for ink postings
error.hi: Waiting for material postings / Waiting for ink postings

reason.en: No issues or returns posted in the period yet.
reason.hi: इस समय में अभी कोई issue या return post नहीं हुआ।

error.en: No costed revenue in the last six months
error.hi: No costed revenue in the last six months

reason.en: Costing has not been posted for dispatched orders.
reason.hi: dispatch हुए order की costing post नहीं हुई।

recoverySteps.en: Switch the timeframe if a panel is empty; "day" is often empty early in the morning.
recoverySteps.hi: पैनल खाली हो तो timeframe बदलें; सुबह-सुबह "day" अक्सर खाली रहता है।

summary.en: Planner's landing page: queue health, release readiness, stock pools, work-center load, demand and recent planner activity on one screen.
summary.hi: Planner का पहला पेज: queue की हालत, release की तैयारी, stock pool, work center का load, demand और हाल की planner गतिविधि एक स्क्रीन पर।

purpose.en: Open it first thing to see pressure: overdue and due-today lines, blocked rows and coverage. Then go to the Control Tower to act. This page only shows numbers and links; release, artwork and stock decisions happen in the Control Tower and Stock launcher.
purpose.hi: दिन की शुरुआत में दबाव देखने के लिए खोलें: overdue और आज due line, blocked row और coverage। फिर काम करने के लिए Control Tower जाएँ। यह पेज सिर्फ़ आँकड़े और link दिखाता है; release, artwork और stock के फ़ैसले Control Tower और Stock launcher में होते हैं।

prerequisites.en: Confirmed sales orders and LIVE templates.
prerequisites.hi: confirm हुए sales order और LIVE template।

keyActions.en: Read the top tiles: "Planning queue", "Ready / released", "Blocked rows", "Required demand", "Allocatable stock" and "Coverage", plus "Overdue" and "Due today".
keyActions.hi: ऊपर के tile पढ़ें: "Planning queue", "Ready / released", "Blocked rows", "Required demand", "Allocatable stock" और "Coverage", साथ में "Overdue" और "Due today"।

keyActions.en: Read "Immediate actions" (what needs planner attention now).
keyActions.hi: "Immediate actions" पढ़ें (अभी planner का ध्यान किस पर चाहिए)।

keyActions.en: Check "Work center load" for capacity pressure and "Demand" for upcoming sales pull (Order, Customer, Template, Pending, Due).
keyActions.hi: capacity के दबाव के लिए "Work center load" और आने वाली demand के लिए "Demand" (Order, Customer, Template, Pending, Due) देखें।

keyActions.en: Check "Source path" (Final Roll Pool, Invariant Pool, Upstream Pool) and "Costing coverage" (Actual, Hybrid, Estimated).
keyActions.hi: "Source path" (Final Roll Pool, Invariant Pool, Upstream Pool) और "Costing coverage" (Actual, Hybrid, Estimated) देखें।

keyActions.en: Under "Quick actions" press "Open" (Planner control tower), "Launch" (Stock launcher) or "Configure" (Product Master).
keyActions.hi: "Quick actions" में "Open" (Planner control tower), "Launch" (Stock launcher) या "Configure" (Product Master) दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Press "Refresh" for fresh numbers.
keyActions.hi: ताज़ा आँकड़ों के लिए "Refresh" दबाएँ।

help.en: Rows waiting for planner action.
help.hi: planner के काम के इंतज़ार में row।

help.en: Rows already releasable.
help.hi: जो row release के लिए तैयार हैं।

help.en: Queue rows with blockers or on hold.
help.hi: blocker या hold वाली row।

help.en: Queue weight still to satisfy, in kg.
help.hi: जो वज़न अभी पूरा करना है, kg में।

help.en: Inventory the planner can use right now.
help.hi: stock जो planner अभी इस्तेमाल कर सकता है।

help.en: Queue state split: ready, queued, blocked.
help.hi: queue की हालत: ready, queued, blocked।

help.en: Latest released and planned jobs.
help.hi: हाल में release और plan हुए job।

error.en: Planner analytics feed is unavailable. This panel is paused instead of showing fallback zeros.
error.hi: Planner analytics feed is unavailable. This panel is paused instead of showing fallback zeros.

reason.en: The planner dashboard feed failed. Press "Refresh"; the Control Tower may still work.
reason.hi: planner dashboard feed fail हुई। "Refresh" दबाएँ; Control Tower फिर भी चल सकता है।

error.en: Planner data feed unavailable
error.hi: Planner data feed unavailable

reason.en: KPI and action cards are paused until the next successful sync.
reason.hi: अगले सफल sync तक KPI और action card रुके हैं।

recoverySteps.en: If numbers do not move after a release, press "Refresh" or open Plan Queue, which reads the live queue.
recoverySteps.hi: release के बाद आँकड़े न बदलें तो "Refresh" दबाएँ या Plan Queue खोलें, जो live queue पढ़ता है।

summary.en: Opens the Control Tower on its first tab, Command.
summary.hi: Control Tower को पहले tab, Command, पर खोलता है।

purpose.en: The Control Tower is the planner's working area. The Control Tower has seven tabs; keys 1–7 jump between them (when you are not typing in a field): 1 Command, 2 Plan Queue, 3 Live Production, 4 Completed Trace, 5 Material readiness, 6 Combine Orders, 7 Launch Stock.
purpose.hi: Control Tower planner का काम करने की जगह है। Control Tower में सात tab हैं; किसी field में type न कर रहे हों तो 1–7 key से tab बदलें: 1 Command, 2 Plan Queue, 3 Live Production, 4 Completed Trace, 5 Material readiness, 6 Combine Orders, 7 Launch Stock।

prerequisites.en: Planner, Plant Manager, Owner or Admin role.
prerequisites.hi: Planner, Plant Manager, Owner या Admin role।

keyActions.en: Open "Planner Control Tower" from the sidebar or Plan workspace.
keyActions.hi: sidebar या Plan workspace से "Planner Control Tower" खोलें।

keyActions.en: You land on Command. Use the workspace bar or keys 1–7 to change tab.
keyActions.hi: Command खुलता है। tab बदलने के लिए workspace bar या 1–7 key इस्तेमाल करें।

help.en: Jump to tab 1 to 7. Ignored while typing in an input.
help.hi: tab 1 से 7 पर जाएँ। input में type करते समय काम नहीं करते।

error.en: Number keys change the tab unexpectedly
error.hi: Number key से tab अचानक बदल गया

reason.en: Keys 1–7 are tab shortcuts when the cursor is not in a field. Click into the search box before typing numbers.
reason.hi: cursor किसी field में न हो तो 1–7 tab shortcut हैं। नंबर लिखने से पहले search box में click करें।

recoverySteps.en: Bookmark the tab you use most, for example Plan Queue.
recoverySteps.hi: जो tab सबसे ज़्यादा इस्तेमाल करते हैं, जैसे Plan Queue, उसे bookmark करें।

summary.en: Tab 1 of the Control Tower: what to act on right now, across the queue, source pools, WCM handoff, blockers and demand.
summary.hi: Control Tower का tab 1: अभी किस पर काम करना है, queue, stock pool, WCM handoff, blocker और demand के हिसाब से।

purpose.en: Open it to decide the next move. It reads the planner dashboard and the order queues and shows the top 5 at-risk orders, stock pools, demand, job states, work-center load, alerts, output and recent movement. Each card links to the tab where you act (Plan Queue, Material readiness, Live Production, Stock launcher).
purpose.hi: अगला कदम तय करने के लिए खोलें। यह planner dashboard और order queue पढ़कर सबसे जोखिम वाले 5 order, stock pool, demand, job की हालत, work center load, alert, output और हाल की हलचल दिखाता है। हर card उस tab पर ले जाता है जहाँ काम होता है (Plan Queue, Material readiness, Live Production, Stock launcher)।

prerequisites.en: Confirmed sales order lines in the planner queue.
prerequisites.hi: planner queue में confirm हुई sales order line।

keyActions.en: Check the feed status line for "Command metrics" and "Order queues"; press "Refresh" if either failed.
keyActions.hi: "Command metrics" और "Order queues" की feed status देखें; कोई fail हो तो "Refresh" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Read "Top 5 at-risk orders": due label (overdue, due today, due in N days) and the four gates Math, Artwork, Material, Route. Press "Open Plan Queue →" to act.
keyActions.hi: "Top 5 at-risk orders" पढ़ें: due label (overdue, due today, due in N days) और चार gate Math, Artwork, Material, Route। काम के लिए "Open Plan Queue →" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Read "Source Mix" (stock pool composition, Coverage, Allocatable vs Required) and "Release readiness" (Ready, Queued, Blocked, Artwork). Press "New stock order" or "Drill" (Material readiness).
keyActions.hi: "Source Mix" (stock pool, Coverage, Allocatable बनाम Required) और "Release readiness" (Ready, Queued, Blocked, Artwork) पढ़ें। "New stock order" या "Drill" (Material readiness) दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Check "Top pending sales demand", "State distribution" and "Where released jobs are waiting".
keyActions.hi: "Top pending sales demand", "State distribution" और "Where released jobs are waiting" देखें।

keyActions.en: Read "Action desk": Today's blockers, Next releases, WCM handoff and Live alerts.
keyActions.hi: "Action desk" पढ़ें: Today's blockers, Next releases, WCM handoff और Live alerts।

keyActions.en: Check "Production rhythm" (Days tracked, Peak day, Avg/day) and "Latest job movement"; press "Live production →" for the floor.
keyActions.hi: "Production rhythm" (Days tracked, Peak day, Avg/day) और "Latest job movement" देखें; floor के लिए "Live production →" दबाएँ।

help.en: Release checks for each line. All four must pass before release.
help.hi: हर line की release जाँच। release से पहले चारों पास होने चाहिए।

help.en: Allocatable stock against required kg.
help.hi: ज़रूरी kg के मुकाबले उपलब्ध stock।

help.en: Pending and running jobs per work center.
help.hi: हर work center पर pending और चल रहे job।

field.en: Total queued / Total jobs / Live handoff
field.hi: Total queued / Total jobs / Live handoff

help.en: Planning queue size, all jobs, and active jobs handed to WCM.
help.hi: planning queue, कुल job, और WCM को दिए चालू job।

error.en: Queue is clear
error.hi: Queue is clear

reason.en: No open queue rows.
reason.hi: कोई खुली queue row नहीं।

error.en: No source pools
error.hi: No source pools

reason.en: No positive FG, WIP, invariant, POD or packaging pool rows were returned; the card shows release readiness instead.
reason.hi: कोई FG, WIP, invariant, POD या packaging pool नहीं मिला; card उसकी जगह release readiness दिखाता है।

error.en: Feed failed in the status line
error.hi: status line में feed fail

reason.en: One of the two reads timed out. Press "Refresh"; nothing is lost.
reason.hi: दोनों में से एक read समय पर नहीं आई। "Refresh" दबाएँ; कुछ खोया नहीं।

recoverySteps.en: Cards appear only after both feeds load; if the page stays empty, press "Refresh".
recoverySteps.hi: दोनों feed load होने पर ही card दिखते हैं; पेज खाली रहे तो "Refresh" दबाएँ।

summary.en: Closed lines with cycle time, on-time delivery, throughput and an expandable per-order route trace and BOM.
summary.hi: बंद line का cycle time, समय पर delivery, throughput, और हर order का खुलने वाला route trace और BOM।

purpose.en: Tab 4. Open it to review what finished: how long lines took, which were late, which closed by stock claim, short-close or WCM posting, and where the trace has gaps. Export the window to CSV for review.
purpose.hi: Tab 4। जो पूरा हुआ उसकी समीक्षा के लिए खोलें: line ने कितना समय लिया, कौन देर से, कौन stock claim, short-close या WCM posting से बंद हुई, और trace में कहाँ कमी है। समीक्षा के लिए CSV export करें।

prerequisites.en: Lines closed by completion, stock claim or short-close.
prerequisites.hi: completion, stock claim या short-close से बंद हुई line।

keyActions.en: Pick the window: Today, 7 days, 30 days or 90 days (default 90).
keyActions.hi: समय चुनें: Today, 7 days, 30 days या 90 days (default 90)।

keyActions.en: Read the KPIs: "Closed lines", "Demand closed", "On-time", "Cycle time", "Stock claims", "Short close", "Trace gaps".
keyActions.hi: KPI पढ़ें: "Closed lines", "Demand closed", "On-time", "Cycle time", "Stock claims", "Short close", "Trace gaps"।

keyActions.en: Filter by audit state (All audit, WCM posted, Stock claim, Short close, Trace gap), source path or customer; search by order, customer, product, size or layer.
keyActions.hi: audit state (All audit, WCM posted, Stock claim, Short close, Trace gap), source path या customer से filter करें; order, customer, product, size या layer से search करें।

keyActions.en: Expand an order to see Customer, Placed, Closed, Delivery, Status, Spec hash and the route with Planned / Posted / Open per step.
keyActions.hi: order खोलकर Customer, Placed, Closed, Delivery, Status, Spec hash और हर step का Planned / Posted / Open देखें।

keyActions.en: Use the charts: "Orders closed per day", "By KG shipped", "By order count".
keyActions.hi: chart देखें: "Orders closed per day", "By KG shipped", "By order count"।

keyActions.en: Press "Export CSV" to download the filtered list.
keyActions.hi: छँटी सूची download करने के लिए "Export CSV" दबाएँ।

help.en: Share of closed lines delivered by the due date (On time vs Late).
help.hi: due date तक पहुँची बंद line का हिस्सा (On time बनाम Late)।

help.en: Days from order placed to closed.
help.hi: order से बंद होने तक के दिन।

help.en: Lines closed from stock or packing claim instead of a fresh run.
help.hi: fresh run की जगह stock या packing claim से बंद line।

help.en: Closed lines whose route postings are incomplete; check them with WCM.
help.hi: बंद line जिनकी route posting अधूरी है; WCM के साथ जाँचें।

help.en: Fingerprint of the line's specification, used to match stock.
help.hi: line की spec की पहचान, stock मिलाने में काम आती है।

error.en: No closed orders
error.hi: No closed orders

reason.en: Nothing closed in the chosen window. Pick a wider window.
reason.hi: चुने समय में कुछ बंद नहीं हुआ। बड़ा समय चुनें।

recoverySteps.en: If a line you expect is missing, widen the window to 90 days and clear filters.
recoverySteps.hi: कोई line न दिखे तो 90 दिन चुनें और filter हटाएँ।

summary.en: Combine multiple orders onto one jumbo roll. Only same Product Master orders at the same live route step can be combined.
summary.hi: कई order को एक jumbo roll पर जोड़ें। सिर्फ़ एक ही Product Master के, एक ही live route step पर खड़े order जुड़ सकते हैं।

purpose.en: Tab 6. Use it to save setups and trim: released roll-output jobs that share Product Master, film recipe, step and target width are grouped. You tick 2 or more and press Combine; at the work-center terminal the roll picker then makes one slit child per selected job. This page only plans; slitting happens at the WC terminal.
purpose.hi: Tab 6। setup और trim बचाने के लिए: release हुए roll-output job जिनका Product Master, film recipe, step और target width एक है, एक group में आते हैं। 2 या ज़्यादा tick करें और Combine दबाएँ; फिर WC terminal पर roll picker हर चुने job के लिए एक slit child बनाता है। यह पेज सिर्फ़ plan करता है; slitting WC terminal पर होती है।

prerequisites.en: At least two released roll-output jobs of the same Product Master, recipe and step, each with a target roll width.
prerequisites.hi: एक ही Product Master, recipe और step के कम से कम दो release हुए roll-output job, हर एक की target roll width के साथ।

keyActions.en: Read the tiles: "PM step groups", "Jumbo-ready orders", "Ready film", "Need setup". Filter by step ("All steps") or search.
keyActions.hi: tile पढ़ें: "PM step groups", "Jumbo-ready orders", "Ready film", "Need setup"। step ("All steps") से filter या search करें।

keyActions.en: Pick a recipe group on the left ("Jumbo-ready groups").
keyActions.hi: बाईं ओर recipe group चुनें ("Jumbo-ready groups")।

keyActions.en: Tick 2 or more orders. Check the "Slit layout preview" (one slit per order, 5 mm trimmed at each cut).
keyActions.hi: 2 या ज़्यादा order tick करें। "Slit layout preview" देखें (हर order एक slit, हर cut पर 5 mm trim)।

keyActions.en: Press "Combine". The toast shows how many orders were combined and the batch id.
keyActions.hi: "Combine" दबाएँ। toast में जुड़े order की गिनती और batch id दिखती है।

keyActions.en: Use "Clear ticks" to start again. The WC manager slits at the work-centre terminal.
keyActions.hi: फिर से शुरू करने के लिए "Clear ticks"। WC manager work-centre terminal पर slit करता है।

help.en: Product Master, film stack, step and process must match.
help.hi: Product Master, film stack, step और process एक जैसे हों।

help.en: Only roll-output jobs with a target width can join a jumbo batch.
help.hi: सिर्फ़ target width वाले roll-output job jumbo batch में आते हैं।

help.en: The machine roll picker creates one slit child per selected job.
help.hi: machine roll picker हर चुने job के लिए एक slit child बनाता है।

field.en: generic stock / no roll width set
field.hi: generic stock / no roll width set

help.en: Row tags: a stock (not customer) job, or a job missing its width, which blocks combining.
help.hi: row tag: stock (customer नहीं) job, या width के बिना job, जो combine रोकता है।

error.en: Select at least 2 jobs to commit a gang.
error.hi: Select at least 2 jobs to commit a gang.

reason.en: Tick two or more orders.
reason.hi: दो या ज़्यादा order tick करें।

error.en: Selected jobs must use the same Product Master before they can share one jumbo.
error.hi: Selected jobs must use the same Product Master before they can share one jumbo.

reason.en: Pick orders from one group only.
reason.hi: सिर्फ़ एक group से order चुनें।

error.en: Selected jobs must be at the same route step and process before they can share one jumbo.
error.hi: Selected jobs must be at the same route step and process before they can share one jumbo.

reason.en: One job moved on; refresh and pick again.
reason.hi: कोई job आगे बढ़ गया; refresh करके फिर चुनें।

error.en: Selected jobs need target roll width before they can share one jumbo.
error.hi: Selected jobs need target roll width before they can share one jumbo.

reason.en: Set the width on the order line, or leave that job out.
reason.hi: order line पर width भरें, या उस job को छोड़ दें।

error.en: Some selected jobs are not open or do not exist.
error.hi: Some selected jobs are not open or do not exist.

reason.en: A job started or closed meanwhile. Press "Refresh".
reason.hi: इस बीच कोई job शुरू या बंद हो गया। "Refresh" दबाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: No groups ("No combinable route groups yet"): jobs must be released and share PM, recipe, step and width.
recoverySteps.hi: कोई group नहीं ("No combinable route groups yet"): job release हों और PM, recipe, step, width एक हों।

summary.en: Released lines, WCM handoff, running jobs, partial replan and the route-wise trace of everything now on the floor.
summary.hi: release हुई line, WCM handoff, चल रहे job, partial replan और floor पर चल रहे हर काम का route के हिसाब से trace।

purpose.en: Tab 3. Open it after release to follow lines through the work centers: which machine runs what since when, what waits, what is paused and what needs a replan. From an order you can open its passport, revise print colors, short-close or cancel.
purpose.hi: Tab 3। release के बाद line को work center में आगे बढ़ते देखने के लिए खोलें: कौन-सी machine क्या और कब से चला रही है, क्या इंतज़ार में है, क्या रुका है और किसे replan चाहिए। order से उसका passport खोल सकते हैं, print color बदल सकते हैं, short-close या cancel कर सकते हैं।

prerequisites.en: Lines released from Plan Queue.
prerequisites.hi: Plan Queue से release हुई line।

keyActions.en: Read the KPIs: "Posted on live lines", "Open on live lines", "Lines by state" (Running, Released, Waiting, Replan), "Needs attention", "Machines busy", "Paused", "Next job released".
keyActions.hi: KPI पढ़ें: "Posted on live lines", "Open on live lines", "Lines by state" (Running, Released, Waiting, Replan), "Needs attention", "Machines busy", "Paused", "Next job released"।

keyActions.en: Check "Machines now" (each machine's current job and since when; refreshes every 30 s) and "Today on the machines" (each job from start to close; scroll sideways).
keyActions.hi: "Machines now" (हर machine का चालू job और कब से; हर 30 s ताज़ा) और "Today on the machines" (हर job start से close तक; बगल में scroll करें) देखें।

keyActions.en: Filter with All live, Running, Released, Waiting / paused, Replan or Blockers, and by "Route path"; search by order, customer, product or route.
keyActions.hi: All live, Running, Released, Waiting / paused, Replan या Blockers से, और "Route path" से filter करें; order, customer, product या route से search करें।

keyActions.en: Open an order card to see its "Order passport" and job cards (RUNNING, REPLAN, RELEASED, WCM HANDOFF, WAITING).
keyActions.hi: order card खोलकर "Order passport" और job card (RUNNING, REPLAN, RELEASED, WCM HANDOFF, WAITING) देखें।

keyActions.en: To change ink names after release, press "Revise colors", fill the NEW colors and a reason, and confirm.
keyActions.hi: release के बाद ink के नाम बदलने के लिए "Revise colors" दबाएँ, NEW color और कारण भरें, पक्का करें।

keyActions.en: Use "Short close" or "Cancel line" with a reason of at least 5 characters; read the Cancel rule and Short-close rule pills first.
keyActions.hi: कम से कम 5 अक्षर के कारण के साथ "Short close" या "Cancel line" इस्तेमाल करें; पहले Cancel rule और Short-close rule pill पढ़ें।

keyActions.en: Check "Release blockers" and "Output rhythm" (30-day posted kg).
keyActions.hi: "Release blockers" और "Output rhythm" (30 दिन का posted kg) देखें।

help.en: From the job board; current job per machine and how long it has run.
help.hi: job board से; हर machine का चालू job और कितनी देर से।

help.en: The final step made less than the target; dispatch can ship what was made, the balance waits in the queue for re-release or short-close.
help.hi: आख़िरी step ने target से कम बनाया; जो बना वह dispatch हो सकता है, बाकी re-release या short-close के लिए queue में।

help.en: Cancel is allowed until machine, material or scrap activity exists; the server refuses after that.
help.hi: machine, material या scrap गतिविधि होने तक cancel हो सकता है; उसके बाद server मना करता है।

help.en: Keeps posted production and closes only the unresolved remaining quantity.
help.hi: post हुआ उत्पादन रहता है, सिर्फ़ बची मात्रा बंद होती है।

help.en: WCM's close records actual output, scrap and variance. Planner short-close is only for the sales-line balance after that.
help.hi: WCM का close असली output, scrap और variance दर्ज करता है। planner short-close उसके बाद sales line के बचे हिस्से के लिए है।

error.en: Print colors can be revised only after Planner release and before completion.
error.hi: Print colors can be revised only after Planner release and before completion.

reason.en: The line is not released yet or is already complete.
reason.hi: line अभी release नहीं हुई या पूरी हो चुकी है।

error.en: Only Planner or an authorised administrator can revise released print colors.
error.hi: Only Planner or an authorised administrator can revise released print colors.

reason.en: Ask the planner to do it.
reason.hi: planner से करवाएँ।

error.en: Cancel is locked because this line is already closed.
error.hi: Cancel is locked because this line is already closed.

reason.en: Closed lines cannot be cancelled or short-closed again. Goods made for them are handled in Dispatch Bay (ship or move to stock).
reason.hi: बंद line दोबारा cancel या short-close नहीं होती। उनका बना माल Dispatch Bay में (भेजें या stock में डालें) संभालें।

error.en: Stock order cancel from Control Hub is not enabled here. Use the stock order lifecycle action.
error.hi: Stock order cancel from Control Hub is not enabled here. Use the stock order lifecycle action.

reason.en: Short close and cancel here are for sales lines only.
reason.hi: यहाँ short close और cancel सिर्फ़ sales line के लिए हैं।

recoverySteps.en: If a job seems stuck, open the WC terminal for that work center; the Stalled tab there lists it.
recoverySteps.hi: job अटका लगे तो उस work center का WC terminal खोलें; वहाँ Stalled tab में दिखता है।

recoverySteps.en: Press "Refresh" if the machine strip looks old.
recoverySteps.hi: machine पट्टी पुरानी लगे तो "Refresh" दबाएँ।

summary.en: Release what is ready, clear what is blocked. One row per sales-order line; pick a row for its full spec, sourcing and release.
summary.hi: जो तैयार है उसे release करें, जो रुका है उसे साफ़ करें। हर sales order line की एक row; पूरी spec, sourcing और release के लिए row चुनें।

purpose.en: Tab 2 of the Control Tower and the planner's main desk. Confirmed order lines arrive here. For each line you check four gates (Spec, Material, Artwork, Route), assign artwork if needed, choose the source (finished stock, WIP, invariant or input stock, or a fresh run), pick work centers for planner-decided steps and press "Plan & Release". Released jobs go to the WC terminal. You can also short-close or cancel a line here.
purpose.hi: Control Tower का tab 2 और planner की मुख्य मेज़। confirm हुई order line यहाँ आती हैं। हर line के चार gate (Spec, Material, Artwork, Route) जाँचें, ज़रूरत हो तो artwork लगाएँ, source चुनें (finished stock, WIP, invariant या input stock, या fresh run), planner वाले step के लिए work center चुनें और "Plan & Release" दबाएँ। release हुए job WC terminal पर जाते हैं। यहाँ line को short-close या cancel भी कर सकते हैं।

prerequisites.en: Sales order confirmed (drafts do not appear).
prerequisites.hi: sales order confirm हो (draft नहीं दिखते)।

prerequisites.en: Product master line with a LIVE template, a route and a production-ready recipe/BOM.
prerequisites.hi: product master line जिसका LIVE template, route और production-ready recipe/BOM हो।

prerequisites.en: For printed lines: an APPROVED artwork for that master, size and print type.
prerequisites.hi: print वाली line के लिए: उस master, size और print type का APPROVED artwork।

keyActions.en: Use the KPI tiles or chips to cut the queue: "Ready to release", "Blocked", "Artwork pending", "Overdue"; chips All, Ready, Blocked, Artwork, Overdue, Aged 30d+, New ≤3d. Search by order, customer, product or template; press "Filters" for the filter dock.
keyActions.hi: KPI tile या chip से queue छाँटें: "Ready to release", "Blocked", "Artwork pending", "Overdue"; chip All, Ready, Blocked, Artwork, Overdue, Aged 30d+, New ≤3d। order, customer, product या template से search करें; filter dock के लिए "Filters" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Sort by Newest, Due first or Largest, then click a row. The detail opens beside the queue.
keyActions.hi: Newest, Due first या Largest से sort करें, फिर row पर click करें। detail queue के बगल में खुलती है।

keyActions.en: Read the row: job name (JOB), product, demand in kg and pcs, gates S M A R, route steps (dashed steps are already covered by WIP or stock), state badge and due date.
keyActions.hi: row पढ़ें: job name (JOB), product, kg और pcs में demand, gate S M A R, route step (dashed step पहले से WIP या stock से पूरे), state badge और due date।

keyActions.en: If "Artwork required" shows, press "Assign artwork", search by design code or name, pick an approved artwork and confirm.
keyActions.hi: "Artwork required" दिखे तो "Assign artwork" दबाएँ, design code या नाम से खोजें, approved artwork चुनें और पक्का करें।

keyActions.en: Check the "Release checklist" (Math validates, Material plan, Route span) and any "Blockers" list.
keyActions.hi: "Release checklist" (Math validates, Material plan, Route span) और "Blockers" सूची देखें।

keyActions.en: Press "Plan & Release" (or "Choose source & release" when finished goods or WIP match). In the dialog pick the source: FG match, Carry WIP, Invariant stock, Input stock or Fresh run; enter "KG to allocate" or press MAX. Only stock this line may take is listed; matching stock of a closed order shows as a note — move it to free stock in Dispatch Bay first.
keyActions.hi: "Plan & Release" दबाएँ (FG या WIP मिलने पर "Choose source & release")। dialog में source चुनें: FG match, Carry WIP, Invariant stock, Input stock या Fresh run; "KG to allocate" भरें या MAX दबाएँ। सिर्फ़ वही stock दिखता है जो यह line ले सकती है; बंद order का matching stock note में दिखता है — पहले Dispatch Bay में free stock में move करें।

keyActions.en: Under "Route dispatch" choose a work center for every planner-decided step. Under "Optional route steps" skip a step only if this run should jump it.
keyActions.hi: "Route dispatch" में planner वाले हर step का work center चुनें। "Optional route steps" में step तभी छोड़ें जब यह run उसे छोड़नी हो।

keyActions.en: Keep "Release immediately after planning" ticked to hand the line to WCM now (button "Plan & Release"), or untick for "Plan only". Press the button and wait for "Order planned & released".
keyActions.hi: line को अभी WCM को देने के लिए "Release immediately after planning" ticked रखें (बटन "Plan & Release"), या untick करके "Plan only"। बटन दबाएँ और "Order planned & released" का इंतज़ार करें।

keyActions.en: To stop a line: press "Short close" (keeps what was produced, closes the rest) or "Cancel line" (only before machine activity), type a reason of at least 5 characters and confirm.
keyActions.hi: line रोकने के लिए: "Short close" (बना हुआ माल रहता है, बाकी बंद) या "Cancel line" (सिर्फ़ machine गतिविधि से पहले) दबाएँ, कम से कम 5 अक्षर का कारण लिखें और पक्का करें।

help.en: Lines whose math is valid, artwork is set and no blocker remains. Click to filter.
help.hi: जिन line का math सही, artwork लगा और कोई blocker नहीं। click करके filter करें।

help.en: Split into Recipe / spec, Artwork only, Replan and Stock check.
help.hi: Recipe / spec, Artwork only, Replan और Stock check में बँटा।

help.en: Required kg of the lines in view.
help.hi: दिख रही line का ज़रूरी kg।

help.en: Spec and quantity math. Red: "Spec or quantity math is invalid" — fix the line on the sales order or product master.
help.hi: spec और मात्रा का हिसाब। लाल: "Spec or quantity math is invalid" — sales order या product master पर line ठीक करें।

help.en: Red only when the recipe/BOM is not production-ready. Amber when the stock lookup failed or the material plan has no lines.
help.hi: लाल सिर्फ़ तब जब recipe/BOM production-ready नहीं। stock lookup fail या material plan में line न हों तो पीला।

help.en: Amber "Artwork pending" until an approved artwork is assigned; skipped when the line has no print.
help.hi: approved artwork लगने तक पीला "Artwork pending"; बिना print की line में skip।

help.en: Route span from start step to last step; amber for a balance replan or unresolved span.
help.hi: start step से last step तक route; balance replan या अनसुलझे span पर पीला।

help.en: Ready to release (FG match / WIP continue / Fresh run), Artwork pending, Blocked · recipe, Planning required, Replan, Check stock or Row error, with the reason.
help.hi: Ready to release (FG match / WIP continue / Fresh run), Artwork pending, Blocked · recipe, Planning required, Replan, Check stock या Row error, कारण के साथ।

field.en: Stock web (What is to be made)
field.hi: Stock web (What is to be made)

help.en: Shows the web the line runs on, e.g. "Open web · 655 mm roll · slit allowed". Rolls within ±20 mm of the planned web are used as they are.
help.hi: line किस web पर चलेगी, जैसे "Open web · 655 mm roll · slit allowed"। planned web के ±20 mm वाले roll सीधे इस्तेमाल होते हैं।

help.en: Ticked: plan and release in one go. Unticked: plan only, release later.
help.hi: tick: plan और release एक साथ। untick: सिर्फ़ plan, release बाद में।

help.en: After release and before completion, change print color names with a reason; artwork, route and color counts stay locked.
help.hi: release के बाद और पूरा होने से पहले, कारण के साथ print color के नाम बदलें; artwork, route और color की गिनती लॉक रहती है।

error.en: Artwork assignment is required before release for printing-enabled order.
error.hi: Artwork assignment is required before release for printing-enabled order.

reason.en: Press "Assign artwork" first.
reason.hi: पहले "Assign artwork" दबाएँ।

error.en: Artwork must be APPROVED before assignment.
error.hi: Artwork must be APPROVED before assignment.

reason.en: Ask engineering to approve the artwork on the Artworks page.
reason.hi: engineering से Artworks पेज पर artwork approve करवाएँ।

error.en: Release is blocked until every planner-decided route step has a work center.
error.hi: Release is blocked until every planner-decided route step has a work center.

reason.en: Pick a work center under "Route dispatch" for each step.
reason.hi: "Route dispatch" में हर step का work center चुनें।

error.en: Allocate at least one candidate to proceed
error.hi: Allocate at least one candidate to proceed

reason.en: You chose a stock source but entered no kg. Enter kg or switch to Fresh run.
reason.hi: stock source चुना पर kg नहीं भरा। kg भरें या Fresh run चुनें।

error.en: Plan saved; release pending
error.hi: Plan saved; release pending

reason.en: The plan was saved but release failed. Press "Retry release"; do not plan again.
reason.hi: plan save हुआ पर release fail। "Retry release" दबाएँ; दोबारा plan न करें।

error.en: Plan not confirmed
error.hi: Plan not confirmed

reason.en: The connection ended before confirmation. Press "Confirm saved plan" to recover the same plan.
reason.hi: पुष्टि से पहले connection टूटा। वही plan वापस पाने के लिए "Confirm saved plan" दबाएँ।

error.en: Saved; queue refresh pending
error.hi: Saved; queue refresh pending

reason.en: The order was saved but the queue did not reload. Press "Retry saved queue" or "Refresh". Do not submit again.
reason.hi: order save हुआ पर queue reload नहीं हुई। "Retry saved queue" या "Refresh" दबाएँ। दोबारा submit न करें।

error.en: Line has machine activity. Use short-close for the remaining quantity.
error.hi: Line has machine activity. Use short-close for the remaining quantity.

reason.en: Cancel is allowed only before machine activity. Use "Short close".
reason.hi: cancel सिर्फ़ machine गतिविधि से पहले। "Short close" इस्तेमाल करें।

error.en: Reason required
error.hi: Reason required

reason.en: Short close and cancel need at least 5 characters of reason for the audit trail.
reason.hi: short close और cancel के लिए audit के लिए कम से कम 5 अक्षर का कारण चाहिए।

error.en: Line must be PLANNED before release. Current: …
error.hi: Line must be PLANNED before release. Current: …

reason.en: The line changed (already released or closed). Press "Refresh" and check its state.
reason.hi: line बदल गई (पहले से release या बंद)। "Refresh" दबाएँ और हालत देखें।

recoverySteps.en: If a banner says "An earlier plan needs confirmation", use Resume; it checks the saved result and finishes the release.
recoverySteps.hi: "An earlier plan needs confirmation" दिखे तो Resume दबाएँ; यह saved नतीजा जाँचकर release पूरा करता है।

recoverySteps.en: If "Could not load the current line detail. Actions are paused.", press "Retry detail".
recoverySteps.hi: "Could not load the current line detail. Actions are paused." दिखे तो "Retry detail" दबाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: Red Material gate: fix the recipe/BOM on the product master, then refresh.
recoverySteps.hi: Material gate लाल: product master पर recipe/BOM ठीक करें, फिर refresh।

recoverySteps.en: Line missing: check the order is confirmed, not draft, and clear filters (chip "All").
recoverySteps.hi: line नहीं दिख रही: देखें order confirm है, draft नहीं, और filter हटाएँ (chip "All")।

summary.en: Which demand is short, by how much, and the one thing to do next: stock vs demand per template, packaging and POD in-house work, aged stock.
summary.hi: कौन-सी demand कम पड़ रही है, कितनी, और अगला एक काम: हर template का stock बनाम demand, packaging और POD का in-house काम, पुराना stock।

purpose.en: Tab 5. Open it when deciding whether to build stock. Templates are marked SHORT, TIGHT, COVERED, OVERSTOCK or STOCK READY. For a short template you can launch a stock order right here ("Build & release") or go to Plan Queue ("Plan").
purpose.hi: Tab 5। stock बनाना है या नहीं, यह तय करते समय खोलें। template पर SHORT, TIGHT, COVERED, OVERSTOCK या STOCK READY लिखा होता है। कम वाले template के लिए यहीं से stock order launch करें ("Build & release") या Plan Queue जाएँ ("Plan")।

prerequisites.en: LIVE templates with demand or stock.
prerequisites.hi: demand या stock वाले LIVE template।

keyActions.en: Read the KPIs: "Templates short", "Tight", "Coverage", "Templates by cover", "FG ready to ship", "In-house packing & POD".
keyActions.hi: KPI पढ़ें: "Templates short", "Tight", "Coverage", "Templates by cover", "FG ready to ship", "In-house packing & POD"।

keyActions.en: In "Critical · build now" see kg short per template; press "Build & release" to open the Quick stock launcher.
keyActions.hi: "Critical · build now" में हर template का कम kg देखें; Quick stock launcher खोलने के लिए "Build & release" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: In the Quick stock launcher enter "Quantity to build" (KG). Keep "Send straight to production" ticked to release the first job at once, then submit.
keyActions.hi: Quick stock launcher में "Quantity to build" (KG) भरें। पहला job तुरंत release करने के लिए "Send straight to production" ticked रखें, फिर submit करें।

keyActions.en: Use "Order specs that need stock decisions" and "Demand vs Stock" (Stock, Demand, Deficit or Surplus per template); search by template.
keyActions.hi: "Order specs that need stock decisions" और "Demand vs Stock" (हर template का Stock, Demand, Deficit या Surplus) देखें; template से search करें।

keyActions.en: Check the funnel Demand → Plannable → Releaseable → Released → Completed.
keyActions.hi: funnel Demand → Plannable → Releaseable → Released → Completed देखें।

keyActions.en: Use "Packaging in-house" ("New packaging", "Launch one") and "POD bulk stock" ("New POD") for in-house stock.
keyActions.hi: in-house stock के लिए "Packaging in-house" ("New packaging", "Launch one") और "POD bulk stock" ("New POD") इस्तेमाल करें।

keyActions.en: Review "Stock without matching demand" and "Jobs stalled ≥ 3 days".
keyActions.hi: "Stock without matching demand" और "Jobs stalled ≥ 3 days" देखें।

field.en: SHORT / TIGHT / COVERED / OVERSTOCK / STOCK READY
field.hi: SHORT / TIGHT / COVERED / OVERSTOCK / STOCK READY

help.en: Cover status of a template: stock against open demand.
help.hi: template की हालत: खुली demand के मुकाबले stock।

help.en: Shown when a row has no product master link; quick launch needs a full template, geometry and layer snapshot.
help.hi: जब row का product master link न हो; quick launch के लिए पूरा template, geometry और layer snapshot चाहिए।

help.en: Stock launcher orders bypass the release gate: the first job is released immediately and there is no artwork gate.
help.hi: stock launcher order release gate नहीं देखते: पहला job तुरंत release होता है और artwork gate नहीं होता।

help.en: Idle stock no open order can use; offer it to sales or plan it.
help.hi: बेकार पड़ा stock जिसे कोई खुला order नहीं ले सकता; sales को बताएँ या plan करें।

error.en: Stock intelligence is paused
error.hi: Stock intelligence is paused

reason.en: A feed failed. Press "Retry feeds".
reason.hi: कोई feed fail हुई। "Retry feeds" दबाएँ।

error.en: Quick launch needs a full template + geometry + layer snapshot
error.hi: Quick launch needs a full template + geometry + layer snapshot

reason.en: This template has no snapshot in the aggregation. Use the full Stock Order Launcher (link in the dialog).
reason.hi: इस template का snapshot नहीं है। पूरा Stock Order Launcher इस्तेमाल करें (dialog में link)।

error.en: Stock order failed
error.hi: Stock order failed

reason.en: The server refused the order; the toast shows the reason (for example "Template must be the current LIVE revision for Stock Order creation").
reason.hi: server ने order मना किया; toast में कारण है (जैसे "Template must be the current LIVE revision for Stock Order creation")।

recoverySteps.en: Use "New stock order" for the full launcher when quick launch is not possible.
recoverySteps.hi: quick launch न हो सके तो पूरे launcher के लिए "New stock order" दबाएँ।

title.en: Launch stock from any Product Master
title.hi: Launch stock from any Product Master

summary.en: Create an in-house stock order (make-to-stock) on a product master: finished stock, a WIP pool, packaging or POD bulk, with the same spec rules as a sales order.
summary.hi: product master पर in-house stock order (stock के लिए बनाना) बनाएँ: finished stock, WIP pool, packaging या POD bulk, sales order जैसे ही spec नियमों के साथ।

purpose.en: Tab 7. Use it when Material readiness shows a shortage or when you want ready stock for fast orders. The order runs the same route, floor and packing as a customer order. Manual launches create and release the production order directly, with no artwork gate. Later, sales lines with the same spec can claim the stock from Plan Queue.
purpose.hi: Tab 7। जब Material readiness कमी दिखाए या जल्दी वाले order के लिए stock तैयार रखना हो। यह order customer order जैसे ही route, floor और packing से गुज़रता है। हाथ से launch करने पर production order सीधे बनता और release होता है, artwork gate नहीं। बाद में उसी spec वाली sales line Plan Queue से यह stock ले सकती है।

prerequisites.en: An active product master with a LIVE template and route.
prerequisites.hi: LIVE template और route वाला active product master।

prerequisites.en: Sizes and layer options on the master; for packaging or POD a linked catalog SKU.
prerequisites.hi: master पर size और layer विकल्प; packaging या POD के लिए जुड़ा catalog SKU।

keyActions.en: "What to build": filter All, Pouch, Roll, Packaging or POD, search by code or name and pick one product master.
keyActions.hi: "What to build": All, Pouch, Roll, Packaging या POD से filter करें, code या नाम से खोजें और एक product master चुनें।

keyActions.en: "Commitment": choose Generic pool (any order may use it), Customer, Artwork or Customer + art, and fill the lock.
keyActions.hi: "Commitment": Generic pool (कोई भी order ले सकता है), Customer, Artwork या Customer + art चुनें और lock भरें।

keyActions.en: "Build up to": tap where the route stops — Finished stock or a WIP pool.
keyActions.hi: "Build up to": route कहाँ रुके वहाँ tap करें — Finished stock या WIP pool।

keyActions.en: "Spec / axes": pick the size and per-layer options; check Width match and Stock form.
keyActions.hi: "Spec / axes": size और हर layer के विकल्प चुनें; Width match और Stock form देखें।

keyActions.en: "Quantity": enter Target qty and UOM (rolls use KG).
keyActions.hi: "Quantity": Target qty और UOM भरें (roll के लिए KG)।

keyActions.en: Press "Validate pool" and clear every item under "Launch blockers".
keyActions.hi: "Validate pool" दबाएँ और "Launch blockers" की हर चीज़ ठीक करें।

keyActions.en: Press the launch button ("Create stock order -> production", "Create WIP pool -> production", "Create packaging order -> production" or "Create POD bulk stock"). Wait for "Stock order created".
keyActions.hi: launch बटन दबाएँ ("Create stock order -> production", "Create WIP pool -> production", "Create packaging order -> production" या "Create POD bulk stock")। "Stock order created" का इंतज़ार करें।

help.en: Controls reuse: Generic pool, Customer (held for one buyer), Artwork (printed for one artwork), Customer + art (exact match only).
help.hi: दोबारा इस्तेमाल तय करता है: Generic pool, Customer (एक खरीदार के लिए), Artwork (एक artwork के लिए छपा), Customer + art (सिर्फ़ exact match)।

help.en: Route stop. Full route gives finished stock; an earlier stop parks a WIP roll pool.
help.hi: route कहाँ रुके। पूरा route = finished stock; पहले रुकना = WIP roll pool।

help.en: Width of the parked WIP roll. Sales demand can resume from it when the required width is the same or lower and the size allows slitting.
help.hi: रुके WIP roll की width। ज़रूरी width बराबर या कम हो और size slitting allow करे तो sales demand इससे आगे बढ़ सकती है।

help.en: Open sales lines that could pull from this pool: Eligible orders, Exact width, Slit allowed, Wrong lock.
help.hi: खुली sales line जो इस pool से ले सकती हैं: Eligible orders, Exact width, Slit allowed, Wrong lock।

help.en: Checks: Product master, Template & route stop, Commitment safety, Axes complete, Stock math + BOM. The button stays off until all pass.
help.hi: जाँच: Product master, Template & route stop, Commitment safety, Axes complete, Stock math + BOM। सब पास होने तक बटन बंद।

help.en: For packaging or POD masters: the SKU stores and packing will receive.
help.hi: packaging या POD master के लिए: store और packing को कौन-सा SKU मिलेगा।

error.en: Template must be the current LIVE revision for Stock Order creation
error.hi: Template must be the current LIVE revision for Stock Order creation

reason.en: Make the template LIVE in Engineering, then retry.
reason.hi: Engineering में template LIVE करें, फिर कोशिश करें।

error.en: Template has no routing rule
error.hi: Template has no routing rule

reason.en: Link a route to the template first.
reason.hi: पहले template पर route जोड़ें।

error.en: Roll stock orders require quantity_uom=KG
error.hi: Roll stock orders require quantity_uom=KG

reason.en: Choose KG for roll stock.
reason.hi: roll stock के लिए KG चुनें।

error.en: committed_customer is required for customer-committed stock
error.hi: committed_customer is required for customer-committed stock

reason.en: Pick the customer in the Customer lock, or choose Generic pool.
reason.hi: Customer lock में customer चुनें, या Generic pool लें।

error.en: committed_artwork is required for artwork-committed stock
error.hi: committed_artwork is required for artwork-committed stock

reason.en: Pick the artwork lock.
reason.hi: artwork lock चुनें।

error.en: Printing enabled but no inks resolved from artwork.
error.hi: Printing enabled but no inks resolved from artwork.

reason.en: The chosen artwork has no inks; fix the artwork or pick another.
reason.hi: चुने artwork में ink नहीं; artwork ठीक करें या दूसरा चुनें।

recoverySteps.en: If the launch button stays grey, read "Launch blockers" and press "Validate pool" again after each fix.
recoverySteps.hi: launch बटन grey रहे तो "Launch blockers" पढ़ें और हर सुधार के बाद फिर "Validate pool" दबाएँ।

summary.en: Order intake, pipeline, delivery promise and customer mix, calculated live from sales orders.
summary.hi: order की आमद, pipeline, delivery का वादा और customer mix, sales order से live।

purpose.en: Sales staff's landing page. Open it to see drafts that still need confirming, overdue orders, what is ready to ship and how intake is trending. Press "Create order" to book a new order or "View orders" for the full list.
purpose.hi: Sales staff का पहला पेज। confirm करने बाकी draft, देर वाले order, भेजने को तैयार माल और order की आमद देखने के लिए खोलें। नया order बुक करने के लिए "Create order" या पूरी सूची के लिए "View orders" दबाएँ।

prerequisites.en: Customers and product masters exist; orders booked.
prerequisites.hi: customer और product master बने हों; order बुक हों।

keyActions.en: Read the hero: "Order value · 30 days", "Open pipeline", "On time in full" (against target) and "Overdue orders".
keyActions.hi: ऊपर पढ़ें: "Order value · 30 days", "Open pipeline", "On time in full" (target के मुकाबले) और "Overdue orders"।

keyActions.en: Click "Drafts to confirm" to open the orders list and confirm drafts; drafts never reach the planner.
keyActions.hi: "Drafts to confirm" पर click करके orders list खोलें और draft confirm करें; draft planner तक नहीं पहुँचते।

keyActions.en: Check "Ready to ship" (orders in Dispatch Bay) and "Quote conversion".
keyActions.hi: "Ready to ship" (Dispatch Bay में order) और "Quote conversion" देखें।

keyActions.en: Read "Needs attention" (work waiting on the sales desk) and "Most overdue".
keyActions.hi: "Needs attention" (sales desk पर रुका काम) और "Most overdue" पढ़ें।

keyActions.en: Switch "Order intake · last 30 days" between Weight and Orders.
keyActions.hi: "Order intake · last 30 days" को Weight और Orders के बीच बदलें।

keyActions.en: Open an order from "Recent orders" (Order, Customer, Weight, Status, Created).
keyActions.hi: "Recent orders" (Order, Customer, Weight, Status, Created) से order खोलें।

keyActions.en: Press "Create order" to start a new sales order.
keyActions.hi: नया sales order शुरू करने के लिए "Create order" दबाएँ।

help.en: Weight of open orders; hint gives the count.
help.hi: खुले order का वज़न; नीचे गिनती।

help.en: Share of completed orders delivered on time and in full; green at or above target.
help.hi: पूरे order में से समय पर और पूरा पहुँचे order; target या उससे ऊपर हरा।

help.en: Orders past promised delivery.
help.hi: वादा की तारीख़ निकल चुके order।

help.en: Orders saved as draft, waiting for confirmation.
help.hi: draft में रखे order, confirm के इंतज़ार में।

help.en: Open orders by stage.
help.hi: stage के हिसाब से खुले order।

field.en: Top customers / Products by value · 30 days
field.hi: Top customers / Products by value · 30 days

help.en: Customers by ordered weight; products by value.
help.hi: order वज़न से customer; कीमत से product।

help.en: Shown only when a monthly sales target is set.
help.hi: सिर्फ़ तब दिखता है जब मासिक sales target तय हो।

error.en: Data unavailable
error.hi: Data unavailable

reason.en: The sales dashboard feed failed; reload the page.
reason.hi: sales dashboard feed fail हुई; पेज reload करें।

error.en: No orders in the last 30 days
error.hi: No orders in the last 30 days

reason.en: No orders created in the window.
reason.hi: इस समय में कोई order नहीं बना।

recoverySteps.en: Use "Fulfillment report" for a detailed sales report.
recoverySteps.hi: विस्तृत sales report के लिए "Fulfillment report" इस्तेमाल करें।

summary.en: Live WCM control for machine assignment, operator coverage, roll and ink handoff, blockers, downtime, output, scrap and shift takeover.
summary.hi: machine assignment, operator coverage, roll और ink handoff, blocker, downtime, output, scrap और shift takeover का live WCM नियंत्रण।

purpose.en: The WC manager's overview across assigned work centers. Open it at shift start or takeover to see blocked jobs, released jobs without a machine, idle machines and discipline (scrap, downtime, ink remix). The real work (picking rolls, issuing input, releasing jobs to machines) is done in the WC terminal, opened from "Open WCM Terminal" or "Open terminal" on a work-center row.
purpose.hi: सौंपे गए work center का WC manager वाला नज़ारा। shift शुरू या takeover पर खोलें: blocked job, बिना machine वाले released job, खाली machine और discipline (scrap, downtime, ink remix) देखें। असली काम (roll चुनना, input issue, machine पर job release) WC terminal में होता है, जो "Open WCM Terminal" या work center row के "Open terminal" से खुलता है।

prerequisites.en: Work centers with machines set up; jobs released by the planner.
prerequisites.hi: machine वाले work center बने हों; planner ने job release किए हों।

keyActions.en: Read the tiles: "Active Work Centers", "Executing Jobs", "Blocked Jobs", "Machines Running", "No Machine", "Output", "Scrap Rate", "Runtime Coverage".
keyActions.hi: tile पढ़ें: "Active Work Centers", "Executing Jobs", "Blocked Jobs", "Machines Running", "No Machine", "Output", "Scrap Rate", "Runtime Coverage"।

keyActions.en: Check "Workload & Risk Overview": "Jobs in Queue" (High risk, Medium risk, Low / ready) and "Machine State Mix". Click a slice to open the matching screen.
keyActions.hi: "Workload & Risk Overview" देखें: "Jobs in Queue" (High risk, Medium risk, Low / ready) और "Machine State Mix"। मिलती स्क्रीन खोलने के लिए हिस्से पर click करें।

keyActions.en: In "Assigned Work-Center Escalations" filter All actions, High priority, Blocked jobs, Machine assignment or Operator coverage, or search by job, blocker, machine or operator; press the action to go there.
keyActions.hi: "Assigned Work-Center Escalations" में All actions, High priority, Blocked jobs, Machine assignment या Operator coverage से filter करें, या job, blocker, machine, operator से खोजें; action दबाकर वहाँ जाएँ।

keyActions.en: In "Assigned Work Center Board" read Run, Pend, Block and OEE avg per work center and press "Open terminal".
keyActions.hi: "Assigned Work Center Board" में हर work center का Run, Pend, Block और OEE avg पढ़ें और "Open terminal" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Check "Machine Readiness" and "Execution Discipline" (Downtime, Ink Remix, Cost Coverage, Unmapped Cost, Shift Output).
keyActions.hi: "Machine Readiness" और "Execution Discipline" (Downtime, Ink Remix, Cost Coverage, Unmapped Cost, Shift Output) देखें।

keyActions.en: Before takeover go through "Shift Handoff": Machine assignment, Operator coverage, Roll and material issue, Maintenance risk.
keyActions.hi: takeover से पहले "Shift Handoff" देखें: Machine assignment, Operator coverage, Roll and material issue, Maintenance risk।

keyActions.en: The page refreshes every 60 s; press "Retry sync" if it failed.
keyActions.hi: पेज हर 60 s ताज़ा होता है; fail हो तो "Retry sync" दबाएँ।

help.en: Released jobs not yet assigned to a machine. Assign them in the WC terminal.
help.hi: release हुए job जिन्हें अभी machine नहीं मिली। WC terminal में assign करें।

help.en: Jobs on hold or with a blocker; the hint gives the number of WCM actions.
help.hi: hold या blocker वाले job; नीचे WCM action की गिनती।

help.en: Share of time machines ran; hint shows downtime minutes.
help.hi: machine कितने समय चली; नीचे downtime मिनट।

help.en: Scrap against output in scope.
help.hi: output के मुकाबले scrap।

help.en: Average overall equipment effectiveness of the work center.
help.hi: work center की औसत OEE।

help.en: Ink remixed vs issued; hint shows material variance.
help.hi: issue के मुकाबले remix ink; नीचे material variance।

help.en: Cost groups not mapped; fix in costing set-up.
help.hi: map न हुए cost group; costing set-up में ठीक करें।

error.en: Execution Command Deck failed to load
error.hi: Execution Command Deck failed to load

reason.en: WCM telemetry is unavailable or returned an unstamped fallback; KPI cards are paused instead of showing zeros. Press "Retry sync".
reason.hi: WCM telemetry नहीं मिली; KPI card शून्य दिखाने की जगह रुके हैं। "Retry sync" दबाएँ।

error.en: No assigned work centers are open for this WCM role.
error.hi: No assigned work centers are open for this WCM role.

reason.en: Use the WCM terminal to select an available floor context, or ask admin to assign work centers.
reason.hi: WCM terminal से उपलब्ध floor context चुनें, या admin से work center assign करवाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: For any job problem open the WC terminal of that work center; its Stalled tab lists stuck jobs.
recoverySteps.hi: किसी job की समस्या के लिए उस work center का WC terminal खोलें; उसका Stalled tab अटके job दिखाता है।

recoverySteps.en: "Manage work centers" opens the factory set-up for work centers.
recoverySteps.hi: "Manage work centers" work center का factory set-up खोलता है।

summary.en: This address has no screen of its own. It sends you straight to the Planner Control Tower, tab "Command".
summary.hi: इस पते की अपनी कोई स्क्रीन नहीं है। यह आपको सीधे Planner Control Tower के "Command" टैब पर ले जाता है।

purpose.en: Old links, bookmarks and the "Jobs" tab of the Floor workspace still point to /production. The planning work now lives in the Control Tower (Command, Plan queue, Live production, Completed trace, Material readiness, Combine orders, Launch stock), so this address forwards there.
purpose.hi: पुराने लिंक, बुकमार्क और Floor workspace का "Jobs" टैब अभी भी /production पर जाते हैं। प्लानिंग का काम अब Control Tower में होता है (Command, Plan queue, Live production, Completed trace, Material readiness, Combine orders, Launch stock), इसलिए यह पता वहीं भेज देता है।

prerequisites.en: A role that may open the Control Tower (Planner, Plant manager, Admin, Owner).
prerequisites.hi: ऐसा रोल जो Control Tower खोल सकता है (Planner, Plant manager, Admin, Owner)।

keyActions.en: Open /production or press the "Jobs" tab in the Floor workspace.
keyActions.hi: /production खोलें या Floor workspace में "Jobs" टैब दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: The page forwards at once to /dashboard/planner/control-tower/command.
keyActions.hi: पेज तुरंत /dashboard/planner/control-tower/command पर चला जाता है।

keyActions.en: To see one job, open it from the plan queue, Live production or Completed trace; its summary opens at /production/jobs/<id>.
keyActions.hi: किसी एक job को देखने के लिए उसे plan queue, Live production या Completed trace से खोलें; उसका सार /production/jobs/<id> पर खुलता है।

keyActions.en: For floor work use "WC terminal" (/production/work-center) or "Machine terminal" (/production/machine-selector).
keyActions.hi: फ्लोर के काम के लिए "WC terminal" (/production/work-center) या "Machine terminal" (/production/machine-selector) खोलें।

help.en: Always /dashboard/planner/control-tower/command. Nothing is saved or changed on the way.
help.hi: हमेशा /dashboard/planner/control-tower/command। रास्ते में कुछ सेव या बदला नहीं जाता।

error.en: You land on a page you cannot use
error.hi: ऐसा पेज खुलता है जो आपके काम का नहीं

reason.en: The Control Tower is for planning roles. A work-centre manager should use the WC terminal; an operator is kept on the machine terminal.
reason.hi: Control Tower प्लानिंग रोल के लिए है। Work-centre manager WC terminal खोलें; operator को machine terminal पर ही रखा जाता है।

recoverySteps.en: If the redirect loops or shows a blank page, open /dashboard/planner/control-tower/command directly.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर पेज घूमता रहे या खाली दिखे, तो सीधे /dashboard/planner/control-tower/command खोलें।

recoverySteps.en: Update old bookmarks to the Control Tower tab you actually use.
recoverySteps.hi: पुराने बुकमार्क को उस Control Tower टैब पर बदल दें जो आप सच में इस्तेमाल करते हैं।

summary.en: Issue ink from the store to a floor location, take returns and mixed-ink returns, count the ink on the floor by time, and compare what was really used with the artwork GSM theory.
summary.hi: स्टोर से फ्लोर लोकेशन पर ink देना, बची ink और मिक्स ink वापस लेना, फ्लोर पर पड़ी ink को समय के साथ गिनना, और असली खपत को artwork GSM के हिसाब (theory) से मिलाना।

purpose.en: Ink is not a job requirement row. It is booked by floor movements and counts: issue to the floor, return what is left, then count. Actual use for a window = opening count + issued − returned − closing count. The Reconcile tab spreads that actual over the jobs that printed in the window and shows the variance against theory.
purpose.hi: Ink job की requirement लाइन नहीं है। यह फ्लोर मूवमेंट और गिनती से बुक होती है: फ्लोर पर issue करें, बची हुई वापस करें, फिर गिनती करें। किसी समय-खिड़की की असली खपत = शुरुआती गिनती + issue − वापसी − आखिरी गिनती। "Reconcile" टैब यह खपत उस समय छपे jobs पर बाँटता है और theory से अंतर दिखाता है।

prerequisites.en: Plant with a store location and a floor location (Factory › Locations).
prerequisites.hi: प्लांट में एक स्टोर लोकेशन और एक फ्लोर लोकेशन होनी चाहिए (Factory › Locations)।

prerequisites.en: Ink masters (Master › Inks) and ink stock received in the store.
prerequisites.hi: Ink master (Master › Inks) बने हों और स्टोर में ink का स्टॉक आया हो।

prerequisites.en: Shift timing set up, so the entry shift is found from the time.
prerequisites.hi: Shift timing सेट हो, ताकि समय से शिफ्ट अपने आप मिल जाए।

keyActions.en: Pick "Plant", then "Store" and "Floor" locations at the top. The shift badge fills itself from the time.
keyActions.hi: ऊपर "Plant" चुनें, फिर "Store" और "Floor" लोकेशन चुनें। शिफ्ट बैज समय से अपने आप भर जाता है।

keyActions.en: Open "Shift Desk". Choose the mode: "Issue", "Return" or "Mix Return".
keyActions.hi: "Shift Desk" खोलें। मोड चुनें: "Issue", "Return" या "Mix Return"।

keyActions.en: Search and pick the ink under "Select ink", enter "Quantity kg" and check "Event time".
keyActions.hi: "Select ink" में ink खोजें और चुनें, "Quantity kg" भरें और "Event time" जाँचें।

keyActions.en: Press "Issue ink" (or "Return ink" / "Return as mix"). For a mix return also choose "Returned mix base" (POLY or PET) and the "Returned mix color".
keyActions.hi: "Issue ink" दबाएँ (या "Return ink" / "Return as mix")। मिक्स वापसी में "Returned mix base" (POLY या PET) और "Returned mix color" भी चुनें।

keyActions.en: At the count time open "Ink stock count snapshot": choose "Count scope" (selected floor or all floor locations), set "Physical count time", type "Counted kg" per ink.
keyActions.hi: गिनती के समय "Ink stock count snapshot" खोलें: "Count scope" चुनें (चुनी फ्लोर लोकेशन या प्लांट की सभी फ्लोर लोकेशन), "Physical count time" डालें, हर ink का "Counted kg" लिखें।

keyActions.en: Press "Post count". "Reset to system" puts the system figures back if you typed wrongly before posting.
keyActions.hi: "Post count" दबाएँ। पोस्ट से पहले गलती हो तो "Reset to system" से सिस्टम के आँकड़े वापस आ जाते हैं।

keyActions.en: Open "Reconcile", set "Analysis from" / "Analysis to" and read "Theory vs actual allocation" per order/job.
keyActions.hi: "Reconcile" खोलें, "Analysis from" / "Analysis to" सेट करें और हर order/job का "Theory vs actual allocation" देखें।

keyActions.en: Check "Recent Movements" and "Posted Counts" to confirm what was saved.
keyActions.hi: जो सेव हुआ उसे "Recent Movements" और "Posted Counts" में जाँचें।

help.en: Ink lots now lying on the floor locations of the plant.
help.hi: अभी प्लांट की फ्लोर लोकेशन पर पड़ी ink के lot।

help.en: Kg issued to the floor in the analysis window, with the number of issue movements.
help.hi: चुनी समय-खिड़की में फ्लोर पर दी गई kg और issue मूवमेंट की गिनती।

help.en: Real use from counts and movements, with the theory kg and "% vs theory". "No theory baseline" means no printed job with artwork GSM fell in the window.
help.hi: गिनती और मूवमेंट से निकली असली खपत, साथ में theory kg और "% vs theory"। "No theory baseline" का मतलब इस समय में artwork GSM वाला कोई छपा job नहीं मिला।

field.en: Artwork theory / Theory kg / Actual kg / Variance %
field.hi: Artwork theory / Theory kg / Actual kg / Variance %

help.en: Per order/job: ink expected from the artwork GSM, ink allocated from the actual, and the difference.
help.hi: हर order/job पर: artwork GSM से अपेक्षित ink, असली खपत में से उसका हिस्सा, और अंतर।

help.en: The shift is resolved from the event time. "No matching shift window" means the time is outside every shift set up.
help.hi: शिफ्ट event time से तय होती है। "No matching shift window" का मतलब समय किसी भी शिफ्ट में नहीं आता।

help.en: Mixed leftover ink is returned as a new ink master of base POLY or PET with the colour name you give.
help.hi: बची हुई मिक्स ink POLY या PET बेस और आपके दिए रंग-नाम के साथ नए ink master के रूप में वापस जाती है।

help.en: "Selected floor location" counts one place; "All floor locations in plant" posts one count for every floor location shown.
help.hi: "Selected floor location" एक जगह गिनती है; "All floor locations in plant" दिख रही हर फ्लोर लोकेशन की गिनती एक साथ पोस्ट करता है।

error.en: Ink issue source and floor locations must be in the same plant.
error.hi: स्टोर और फ्लोर लोकेशन अलग प्लांट की हैं

reason.en: Store and floor were picked from different plants. Pick both under the same plant.
reason.hi: स्टोर और फ्लोर अलग प्लांट से चुने गए। दोनों एक ही प्लांट के चुनें।

error.en: Ink floor movements accept INK materials only.
error.hi: केवल INK सामग्री चलती है

reason.en: The chosen material is not an ink master. Pick an ink.
reason.hi: चुनी सामग्री ink master नहीं है। ink चुनें।

error.en: Ink floor window … is already posted for this timestamp.
error.hi: इस समय की खिड़की पहले से पोस्ट है

reason.en: A count already closed this time window, so a movement cannot be back-dated into it. Use a later event time.
reason.hi: इस समय-खिड़की की गिनती पहले ही पोस्ट हो चुकी है, इसलिए उसमें पुरानी तारीख की मूवमेंट नहीं जा सकती। बाद का event time डालें।

error.en: Quantity must be positive.
error.hi: मात्रा शून्य से ज़्यादा हो

reason.en: Enter kg above zero. The buttons stay off until plant, floor, ink and quantity are filled.
reason.hi: kg शून्य से ज़्यादा लिखें। प्लांट, फ्लोर, ink और मात्रा भरे बिना बटन चालू नहीं होते।

error.en: Mix ink base type must be POLY or PET. / Mix ink color name is required.
error.hi: मिक्स ink का बेस और रंग चाहिए

reason.en: For "Mix Return" choose POLY or PET and type the colour.
reason.hi: "Mix Return" में POLY या PET चुनें और रंग लिखें।

error.en: Count location does not belong to selected plant.
error.hi: गिनती की लोकेशन इस प्लांट की नहीं

reason.en: Re-select the plant, then the floor location from its list.
reason.hi: प्लांट फिर से चुनें, फिर उसी सूची से फ्लोर लोकेशन चुनें।

recoverySteps.en: Press the refresh button; the toast "Ink control data refreshed." confirms fresh data.
recoverySteps.hi: रिफ्रेश बटन दबाएँ; "Ink control data refreshed." संदेश से पता चलता है कि नया डेटा आ गया।

recoverySteps.en: If variance looks wrong, check that an opening and a closing count exist in the window ("Opening count" / "Closing count" in the reconciliation box).
recoverySteps.hi: अंतर गलत लगे तो देखें कि समय-खिड़की में शुरुआती और आखिरी गिनती दोनों हैं ("Opening count" / "Closing count")।

recoverySteps.en: A wrong issue is corrected with a matching "Return", not by editing.
recoverySteps.hi: गलत issue को एडिट नहीं, उतनी ही "Return" करके ठीक करें।

recoverySteps.en: Use "Open Stock Lifecycle" to see the full stock history of an ink.
recoverySteps.hi: किसी ink का पूरा स्टॉक इतिहास देखने के लिए "Open Stock Lifecycle" दबाएँ।

summary.en: A read-only summary of one production job: state, planned / produced / remaining quantity, where it runs and its layer stack.
summary.hi: एक production job का केवल देखने वाला सार: स्थिति, योजना / बना / बाकी मात्रा, कहाँ चल रहा है और उसकी लेयर।

purpose.en: Activity feeds, trace results and audit entries link here. Use it to see where a job stands and jump to its machine terminal, WC terminal, trace or plan queue. Nothing is posted from this page.
purpose.hi: Activity feed, trace और audit से यहाँ लिंक आते हैं। इससे देखें कि job कहाँ है और उसके machine terminal, WC terminal, trace या plan queue पर जाएँ। इस पेज से कुछ पोस्ट नहीं होता।

prerequisites.en: The job exists and your role may read production jobs.
prerequisites.hi: job मौजूद हो और आपके रोल को production job देखने की अनुमति हो।

keyActions.en: Open the job from a feed, trace or audit link.
keyActions.hi: job को feed, trace या audit लिंक से खोलें।

keyActions.en: Read the header: job number, product and customer, the state chip, order number and priority.
keyActions.hi: हेडर पढ़ें: job नंबर, product और customer, स्थिति चिप, order नंबर और priority।

keyActions.en: Check "Planned", "Produced" (with % of plan), "Remaining" and "Process".
keyActions.hi: "Planned", "Produced" (योजना का %), "Remaining" और "Process" देखें।

keyActions.en: In "Where it runs" read work centre, machine, operator, batch and order line.
keyActions.hi: "Where it runs" में work centre, machine, operator, batch और order line देखें।

keyActions.en: Press "Machine terminal" to open the machine screen, or "Trace" for the job in Completed trace.
keyActions.hi: machine स्क्रीन के लिए "Machine terminal" दबाएँ, या Completed trace में job देखने के लिए "Trace"।

keyActions.en: Use "Work-centre terminal" or "Order in plan queue" to go to those screens.
keyActions.hi: उन स्क्रीन पर जाने के लिए "Work-centre terminal" या "Order in plan queue" दबाएँ।

help.en: Quantities in the job unit (kg or pcs). "Produced" also shows the % of plan; the total weight in kg shows under Planned when known.
help.hi: job की इकाई (kg या pcs) में मात्रा। "Produced" के नीचे योजना का % दिखता है; कुल kg पता हो तो Planned के नीचे दिखता है।

help.en: The process code of the step this job runs (for example printing or lamination).
help.hi: इस job का step किस process का है (जैसे printing या lamination)।

help.en: Produced ÷ planned, capped at 100%.
help.hi: बना ÷ योजना, अधिकतम 100%।

help.en: Stock form taken in and given out, e.g. ROLL → ROLL or ROLL → BULK.
help.hi: लिया और दिया गया stock form, जैसे ROLL → ROLL या ROLL → BULK।

help.en: Layer list with material, micron and grade, plus ink colours. "No layer stack recorded" when the job carries no layers.
help.hi: लेयर की सूची: सामग्री, माइक्रोन और ग्रेड, साथ में ink रंग। job में लेयर न हों तो "No layer stack recorded"।

error.en: Job not found
error.hi: Job not found

reason.en: "It may have been removed, or you may not have access to it." The job id is wrong, archived, or outside your work centre.
reason.hi: "It may have been removed, or you may not have access to it." job id गलत है, archive हो गया, या आपके work centre से बाहर है।

recoverySteps.en: Reopen the job from the plan queue or Completed trace instead of an old link.
recoverySteps.hi: पुराने लिंक की जगह plan queue या Completed trace से job फिर खोलें।

recoverySteps.en: The "Machine terminal" button shows only when a machine is assigned; assign one on the WC terminal.
recoverySteps.hi: "Machine terminal" बटन तभी दिखता है जब machine लगी हो; WC terminal पर machine लगाएँ।

summary.en: Shows the machines you may run as cards. Tap one to open its machine terminal.
summary.hi: जिन machines पर आप काम कर सकते हैं वे कार्ड में दिखती हैं। किसी पर टैप करके उसका machine terminal खोलें।

purpose.en: This is the operator's home page. An operator sees only the machines assigned to them on the Users page; a work-centre manager sees the machines of their work centres; Admin and Owner see every active machine. If only one machine is allowed, the page opens its terminal at once.
purpose.hi: यह operator का होम पेज है। Operator को केवल Users पेज पर उसे दी गई machines दिखती हैं; work-centre manager को अपने work centre की machines; Admin और Owner को हर active machine। अगर एक ही machine मिली हो तो पेज सीधे उसका terminal खोल देता है।

prerequisites.en: Machine created under a work centre and set ACTIVE (Factory › Machines).
prerequisites.hi: machine किसी work centre में बनी हो और ACTIVE हो (Factory › Machines)।

prerequisites.en: For an operator: the machine assigned to the user on System › Users. For a WCM: the work centre assigned.
prerequisites.hi: Operator के लिए: System › Users पर machine दी गई हो। WCM के लिए: work centre दिया गया हो।

keyActions.en: Open "Machine terminal" in the Floor menu (operators land here after sign-in).
keyActions.hi: Floor मेनू में "Machine terminal" खोलें (operator साइन-इन के बाद यहीं आते हैं)।

keyActions.en: Type in "Search machine, code, work center, or plant..." or use the state, work-center and plant filters.
keyActions.hi: "Search machine, code, work center, or plant..." में लिखें या state, work center और plant फ़िल्टर लगाएँ।

keyActions.en: The card marked "Last Used" is your last terminal and sorts first; machines running a job come next.
keyActions.hi: "Last Used" वाला कार्ड आपका पिछला terminal है और सबसे ऊपर आता है; फिर चल रहे job वाली machines।

keyActions.en: Read the card: "Active Execution" with job number and product, or "Idle Terminal"; "Pending Jobs" shows the queue count.
keyActions.hi: कार्ड पढ़ें: "Active Execution" में job नंबर और product, या "Idle Terminal"; "Pending Jobs" में कतार की गिनती।

keyActions.en: Press "Enter Terminal" (or the card, or Enter / Space on it).
keyActions.hi: "Enter Terminal" दबाएँ (या कार्ड पर टैप करें, या उस पर Enter / Space)।

keyActions.en: Use "Clear" to remove all filters.
keyActions.hi: सभी फ़िल्टर हटाने के लिए "Clear" दबाएँ।

field.en: Active machines / Running now / Jobs waiting / Machine groups
field.hi: Active machines / Running now / Jobs waiting / Machine groups

help.en: Counts for the machines you can see: active, running a job, total queued jobs, and number of work centres.
help.hi: आपको दिख रही machines की गिनती: active, job चला रही, कुल कतार के jobs, और work centre की संख्या।

help.en: "All states", "Active", "Running job", "Idle".
help.hi: "All states", "Active", "Running job", "Idle"।

help.en: The machine code, the same code printed on its QR poster.
help.hi: machine का कोड, वही जो उसके QR पोस्टर पर छपा है।

help.en: Jobs released to this machine and waiting.
help.hi: इस machine पर रिलीज़ होकर इंतज़ार कर रहे jobs।

error.en: No Machines Assigned
error.hi: No Machines Assigned

reason.en: "Assign a work center to this manager to unlock its machines." Your account has no machine (operator) or no work centre (WCM). An admin fixes it on System › Users.
reason.hi: "Assign a work center to this manager to unlock its machines." आपके खाते में कोई machine (operator) या work centre (WCM) नहीं दिया गया। Admin इसे System › Users पर ठीक करेगा।

error.en: Failed to load machines
error.hi: Failed to load machines

reason.en: Network or server problem. Press "Retry".
reason.hi: नेटवर्क या सर्वर की समस्या। "Retry" दबाएँ।

error.en: No machine matched the current search query.
error.hi: कोई machine नहीं मिली

reason.en: The search or filters hide every card. Press "Clear".
reason.hi: खोज या फ़िल्टर ने सब कार्ड छिपा दिए। "Clear" दबाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: A machine that is DOWN for maintenance is not listed; ask maintenance to resolve the fault.
recoverySteps.hi: मेंटेनेंस के लिए DOWN machine सूची में नहीं आती; मेंटेनेंस से fault ठीक करवाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: Scan the machine QR poster with the phone to open its card directly.
recoverySteps.hi: machine का QR पोस्टर फ़ोन से स्कैन करें, उसका कार्ड सीधे खुल जाएगा।

recoverySteps.en: The list refreshes by itself every 45 seconds; reload the page if a new assignment does not show.
recoverySteps.hi: सूची हर 45 सेकंड में खुद रिफ्रेश होती है; नया assignment न दिखे तो पेज रीलोड करें।

summary.en: The operator's screen for one machine: pick a released job, Start, log output (rolls, pieces, trim and scrap), Pause with a reason, and Complete the step.
summary.hi: एक machine के लिए operator की स्क्रीन: रिलीज़ job चुनें, "Start" करें, output लिखें (roll, pieces, trim और scrap), कारण के साथ "Pause" करें, और step "Complete" करें।

purpose.en: Jobs reach this screen only after the work-centre manager releases them to this machine on the WC terminal with rolls and material issued. Every output you log moves the order forward: the next route step can run on it, pouches go to the Packing Yard, rolls go to the next step or to dispatch.
purpose.hi: Job यहाँ तभी आता है जब work-centre manager उसे WC terminal पर roll और सामग्री issue करके इस machine पर रिलीज़ करता है। आप जो output लिखते हैं उससे order आगे बढ़ता है: अगला route step उस पर चल सकता है, pouches Packing Yard जाते हैं, rolls अगले step या dispatch पर जाते हैं।

prerequisites.en: Job released to this machine on the WC terminal ("Release to machine"), with input rolls reserved.
prerequisites.hi: WC terminal पर job इस machine पर रिलीज़ हो ("Release to machine"), और input rolls reserve हों।

prerequisites.en: Machine assigned to your account (operator) or your work centre (WCM).
prerequisites.hi: machine आपके खाते (operator) या आपके work centre (WCM) को दी गई हो।

prerequisites.en: Scrap reasons and downtime reasons set up in System › Reason codes.
prerequisites.hi: Scrap और downtime के कारण System › Reason codes में बने हों।

keyActions.en: Pick the job in the "Queue" rail on the left (search "Search SO, customer, final output").
keyActions.hi: बाईं ओर "Queue" में job चुनें ("Search SO, customer, final output" से खोजें)।

keyActions.en: Check the plate "what is to be made" and the focus strip "Target · लक्ष्य", "Done · बन गया", "Left · बाकी".
keyActions.hi: "what is to be made" प्लेट और ऊपर की पट्टी "Target · लक्ष्य", "Done · बन गया", "Left · बाकी" देखें।

keyActions.en: Press "Start" (or "Resume" after a pause). It stays off until the input rolls are reserved.
keyActions.hi: "Start" दबाएँ (रुकने के बाद "Resume")। input rolls reserve होने तक यह बंद रहता है।

keyActions.en: Under "Output logging" enter the output: roll rows (Gross kg, Tare kg, Width mm, Length m) for roll steps, "Good output PCS" for pouching, or split child rolls for slitting.
keyActions.hi: "Output logging" में output लिखें: roll step में roll की पंक्तियाँ (Gross kg, Tare kg, Width mm, Length m), pouching में "Good output PCS", slitting में child rolls।

keyActions.en: Fill "Trim" and "Scrap" if any. Above the wastage limit choose a reason and write why.
keyActions.hi: Trim और Scrap हो तो भरें। वेस्टेज सीमा से ऊपर हो तो कारण चुनें और लिखें क्यों हुआ।

keyActions.en: Press "Log output". Watch "Can log now (max) · अभी अधिकतम" — the button is off above that cap.
