keyActions.hi: टाइल पढ़ें: Open alerts, Critical now, Resolved in view, Current filter; और "Severity mix" व "Top alert families" चार्ट।

keyActions.en: In "Alert queue" read the message, material, roll and plant of each alert.
keyActions.hi: "Alert queue" में हर alert का संदेश, material, roll और plant पढ़ें।

keyActions.en: Fix the cause first (stock count, stock adjustment, roll fix).
keyActions.hi: पहले कारण ठीक करें (stock count, stock adjustment, roll सुधार)।

keyActions.en: Press "Resolve", write the "Resolution note" and press "Mark resolved".
keyActions.hi: "Resolve" दबाएँ, "Resolution note" लिखें और "Mark resolved" दबाएँ।

help.en: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW. Critical and high need action first.
help.hi: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW। Critical और high पहले देखें।

help.en: Negative Stock, Low Stock, Orphan Roll, Missing Parent, Missing Child, Stuck WIP, Cost Mismatch, Weight Mismatch, Transaction Mismatch.
help.hi: Negative Stock, Low Stock, Orphan Roll, Missing Parent, Missing Child, Stuck WIP, Cost Mismatch, Weight Mismatch, Transaction Mismatch।

help.en: Resolved alerts show who closed them, when and the note.
help.hi: Resolved alert में किसने, कब बंद किया और नोट दिखता है।

error.en: No alerts found
error.hi: No alerts found

reason.en: Nothing open for this filter. Switch to "All" to see past closes. If you expected alerts, press "Refresh" — a failed load also shows this.
reason.hi: इस filter में कुछ खुला नहीं। पुराने बंद देखने के लिए "All" चुनें। Alert की उम्मीद थी तो "Refresh" दबाएँ — लोड न होने पर भी यही दिखता है।

error.en: Alert already resolved
error.hi: Alert already resolved

reason.en: Someone closed it first, or the nightly check closed it automatically. Press "Refresh".
reason.hi: किसी और ने पहले बंद किया, या रात की जाँच ने खुद बंद कर दिया। "Refresh" दबाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: Mismatch alerts (TXN_MISMATCH, NEGATIVE_STOCK, WEIGHT_MISMATCH, ORPHAN_ROLL, STUCK_WIP) keep one alert per problem and close themselves the night after the cause is fixed.
recoverySteps.hi: Mismatch alert (TXN_MISMATCH, NEGATIVE_STOCK, WEIGHT_MISMATCH, ORPHAN_ROLL, STUCK_WIP) हर गड़बड़ी के लिए एक ही रहते हैं और कारण ठीक होने के अगले दिन खुद बंद हो जाते हैं।

recoverySteps.en: If Resolve seems to do nothing, press "Refresh" and try again; the error is not shown on screen.
recoverySteps.hi: Resolve से कुछ न हो तो "Refresh" दबाकर फिर कोशिश करें; गलती स्क्रीन पर नहीं दिखती।

summary.en: Every bulk stock row — granules, resins, inks, adhesives, solvents, chemicals — by material code, plant, location and class, with reservations.
summary.hi: हर bulk स्टॉक row — granules, resin, ink, adhesive, solvent, chemical — material code, plant, location और class के हिसाब से, reservation के साथ।

purpose.en: Open it to find where a granule or chemical sits, how much is free after sales holds, and to export the bulk list. Stock comes in by GRN ("Receive bulk") and goes out by consumption and adjustments.
purpose.hi: कोई granule या chemical कहाँ रखा है, sales hold के बाद कितना खाली है, यह देखने और bulk सूची export करने के लिए खोलें। स्टॉक GRN ("Receive bulk") से आता है, खपत और adjustment से घटता है।

prerequisites.en: Materials in the master and stock received by GRN or opening stock.
prerequisites.hi: Material master में हों और स्टॉक GRN या opening stock से आया हो।

keyActions.en: Choose "Pulse" (KPIs and breakdowns) or "Browse" (full table / grid).
keyActions.hi: "Pulse" (KPI और बँटवारा) या "Browse" (पूरी टेबल / ग्रिड) चुनें।

keyActions.en: Pick a saved view: "All bulk" or "Has reservation"; "Save current" stores your own.
keyActions.hi: Saved view चुनें: "All bulk" या "Has reservation"; अपना view "Save current" से रखें।

keyActions.en: Search (material, lot, vendor, location) and use the rail: Material code / family, Ink / color shade, Material class, Plant, Location.
keyActions.hi: Search (material, lot, vendor, location) करें और पट्टी में: Material code / family, Ink / color shade, Material class, Plant, Location।

keyActions.en: Tick "Show only reserved rows" or "Purchased add-ons only" if needed.
keyActions.hi: ज़रूरत हो तो "Show only reserved rows" या "Purchased add-ons only" टिक करें।

keyActions.en: Click a row for its drawer (Code, Grade, Vendor, UOM, Plant, Location, Expiry, Age, Sales reservations), then "Stock card" for its month movements.
keyActions.hi: Row पर क्लिक करें (Code, Grade, Vendor, UOM, Plant, Location, Expiry, Age, Sales reservations), फिर महीने की आवाजाही के लिए "Stock card"।

keyActions.en: Press "Export" to download the bulk list; change rows per page (25–500) at the bottom.
keyActions.hi: Bulk सूची के लिए "Export" दबाएँ; नीचे प्रति पेज rows (25–500) बदलें।

help.en: Granules / resin, Inks / pigment, Adhesives, Solvents, Chemicals, Other.
help.hi: Granules / resin, Inks / pigment, Adhesives, Solvents, Chemicals, Other।

help.en: Only purchased add-ons from the Add-on Master get it; normal inks, adhesives and solvents stay plain bulk.
help.hi: सिर्फ़ Add-on Master के खरीदे add-on पर लगता है; सामान्य ink, adhesive, solvent साधारण bulk ही रहते हैं।

help.en: Quality code row; one material may sit under several codes at one location.
help.hi: Quality code; एक material एक location पर कई code में हो सकता है।

help.en: Reserved = held for sales orders; Available = On hand − Reserved.
help.hi: Reserved = sales order के लिए रोका; Available = On hand − Reserved।

error.en: Could not load bulk inventory.
error.hi: Could not load bulk inventory.

reason.en: The stock snapshot failed. Reload; if it repeats tell the administrator.
reason.hi: स्टॉक snapshot नहीं आया। Reload करें; बार-बार हो तो administrator को बताएँ।

error.en: No active reservations.
error.hi: No active reservations.

reason.en: No sales order holds this row; all of it is free.
reason.hi: कोई sales order इसे नहीं रोक रहा; पूरा खाली है।

recoverySteps.en: If a row seems missing, clear the filter chips ("Clear all") and check the plant and location selectors.
recoverySteps.hi: कोई row न दिखे तो filter chips हटाएँ ("Clear all") और plant व location देखें।

summary.en: Read-only log of every bulk (pooled) material movement: inward, consumption, transfer and adjustment, newest first.
summary.hi: हर bulk (pooled) material की आवाजाही का केवल-पढ़ने वाला लॉग: inward, consumption, transfer और adjustment, नया सबसे ऊपर।

purpose.en: Open it to trace why a bulk balance changed: which GRN, job or adjustment moved it and when.
purpose.hi: किसी bulk बैलेंस के बदलने का कारण देखने के लिए खोलें: किस GRN, job या adjustment से और कब।

prerequisites.en: Inventory view right. Movements come from GRNs, production consumption, transfers and adjustments.
prerequisites.hi: Inventory देखने का अधिकार। आवाजाही GRN, production खपत, transfer और adjustment से आती है।

keyActions.en: Read "Recent Activity" (50 per page).
keyActions.hi: "Recent Activity" पढ़ें (हर पेज पर 50)।

keyActions.en: Check Type: Inward, Consumption, Transfer, Adjustment.
keyActions.hi: Type देखें: Inward, Consumption, Transfer, Adjustment।

keyActions.en: Read Material, Location, Quantity (+ in, − out, with unit) and Reference (Job number or the document reference).
keyActions.hi: Material, Location, Quantity (+ आया, − गया, unit के साथ) और Reference (Job नंबर या document) पढ़ें।

keyActions.en: Use the pager at the bottom for older rows; for even older ones pick an earlier financial year in the header.
keyActions.hi: पुरानी rows के लिए नीचे pager; और पुरानी के लिए header में पिछला financial year चुनें।

help.en: "Job …" when a production job consumed it; otherwise the document reference or "System Auto".
help.hi: Production job ने खर्च किया तो "Job …"; वरना document reference या "System Auto"।

help.en: Signed amount in the stock unit (KG 2 decimals, METER 1, PCS whole).
help.hi: Unit में + या − मात्रा (KG 2 दशमलव, METER 1, PCS पूरे)।

error.en: Showing the newest … of … entries
error.hi: Showing the newest … of … entries

reason.en: The list is capped. Pick an earlier financial year in the header to see older entries.
reason.hi: सूची सीमित है। पुरानी entries के लिए header में पिछला financial year चुनें।

error.en: No transactions recorded yet.
error.hi: No transactions recorded yet.

reason.en: No bulk movement in the selected year.
reason.hi: चुने साल में कोई bulk आवाजाही नहीं।

recoverySteps.en: For one material's running balance use the Stock card (Bulk drawer → "Stock card") or the Stock ledger.
recoverySteps.hi: किसी एक material का चलता बैलेंस Stock card (Bulk drawer → "Stock card") या Stock ledger में देखें।

summary.en: Old address for stock counting. It opens Stock lifecycle on the "Stock count" tab.
summary.hi: स्टॉक गिनती का पुराना पता। यह Stock lifecycle का "Stock count" टैब खोलता है।

purpose.en: Counting now lives in one place, "Count and close": stock counts on any day, month end or a period, plus the evening packing count. Old links and the "Count at rack" tab still land there.
purpose.hi: गिनती अब एक जगह है, "Count and close": किसी भी दिन, month end या period की stock count, और evening packing count। पुराने link और "Count at rack" टैब वहीं पहुँचाते हैं।

prerequisites.en: Stock lifecycle rights (inventory audit view or manage).
prerequisites.hi: Stock lifecycle का अधिकार (inventory audit view या manage)।

keyActions.en: Open the link; you land on Stock lifecycle → "Stock count".
keyActions.hi: Link खोलें; आप Stock lifecycle → "Stock count" पर पहुँचेंगे।

keyActions.en: Choose "Stock count · any day, month end or period" or the packing count, and follow that tab.
keyActions.hi: "Stock count · any day, month end or period" या packing count चुनें और उस टैब के कदम करें।

keyActions.en: Update your bookmark to /inventory/stock-lifecycle?tab=count.
keyActions.hi: अपना bookmark /inventory/stock-lifecycle?tab=count कर लें।

recoverySteps.en: If you see an access message after the redirect, ask the administrator for stock lifecycle rights.
recoverySteps.hi: Redirect के बाद access संदेश आए तो administrator से stock lifecycle अधिकार माँगें।

summary.en: One register for every bill the factory receives — photographed at the gate or uploaded at the office (photos or PDF) — with an inbox, search, filed records, follow-ups and reports.
summary.hi: फैक्ट्री को मिलने वाले हर बिल का एक रजिस्टर — गेट पर फ़ोटो या ऑफ़िस में अपलोड (फ़ोटो या PDF) — inbox, search, filed records, follow-ups और reports के साथ।

purpose.en: Work through the Inbox so every paper ends the right way: stock goes to a GRN, job work to its order, spares / machinery / services to a General Receipt, utilities, fees, transport and notes are filed. Only stock posts inventory.
purpose.hi: Inbox से हर काग़ज़ को सही अंत तक पहुँचाएँ: stock का GRN, job work का उसका order, spares / machinery / service की General Receipt, utility, fee, transport और notes file होते हैं। सिर्फ़ stock से inventory बदलती है।

prerequisites.en: Bills & documents rights: Inventory (STORE) has them by default; Owner and Admin always. Other roles or people need documents rights given in the Role matrix or User overrides. A watchman never sees this screen.
prerequisites.hi: Bills & documents के अधिकार: Inventory (STORE) के पास पहले से होते हैं, Owner और Admin के पास हमेशा। किसी और role या व्यक्ति को Role matrix या User overrides में documents अधिकार देने पड़ते हैं। Watchman को यह स्क्रीन कभी नहीं दिखती।

prerequisites.en: Gate photos come from the watchman's gate terminal; "Upload bill" needs the documents upload right.
prerequisites.hi: गेट की फ़ोटो watchman के gate terminal से आती हैं; "Upload bill" के लिए documents upload अधिकार चाहिए।

keyActions.en: Read the counts in the header: need classifying, waiting for receipt, partly received.
keyActions.hi: Header की गिनती पढ़ें: need classifying, waiting for receipt, partly received।

keyActions.en: In "Inbox" pick a stage chip: "Needs classifying", "Waiting for receipt" or "Partly received"; pick the factory if needed. The list refreshes by itself.
keyActions.hi: "Inbox" में chip चुनें: "Needs classifying", "Waiting for receipt" या "Partly received"; ज़रूरत हो तो factory चुनें। सूची खुद refresh होती है।

keyActions.en: Click a document row to open it and do its next step (shown in blue on the row, e.g. "Classify it", "Post GRN", "File it").
keyActions.hi: Row पर क्लिक करके खोलें और अगला कदम करें (row पर नीला लिखा होता है, जैसे "Classify it", "Post GRN", "File it")।

keyActions.en: For a bill that came by post or email press "Upload bill": choose the factory, add photos or PDFs, order the pages, optionally "Add bill details now (optional)", then "Upload N files".
keyActions.hi: डाक या ईमेल से आए बिल के लिए "Upload bill": factory चुनें, फ़ोटो या PDF जोड़ें, पेज क्रम लगाएँ, चाहें तो "Add bill details now (optional)", फिर "Upload N files"।

keyActions.en: Use "All documents" or "Filed" to search by invoice no., party, vendor or bill ref with filters (status, category, source, factory, vendor, dates, order) and "Export CSV".
keyActions.hi: "All documents" या "Filed" में invoice no., party, vendor या bill ref से खोजें, filter (status, category, source, factory, vendor, dates, order) लगाएँ और "Export CSV" करें।

keyActions.en: In "Non-stock follow-ups" (manage right) press "General receipt" on each old non-stock void to record what it delivered.
keyActions.hi: "Non-stock follow-ups" (manage अधिकार) में हर पुराने non-stock void पर "General receipt" दबाकर दर्ज करें कि उसमें क्या आया।

keyActions.en: Open "Reports" for status, ageing, amounts by category, top vendors, General Receipt spend and top machines; Owner/Admin also see "Document storage".
keyActions.hi: "Reports" में status, ageing, category के हिसाब से रकम, top vendors, General Receipt खर्च और top machines देखें; Owner/Admin को "Document storage" भी दिखता है।

help.en: Waiting for receipt, Partly received, Received, Filed, Voided (plus "Ready to file" for record-only paper).
help.hi: Waiting for receipt, Partly received, Received, Filed, Voided (record-only काग़ज़ के लिए "Ready to file")।

help.en: Gate photo = watchman photographed it on arrival; Office upload = added later, does not claim a gate arrival.
help.hi: Gate photo = आते समय watchman ने फ़ोटो ली; Office upload = बाद में जोड़ा, गेट आगमन नहीं माना जाता।

help.en: Right-hand number: how long an open bill has waited since arrival.
help.hi: दाईं ओर का नंबर: खुला बिल आने के बाद से कितनी देर से रुका है।

help.en: Up to 20 files and 20 pages per document; photo up to 10 MB, PDF up to 15 MB; JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF (convert HEIC to JPEG).
help.hi: एक document में 20 file और 20 पेज तक; फ़ोटो 10 MB, PDF 15 MB तक; JPEG, PNG, WebP या PDF (HEIC को JPEG बनाएँ)।

help.en: Same vendor + bill no. + financial year already recorded.
help.hi: वही vendor + bill no. + financial year पहले से दर्ज है।

error.en: Uploading bills needs the documents upload right (Inventory by default).
error.hi: Uploading bills needs the documents upload right (Inventory by default).

reason.en: Ask the Owner/Admin to grant documents upload in the Role matrix.
reason.hi: Owner/Admin से Role matrix में documents upload अधिकार माँगें।

error.en: Upload not confirmed
error.hi: Upload not confirmed

reason.en: The network dropped. Press "Send the same upload again" — it never creates a second bill. Discard only if the register does not show it.
reason.hi: नेटवर्क टूटा। "Send the same upload again" दबाएँ — दूसरा बिल नहीं बनेगा। Discard तभी करें जब रजिस्टर में न दिखे।

error.en: Not added: … is larger than 10 MB / 15 MB
error.hi: Not added: … is larger than 10 MB / 15 MB

reason.en: Compress the photo or split the PDF.
reason.hi: फ़ोटो छोटी करें या PDF बाँटें।

error.en: The register export is limited to … documents. Narrow the dates or filters.
error.hi: The register export is limited to … documents. Narrow the dates or filters.

reason.en: Pick a shorter date range or more filters, then export again.
reason.hi: छोटी तारीख़ सीमा या और filter चुनकर फिर export करें।

recoverySteps.en: If a save says it is not confirmed (network drop), press the same button again (it now reads "Send same request again" or similar). The system knows the retry and never records twice.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर सेव "not confirmed" दिखाए (नेटवर्क टूटा), तो वही बटन दोबारा दबाएँ (अब उस पर "Send same request again" जैसा लिखा होगा)। सिस्टम दोबारा भेजा गया request पहचानता है और दो बार दर्ज नहीं करता।

recoverySteps.en: If counts say "Counts could not refresh", the last counts are shown; reload the page.
recoverySteps.hi: "Counts could not refresh" दिखे तो पिछली गिनती दिख रही है; पेज reload करें।

summary.en: One bill: its pages stay beside the form while you type its details, choose the category and take the next step (GRN, job work, General Receipt, file or attach).
summary.hi: एक बिल: उसके पेज फ़ॉर्म के बगल में रहते हैं, आप विवरण भरते हैं, category चुनते हैं और अगला कदम लेते हैं (GRN, job work, General Receipt, file या attach)।

purpose.en: Open it from the Inbox to finish one paper without retyping. Saving the details never receives or posts anything; stock changes only when a GRN is posted from here.
purpose.hi: Inbox से खोलकर एक काग़ज़ बिना दोबारा टाइप किए पूरा करें। विवरण सेव करने से कुछ receive या post नहीं होता; स्टॉक तभी बदलता है जब यहाँ से GRN post हो।

prerequisites.en: Bills & documents rights: Inventory (STORE) has them by default; Owner and Admin always. Other roles or people need documents rights given in the Role matrix or User overrides. A watchman never sees this screen.
prerequisites.hi: Bills & documents के अधिकार: Inventory (STORE) के पास पहले से होते हैं, Owner और Admin के पास हमेशा। किसी और role या व्यक्ति को Role matrix या User overrides में documents अधिकार देने पड़ते हैं। Watchman को यह स्क्रीन कभी नहीं दिखती।

prerequisites.en: Classifying, filing and voiding need the documents manage right; posting a GRN or job-work receipt needs inventory receiving rights.
prerequisites.hi: Classify, file और void के लिए documents manage अधिकार; GRN या job-work receipt के लिए inventory receiving अधिकार चाहिए।

keyActions.en: Keep the bill readable: "Dock beside the form", "Float over the form", "Open in another window" or "Hide the bill (Alt+B)". On a phone it is a bottom sheet.
keyActions.hi: बिल पढ़ने लायक रखें: "Dock beside the form", "Float over the form", "Open in another window" या "Hide the bill (Alt+B)"। फ़ोन पर नीचे sheet आती है।

keyActions.en: In "What is this paper?" choose the "Document type" and the "Category — decides the next step".
keyActions.hi: "What is this paper?" में "Document type" और "Category — decides the next step" चुनें।

keyActions.en: Pick the vendor or type the party, then "Bill / invoice number", "Bill date", "Taxable (₹)", "Tax (₹)", "Total (₹)" (use "Set total = taxable + tax" if offered), due date, valid-until and "Shipped to" if needed.
keyActions.hi: Vendor चुनें या party लिखें, फिर "Bill / invoice number", "Bill date", "Taxable (₹)", "Tax (₹)", "Total (₹)" ("Set total = taxable + tax" दिखे तो दबाएँ), due date, valid-until और ज़रूरत हो तो "Shipped to"।

keyActions.en: Press "Save details".
keyActions.hi: "Save details" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: In "Next step" press the button for the category: "Open GRN" (stock), "Receive job work", "Create general receipt" (spares, machinery, service), "Attach to the stock bill" (transport) or "File as record".
keyActions.hi: "Next step" में category का बटन दबाएँ: "Open GRN" (stock), "Receive job work", "Create general receipt" (spares, machinery, service), "Attach to the stock bill" (transport) या "File as record"।

keyActions.en: If a GRN was already posted before the photo was reviewed, use "Match an existing receipt" and tick it to close if it covers every line.
keyActions.hi: अगर फ़ोटो देखने से पहले GRN post हो गया था तो "Match an existing receipt" से जोड़ें, और सब लाइनें पूरी हों तो close वाला टिक लगाएँ।

keyActions.en: When the bill shows "Partly received" and every line is in, press "Confirm all lines received", give a reason and "Close bill as received".
keyActions.hi: बिल "Partly received" हो और सब लाइनें आ गई हों तो "Confirm all lines received" दबाएँ, कारण लिखें और "Close bill as received"।

keyActions.en: Use "More actions" for "Attach to another bill…", "File as record…", "Detach from main bill…", "Reopen…" (Owner/Admin) or "Void…".
keyActions.hi: "More actions" में "Attach to another bill…", "File as record…", "Detach from main bill…", "Reopen…" (Owner/Admin) या "Void…"।

help.en: Stock items (GRN); Job work; Spares and parts / Machinery and equipment / Service / repair → General Receipt; Utility, Professional / statutory fee, Other expense → file; Transport / freight → attach to the stock bill or file.
help.hi: Stock items (GRN); Job work; Spares and parts / Machinery and equipment / Service / repair → General Receipt; Utility, Professional / statutory fee, Other expense → file; Transport / freight → stock बिल से जोड़ें या file करें।

help.en: Tax invoice, Delivery challan, Transport LR / consignment note, Debit note, Credit note, Service report, Utility bill, Other document.
help.hi: Tax invoice, Delivery challan, Transport LR / consignment note, Debit note, Credit note, Service report, Utility bill, Other document।

help.en: Optional; reminder from 3 days before.
help.hi: वैकल्पिक; 3 दिन पहले से याद दिलाता है।

help.en: Optional; renewal reminders at 60, 30 and 7 days.
help.hi: वैकल्पिक; 60, 30 और 7 दिन पहले renewal की याद।

help.en: When the bill is addressed to this factory but goods went to another; receipts may then be recorded there.
help.hi: बिल इस factory के नाम है पर माल दूसरी में गया; तब receipt वहाँ दर्ज हो सकती है।

help.en: GRNs and receipts against the bill (reversed ones stay for history) and every event on it.
help.hi: बिल पर लगे GRN और receipt (reversed भी इतिहास में रहते हैं) और उसकी हर घटना।

help.en: Alt+B show/hide, Alt+←/→ page, Alt+= / − zoom, Alt+0 fit width, Alt+R rotate; work while typing.
help.hi: Alt+B दिखाएँ/छिपाएँ, Alt+←/→ पेज, Alt+= / − zoom, Alt+0 fit width, Alt+R घुमाएँ; टाइप करते हुए भी चलते हैं।

error.en: Someone else saved this document while you were editing.
error.hi: Someone else saved this document while you were editing.

reason.en: Another reviewer saved first. Their values are loaded behind your edits; check, then save again or discard yours.
reason.hi: किसी और ने पहले सेव किया। उनके मान आपके बदलाव के पीछे लोड हैं; जाँचें, फिर दोबारा सेव करें या अपने हटाएँ।

error.en: Save or discard the changed details first, so the next screen uses them.
error.hi: Save or discard the changed details first, so the next screen uses them.

reason.en: Press "Save details" before "Open GRN" or the General Receipt button.
reason.hi: "Open GRN" या General Receipt बटन से पहले "Save details" दबाएँ।

error.en: Only record-only paper can be filed …
error.hi: Only record-only paper can be filed …

reason.en: Pick a utility, fee, transport or other-expense category, or a note / report document type, before filing.
reason.hi: File करने से पहले utility, fee, transport या other-expense category, या note / report document type चुनें।

error.en: A bill with posted receipts cannot be voided. Review its remaining lines.
error.hi: A bill with posted receipts cannot be voided. Review its remaining lines.

reason.en: Receipts are linked; confirm it complete instead, or ask Owner/Admin.
reason.hi: Receipt जुड़ी हैं; void की जगह complete करें, या Owner/Admin से पूछें।

error.en: Same invoice already recorded.
error.hi: Same invoice already recorded.

reason.en: The same vendor bill number is on another document. Void this one as "Duplicate", or give a reason to file/receive it anyway.
reason.hi: वही vendor bill नंबर दूसरे document पर है। इसे "Duplicate" से void करें, या फिर भी रखने का कारण लिखें।

error.en: Posting a GRN needs inventory receiving rights.
error.hi: Posting a GRN needs inventory receiving rights.

reason.en: An Inventory (Store) user must post the GRN from this bill.
reason.hi: Inventory (Store) user को इस बिल से GRN post करना होगा।

recoverySteps.en: If a save says it is not confirmed (network drop), press the same button again (it now reads "Send same request again" or similar). The system knows the retry and never records twice.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर सेव "not confirmed" दिखाए (नेटवर्क टूटा), तो वही बटन दोबारा दबाएँ (अब उस पर "Send same request again" जैसा लिखा होगा)। सिस्टम दोबारा भेजा गया request पहचानता है और दो बार दर्ज नहीं करता।

recoverySteps.en: If "Live refresh failed" shows, press "Retry"; the last loaded state is on screen.
recoverySteps.hi: "Live refresh failed" दिखे तो "Retry" दबाएँ; स्क्रीन पर आख़िरी लोड हुई स्थिति है।

recoverySteps.en: A filed or voided bill was wrong: Owner/Admin uses "More actions" → "Reopen…" with a reason.
recoverySteps.hi: File या void गलत हुआ: Owner/Admin "More actions" → "Reopen…" से कारण लिखकर खोलें।

summary.en: Shows one bill alone in its own window, ideal for a second monitor, while the form stays in the main window.
summary.hi: एक बिल को अलग विंडो में दिखाता है — दूसरे monitor के लिए अच्छा — जबकि फ़ॉर्म मुख्य विंडो में रहता है।

purpose.en: Opened by "Open in another window" on the bill, GRN or General Receipt screen. Page, zoom, rotation and pinned area follow the form window.
purpose.hi: बिल, GRN या General Receipt स्क्रीन पर "Open in another window" से खुलता है। पेज, zoom, घुमाव और pin किया हिस्सा फ़ॉर्म वाली विंडो के साथ चलते हैं।

prerequisites.en: Bills & documents rights: Inventory (STORE) has them by default; Owner and Admin always. Other roles or people need documents rights given in the Role matrix or User overrides. A watchman never sees this screen.
prerequisites.hi: Bills & documents के अधिकार: Inventory (STORE) के पास पहले से होते हैं, Owner और Admin के पास हमेशा। किसी और role या व्यक्ति को Role matrix या User overrides में documents अधिकार देने पड़ते हैं। Watchman को यह स्क्रीन कभी नहीं दिखती।

keyActions.en: On the form screen press "Open in another window"; drag the new window to the second monitor.
keyActions.hi: फ़ॉर्म स्क्रीन पर "Open in another window" दबाएँ; नई विंडो दूसरे monitor पर ले जाएँ।

keyActions.en: Check the chip: "Follows the form window" means it is linked; "Form window not open" means it is not.
keyActions.hi: Chip देखें: "Follows the form window" = जुड़ा है; "Form window not open" = नहीं जुड़ा।

keyActions.en: Drag to move the page, Ctrl/⌘ + scroll or pinch to zoom, double-click to zoom in, Shift-drag to pin the part you are copying.
keyActions.hi: पेज खिसकाने के लिए drag, zoom के लिए Ctrl/⌘ + scroll या pinch, double-click से zoom in, जो हिस्सा कॉपी कर रहे हैं उसे Shift-drag से pin करें।

keyActions.en: Alt + ←/→ changes the page, Alt+= / − zooms, Alt+0 fits width, Alt+R rotates — even while typing in the form.
keyActions.hi: Alt + ←/→ पेज बदलता है, Alt+= / − zoom, Alt+0 fit width, Alt+R घुमाता है — फ़ॉर्म में टाइप करते हुए भी।

keyActions.en: Press "Close window" (or "Bring back" in the form) to dock the bill beside the form again.
keyActions.hi: बिल वापस फ़ॉर्म के बगल में लाने के लिए "Close window" (या फ़ॉर्म में "Bring back") दबाएँ।

help.en: Rotation is only for you unless you press this; the stored image is never changed.
help.hi: घुमाव सिर्फ़ आपके लिए है जब तक यह न दबाएँ; असली image कभी नहीं बदलती।

error.en: You cannot open this bill
error.hi: You cannot open this bill

reason.en: Bills are for the inventory team; ask an administrator for the documents permission.
reason.hi: बिल inventory टीम के लिए हैं; administrator से documents अनुमति माँगें।

error.en: This bill link is not valid
error.hi: This bill link is not valid

reason.en: Open the bill again from the bill register or the GRN screen.
reason.hi: बिल रजिस्टर या GRN स्क्रीन से बिल फिर खोलें।

error.en: This bill is no longer available
error.hi: This bill is no longer available

reason.en: It belongs to another factory or the link is wrong; reopen it from the register.
reason.hi: दूसरी factory का है या link गलत है; रजिस्टर से फिर खोलें।

recoverySteps.en: If pages stop following the form, close this window and press "Open in another window" again.
recoverySteps.hi: पेज फ़ॉर्म के साथ न चलें तो यह विंडो बंद करके फिर "Open in another window" दबाएँ।

summary.en: Numbered returnable (RGP) and non-returnable (NRGP) gate passes for machine parts, tools and equipment leaving the factory. Gate passes never move stock.
summary.hi: फैक्ट्री से बाहर जाने वाले मशीन पुर्ज़े, औज़ार और उपकरण के लिए नंबर वाले returnable (RGP) और non-returnable (NRGP) gate pass। Gate pass से स्टॉक नहीं बदलता।

purpose.en: Open it to see what is outside the factory, with whom and when it must come back, and to raise a new pass. The watchman scans the printed QR when items leave; returns close the pass.
purpose.hi: क्या बाहर है, किसके पास है और कब लौटना है यह देखने और नया pass बनाने के लिए खोलें। सामान निकलते समय watchman छपा QR scan करता है; वापसी से pass बंद होता है।

prerequisites.en: Bills & documents rights: Inventory (STORE) has them by default; Owner and Admin always. Other roles or people need documents rights given in the Role matrix or User overrides. A watchman never sees this screen.
prerequisites.hi: Bills & documents के अधिकार: Inventory (STORE) के पास पहले से होते हैं, Owner और Admin के पास हमेशा। किसी और role या व्यक्ति को Role matrix या User overrides में documents अधिकार देने पड़ते हैं। Watchman को यह स्क्रीन कभी नहीं दिखती।

prerequisites.en: Raising, issuing and closing passes needs the gate pass right (gatepass.manage).
prerequisites.hi: Pass बनाने, issue और बंद करने के लिए gate pass अधिकार (gatepass.manage) चाहिए।

keyActions.en: Read the header counts: open and overdue.
keyActions.hi: Header की गिनती पढ़ें: open और overdue।

keyActions.en: Pick a tab: "Open", "Overdue", "Returned / closed", "Drafts", "All".
keyActions.hi: टैब चुनें: "Open", "Overdue", "Returned / closed", "Drafts", "All"।

keyActions.en: Search by number, party, item, serial or vehicle; filter by Factory, Type, Vendor and Machine.
keyActions.hi: Number, party, item, serial या vehicle से खोजें; Factory, Type, Vendor और Machine से छाँटें।

keyActions.en: Click a pass to open it (issue, print, receive back, short-close).
keyActions.hi: Pass पर क्लिक करके खोलें (issue, print, receive back, short-close)।

keyActions.en: Press "New gate pass" to raise one.
keyActions.hi: नया बनाने के लिए "New gate pass" दबाएँ।

help.en: Returnable (RGP): repair, calibration, fabrication, trial or loan, open until all items return or short-closed. Non-returnable (NRGP): scrap sale, sample or return to supplier, closes when it leaves the gate.
help.hi: Returnable (RGP): repair, calibration, fabrication, trial या loan; सब सामान लौटने या short-close तक खुला। Non-returnable (NRGP): scrap sale, sample या supplier को वापसी; गेट से निकलते ही बंद।

help.en: Draft, Issued · waiting at gate, Out of factory, Partly returned, Returned, Closed, Short-closed, Cancelled; Overdue N days in red.
help.hi: Draft, Issued · waiting at gate, Out of factory, Partly returned, Returned, Closed, Short-closed, Cancelled; लाल में Overdue N days।

help.en: For an RGP that is out: how many lines are back and the expected return date.
help.hi: बाहर गए RGP के लिए: कितनी लाइनें लौटीं और लौटने की तारीख़।

error.en: Gate passes are for the inventory team
error.hi: Gate passes are for the inventory team

reason.en: Your account has no documents right; ask the administrator.
reason.hi: आपके खाते में documents अधिकार नहीं; administrator से पूछें।

recoverySteps.en: If the list looks old, it refreshes every 30 seconds; switch tabs or reload.
recoverySteps.hi: सूची पुरानी लगे तो वह हर 30 सेकंड में refresh होती है; टैब बदलें या reload करें।

summary.en: One gate pass with its details, items (qty, back, still out), returns, gate exit photos and history, plus Issue, Print, Receive back, Short-close and Cancel.
summary.hi: एक gate pass — विवरण, सामान (qty, back, still out), वापसी, गेट से निकलने की फ़ोटो और इतिहास, साथ में Issue, Print, Receive back, Short-close और Cancel।

purpose.en: Use it to issue a draft, print it for the gate, and track it until every returnable item is back or the pass is short-closed.
purpose.hi: Draft issue करने, गेट के लिए print करने और हर returnable सामान लौटने या short-close होने तक नज़र रखने के लिए।

prerequisites.en: Bills & documents rights: Inventory (STORE) has them by default; Owner and Admin always. Other roles or people need documents rights given in the Role matrix or User overrides. A watchman never sees this screen.
prerequisites.hi: Bills & documents के अधिकार: Inventory (STORE) के पास पहले से होते हैं, Owner और Admin के पास हमेशा। किसी और role या व्यक्ति को Role matrix या User overrides में documents अधिकार देने पड़ते हैं। Watchman को यह स्क्रीन कभी नहीं दिखती।

prerequisites.en: The gate pass right (gatepass.manage) for any change.
prerequisites.hi: कोई भी बदलाव करने के लिए gate pass अधिकार (gatepass.manage)।

keyActions.en: For a draft: press "Edit draft" if needed, then "Issue" to get the number.
keyActions.hi: Draft हो तो: ज़रूरत पर "Edit draft", फिर नंबर पाने के लिए "Issue" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Press "Print PDF" ("Preview PDF" for a draft) and send the paper with the items.
keyActions.hi: "Print PDF" (draft पर "Preview PDF") दबाएँ और काग़ज़ सामान के साथ भेजें।

keyActions.en: If the items leave on another paper, use the QR label button and stick the label on that paper; the gate scans it.
keyActions.hi: अगर सामान दूसरे काग़ज़ पर जाता है तो QR label बटन से label छापकर उस काग़ज़ पर लगाएँ; गेट उसे scan करेगा।

keyActions.en: When the watchman scans it, the status becomes "Out of factory".
keyActions.hi: Watchman के scan करने पर status "Out of factory" हो जाता है।

keyActions.en: When items return with a vendor bill, record a General Receipt against the bill and tick "Came back on a returnable gate pass (RGP)".
keyActions.hi: सामान vendor बिल के साथ लौटे तो बिल पर General Receipt बनाएँ और "Came back on a returnable gate pass (RGP)" टिक करें।

keyActions.en: When items return without a bill, press "Receive back", enter the quantity per line and a reason.
keyActions.hi: बिना बिल लौटे तो "Receive back" दबाएँ, हर लाइन की मात्रा और कारण लिखें।

keyActions.en: If the rest will not come back, press "Short-close" with a reason; to stop an unused pass press "Cancel pass".
keyActions.hi: बाकी सामान नहीं लौटेगा तो कारण के साथ "Short-close"; न इस्तेमाल हुए pass को रोकने के लिए "Cancel pass"।

help.en: Quantity of each line not yet returned.
help.hi: हर लाइन की अभी तक न लौटी मात्रा।

help.en: Every return recorded once and never edited, with linked General Receipt lines.
help.hi: हर वापसी एक बार दर्ज, कभी बदली नहीं जाती, जुड़ी General Receipt लाइनों के साथ।

help.en: Outward photos the gate linked by QR scan or office match.
help.hi: गेट द्वारा QR scan या office match से जोड़ी गई बाहर जाने की फ़ोटो।

help.en: Party, address, GSTIN, purpose, expected back, carried by, vehicle, issued, left the gate, closed, approx. value, notes.
help.hi: Party, address, GSTIN, purpose, expected back, carried by, vehicle, issued, left the gate, closed, approx. value, notes।

error.en: Only … of line … is still out on …
error.hi: Only … of line … is still out on …

reason.en: You entered more than is still out. Enter the remaining quantity or less.
reason.hi: आपने बाहर बची मात्रा से ज़्यादा लिखा। बची मात्रा या कम लिखें।

error.en: This gate pass was changed by someone else. Reload it and try again.
error.hi: This gate pass was changed by someone else. Reload it and try again.

reason.en: Reload the page and repeat the action.
reason.hi: पेज reload करके फिर करें।

error.en: Set an expected return date of today or later before issuing.
error.hi: Set an expected return date of today or later before issuing.

reason.en: The return date passed while it was a draft; "Edit draft" and set a new date.
reason.hi: Draft रहते तारीख़ निकल गई; "Edit draft" से नई तारीख़ डालें।

error.en: This gate pass is still a draft. Ask the office to issue it before the items leave.
error.hi: This gate pass is still a draft. Ask the office to issue it before the items leave.

reason.en: Shown at the gate when a draft is scanned. Press "Issue" here.
reason.hi: Draft scan होने पर गेट पर दिखता है। यहाँ "Issue" दबाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: If a save says it is not confirmed (network drop), press the same button again (it now reads "Send same request again" or similar). The system knows the retry and never records twice.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर सेव "not confirmed" दिखाए (नेटवर्क टूटा), तो वही बटन दोबारा दबाएँ (अब उस पर "Send same request again" जैसा लिखा होगा)। सिस्टम दोबारा भेजा गया request पहचानता है और दो बार दर्ज नहीं करता।

recoverySteps.en: A General Receipt that brought items back cannot be reversed; correct the pass with an owner first.
recoverySteps.hi: जिस General Receipt से सामान लौटा वह reverse नहीं होती; पहले owner के साथ pass ठीक करें।

summary.en: Form to raise an RGP (items come back) or NRGP (items do not come back). It is saved as a draft first, then issued to get its number and QR.
summary.hi: RGP (सामान लौटेगा) या NRGP (नहीं लौटेगा) बनाने का फ़ॉर्म। पहले draft सेव होता है, फिर issue करने पर नंबर और QR मिलता है।

purpose.en: Use it whenever a part, tool or equipment (not stock) leaves the factory. Stock to another plant uses Inter-plant, material to a job worker uses Job work, goods to a customer use the Dispatch bay.
purpose.hi: जब भी कोई पुर्ज़ा, औज़ार या उपकरण (स्टॉक नहीं) बाहर जाए तब इस्तेमाल करें। दूसरी plant को स्टॉक Inter-plant से, job worker को material Job work से, ग्राहक को माल Dispatch bay से जाता है।

prerequisites.en: Gate pass right (gatepass.manage); factories and machines set up; vendor in the master or the party name.
prerequisites.hi: Gate pass अधिकार (gatepass.manage); factory और machine बने हों; vendor master में हो या party का नाम।

keyActions.en: Under "Type of gate pass" choose Returnable (RGP) or Non-returnable (NRGP).
keyActions.hi: "Type of gate pass" में Returnable (RGP) या Non-returnable (NRGP) चुनें।

keyActions.en: In "Where the items go" pick "Factory (items leave from)" and "Purpose".
keyActions.hi: "Where the items go" में "Factory (items leave from)" और "Purpose" चुनें।

keyActions.en: Pick the "Vendor" or fill "Or party name (not in vendor list)", "Address" and optional "GSTIN".
keyActions.hi: "Vendor" चुनें या "Or party name (not in vendor list)", "Address" और वैकल्पिक "GSTIN" भरें।

keyActions.en: For an RGP set "Expected back by"; add "Carried by", "Vehicle" and printed notes if useful.
keyActions.hi: RGP के लिए "Expected back by" डालें; ज़रूरत हो तो "Carried by", "Vehicle" और छपने वाले notes।

keyActions.en: Under "Items" add one line per item: Description, Qty, Unit, Machine (optional), Equipment, Serial no., Approx. value ₹, Remarks.
keyActions.hi: "Items" में हर सामान की एक लाइन: Description, Qty, Unit, Machine (वैकल्पिक), Equipment, Serial no., Approx. value ₹, Remarks।

keyActions.en: Press "Save as draft", or "Save and issue" to get the number at once. Then print it on the next screen.
keyActions.hi: "Save as draft" या तुरंत नंबर के लिए "Save and issue" दबाएँ। फिर अगली स्क्रीन पर print करें।

help.en: Repair, calibration, fabrication, trial, loan for RGP; scrap sale, sample, return to supplier for NRGP. Scrap sale is not allowed on an RGP.
help.hi: RGP: repair, calibration, fabrication, trial, loan; NRGP: scrap sale, sample, supplier को वापसी। RGP पर scrap sale नहीं।

help.en: Link the machine when the part belongs to one, so its machine history shows the trip.
help.hi: पुर्ज़ा किसी मशीन का हो तो मशीन जोड़ें, ताकि machine history में दिखे।

help.en: Required for RGP; cannot be in the past. After it passes the pass shows Overdue.
help.hi: RGP के लिए ज़रूरी; पिछली तारीख़ नहीं। निकलने पर pass Overdue दिखता है।

error.en: A returnable gate pass needs an expected return date.
error.hi: A returnable gate pass needs an expected return date.

reason.en: Fill "Expected back by".
reason.hi: "Expected back by" भरें।

error.en: Choose a vendor or type who the items go to.
error.hi: Choose a vendor or type who the items go to.

reason.en: Pick a vendor or type the party name.
reason.hi: Vendor चुनें या party का नाम लिखें।

error.en: Scrap sale items do not come back. Use a non-returnable gate pass (NRGP).
error.hi: Scrap sale items do not come back. Use a non-returnable gate pass (NRGP).

reason.en: Switch the type to NRGP.
reason.hi: Type को NRGP करें।

error.en: Enter a valid 15-character GSTIN or leave it blank.
error.hi: Enter a valid 15-character GSTIN or leave it blank.

reason.en: Correct the GSTIN or clear it.
reason.hi: GSTIN ठीक करें या खाली छोड़ें।

error.en: Draft saved, but it could not be issued: …
error.hi: Draft saved, but it could not be issued: …

reason.en: The draft exists; press "Issue" on the next screen after fixing the reason shown.
reason.hi: Draft बन गया है; बताया कारण ठीक करके अगली स्क्रीन पर "Issue" दबाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: If a save says it is not confirmed (network drop), press the same button again (it now reads "Send same request again" or similar). The system knows the retry and never records twice.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर सेव "not confirmed" दिखाए (नेटवर्क टूटा), तो वही बटन दोबारा दबाएँ (अब उस पर "Send same request again" जैसा लिखा होगा)। सिस्टम दोबारा भेजा गया request पहचानता है और दो बार दर्ज नहीं करता।

summary.en: Register of spares, machinery, tools, services and charges: what came in or what work was done, who confirmed it, when, and on which machine. These never change stock.
summary.hi: Spares, machinery, औज़ार, service और charges का रजिस्टर: क्या आया या क्या काम हुआ, किसने पुष्टि की, कब और किस मशीन पर। इनसे स्टॉक नहीं बदलता।

purpose.en: Open it to find a past non-stock purchase or to see a machine's full history of spares, service visits and gate-pass trips.
purpose.hi: पुरानी non-stock खरीद ढूँढने या किसी मशीन के spares, service और gate-pass आने-जाने का पूरा इतिहास देखने के लिए खोलें।

prerequisites.en: Bills & documents rights: Inventory (STORE) has them by default; Owner and Admin always. Other roles or people need documents rights given in the Role matrix or User overrides. A watchman never sees this screen.
prerequisites.hi: Bills & documents के अधिकार: Inventory (STORE) के पास पहले से होते हैं, Owner और Admin के पास हमेशा। किसी और role या व्यक्ति को Role matrix या User overrides में documents अधिकार देने पड़ते हैं। Watchman को यह स्क्रीन कभी नहीं दिखती।

keyActions.en: On "Receipts" search GR no., party, invoice, item or serial.
keyActions.hi: "Receipts" में GR no., party, invoice, item या serial से खोजें।

keyActions.en: Filter by type (Goods / Services), line type, status (Posted / Reversed), factory and dates.
keyActions.hi: Type (Goods / Services), line type, status (Posted / Reversed), factory और तारीख़ से छाँटें।

keyActions.en: Click a receipt to open, print or (Owner/Admin) reverse it.
keyActions.hi: Receipt पर क्लिक करके खोलें, print करें या (Owner/Admin) reverse करें।

keyActions.en: On "Machine history" choose the factory and machine to see every spare, service and gate-pass movement, newest first.
keyActions.hi: "Machine history" में factory और machine चुनें; हर spare, service और gate-pass आवाजाही, नई पहले।

keyActions.en: Press "New general receipt" (documents manage right) to record one without a bill; normally start it from the bill.
keyActions.hi: बिना बिल के दर्ज करने के लिए "New general receipt" (documents manage अधिकार); सामान्यतः बिल से शुरू करें।

help.en: Total including GST on the right of each row.
help.hi: हर row के दाईं ओर GST सहित कुल।

help.en: Spares and parts, Machinery / equipment, Tools, General consumable, Safety items, Electrical, Civil / building, Office / admin, Service / labour, Freight / other charge.
help.hi: Spares and parts, Machinery / equipment, Tools, General consumable, Safety items, Electrical, Civil / building, Office / admin, Service / labour, Freight / other charge।

help.en: Receipt lines (reversed ones struck through) and "Left on gate pass" / "Came back on gate pass" events.
help.hi: Receipt लाइनें (reversed कटी हुई) और "Left on gate pass" / "Came back on gate pass" घटनाएँ।

error.en: General receipts are for the Inventory team
error.hi: General receipts are for the Inventory team

reason.en: No documents view right; ask the administrator.
reason.hi: Documents देखने का अधिकार नहीं; administrator से पूछें।

error.en: No general receipts
error.hi: No general receipts

reason.en: Nothing for these filters. Clear filters or widen the dates.
reason.hi: इन filter में कुछ नहीं। Filter हटाएँ या तारीख़ बढ़ाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: A receipt is missing from a machine's history: open it and check the line has that machine chosen.
recoverySteps.hi: मशीन के इतिहास में receipt नहीं: receipt खोलकर देखें लाइन में वह मशीन चुनी है या नहीं।

summary.en: A read-only, printable general receipt with its lines, GST, machine and gate-pass links and its bill.
summary.hi: केवल-पढ़ने वाली, print होने वाली general receipt — लाइनें, GST, machine और gate-pass link और उसका बिल।

purpose.en: Proof of what was received or what work was done. Mistakes are corrected only by reversal; nothing is deleted.
purpose.hi: क्या आया या क्या काम हुआ इसका सबूत। गलती सिर्फ़ reverse से ठीक होती है; कुछ delete नहीं होता।

prerequisites.en: Bills & documents rights: Inventory (STORE) has them by default; Owner and Admin always. Other roles or people need documents rights given in the Role matrix or User overrides. A watchman never sees this screen.
prerequisites.hi: Bills & documents के अधिकार: Inventory (STORE) के पास पहले से होते हैं, Owner और Admin के पास हमेशा। किसी और role या व्यक्ति को Role matrix या User overrides में documents अधिकार देने पड़ते हैं। Watchman को यह स्क्रीन कभी नहीं दिखती।

keyActions.en: Check the header: number, factory, Posted / Reversed, "No stock posted".
keyActions.hi: ऊपर देखें: नंबर, factory, Posted / Reversed, "No stock posted"।

keyActions.en: Check Party, Bill / invoice, Bill in register, Received by (or Work confirmed by), Received at, Recorded by and PO / work order.
keyActions.hi: Party, Bill / invoice, Bill in register, Received by (या Work confirmed by), Received at, Recorded by और PO / work order देखें।

keyActions.en: Check lines: Description, Type, Qty, Rate, Amount, GST, Machine / equipment, What happened; totals Before GST, GST, Total.
keyActions.hi: लाइनें देखें: Description, Type, Qty, Rate, Amount, GST, Machine / equipment, What happened; कुल Before GST, GST, Total।

keyActions.en: Press "Print" for the file copy (signature lines are printed).
keyActions.hi: फ़ाइल के लिए "Print" दबाएँ (हस्ताक्षर की लाइनें छपती हैं)।

keyActions.en: Owner/Admin: press "Reverse…", write a reason (5–500 characters) and "Reverse receipt".
keyActions.hi: Owner/Admin: "Reverse…" दबाएँ, कारण (5–500 अक्षर) लिखें और "Reverse receipt"।

help.en: Link to the bill; "Not linked yet" if made without one; notes when it follows up an old non-stock void.
help.hi: बिल का link; बिना बिल बनी हो तो "Not linked yet"; पुराने non-stock void का follow-up हो तो लिखा होता है।

help.en: Kept in store, Installed / fitted, Used immediately, Not applicable.
help.hi: Kept in store, Installed / fitted, Used immediately, Not applicable।

error.en: … recorded items coming back on gate pass …, so it cannot be reversed.
error.hi: … recorded items coming back on gate pass …, so it cannot be reversed.

reason.en: Reversing would not undo the return. Correct the gate pass with an owner first and record a fresh receipt if needed.
reason.hi: Reverse करने से वापसी नहीं हटेगी। पहले owner के साथ gate pass ठीक करें और ज़रूरत हो तो नई receipt बनाएँ।

error.en: Only an owner or administrator can reverse a General Receipt.
error.hi: Only an owner or administrator can reverse a General Receipt.

reason.en: Ask the Owner/Admin.
reason.hi: Owner/Admin से कहें।

error.en: General receipt not found
error.hi: General receipt not found

reason.en: Wrong link or a factory outside your access.
reason.hi: गलत link या आपकी पहुँच से बाहर की factory।

recoverySteps.en: After a reversal the bill goes back to waiting (or partly received); record a new receipt from the bill.
recoverySteps.hi: Reverse के बाद बिल फिर waiting (या partly received) हो जाता है; बिल से नई receipt बनाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: If a save says it is not confirmed (network drop), press the same button again (it now reads "Send same request again" or similar). The system knows the retry and never records twice.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर सेव "not confirmed" दिखाए (नेटवर्क टूटा), तो वही बटन दोबारा दबाएँ (अब उस पर "Send same request again" जैसा लिखा होगा)। सिस्टम दोबारा भेजा गया request पहचानता है और दो बार दर्ज नहीं करता।

summary.en: Record goods received or service work done against a bill, with the bill beside the form. It never touches production stock.
summary.hi: बिल को बगल में रखकर आया माल या हुआ service काम दर्ज करें। इससे production स्टॉक नहीं बदलता।

purpose.en: Opened from a classified bill ("Create general receipt"), from a non-stock follow-up, or empty. It records what arrived, who received or confirmed it, where it went and on which machine, and can close returnable gate-pass lines.
purpose.hi: Classified बिल ("Create general receipt"), non-stock follow-up या खाली खुलता है। क्या आया, किसने लिया या पुष्टि की, कहाँ गया और किस मशीन पर — यह दर्ज करता है, और returnable gate-pass लाइनें बंद कर सकता है।

prerequisites.en: Bills & documents rights: Inventory (STORE) has them by default; Owner and Admin always. Other roles or people need documents rights given in the Role matrix or User overrides. A watchman never sees this screen.
prerequisites.hi: Bills & documents के अधिकार: Inventory (STORE) के पास पहले से होते हैं, Owner और Admin के पास हमेशा। किसी और role या व्यक्ति को Role matrix या User overrides में documents अधिकार देने पड़ते हैं। Watchman को यह स्क्रीन कभी नहीं दिखती।

prerequisites.en: Recording needs the documents manage right. The bill must be classified as spares, machinery or service and still open.
prerequisites.hi: दर्ज करने के लिए documents manage अधिकार चाहिए। बिल spares, machinery या service में classified और खुला होना चाहिए।

keyActions.en: Under "What came in?" choose "Goods" or "Service / work done".
keyActions.hi: "What came in?" में "Goods" या "Service / work done" चुनें।

keyActions.en: Check the factory, vendor or party, "Bill / invoice number" and "Bill date" (filled from the bill).
keyActions.hi: Factory, vendor या party, "Bill / invoice number" और "Bill date" जाँचें (बिल से भरे आते हैं)।

keyActions.en: Set "Received by" / "Work confirmed by" and "Received at"; add PO / work order reference and a note if any.
keyActions.hi: "Received by" / "Work confirmed by" और "Received at" डालें; PO / work order reference और note हो तो लिखें।

keyActions.en: In "Lines" fill Description (suggestions from past receipts), Type, Qty, Unit, Rate (₹), GST % — Amount = Qty × Rate.
keyActions.hi: "Lines" में Description (पुरानी receipts से सुझाव), Type, Qty, Unit, Rate (₹), GST % भरें — Amount = Qty × Rate।

keyActions.en: Choose "What happened" and the "Machine" (or "Equipment (if not a listed machine)"); add serial and remarks.
keyActions.hi: "What happened" और "Machine" (या "Equipment (if not a listed machine)") चुनें; serial और remarks जोड़ें।

keyActions.en: If the item came back on an RGP, tick "Came back on a returnable gate pass (RGP)", choose the line and the returned quantity.
keyActions.hi: सामान RGP पर लौटा हो तो "Came back on a returnable gate pass (RGP)" टिक करें, लाइन और लौटी मात्रा चुनें।

keyActions.en: Press "Add line" for more. Tick "This receipt completes the bill" only if every bill line is covered.
keyActions.hi: और लाइन के लिए "Add line"। "This receipt completes the bill" तभी टिक करें जब बिल की हर लाइन पूरी हो।

keyActions.en: Press "Save general receipt" (or "Save receipt & complete bill"), then "Open receipt".
keyActions.hi: "Save general receipt" (या "Save receipt & complete bill") दबाएँ, फिर "Open receipt"।

help.en: Line category, e.g. Spares and parts, Tools, Service / labour, Freight / other charge.
help.hi: लाइन की श्रेणी, जैसे Spares and parts, Tools, Service / labour, Freight / other charge।

help.en: NOS, PCS, SET, PAIR, KG, LTR, MTR, BOX, ROLL, JOB, HRS, VISIT, LOT.
help.hi: NOS, PCS, SET, PAIR, KG, LTR, MTR, BOX, ROLL, JOB, HRS, VISIT, LOT।

help.en: Kept in store, Installed / fitted (machine or equipment required), Used immediately, Not applicable (services).
help.hi: Kept in store, Installed / fitted (machine या equipment ज़रूरी), Used immediately, Not applicable (service)।

help.en: Before GST, GST and Total at the bottom.
help.hi: नीचे Before GST, GST और Total।

error.en: Amount must equal quantity × rate = …
error.hi: Amount must equal quantity × rate = …

reason.en: Correct the quantity or rate.
reason.hi: Qty या rate ठीक करें।

error.en: A service receipt needs at least one Service / labour line.
error.hi: A service receipt needs at least one Service / labour line.

reason.en: Set one line's type to Service / labour, or switch to Goods.
reason.hi: किसी एक लाइन का type Service / labour करें, या Goods चुनें।

error.en: A goods receipt needs at least one goods line (not only service or freight).
error.hi: A goods receipt needs at least one goods line (not only service or freight).

reason.en: Add a goods line or switch to Service.
reason.hi: Goods लाइन जोड़ें या Service चुनें।

error.en: Choose the machine (or type the equipment) it was installed on.
error.hi: Choose the machine (or type the equipment) it was installed on.

reason.en: Installed lines need a machine or equipment name.
reason.hi: Installed लाइन में machine या equipment का नाम चाहिए।

error.en: Only … of line … is still out on …
error.hi: Only … of line … is still out on …

reason.en: You cannot return more than is still out on the RGP line.
reason.hi: RGP लाइन पर बाहर बची मात्रा से ज़्यादा वापसी नहीं हो सकती।

error.en: Received time cannot be in the future.
error.hi: Received time cannot be in the future.

reason.en: Fix "Received at".
reason.hi: "Received at" ठीक करें।

error.en: Give a reason to receive a bill whose invoice is already recorded (or void this bill as a duplicate).
error.hi: Give a reason to receive a bill whose invoice is already recorded (or void this bill as a duplicate).

reason.en: Fill the reason in "Same invoice already recorded" or void the bill as duplicate.
reason.hi: "Same invoice already recorded" में कारण लिखें या बिल को duplicate void करें।

error.en: This bill is classified as record-only paper … Change its category before receiving against it.
error.hi: This bill is classified as record-only paper … Change its category before receiving against it.

reason.en: Go back to the bill and change the category to spares, machinery or service.
reason.hi: बिल पर लौटकर category spares, machinery या service करें।

recoverySteps.en: If a save says it is not confirmed (network drop), press the same button again (it now reads "Send same request again" or similar). The system knows the retry and never records twice.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर सेव "not confirmed" दिखाए (नेटवर्क टूटा), तो वही बटन दोबारा दबाएँ (अब उस पर "Send same request again" जैसा लिखा होगा)। सिस्टम दोबारा भेजा गया request पहचानता है और दो बार दर्ज नहीं करता।

recoverySteps.en: "I checked — it was not saved, unlock the form" only after checking General receipts does not show it.
recoverySteps.hi: "I checked — it was not saved, unlock the form" तभी दबाएँ जब General receipts में यह न दिखे।

summary.en: One list of everything of ours outside a factory gate and what is due back: inter-plant transfers, job work, returnable and non-returnable gate passes.
summary.hi: फैक्ट्री गेट के बाहर गया हमारा हर माल और जो लौटना है, एक सूची में: inter-plant transfer, job work, returnable और non-returnable gate pass।

purpose.en: See at a glance what is outside, what is back at a gate waiting for the store, what paper is made but not left, and what is late. Each paper keeps its own screen; open the row to work on it.
purpose.hi: एक नज़र में देखें: क्या बाहर है, क्या गेट पर लौटकर store का इंतज़ार कर रहा है, कौन सा काग़ज़ बना पर माल नहीं निकला, और क्या देर से है। हर काग़ज़ की अपनी स्क्रीन है; row खोलकर काम करें।

prerequisites.en: Inventory view right. "New movement" needs inventory manage or the gate pass right.
prerequisites.hi: Inventory देखने का अधिकार। "New movement" के लिए inventory manage या gate pass अधिकार।

keyActions.en: Pick a stage: "Outside", "Back at gate", "Prepared" or "Done" (each shows a count).
keyActions.hi: Stage चुनें: "Outside", "Back at gate", "Prepared" या "Done" (हर एक पर गिनती)।

keyActions.en: Search number, party, vehicle or job; use the chips All, Inter-plant, Job work, Returnable, Non-returnable.
keyActions.hi: Number, party, vehicle या job खोजें; chips All, Inter-plant, Job work, Returnable, Non-returnable।

keyActions.en: Press "Late" to see returns past due and loads in transit too long.
keyActions.hi: तय तारीख़ से देर वाली वापसी और लंबे समय रास्ते में माल देखने के लिए "Late" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Press "Open" (or "Receive" for rows back at the gate) to work on the paper in its own screen.
keyActions.hi: काग़ज़ उसकी स्क्रीन पर खोलने के लिए "Open" (गेट पर लौटे row के लिए "Receive") दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: If the watchman could not scan the paper, use "Mark back at gate" on the row; the store is told to receive it. Nothing moves in stock.
keyActions.hi: Watchman काग़ज़ scan न कर पाया हो तो row पर "Mark back at gate" दबाएँ; store को receive करने की सूचना जाती है। स्टॉक नहीं बदलता।

keyActions.en: "New movement" asks "What is leaving?": another factory (Inter-plant challan), a job worker (job-work order and challan), a part that comes back (RGP), something that does not (NRGP), or goods to a customer (Dispatch bay).
keyActions.hi: "New movement" पूछता है "What is leaving?": दूसरी factory (Inter-plant challan), job worker (job-work order और challan), लौटने वाला पुर्ज़ा (RGP), न लौटने वाला (NRGP), या ग्राहक को माल (Dispatch bay)।

help.en: Outside = in transit, at a job worker or out on a pass; Back at gate = arrived, store still to receive; Prepared = paper made, goods not left; Done = received, returned or closed.
help.hi: Outside = रास्ते में, job worker के पास या pass पर बाहर; Back at gate = पहुँचा, store को receive करना है; Prepared = काग़ज़ बना, माल नहीं निकला; Done = received, returned या closed।

help.en: When it left; "no gate scan" means the gate did not record it.
help.hi: कब निकला; "no gate scan" = गेट ने दर्ज नहीं किया।

help.en: Expected return date; a red Late tag when past due (hover for the note).
help.hi: लौटने की तारीख़; देर होने पर लाल Late (नोट के लिए माउस रखें)।

help.en: Rows created automatically by a job route step or production.
help.hi: Job route step या production से अपने-आप बनी rows।

error.en: Not recorded (after Mark back at gate)
error.hi: Not recorded (Mark back at gate के बाद)

reason.en: The paper is already received or belongs to another factory's gate. Open the row to check.
reason.hi: काग़ज़ पहले ही receive हो चुका है या दूसरी factory के गेट का है। Row खोलकर देखें।

recoverySteps.en: If a save says it is not confirmed (network drop), press the same button again (it now reads "Send same request again" or similar). The system knows the retry and never records twice.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर सेव "not confirmed" दिखाए (नेटवर्क टूटा), तो वही बटन दोबारा दबाएँ (अब उस पर "Send same request again" जैसा लिखा होगा)। सिस्टम दोबारा भेजा गया request पहचानता है और दो बार दर्ज नहीं करता।

recoverySteps.en: If the list looks old, reload before acting on it.
recoverySteps.hi: सूची पुरानी लगे तो काम से पहले reload करें।

summary.en: One form to receive a supplier invoice into stock: film rolls, bulk material, packaging or trading goods. Totals, GST, freight and the post button stay in the bar at the bottom.
summary.hi: सप्लायर के एक बिल का माल स्टॉक में लेने का एक ही फ़ॉर्म: film roll, bulk माल, packaging या trading goods। Total, GST, freight और post बटन नीचे की पट्टी में रहते हैं।

purpose.en: Open it when goods arrive at the store against a purchase order, a vendor's own PO reference or no PO. Posting creates the rolls / stock rows and the ledger entries. If the bill was first photographed at the gate, open it from Bills & documents so the bill sits beside the form and gets linked in the same save. Job-work returns are not received here (use Job work → Receive) and inter-plant receipts are received in Inter-plant.
purpose.hi: जब स्टोर में माल PO, vendor के PO नंबर या बिना PO के आए, तब यह पेज खोलें। Post करते ही roll / stock की लाइन और ledger entry बनती है। अगर बिल gate पर फोटो हुआ था, तो उसे Bills & documents से खोलें — बिल फ़ॉर्म के बगल में दिखेगा और उसी save में जुड़ जाएगा। Job worker से लौटा माल यहाँ नहीं लिया जाता (Job work → Receive), और दूसरे plant से आया माल Inter-plant में लिया जाता है।

prerequisites.en: Vendor exists, is active and is of type Raw Material (RM) or Hybrid (BOTH).
prerequisites.hi: Vendor बना हो, active हो और उसका type Raw Material (RM) या Hybrid (BOTH) हो।

prerequisites.en: Material masters exist: film variants for rolls, bulk categories (granule, ink, adhesive, solvent, POD, purchased add-on) and packaging items.
prerequisites.hi: Material master बने हों: roll के लिए film variant, bulk (granule, ink, adhesive, solvent, POD, purchased add-on) और packaging item।

prerequisites.en: A receiving warehouse (store location) of the right plant; virtual locations are refused.
prerequisites.hi: सही plant का receiving warehouse (store location) हो; virtual location नहीं चलती।

prerequisites.en: For 'Against system PO' the PO must be sent / acknowledged / partly received and still have open quantity for this stock class.
prerequisites.hi: 'Against system PO' के लिए PO sent / acknowledged / partly received हो और इस stock class की बाकी मात्रा बची हो।

prerequisites.en: Inventory manage or purchase receipt rights.
prerequisites.hi: Inventory manage या purchase receipt का अधिकार।

keyActions.en: 1. Pick the stock class: "Bulk material", "Film roll", "Packaging" or "Trading goods".
keyActions.hi: 1. Stock class चुनें: "Bulk material", "Film roll", "Packaging" या "Trading goods"।

keyActions.en: 2. Under "Where is this coming from?" choose "Against system PO", "Manual vendor PO ref" or "Direct receipt", then fill vendor, "Vendor invoice #", "Vendor invoice date", "LR / vehicle / driver" and "Receiving warehouse".
keyActions.hi: 2. "Where is this coming from?" में "Against system PO", "Manual vendor PO ref" या "Direct receipt" चुनें, फिर vendor, "Vendor invoice #", "Vendor invoice date", "LR / vehicle / driver" और "Receiving warehouse" भरें।

keyActions.en: 3. Under "What did you actually receive?" fill the first line. For rolls use the fast roll grid: film variant, stock form, width, micron, gross, tare (net fills itself), length, grade, location, rate. Enter on the last field starts the next roll as a copy, so only weights change.
keyActions.hi: 3. "What did you actually receive?" में पहली लाइन भरें। Roll के लिए fast grid: film variant, stock form, width, micron, gross, tare (net अपने आप), length, grade, location, rate। आख़िरी खाने पर Enter दबाने से अगला roll उसी की copy बनकर आता है, सिर्फ़ वज़न बदलें।

keyActions.en: 4. Many rolls at once: paste rows from Excel into the grid, or use "Live template" then "Upload Excel"; check the "Excel validated · review before posting" list.
keyActions.hi: 4. बहुत सारे roll हों तो Excel से rows paste करें, या "Live template" लेकर "Upload Excel" करें; "Excel validated · review before posting" वाली सूची जाँचें।

keyActions.en: 5. Open "QC checks & documents" only when a COA, lab values (density, MFI, moisture) or inspector notes are needed.
keyActions.hi: 5. "QC checks & documents" तभी खोलें जब COA, lab values (density, MFI, moisture) या inspector की नोट चाहिए।

keyActions.en: 6. Check "Costs & taxes": material subtotal, GST, freight, other charges, grand total.
keyActions.hi: 6. "Costs & taxes" जाँचें: material subtotal, GST, freight, other charges, grand total।

keyActions.en: 7. When the bottom bar shows "Ready to post" (all chips ✓), press "Submit & post" (Ctrl/⌘+Enter). Trading goods post with "Post from trading row".
keyActions.hi: 7. नीचे की पट्टी में "Ready to post" (सभी chip ✓) दिखे तो "Submit & post" दबाएँ (Ctrl/⌘+Enter)। Trading goods "Post from trading row" से post होते हैं।

keyActions.en: 8. The green "Posted GRN-…" box confirms the quantity and movements; download roll labels there if needed. The form resets for the next receipt.
keyActions.hi: 8. हरा "Posted GRN-…" बॉक्स मात्रा और movements दिखाता है; ज़रूरत हो तो वहीं से roll label लें। फ़ॉर्म अगली रसीद के लिए खाली हो जाता है।

help.en: Decides the grid: rolls (one row per physical roll), bulk/packaging (one row per material and location) or a trading-good row.
help.hi: इससे grid तय होता है: roll (हर असली roll की एक लाइन), bulk/packaging (हर material और location की एक लाइन) या trading की लाइन।

help.en: Against system PO locks lines to the PO's open lines; Manual vendor PO ref only stores the vendor's reference; Direct receipt has no PO.
help.hi: Against system PO में लाइनें PO की बाकी लाइनों से बँध जाती हैं; Manual vendor PO ref में सिर्फ़ vendor का नंबर रहता है; Direct receipt में PO नहीं।

help.en: Checked for duplicates per vendor; the same invoice number cannot be received twice for one vendor.
help.hi: हर vendor के लिए duplicate जाँच होती है; एक vendor का एक invoice नंबर दो बार नहीं लिया जा सकता।

help.en: The plant is taken from this warehouse. With a gate bill linked, only the bill's factory locations are offered.
help.hi: Plant इसी warehouse से तय होता है। Gate bill जुड़ा हो तो सिर्फ़ उसी factory की location मिलती हैं।

help.en: Optional number printed on the supplier's roll; it is the physical identity used to find the roll later.
help.hi: Supplier के roll पर छपा नंबर (वैकल्पिक); बाद में roll ढूँढने के लिए यही पहचान है।

help.en: Open web / sheet, Lay-flat tube or Folded web. Width is read as open width, lay-flat width or folded width accordingly.
help.hi: Open web / sheet, Lay-flat tube या Folded web। उसी हिसाब से width open, lay-flat या folded मानी जाती है।

field.en: Gross kg / Tare kg / Net kg auto
field.hi: Gross kg / Tare kg / Net kg auto

help.en: Net = gross − tare. Gross must equal net + tare within 0.05 kg.
help.hi: Net = gross − tare। Gross, net + tare के 0.05 kg के अंदर होना चाहिए।

help.en: Required for extrudable film variants.
help.hi: Extrudable film variant के लिए ज़रूरी।

help.en: Quality / inward code of a granule; must be active and belong to that granule.
help.hi: Granule का quality / inward code; active हो और उसी granule का हो।

field.en: Download 4 × 2 inch roll labels after saving inward (optional)
field.hi: Download 4 × 2 inch roll labels after saving inward (optional)

help.en: Tick to get roll labels right after posting. Labels are optional; a roll can be identified by supplier number or handwritten ERP ID and location.
help.hi: Post के तुरंत बाद roll label चाहिए तो tick करें। Label ज़रूरी नहीं; roll को supplier नंबर या हाथ से लिखे ERP ID और location से पहचाना जा सकता है।

help.en: Vendor, Warehouse, System PO (when against PO), Materials, Qty, Period. Each must show ✓ before posting.
help.hi: Vendor, Warehouse, System PO (PO वाली रसीद में), Materials, Qty, Period। Post से पहले सब पर ✓ होना चाहिए।

help.en: Enter next field · Enter on last field = new line (copy) · Shift+Enter back · ↑ ↓ same field other line · Alt+↓ copy down · Alt+⌫ remove line · Ctrl/⌘+Enter receive.
help.hi: Enter अगला खाना · आख़िरी खाने पर Enter = नई लाइन (copy) · Shift+Enter पीछे · ↑ ↓ दूसरी लाइन का वही खाना · Alt+↓ नीचे copy · Alt+⌫ लाइन हटाएँ · Ctrl/⌘+Enter receive।

error.en: Duplicate vendor invoice '…' for vendor …
error.hi: Duplicate vendor invoice '…' for vendor …

reason.en: This invoice number was already received for this vendor. Check GRN history; correct the old GRN instead of posting again.
reason.hi: इस vendor का यह invoice पहले ही लिया जा चुका है। GRN history देखें; दोबारा post करने के बजाय पुरानी GRN सुधारें।

error.en: Vendor is required before posting GRN.
error.hi: Vendor is required before posting GRN.

reason.en: Pick the vendor in the Source section.
reason.hi: Source हिस्से में vendor चुनें।

error.en: GRN vendor must be RM or BOTH type.
error.hi: GRN vendor must be RM or BOTH type.

reason.en: A job-worker or service vendor cannot supply stock. Change the vendor type in Vendors or pick the right vendor.
reason.hi: Job worker या service vendor से stock नहीं आता। Vendors में type बदलें या सही vendor चुनें।

error.en: Roll gross weight must equal net + tare within 0.05 KG.
error.hi: Roll gross weight must equal net + tare within 0.05 KG.

reason.en: Re-weigh or fix gross / tare; leave net to fill itself.
reason.hi: दोबारा तौलें या gross / tare ठीक करें; net को अपने आप भरने दें।

error.en: Roll label … already exists.
error.hi: Roll label … already exists.

reason.en: The label is already used by another roll. Leave the label blank so the system numbers it.
reason.hi: यह label किसी दूसरे roll पर है। Label खाली छोड़ें, सिस्टम नंबर देगा।

error.en: Grade is required for extrudable film variants.
error.hi: Grade is required for extrudable film variants.

reason.en: Pick the grade on that roll line.
reason.hi: उस roll लाइन में grade चुनें।

error.en: Selected PO has no receivable lines for this stock class.
error.hi: Selected PO has no receivable lines for this stock class.

reason.en: The PO is fully received or is for another class. Pick another PO or use Direct receipt.
reason.hi: PO पूरा आ चुका है या दूसरी class का है। दूसरा PO चुनें या Direct receipt करें।

error.en: Use the receiving grid while a gate bill is linked. Excel posting does not link this bill.
error.hi: Use the receiving grid while a gate bill is linked. Excel posting does not link this bill.

reason.en: Enter the rolls in the grid (paste works) so the bill gets linked.
reason.hi: Roll grid में भरें (paste चलता है) ताकि बिल जुड़ जाए।

error.en: Stock saved; label download needs retry
error.hi: Stock saved; label download needs retry

reason.en: The GRN is posted. Use "Download all labels" on the saved receipt; do not post again.
reason.hi: GRN post हो चुकी है। Saved receipt पर "Download all labels" दबाएँ; दोबारा post न करें।

error.en: Master data did not load.
error.hi: Master data did not load.

reason.en: Vendors, materials or locations could not be fetched. Refresh; if it repeats tell the admin.
reason.hi: Vendor, material या location नहीं आ पाए। Refresh करें; बार-बार हो तो admin को बताएँ।

recoverySteps.en: If posting times out, check GRN history for the invoice before pressing again.
recoverySteps.hi: Post करते समय time out हो तो दोबारा दबाने से पहले GRN history में invoice देखें।

recoverySteps.en: A wrong quantity, rate or roll spec after posting is fixed with "Correct" in GRN history, not with a new GRN.
recoverySteps.hi: Post के बाद गलत मात्रा, rate या roll spec को GRN history के "Correct" से सुधारें, नई GRN से नहीं।

recoverySteps.en: If a material or vendor is missing from the pickers, ask the admin to add or activate the master.
recoverySteps.hi: Picker में material या vendor न दिखे तो admin से master बनवाएँ या active करवाएँ।

summary.en: Every inward GRN row — roll, bulk, packaging and trading — with filters, totals and audited corrections until the financial year closes.
summary.hi: हर inward GRN लाइन — roll, bulk, packaging और trading — filter, total और audit वाले सुधार के साथ, जब तक financial year बंद न हो।

purpose.en: Use it to find what came in (by source, time window, plant, vendor or search), export it, and correct a posted GRN row. The original GRN stays locked; a correction posts a separate entry with before, after, delta, user and reason.
purpose.hi: यहाँ देखें कि क्या माल आया (source, समय, plant, vendor या search से), CSV निकालें, और post हुई GRN लाइन सुधारें। असली GRN बदलती नहीं; सुधार एक अलग entry बनाता है जिसमें पहले, बाद, फ़र्क, user और कारण रहता है।

prerequisites.en: GRNs posted from Smart GRN.
prerequisites.hi: Smart GRN से post हुई GRN।

prerequisites.en: Correcting needs inventory manage rights and an open financial year.
prerequisites.hi: सुधार के लिए inventory manage अधिकार और खुला financial year चाहिए।

keyActions.en: 1. Pick "Source" (All, Roll, Bulk, Packaging, Trading) and "Time window" (Today, 7 days, 30 days, This FY, All time) in the left rail; add plant / vendor filters or search.
keyActions.hi: 1. बाएँ rail में "Source" (All, Roll, Bulk, Packaging, Trading) और "Time window" (Today, 7 days, 30 days, This FY, All time) चुनें; plant / vendor filter या search लगाएँ।

keyActions.en: 2. Read the tiles: inward rows, total qty, roll / bulk / packaging GRNs, top vendors.
keyActions.hi: 2. ऊपर के tile देखें: inward rows, total qty, roll / bulk / packaging GRN, top vendors।

keyActions.en: 3. Use Export for a CSV of the history.
keyActions.hi: 3. CSV के लिए Export दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: 4. On a wrong row press "Correct" to open "Correct GRN row".
keyActions.hi: 4. गलत लाइन पर "Correct" दबाकर "Correct GRN row" खोलें।

keyActions.en: 5. Enter the corrected quantity / unit rate, or for rolls the label, batch, width, micron, length or roll form; optionally move plant / location.
keyActions.hi: 5. सही मात्रा / unit rate भरें, या roll के लिए label, batch, width, micron, length या roll form; चाहें तो plant / location बदलें।

keyActions.en: 6. Choose "Reason code · required" and write "Reason · required", then press "Post correction".
keyActions.hi: 6. "Reason code · required" चुनें, "Reason · required" लिखें, फिर "Post correction" दबाएँ।

help.en: The value after all earlier corrections; the row shows "corrected effective" when changed.
help.hi: पहले हुए सभी सुधारों के बाद की मात्रा/rate; बदली हो तो "corrected effective" दिखता है।

help.en: Rows of a closed financial year are read-only.
help.hi: बंद financial year की लाइनें सिर्फ़ पढ़ने के लिए हैं।

help.en: Quantity mismatch, Rate mismatch, Roll identity/spec correction, Other approved correction.
help.hi: Quantity mismatch, Rate mismatch, Roll identity/spec correction, Other approved correction।

help.en: "Keep current plant" / "Keep current location" unless the goods were booked to the wrong place.
help.hi: माल गलत जगह चढ़ा हो तभी बदलें, वरना "Keep current plant" / "Keep current location" रहने दें।

help.en: Save a filter set by name and pin it.
help.hi: Filter का सेट नाम से save और pin करें।

error.en: Reason is required before this correction can post.
error.hi: Reason is required before this correction can post.

reason.en: Write the reason; it is kept in the audit trail.
reason.hi: कारण लिखें; यह audit में रहता है।

error.en: This roll already has genealogy or consumption history. Use stock count / correction instead.
error.hi: This roll already has genealogy or consumption history. Use stock count / correction instead.

reason.en: The roll has been used or split. Fix it with a stock count or adjustment.
reason.hi: Roll इस्तेमाल या split हो चुका है। Stock count या adjustment से सुधारें।

error.en: Consumed or scrapped rolls cannot be corrected from GRN history.
error.hi: Consumed or scrapped rolls cannot be corrected from GRN history.

reason.en: Use the stock count / correction route.
reason.hi: Stock count / correction से करें।

error.en: Corrected roll weight must be greater than zero.
error.hi: Corrected roll weight must be greater than zero.

reason.en: Enter a positive weight; to remove a roll use a stock adjustment.
reason.hi: Positive वज़न भरें; roll हटाना हो तो stock adjustment करें।

error.en: Cannot reduce this trading-good GRN below already dispatched/adjusted stock.
error.hi: Cannot reduce this trading-good GRN below already dispatched/adjusted stock.

reason.en: Part of the stock is already gone; reduce only what is still in stock.
reason.hi: कुछ माल जा चुका है; सिर्फ़ बचे माल तक घटाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: No rows? Widen the time window to "All time" and clear the chips.
recoverySteps.hi: कोई लाइन नहीं? Time window "All time" करें और chip हटाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: A year-closed row needs an FY correction from Count and close → Year end; ask the owner.
recoverySteps.hi: बंद साल की लाइन के लिए Count and close → Year end से FY correction चाहिए; owner से पूछें।

summary.en: This old address opens Ink control (/production/ink-control). Ink issue, return and floor counts are done there.
summary.hi: यह पुराना पता Ink control (/production/ink-control) खोलता है। Ink issue, return और floor count वहीं होते हैं।

purpose.en: The ink floor screen was merged into Ink control so inks are issued, returned and counted in one place. The Floor menu link "Ink floor" still points here and forwards you.
purpose.hi: Ink floor स्क्रीन Ink control में मिला दी गई है ताकि ink का issue, return और count एक जगह हो। Floor menu का "Ink floor" लिंक अभी भी यहीं आता है और आगे भेज देता है।

prerequisites.en: Rights to open Ink control.
prerequisites.hi: Ink control खोलने का अधिकार।

keyActions.en: 1. Open "Ink floor" from the Floor menu or this address.
keyActions.hi: 1. Floor menu से "Ink floor" या यह पता खोलें।

keyActions.en: 2. You land on Ink control; do the issue, return or count there.
keyActions.hi: 2. आप Ink control पर पहुँचेंगे; issue, return या count वहीं करें।

keyActions.en: 3. The ink floor count proof for a date is also shown under Count and close → Stock count.
keyActions.hi: 3. किसी तारीख़ का ink floor count proof Count and close → Stock count में भी दिखता है।

keyActions.en: 4. Update any bookmark to /production/ink-control.
keyActions.hi: 4. अपना bookmark /production/ink-control पर बदल लें।

recoverySteps.en: If the redirect shows an access message, you lack Ink control rights; ask the admin.
recoverySteps.hi: Redirect पर access का संदेश आए तो Ink control का अधिकार नहीं है; admin से कहें।

summary.en: Move rolls and bulk stock from one plant to another on a delivery challan: draft, dispatch (stock goes to the source plant's IN_TRANSIT), then receive at the destination.
summary.hi: एक plant से दूसरे plant में roll और bulk माल delivery challan पर भेजें: draft, dispatch (माल source plant के IN_TRANSIT में जाता है), फिर destination पर receive।

purpose.en: Use it whenever material physically goes between plants. A roll cannot be moved to another plant any other way. Open challans block the financial-year close, so receive every in-transit challan.
purpose.hi: जब भी माल plant से plant जाए, यही पेज इस्तेमाल करें। Roll को दूसरे plant में किसी और तरीके से नहीं ले जा सकते। खुले challan financial year close रोकते हैं, इसलिए हर in-transit challan receive करें।

prerequisites.en: Both plants exist; plant legal profiles (GST, address) are set under "Plant Legal Profiles".
prerequisites.hi: दोनों plant बने हों; "Plant Legal Profiles" में GST, पता भरा हो।

prerequisites.en: Rolls are AVAILABLE, not empty, not quarantined and not reserved for a job.
prerequisites.hi: Roll AVAILABLE हों, खाली न हों, quarantine में न हों और किसी job के लिए reserved न हों।

prerequisites.en: The source plant has its IN_TRANSIT system location.
prerequisites.hi: Source plant में IN_TRANSIT system location हो।

prerequisites.en: Inventory or production rights.
prerequisites.hi: Inventory या production का अधिकार।

keyActions.en: 1. Press "New Transfer" → "Create Inter-Plant Challan".
keyActions.hi: 1. "New Transfer" दबाएँ → "Create Inter-Plant Challan"।

keyActions.en: 2. Pick "Source Plant", "Destination Plant" and "Material Type" (Rolls or Bulk), then the source and destination locations.
keyActions.hi: 2. "Source Plant", "Destination Plant" और "Material Type" (Rolls या Bulk) चुनें, फिर source और destination location।

keyActions.en: 3. Tick rolls under "Available Rolls" or enter "Qty kg" for bulk lines.
keyActions.hi: 3. "Available Rolls" में roll tick करें या bulk लाइन में "Qty kg" भरें।

keyActions.en: 4. Leave "Dispatch immediately after create" on to send now, or off to keep a draft.
keyActions.hi: 4. अभी भेजना है तो "Dispatch immediately after create" चालू रखें, नहीं तो draft बनेगा।

keyActions.en: 5. A draft card in the "Draft" column: press "Dispatch", pick lines, "Confirm Dispatch".
keyActions.hi: 5. "Draft" कॉलम के card पर "Dispatch" दबाएँ, लाइन चुनें, "Confirm Dispatch"।

keyActions.en: 6. Press "Print" for the challan PDF and QR sticker; the challan travels with the truck.
keyActions.hi: 6. Challan PDF और QR sticker के लिए "Print" दबाएँ; challan गाड़ी के साथ जाता है।
