keyActions.en: 7. At the destination, on the "In Transit" card press "Receive", choose "Target Location", tick "Transit Rolls" / "Transit Bulk" and press "Confirm Receipt".
keyActions.hi: 7. Destination पर "In Transit" card पर "Receive" दबाएँ, "Target Location" चुनें, "Transit Rolls" / "Transit Bulk" tick करें और "Confirm Receipt" दबाएँ।

field.en: Total Challans / Draft / In Transit / Received
field.hi: Total Challans / Draft / In Transit / Received

help.en: Counts of challans in each stage; the three columns below list them.
help.hi: हर stage के challan की गिनती; नीचे तीन कॉलम में सूची।

help.en: Marks a challan created automatically by the system.
help.hi: सिस्टम से अपने आप बना challan।

help.en: Unconsumed parent roll returned to reusable stock, shown as out / back.
help.hi: Parent roll का बचा हिस्सा जो फिर से इस्तेमाल के stock में लौटा, out / back में दिखता है।

help.en: Captured at create as guidance; the real place is chosen at receipt as Target Location.
help.hi: Create पर सिर्फ़ मार्गदर्शन के लिए; असली जगह receive पर Target Location में चुनी जाती है।

error.en: Source and destination must be different.
error.hi: Source and destination must be different.

reason.en: Pick two different plants.
reason.hi: दो अलग plant चुनें।

error.en: Roll … is not AVAILABLE. / has an active job reservation.
error.hi: Roll … is not AVAILABLE. / has an active job reservation.

reason.en: The roll is reserved or in process. Unreserve it on the WC terminal or pick another roll.
reason.hi: Roll reserved है या चल रहा है। WC terminal पर reservation हटाएँ या दूसरा roll चुनें।

error.en: Roll … is empty or quarantined.
error.hi: Roll … is empty or quarantined.

reason.en: Release the quarantine or choose another roll.
reason.hi: Quarantine हटवाएँ या दूसरा roll लें।

error.en: System location IN_TRANSIT not found for source plant.
error.hi: System location IN_TRANSIT not found for source plant.

reason.en: Ask the admin to add the IN_TRANSIT location for that plant.
reason.hi: Admin से उस plant में IN_TRANSIT location बनवाएँ।

error.en: Challan is not IN_TRANSIT.
error.hi: Challan is not IN_TRANSIT.

reason.en: It was already received or never dispatched. Refresh the page.
reason.hi: पहले ही receive हो चुका है या dispatch नहीं हुआ। Page refresh करें।

error.en: Select at least one pending challan line to receive.
error.hi: Select at least one pending challan line to receive.

reason.en: Tick the rolls / bulk that arrived.
reason.hi: जो roll / bulk आया उसे tick करें।

error.en: Popup blocked. Allow popups to print challan.
error.hi: Popup blocked. Allow popups to print challan.

reason.en: Allow pop-ups for the ERP in the browser and press Print again.
reason.hi: Browser में ERP के pop-up चालू करें और फिर Print दबाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: If a dispatch save timed out, refresh before trying again; the transfer key stops a double send.
recoverySteps.hi: Dispatch save time out हो तो दोबारा से पहले refresh करें; transfer key दोहरा भेजना रोकता है।

recoverySteps.en: A roll missing from "Available Rolls" is reserved, quarantined or at another plant; check it in Roll genealogy.
recoverySteps.hi: "Available Rolls" में roll न दिखे तो वह reserved, quarantine या दूसरे plant में है; Roll genealogy में देखें।

title.hi: Inter-plant challan का preview और print

summary.en: PDF preview of one inter-plant delivery challan with Open PDF, Print and the QR gate sticker.
summary.hi: एक inter-plant delivery challan का PDF preview, साथ में Open PDF, Print और QR gate sticker।

purpose.en: Opens in a new tab from the Print button on an inter-plant challan. Print the challan to send with the truck and the QR sticker the gate scans at departure.
purpose.hi: Inter-plant challan के Print बटन से नए tab में खुलता है। Challan गाड़ी के साथ भेजने के लिए print करें और QR sticker भी, जिसे gate पर scan किया जाता है।

prerequisites.en: The challan exists (opened from Inter-Plant Transfers).
prerequisites.hi: Challan बना हो (Inter-Plant Transfers से खोला गया)।

keyActions.en: 1. Wait for the preview to load.
keyActions.hi: 1. Preview आने दें।

keyActions.en: 2. Press "Print"; if the browser blocks the pop-up, press "Open PDF" and print from the viewer.
keyActions.hi: 2. "Print" दबाएँ; browser pop-up रोके तो "Open PDF" दबाकर viewer से print करें।

keyActions.en: 3. Print the QR gate sticker (choose copies) and stick it on the challan or load.
keyActions.hi: 3. QR gate sticker print करें (copies चुनें) और challan या माल पर लगाएँ।

keyActions.en: 4. Close the tab; the challan stays in its column on Inter-Plant Transfers.
keyActions.hi: 4. Tab बंद करें; challan Inter-Plant Transfers में अपने कॉलम में रहता है।

help.en: Internal id of the challan shown under the heading.
help.hi: Heading के नीचे challan का internal id।

help.en: 4 × 2 inch label the watchman scans so the departure matches itself.
help.hi: 4 × 2 inch label, जिसे watchman scan करता है ताकि departure अपने आप match हो।

error.en: Unable to load PDF preview.
error.hi: Unable to load PDF preview.

reason.en: The challan id is wrong or the server failed. Reopen Print from the challan card.
reason.hi: Challan id गलत है या server में दिक्कत। Challan card से Print फिर खोलें।

error.en: Popup was blocked. Use "Open PDF" and print from the viewer.
error.hi: Popup was blocked. Use "Open PDF" and print from the viewer.

reason.en: Allow pop-ups or use Open PDF.
reason.hi: Pop-up चालू करें या Open PDF लें।

recoverySteps.en: Close the tab and press Print on the challan again.
recoverySteps.hi: Tab बंद करें और challan पर फिर Print दबाएँ।

summary.en: Material sent to outside job workers: orders, Rule 45 challans, returns, balances, overdue items, reports and bill linking.
summary.hi: बाहर के job worker को भेजा माल: order, Rule 45 challan, वापसी, बाकी माल, overdue, report और बिल जोड़ना।

purpose.en: Create an order when a route step goes out (Planned route step) or in-house capacity is short (Emergency handoff), then track what is still at each job worker and keep the GST ITC-04 one-year limit. Opened from a job-work bill (?bill=), it shows the vendor's open orders and returns without a bill.
purpose.hi: जब route का कोई step बाहर जाता है (Planned route step) या अंदर क्षमता कम है (Emergency handoff), तब order बनाएँ; फिर देखें कि किस job worker के पास क्या बचा है और GST ITC-04 की एक साल की सीमा का ध्यान रखें। Job-work बिल (?bill=) से खुलने पर उस vendor के खुले order और बिना बिल वाली वापसी दिखती है।

prerequisites.en: Job worker vendor: active, type Job Worker or Hybrid, supports the process and mapped to the plant.
prerequisites.hi: Job worker vendor: active, type Job Worker या Hybrid, वह process करता हो और plant से जुड़ा हो।

prerequisites.en: For a planned step, a released / running / paused production job.
prerequisites.hi: Planned step के लिए released / running / paused production job।

prerequisites.en: Inventory manage rights to create, send, receive and close; others can only view.
prerequisites.hi: Order बनाने, भेजने, receive और close करने के लिए inventory manage अधिकार; बाकी सिर्फ़ देख सकते हैं।

keyActions.en: 1. Pick a view: "Open", "At vendor", "Overdue", "Closed", "Reports" (Owner also sees "Before upgrade").
keyActions.hi: 1. View चुनें: "Open", "At vendor", "Overdue", "Closed", "Reports" (Owner को "Before upgrade" भी)।

keyActions.en: 2. Filter by plant and job worker or "Search JWO, challan, return, job no. or vendor".
keyActions.hi: 2. Plant और job worker से filter करें या "Search JWO, challan, return, job no. or vendor"।

keyActions.en: 3. Press "New job-work order": choose "Planned route step" or "Emergency handoff", the production job, process, job worker, expected output and quantity, "Expected back by", "Agreed labour rate (₹, before GST)" and "Balance tolerance %".
keyActions.hi: 3. "New job-work order" दबाएँ: "Planned route step" या "Emergency handoff", production job, process, job worker, expected output और मात्रा, "Expected back by", "Agreed labour rate (₹, before GST)" और "Balance tolerance %" भरें।

keyActions.en: 4. Open the order to send material, receive returns and close it.
keyActions.hi: 4. Order खोलकर माल भेजें, वापसी लें और close करें।

keyActions.en: 5. Reports: "Material at job workers" by age and "Yield and wastage by job worker" for a period.
keyActions.hi: 5. Reports: उम्र के हिसाब से "Material at job workers" और किसी अवधि का "Yield and wastage by job worker"।

keyActions.en: 6. From a bill: pick the open order the material belongs to, or under "Already received — link this bill" tick the returns the bill charges for and press Link.
keyActions.hi: 6. बिल से आए हों: माल जिस खुले order का है उसे चुनें, या "Already received — link this bill" में बिल वाली वापसी tick करके Link दबाएँ।

help.en: Draft · At job worker · Partly returned · All returned (ready to close) · Closed · Cancelled.
help.hi: Draft · At job worker · Partly returned · All returned (close के लिए तैयार) · Closed · Cancelled।

help.en: Material at the job worker for 300+ days; GST allows one year.
help.hi: माल 300+ दिन से job worker के पास है; GST एक साल देता है।

help.en: The route step was completed with what came back; the rest is still expected.
help.hi: जो वापस आया उससे route step पूरा किया गया; बाकी अभी आना है।

help.en: Overdue alerts start after this date.
help.hi: इस तारीख़ के बाद overdue alert शुरू।

help.en: Unexplained difference allowed between material sent and material accounted for.
help.hi: भेजे गए और हिसाब में आए माल के बीच बिना कारण कितना फ़र्क चल सकता है।

help.en: Finished pieces, Rolls or Bulk material. Finished pieces need a production job.
help.hi: Finished pieces, Rolls या Bulk material। Finished pieces के लिए production job ज़रूरी।

error.en: Vendor is not compatible for this jobwork context.
error.hi: Vendor is not compatible for this jobwork context.

reason.en: The job worker must be active, of type Job worker/Hybrid, support the process and be mapped to the plant. Fix the vendor master.
reason.hi: Job worker active हो, type Job worker/Hybrid हो, process करता हो और plant से जुड़ा हो। Vendor master ठीक करें।

error.en: Pick the production job whose route step goes to job work.
error.hi: Pick the production job whose route step goes to job work.

reason.en: A planned route step needs its job.
reason.hi: Planned route step के लिए job चुनना ज़रूरी है।

error.en: Say why this work goes out in an emergency.
error.hi: Say why this work goes out in an emergency.

reason.en: Fill "Why is it going out?" for an emergency handoff.
reason.hi: Emergency handoff में "Why is it going out?" भरें।

error.en: Job … is …; only released, running or paused jobs can go to job work.
error.hi: Job … is …; only released, running or paused jobs can go to job work.

reason.en: Release the job in the planner first.
reason.hi: पहले planner में job release करें।

error.en: This document is not classified as a job-work bill. Change its category in Bills & documents first.
error.hi: This document is not classified as a job-work bill. Change its category in Bills & documents first.

reason.en: Classify the bill as job work, then reopen.
reason.hi: बिल को job work में classify करें, फिर खोलें।

recoverySteps.en: If a save times out, press the same button again — the retry is recognised and never records twice. Use "Start over with my edits" to send a fresh request.
recoverySteps.hi: Save time out हो तो वही बटन फिर दबाएँ — दोहराना पहचाना जाता है, दो बार दर्ज नहीं होता। नया request भेजना हो तो "Start over with my edits"।

recoverySteps.en: Owner: rolls the old screen left at a job worker are settled under "Before upgrade".
recoverySteps.hi: Owner: पुरानी स्क्रीन से job worker के पास अटके roll "Before upgrade" में निपटाएँ।

title.hi: एक job-work order का पूरा हाल

summary.en: One job-work order: what was sent, challans, returns, the balance at the job worker, bill link and timeline.
summary.hi: एक job-work order: क्या भेजा, challan, वापसी, job worker के पास बचा माल, बिल और timeline।

purpose.en: Send material on a Rule 45 challan, receive what comes back so finished goods, balance rolls and wastage are all accounted for, let production continue with a part return, then close the order (which completes the planned route step).
purpose.hi: Rule 45 challan पर माल भेजें, जो वापस आए उसे receive करें ताकि finished माल, बचे roll और wastage सब हिसाब में आएँ, आंशिक वापसी से production आगे बढ़ाएँ, फिर order close करें (इससे planned route step पूरा होता है)।

prerequisites.en: The order exists (created on Job work).
prerequisites.hi: Order बना हो (Job work पेज से)।

prerequisites.en: Rolls / bulk available at the sending plant; HSN code for each material.
prerequisites.hi: भेजने वाले plant में roll / bulk उपलब्ध; हर material का HSN code।

prerequisites.en: Rolls from before the upgrade must be reconciled first (Owner).
prerequisites.hi: Upgrade से पहले के roll पहले reconcile हों (Owner)।

keyActions.en: 1. Press "Send material": tick rolls ("Roll label, material or job"), add bulk if needed, fill "HSN code", "Purpose on the challan", "Vehicle number", then "Issue challan". Print it; the gate scans its QR when the truck leaves.
keyActions.hi: 1. "Send material" दबाएँ: roll tick करें ("Roll label, material or job"), ज़रूरत हो तो bulk जोड़ें, "HSN code", "Purpose on the challan", "Vehicle number" भरें, फिर "Issue challan"। Print करें; गाड़ी निकलते समय gate QR scan करता है।

keyActions.en: 2. When goods return press "Receive": enter "Received on", the job worker's challan no. and date.
keyActions.hi: 2. माल लौटे तो "Receive" दबाएँ: "Received on", job worker का challan नंबर और तारीख़ भरें।

keyActions.en: 3. Under "Sent material" mark each roll "Used up", "Came back unused" or "Partly used" (enter the balance kg), or "Mark all used up".
keyActions.hi: 3. "Sent material" में हर roll को "Used up", "Came back unused" या "Partly used" (बचा kg भरें) करें, या "Mark all used up"।

keyActions.en: 4. Under "What came back" enter finished pieces (pieces, boxes / bags, weight, store at, inner packs), output rolls or bulk, and wastage.
keyActions.hi: 4. "What came back" में finished pieces (pieces, boxes / bags, weight, store at, inner packs), output roll या bulk, और wastage भरें।

keyActions.en: 5. Check "Material balance": settled = output + balance back + wastage within the tolerance, or fill "Why does the balance not match?". If the bill is beside the form, fill billed quantity / rate; it links in the same save. Press "Save return".
keyActions.hi: 5. "Material balance" देखें: settled = output + balance back + wastage, tolerance के अंदर; नहीं तो "Why does the balance not match?" भरें। बिल साथ खुला हो तो billed quantity / rate भरें; उसी save में जुड़ता है। "Save return" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: 6. Part back and production must start: "Continue production with what's back" completes the route step now; later returns go to that step. Not offered on a job's last step.
keyActions.hi: 6. आंशिक माल आया और production शुरू करना है: "Continue production with what's back" से route step अभी पूरा होता है; बाद की वापसी उसी step में जाती है। Job के आख़िरी step पर यह नहीं मिलता।

keyActions.en: 7. When nothing is left, press "Close" → "Close order". If something will never come back, "Close short" → "Close short and write off" with a reason. A draft with nothing sent: "Cancel draft".
keyActions.hi: 7. कुछ बाकी न हो तो "Close" → "Close order"। कुछ कभी नहीं लौटेगा तो कारण देकर "Close short" → "Close short and write off"। कुछ न भेजा गया draft: "Cancel draft"।

field.en: At the job worker / Sent / Output / Balance back / Wastage / Unexplained / Written off
field.hi: At the job worker / Sent / Output / Balance back / Wastage / Unexplained / Written off

help.en: The order's material meter in kg.
help.hi: Order का kg में माल हिसाब।

help.en: Each dispatch issues a job-work delivery challan (GST Rule 45) with a QR; "Not scanned at gate" until the watchman scans it.
help.hi: हर भेजने पर QR वाला job-work delivery challan (GST Rule 45) बनता है; watchman के scan तक "Not scanned at gate" दिखता है।

help.en: If the order packs pieces in inner packs, choose "Packed in our inner packs" or "Packed in the job worker's own inner packs". With our packs, in-house inner pouches come off stock now, as at the machine's last pouching step, and bought ones are booked by the evening packing count. The job worker's own packs take nothing from our stock.
help.hi: Order में inner pack हो तो "Packed in our inner packs" या "Packed in the job worker's own inner packs" चुनें। हमारे pack हों तो घर के (in-house) inner pouch अभी stock से कटते हैं, जैसे मशीन के आखिरी pouching step पर, और खरीदे हुए शाम की packing गिनती से बुक होते हैं। Job worker के अपने pack हों तो हमारे stock से कुछ नहीं कटता।

help.en: Tick when nothing more will be received against this bill.
help.hi: इस बिल पर आगे कुछ नहीं आएगा तो tick करें।

help.en: Every send, return, link, release and close with who and when.
help.hi: हर send, return, link, release और close — किसने, कब।

error.en: Material balance is off by … kg (…%). Explain the difference to close.
error.hi: Material balance is off by … kg (…%). Explain the difference to close.

reason.en: Sent ≠ output + balance + wastage beyond the tolerance. Recheck weights or give the reason.
reason.hi: भेजा ≠ output + balance + wastage, tolerance से ज़्यादा। वज़न फिर जाँचें या कारण लिखें।

error.en: Enter the HSN code for …
error.hi: Enter the HSN code for …

reason.en: Every challan line prints an HSN code (e.g. 3920 plastic film).
reason.hi: हर challan लाइन पर HSN code छपता है (जैसे 3920 plastic film)।

error.en: …: the balance roll must weigh more than 0 and less than … kg.
error.hi: …: the balance roll must weigh more than 0 and less than … kg.

reason.en: For "Partly used" enter a balance below the sent weight; use "Came back unused" for the full roll.
reason.hi: "Partly used" में भेजे वज़न से कम balance भरें; पूरा roll लौटा हो तो "Came back unused"।

error.en: Finished pieces can only be received against a production job. Link the job.
error.hi: Finished pieces can only be received against a production job. Link the job.

reason.en: FG batches belong to a job; receive as rolls/bulk or link the job.
reason.hi: FG batch job का होता है; roll/bulk में लें या job जोड़ें।

error.en: Explain why the order is closed short (at least 5 characters).
error.hi: Explain why the order is closed short (at least 5 characters).

reason.en: Write a clear reason.
reason.hi: साफ़ कारण लिखें।

error.en: This is the job's last route step. Finished pieces can be packed and dispatched as they come back; close the order when everything is back.
error.hi: This is the job's last route step. Finished pieces can be packed and dispatched as they come back; close the order when everything is back.

reason.en: Continue production is not needed on the last step.
reason.hi: आख़िरी step पर Continue production की ज़रूरत नहीं।

error.en: This bill is from another vendor.
error.hi: This bill is from another vendor.

reason.en: Open the order of the bill's job worker.
reason.hi: बिल वाले job worker का order खोलें।

recoverySteps.en: If a save times out, press the same button again ("Retry save"); it never records twice.
recoverySteps.hi: Save time out हो तो वही बटन ("Retry save") फिर दबाएँ; दो बार दर्ज नहीं होता।

recoverySteps.en: Closing never deducts the step's inks, adhesive or packs from factory stock: job-worker material is recorded as vendor-supplied.
recoverySteps.hi: Close करने से step की ink, adhesive या pack factory stock से नहीं कटते: job worker का माल vendor-supplied दर्ज होता है।

summary.en: A combined list of the latest bulk transactions and roll movements: time, operation, item / batch, location, quantity and reference.
summary.hi: Bulk लेन-देन और roll movement की ताज़ा मिली-जुली सूची: समय, operation, item / batch, location, मात्रा और reference।

purpose.en: Use it for a quick look at recent stock movements of any kind. For a full item history with opening and closing balance use the stock card under Count and close → Month end; for one roll use Roll genealogy.
purpose.hi: किसी भी तरह के हाल के stock movement को जल्दी देखने के लिए। किसी item का पूरा हिसाब opening-closing के साथ Count and close → Month end के stock card में देखें; एक roll के लिए Roll genealogy।

prerequisites.en: Inventory view rights.
prerequisites.hi: Inventory view अधिकार।

keyActions.en: 1. Choose the operation: "All Operations", "Inward (GRN)", "Outward (Dispatch)", "Receive", "Consumption" or "Transfer".
keyActions.hi: 1. Operation चुनें: "All Operations", "Inward (GRN)", "Outward (Dispatch)", "Receive", "Consumption" या "Transfer"।

keyActions.en: 2. Type in "Search ledger..." (material, reference or roll label).
keyActions.hi: 2. "Search ledger..." में material, reference या roll label लिखें।

keyActions.en: 3. Read the tiles "Total Transactions", "Inward Flow", "Outward Flow".
keyActions.hi: 3. "Total Transactions", "Inward Flow", "Outward Flow" tile देखें।

keyActions.en: 4. Page through the "Transaction Log" (50 rows a page).
keyActions.hi: 4. "Transaction Log" में पन्ने बदलें (हर पन्ने पर 50 लाइन)।

help.en: GRN (inward), DISPATCH, RECEIVE, CONSUMPTION, TRANSFER, ADJUST.
help.hi: GRN (inward), DISPATCH, RECEIVE, CONSUMPTION, TRANSFER, ADJUST।

help.en: Shown with + for GRN and Receive and − for every other type.
help.hi: GRN और Receive पर +, बाकी सब पर − दिखता है।

help.en: GRN, challan, job or adjustment number that created the row.
help.hi: जिस GRN, challan, job या adjustment से लाइन बनी।

error.en: No matching records
error.hi: No matching records

reason.en: The search or operation filter hides everything, or the row is older than the latest rows loaded. Clear the search or use the stock card.
reason.hi: Search या filter से सब छिप गया, या लाइन लोड हुई ताज़ा लाइनों से पुरानी है। Search हटाएँ या stock card देखें।

recoverySteps.en: For older history or exact balances open Count and close → Month end → stock card drill.
recoverySteps.hi: पुराने हिसाब या सही balance के लिए Count and close → Month end → stock card drill खोलें।

summary.en: Every physical move of a roll from one location to another — GRN, production, WIP transfer, inter-plant, job work and dispatch — with reason, job and who moved it.
summary.hi: Roll का एक location से दूसरी location तक हर असली move — GRN, production, WIP transfer, inter-plant, job work और dispatch — कारण, job और किसने किया, के साथ।

purpose.en: Open it to answer "where did this roll go and why" for many rolls at once. This page only reads; moves are made by GRN, the terminals, inter-plant challans, job work and dispatch.
purpose.hi: बहुत से roll के लिए "यह roll कहाँ गया और क्यों" देखने के लिए। यह पेज सिर्फ़ दिखाता है; move GRN, terminal, inter-plant challan, job work और dispatch से होते हैं।

prerequisites.en: Inventory view rights.
prerequisites.hi: Inventory view अधिकार।

keyActions.en: 1. Type in "Search roll, move reason, location, or job".
keyActions.hi: 1. "Search roll, move reason, location, or job" में लिखें।

keyActions.en: 2. Read the tiles: "Visible moves", "Production moves", "Dispatch moves", "Route spread".
keyActions.hi: 2. Tile देखें: "Visible moves", "Production moves", "Dispatch moves", "Route spread"।

keyActions.en: 3. "Movement mix" shows the most common reasons; "Recent movement cards" the latest moves.
keyActions.hi: 3. "Movement mix" में सबसे आम कारण; "Recent movement cards" में ताज़ा move।

keyActions.en: 4. Check each row in "Movement ledger": roll, from → to (NEW for a fresh roll), reason, job, time, by.
keyActions.hi: 4. "Movement ledger" की हर लाइन देखें: roll, from → to (नए roll पर NEW), reason, job, समय, किसने।

keyActions.en: 5. Press "Refresh" to reload.
keyActions.hi: 5. दोबारा लोड करने के लिए "Refresh"।

help.en: Why the roll moved, e.g. GRN, PRODUCTION, DISPATCH, inter-plant, job work.
help.hi: Roll क्यों हिला, जैसे GRN, PRODUCTION, DISPATCH, inter-plant, job work।

help.en: Number of plants seen in the moves and the time of the latest move.
help.hi: Move में दिखे plant की गिनती और आख़िरी move का समय।

error.en: No movements found for the current filter.
error.hi: No movements found for the current filter.

reason.en: Clear the search. If it stays empty, the list may have failed to load; press Refresh.
reason.hi: Search हटाएँ। फिर भी खाली रहे तो list लोड नहीं हुई होगी; Refresh दबाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: For one roll's full story use Roll genealogy.
recoverySteps.hi: एक roll की पूरी कहानी के लिए Roll genealogy।

summary.en: Papers the watchman photographed as goods left the gate, to match with the ERP challan, invoice or gate pass they belong to.
summary.hi: माल gate से निकलते समय watchman ने जो काग़ज़ फोटो किए, उन्हें ERP के challan, invoice या gate pass से मिलाने के लिए।

purpose.en: Make sure every departure is matched to the ERP document it carried. QR-printed ERP papers match themselves; the rest wait in "Pending match", oldest first. Matching never moves stock or marks delivery.
purpose.hi: हर गाड़ी के निकलने को उसके ERP document से मिलाना। QR वाले ERP काग़ज़ अपने आप match होते हैं; बाकी "Pending match" में पुराने पहले। Match करने से stock नहीं हिलता और delivery नहीं होती।

prerequisites.en: The "Match outward gate photos" right (Inventory, Admin, Owner by default).
prerequisites.hi: "Match outward gate photos" अधिकार (default में Inventory, Admin, Owner)।

prerequisites.en: The watchman recorded the departure on the gate terminal.
prerequisites.hi: Watchman ने gate terminal पर departure दर्ज किया हो।

keyActions.en: 1. Pick a tab: "Pending match", "Discrepancy", "Matched" or "All".
keyActions.hi: 1. Tab चुनें: "Pending match", "Discrepancy", "Matched" या "All"।

keyActions.en: 2. Filter by "Factory", "ERP link" (Has an ERP link / No ERP link yet), "Left from" / "Left to", or search "Vehicle, DC / invoice no. or party".
keyActions.hi: 2. "Factory", "ERP link" (Has an ERP link / No ERP link yet), "Left from" / "Left to" से filter करें, या "Vehicle, DC / invoice no. or party" खोजें।

keyActions.en: 3. Open a departure to link documents, mark it matched or note a discrepancy.
keyActions.hi: 3. Departure खोलकर document जोड़ें, matched करें या discrepancy लिखें।

keyActions.en: 4. Use "Previous page" / "Next page" to move through long lists; work the oldest first.
keyActions.hi: 4. लंबी सूची में "Previous page" / "Next page" से चलें; पुराने पहले निपटाएँ।

help.en: The photo has no link yet; open it to match.
help.hi: फोटो से अभी कोई link नहीं; खोलकर match करें।

help.en: A difference was noted and needs follow-up.
help.hi: फ़र्क दर्ज हुआ है, follow-up चाहिए।

help.en: Every outward photo record, including voided ones.
help.hi: हर outward फोटो record, void वाले भी।

error.en: Outward documents are for the inventory team
error.hi: Outward documents are for the inventory team

reason.en: Your account lacks the "Match outward gate photos" right; an administrator can grant it in the role matrix. Watchmen record departures on the gate terminal.
reason.hi: आपके account में "Match outward gate photos" अधिकार नहीं; admin role matrix में दे सकता है। Watchman gate terminal पर departure दर्ज करते हैं।

error.en: Choose an ordered date range of 366 days or fewer.
error.hi: Choose an ordered date range of 366 days or fewer.

reason.en: Fix Left from / Left to.
reason.hi: Left from / Left to ठीक करें।

recoverySteps.en: If the list looks stale, wait for "Updating…" to finish or reload the page.
recoverySteps.hi: List पुरानी लगे तो "Updating…" खत्म होने दें या page reload करें।

summary.en: The gate photos of one departure beside the matching panel: link the ERP documents that left on the truck, then mark it matched or note a discrepancy.
summary.hi: एक departure के gate फोटो और उसके बगल में matching panel: गाड़ी में गए ERP document जोड़ें, फिर matched करें या discrepancy लिखें।

purpose.en: Confirm what left the factory on this truck. One truck may carry several documents. Matching never moves stock or marks delivery.
purpose.hi: पक्का करें कि इस गाड़ी में factory से क्या गया। एक गाड़ी में कई document हो सकते हैं। Match से stock नहीं हिलता और delivery नहीं होती।

prerequisites.en: "Match outward gate photos" right.
prerequisites.hi: "Match outward gate photos" अधिकार।

keyActions.en: 1. Look at the photos (zoom, rotate, pin, or pop them out to a second screen).
keyActions.hi: 1. फोटो देखें (zoom, rotate, pin, या दूसरी screen पर pop-out)।

keyActions.en: 2. Under "Find the ERP document" search by number, party or vehicle, optionally pick "Document type", and link the match.
keyActions.hi: 2. "Find the ERP document" में नंबर, party या गाड़ी से खोजें, चाहें तो "Document type" चुनें, और link करें।

keyActions.en: 3. Or use "Link by QR code": scan with a desk scanner or paste the QR text.
keyActions.hi: 3. या "Link by QR code": desk scanner से scan करें या QR text paste करें।

keyActions.en: 4. A paper not in the ERP (supplier return note, courier receipt): "Paper not in the ERP" → number, party, what it is → "Add paper".
keyActions.hi: 4. ERP में न हो ऐसा काग़ज़ (supplier return note, courier रसीद): "Paper not in the ERP" → नंबर, party, क्या है → "Add paper"।

keyActions.en: 5. Press "Mark matched", or write the difference and "Save discrepancy".
keyActions.hi: 5. "Mark matched" दबाएँ, या फ़र्क लिखकर "Save discrepancy"।

keyActions.en: 6. Wrong link: "Remove" with a reason. Owner/Admin: "Void record" for a duplicate or mistaken photo.
keyActions.hi: 6. गलत link: कारण देकर "Remove"। Owner/Admin: duplicate या गलत फोटो के लिए "Void record"।

help.en: What the office confirmed left on this truck.
help.hi: Office ने जो पक्का किया कि इस गाड़ी में गया।

help.en: Every code the watchman scanned, including codes not recognised.
help.hi: Watchman के scan किए सभी code, न पहचाने गए भी।

help.en: Every change with who did it and why; kept permanently.
help.hi: हर बदलाव — किसने, क्यों; हमेशा रहता है।

error.en: Link at least one ERP document before marking the departure matched.
error.hi: Link at least one ERP document before marking the departure matched.

reason.en: Link a document or add a paper first.
reason.hi: पहले document link करें या paper जोड़ें।

error.en: This document is already linked to the departure.
error.hi: This document is already linked to the departure.

reason.en: It is already in the list.
reason.hi: यह पहले से सूची में है।

error.en: This outward record is voided. Refresh the queue.
error.hi: This outward record is voided. Refresh the queue.

reason.en: Someone voided it; go back to the queue.
reason.hi: किसी ने void किया; queue पर लौटें।

error.en: This document belongs to another factory. It cannot be matched at this gate.
error.hi: This document belongs to another factory. It cannot be matched at this gate.

reason.en: Pick the document of the factory the truck left from.
reason.hi: जिस factory से गाड़ी निकली उसी का document चुनें।

error.en: Linked. The same document also left on …
error.hi: Linked. The same document also left on …

reason.en: A challan leaving over several trips is flagged, not blocked.
reason.hi: कई trip में जाने वाला challan सिर्फ़ flag होता है, रुकता नहीं।

recoverySteps.en: "This outward record is not available": open it again from the queue.
recoverySteps.hi: "This outward record is not available": queue से फिर खोलें।

recoverySteps.en: Removing a link reopens a gate pass that left only on this record.
recoverySteps.hi: Link हटाने पर सिर्फ़ इसी record पर गया gate pass फिर 'issued' हो जाता है।

summary.en: The outward photos of one departure in their own window, for a second monitor.
summary.hi: एक departure के outward फोटो अलग window में, दूसरी screen के लिए।

purpose.en: Opened with the pop-out mode of the photo viewer on the matching screen. Page, zoom, rotation and pin follow the matching screen, so you can read the paper large while linking documents on the main screen.
purpose.hi: Matching screen पर photo viewer के pop-out mode से खुलता है। Page, zoom, rotation और pin matching screen के साथ चलते हैं, ताकि काग़ज़ बड़ा पढ़ते हुए मुख्य screen पर document जोड़ सकें।

prerequisites.en: "Match outward gate photos" right.
prerequisites.hi: "Match outward gate photos" अधिकार।

keyActions.en: 1. On the matching screen switch the viewer to pop-out.
keyActions.hi: 1. Matching screen पर viewer को pop-out करें।

keyActions.en: 2. Drag the new window to the second monitor.
keyActions.hi: 2. नई window दूसरी screen पर ले जाएँ।

keyActions.en: 3. Keep matching on the main screen; the pop-out follows.
keyActions.hi: 3. मुख्य screen पर matching करते रहें; pop-out साथ चलता है।

keyActions.en: 4. Close the pop-out window when the departure is matched.
keyActions.hi: 4. Departure match होने पर pop-out window बंद करें।

error.en: You cannot open these photos
error.hi: You cannot open these photos

reason.en: Ask an administrator for the "Match outward gate photos" right.
reason.hi: Admin से "Match outward gate photos" अधिकार माँगें।

error.en: This link is not valid
error.hi: This link is not valid

reason.en: Open the photos again from the outward documents queue.
reason.hi: Outward documents queue से फोटो फिर खोलें।

recoverySteps.en: Close the pop-out and open it again from the matching screen.
recoverySteps.hi: Pop-out बंद करके matching screen से फिर खोलें।

summary.en: Stock of inner pouches, gonny, cartons, tape, sheet, labels, tags and POD sleeves by kind, plant and location, with health, sales-order holds and today's evening count figures.
summary.hi: Inner pouch, gonny, carton, tape, sheet, label, tag और POD sleeve का stock — kind, plant और location के हिसाब से, health, sales-order hold और आज के evening count के आँकड़ों के साथ।

purpose.en: Check what packing material is on hand and what needs reorder. Remember the rule: in-house inner pouches leave stock at the machine's last pouching step when the output is logged; bought inner pouches and every other item are taken off stock by the evening packing count (other items are ticked at release; inner pouches never are). Receive packing items with Smart GRN.
purpose.hi: देखें कि packing का कितना सामान है और क्या मँगाना है। नियम याद रखें: घर के (in-house) inner pouch मशीन के आखिरी pouching step पर output दर्ज होते ही stock से कटते हैं; खरीदे हुए inner pouch और बाकी हर item evening packing count से कटते हैं (बाकी item release पर tick होते हैं; inner pouch कभी नहीं)। Packing का सामान Smart GRN से लें।

prerequisites.en: Packaging masters (kind, pcs / pack, UOM, reorder point).
prerequisites.hi: Packaging master (kind, pcs / pack, UOM, reorder point)।

keyActions.en: 1. Filter by kind (Inner pouch, Gunny, Carton / box, Tape, Sheet, Label, Tag, POD sleeve, Other), plant, location, supply mode (Purchased, In-house, Both) and health.
keyActions.hi: 1. Kind (Inner pouch, Gunny, Carton / box, Tape, Sheet, Label, Tag, POD sleeve, Other), plant, location, supply mode (Purchased, In-house, Both) और health से filter करें।

keyActions.en: 2. Read the tiles: SKU rows, total pieces, available, low stock, stock-outs.
keyActions.hi: 2. Tile देखें: SKU rows, total pieces, available, low stock, stock-outs।

keyActions.en: 3. Open a row ("View") for specs and "SO holds" (active reservations).
keyActions.hi: 3. लाइन खोलें ("View") — specs और "SO holds" (active reservation)।

keyActions.en: 4. Check the "EOD packing count" box for today; press "Open EOD count" to go to the evening count.
keyActions.hi: 4. आज का "EOD packing count" बॉक्स देखें; evening count के लिए "Open EOD count" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: 5. Press "Receive packaging" to open Smart GRN.
keyActions.hi: 5. Smart GRN खोलने के लिए "Receive packaging"।

help.en: Empty at 0; Low below the reorder point; Healthy otherwise (reorder point 50 if not set).
help.hi: 0 पर Empty; reorder point से कम पर Low; बाकी Healthy (reorder point न हो तो 50)।

help.en: Pieces held for sales orders.
help.hi: Sales order के लिए रोके गए pieces।

help.en: What the evening count booked today and to how many orders.
help.hi: आज evening count ने कितना काटा और कितने order पर।

help.en: Count shortfall not shared to any order; should stay 0.
help.hi: Count की कमी जो किसी order पर नहीं बँटी; 0 रहनी चाहिए।

error.en: Could not load packaging.
error.hi: Could not load packaging.

reason.en: Refresh; if it repeats, tell the admin.
reason.hi: Refresh करें; बार-बार हो तो admin को बताएँ।

error.en: No packaging items match these filters
error.hi: No packaging items match these filters

reason.en: Clear filters or search.
reason.hi: Filter या search हटाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: Stock looks wrong after packing? Check the evening count in Packing audit before adjusting.
recoverySteps.hi: Packing के बाद stock गलत लगे? Adjust से पहले Packing audit में evening count देखें।

summary.en: This old address opens Count and close on the Year end tab (/inventory/stock-lifecycle?tab=close).
summary.hi: यह पुराना पता Count and close का Year end tab खोलता है (/inventory/stock-lifecycle?tab=close)।

purpose.en: Period close moved into Count and close so counts, month end and year end sit together. The Stock menu link "Period" forwards you there.
purpose.hi: Period close अब Count and close में है ताकि count, month end और year end एक साथ रहें। Stock menu का "Period" लिंक वहीं भेजता है।

prerequisites.en: Stock lifecycle rights.
prerequisites.hi: Stock lifecycle अधिकार।

keyActions.en: 1. Open "Period" from the Stock menu.
keyActions.hi: 1. Stock menu से "Period" खोलें।

keyActions.en: 2. You land on Year end: clear blockers, then "Close Financial Year".
keyActions.hi: 2. Year end पर पहुँचेंगे: blockers हटाएँ, फिर "Close Financial Year"।

keyActions.en: 3. Month snapshots and the stock card are on the Month end tab.
keyActions.hi: 3. Month snapshot और stock card Month end tab पर हैं।

keyActions.en: 4. Update any bookmark to /inventory/stock-lifecycle?tab=close.
keyActions.hi: 4. अपना bookmark /inventory/stock-lifecycle?tab=close पर बदल लें।

recoverySteps.en: Use the Count and close tabs directly.
recoverySteps.hi: सीधे Count and close के tab इस्तेमाल करें।

summary.en: All rolls by film and width first: a film board, a variant × thickness matrix, a table and cards, every roll filterable by family, status, role, form, plant, location, age and size.
summary.hi: सभी roll पहले film और width के हिसाब से: film board, variant × thickness matrix, table और card; हर roll को family, status, role, form, plant, location, उम्र और size से filter करें।

purpose.en: The store's home page. Find a free roll of the right film and width, see what is reserved or on a machine, spot old stock, and open a roll's detail, lineage or stock card. Rolls are never edited here: weight, status and location change only through GRN, production, dispatch, job work, moves and adjustments.
purpose.hi: Store का मुख्य पेज। सही film और width का खाली roll ढूँढें, देखें कौन reserved है या machine पर है, पुराना stock पहचानें, और roll का detail, lineage या stock card खोलें। यहाँ roll बदलता नहीं: वज़न, status और location सिर्फ़ GRN, production, dispatch, job work, move और adjustment से बदलते हैं।

prerequisites.en: Rolls received through Smart GRN, opening stock or production.
prerequisites.hi: Roll Smart GRN, opening stock या production से आए हों।

keyActions.en: 1. Pick the view: films (default), matrix, table or cards.
keyActions.hi: 1. View चुनें: films (default), matrix, table या cards।

keyActions.en: 2. Filter in the left rail: variant / film code, status (Available, Reserved, In process, Consumed, Quarantine), role (Base / new, Output, Remainder, Split output, Finished), stock form, plant, location, age (≤30 d, 31–90, 90+ d) and size.
keyActions.hi: 2. बाएँ rail में filter: variant / film code, status (Available, Reserved, In process, Consumed, Quarantine), role (Base / new, Output, Remainder, Split output, Finished), stock form, plant, location, उम्र (≤30 d, 31–90, 90+ d) और size।

keyActions.en: 3. On the film board each roll ring is coloured Free, Reserved, On machine or Away; tap a roll for its detail.
keyActions.hi: 3. Film board पर हर roll का घेरा Free, Reserved, On machine या Away रंग में; detail के लिए roll पर tap करें।

keyActions.en: 4. In the matrix, tap a cell to see the individual rolls of that variant and thickness.
keyActions.hi: 4. Matrix में cell पर tap करके उस variant और thickness के roll देखें।

keyActions.en: 5. In "Roll detail" use "Trace lineage" (Roll genealogy) or "Stock card"; labels can be (re)printed in 4 × 2 inch.
keyActions.hi: 5. "Roll detail" में "Trace lineage" (Roll genealogy) या "Stock card"; label 4 × 2 inch में फिर print हो सकता है।

keyActions.en: 6. "Receive rolls" opens Smart GRN; quick actions "Trace" and "Move →" (inter-plant).
keyActions.hi: 6. "Receive rolls" Smart GRN खोलता है; quick action "Trace" और "Move →" (inter-plant)।

help.en: Total roll weight, free weight and weight reserved for jobs.
help.hi: कुल roll वज़न, खाली वज़न और job के लिए reserved वज़न।

help.en: Rolls older than 90 days; use them first.
help.hi: 90 दिन से पुराने roll; पहले इन्हें इस्तेमाल करें।

help.en: Roll counts by stock form.
help.hi: Stock form के हिसाब से roll गिनती।

help.en: Balance pieces of parent rolls returned to stock after slitting or part use.
help.hi: Slitting या आंशिक उपयोग के बाद लौटे parent roll के बचे हिस्से।

help.en: Share of on-hand kg already reserved.
help.hi: कुल kg का कितना हिस्सा पहले से reserved।

help.en: The job holding the roll (in Roll detail).
help.hi: Roll किस job के लिए रुका है (Roll detail में)।

error.en: Could not load roll inventory.
error.hi: Could not load roll inventory.

reason.en: Refresh; if it repeats, tell the admin.
reason.hi: Refresh करें; बार-बार हो तो admin को बताएँ।

error.en: No rolls match these filters.
error.hi: No rolls match these filters.

reason.en: Clear chips or search.
reason.hi: Chip या search हटाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: A roll you can see on the floor is missing: search its supplier number in Roll genealogy, then count it in Count and close → Stock count.
recoverySteps.hi: Floor पर दिखता roll यहाँ नहीं: Roll genealogy में supplier नंबर खोजें, फिर Count and close → Stock count में गिनें।

summary.en: Change a roll's physical form without a route: slit an open-web jumbo, open a tube into one or two sheets, fold a web or unfold it. Weight and genealogy are kept.
summary.hi: Route के बिना roll का रूप बदलें: open-web jumbo slit करें, tube खोलकर एक या दो sheet बनाएँ, web fold या unfold करें। वज़न और genealogy बने रहते हैं।

purpose.en: Use it when the store must prepare a roll for a job, e.g. open a tube for a side-seal job or slit a jumbo to the exact width the WC terminal needs. The parent is used up and children (plus any remainder) become new rolls.
purpose.hi: जब store को job के लिए roll तैयार करना हो, जैसे side-seal job के लिए tube खोलना या WC terminal की सही width के लिए jumbo slit करना। Parent खत्म होता है और children (और बचा हिस्सा) नए roll बनते हैं।

prerequisites.en: The parent roll is AVAILABLE.
prerequisites.hi: Parent roll AVAILABLE हो।

prerequisites.en: Inventory or production rights.
prerequisites.hi: Inventory या production अधिकार।

keyActions.en: 1. Pick the operation: "Slit open-web jumbo", "Open tube to one sheet", "Open tube to two sheets", "Fold open web" or "Unfold to open web".
keyActions.hi: 1. Operation चुनें: "Slit open-web jumbo", "Open tube to one sheet", "Open tube to two sheets", "Fold open web" या "Unfold to open web"।

keyActions.en: 2. Under "Pick parent roll" search roll, material, grade or location; only compatible rolls are offered.
keyActions.hi: 2. "Pick parent roll" में roll, material, grade या location खोजें; सिर्फ़ मेल खाते roll मिलते हैं।

keyActions.en: 3. For slitting enter "Child widths (mm)" like 500, 500, 300 and "Trim per child".
keyActions.hi: 3. Slitting में "Child widths (mm)" जैसे 500, 500, 300 और "Trim per child" भरें।

keyActions.en: 4. Check the preview: each output's form, width and weight, and the remainder.
keyActions.hi: 4. Preview देखें: हर output का form, width, वज़न और remainder।

keyActions.en: 5. Write "Reason / operator note" and press "Post conversion".
keyActions.hi: 5. "Reason / operator note" लिखें और "Post conversion" दबाएँ।

help.en: One sheet of twice the lay-flat width, same weight.
help.hi: Lay-flat width से दोगुनी एक sheet, वही वज़न।

help.en: Two sheets of the lay-flat width, half the weight each.
help.hi: Lay-flat width की दो sheet, हर एक आधा वज़न।

help.en: Fold halves the width; unfold doubles it; weight unchanged.
help.hi: Fold से width आधी; unfold से दोगुनी; वज़न वही।

help.en: Weight is shared by width. Children + trim must not exceed the parent width; any width left becomes a Remainder roll; trim is scrap.
help.hi: वज़न width के हिसाब से बँटता है। Children + trim parent width से ज़्यादा न हो; बची width Remainder roll बनती है; trim scrap है।

error.en: Only available rolls can be converted.
error.hi: Only available rolls can be converted.

reason.en: Unreserve the roll or pick another.
reason.hi: Roll का reservation हटाएँ या दूसरा लें।

error.en: Requested child widths plus trim exceed parent width.
error.hi: Requested child widths plus trim exceed parent width.

reason.en: Reduce child widths or trim.
reason.hi: Child width या trim घटाएँ।

error.en: Width slitting requires open-web stock. Use tube-opening for tube stock.
error.hi: Width slitting requires open-web stock. Use tube-opening for tube stock.

reason.en: Open the tube first, then slit.
reason.hi: पहले tube खोलें, फिर slit करें।

error.en: Open tube to one sheet requires lay-flat tube stock.
error.hi: Open tube to one sheet requires lay-flat tube stock.

reason.en: Pick a lay-flat tube roll.
reason.hi: Lay-flat tube roll चुनें।

error.en: Unfold requires folded-web stock.
error.hi: Unfold requires folded-web stock.

reason.en: Pick a folded-web roll.
reason.hi: Folded-web roll चुनें।

recoverySteps.en: A wrong conversion cannot be undone here; count the children and correct through Count and close or an adjustment.
recoverySteps.hi: गलत conversion यहाँ वापस नहीं होता; children गिनकर Count and close या adjustment से सुधारें।

summary.en: Opening stock, stock counts on any day, the evening packing count, month end and year end, for one plant and financial year.
summary.hi: एक plant और financial year के लिए opening stock, किसी भी दिन की stock count, evening packing count, month end और year end।

purpose.en: All stock-cycle work in one place. Work left to right: Overview, Opening stock, Stock count, Month end, Year end. Closed financial years cannot change; adjustments belong only in an open year.
purpose.hi: Stock cycle का सारा काम एक जगह। बाएँ से दाएँ चलें: Overview, Opening stock, Stock count, Month end, Year end। बंद financial year नहीं बदलता; adjustment सिर्फ़ खुले साल में।

prerequisites.en: Plant and financial year picked at the top; the year must be opened ("Open FY") before counts and close.
prerequisites.hi: ऊपर plant और financial year चुना हो; count और close से पहले साल "Open FY" से खुला हो।

prerequisites.en: Active locations in the plant.
prerequisites.hi: Plant में active location।

prerequisites.en: Inventory audit or manage rights.
prerequisites.hi: Inventory audit या manage अधिकार।

keyActions.en: 1. Overview: stock value by class, ageing (0-30, 31-90, 90+ days), valuation trend, opening → in → consumed → dispatch → adjust → closing, top movers, dead stock.
keyActions.hi: 1. Overview: class के हिसाब से stock value, ageing (0-30, 31-90, 90+ दिन), valuation trend, opening → in → consumed → dispatch → adjust → closing, top movers, dead stock।

keyActions.en: 2. Opening stock: enter quantities, paste rows ("Apply paste") or upload CSV/XLSX (validate, then "Post file"); rolls are entered one physical roll at a time; press "Post Opening Stock" (or "Post Cutover Stock").
keyActions.hi: 2. Opening stock: मात्रा भरें, rows paste करें ("Apply paste") या CSV/XLSX upload (validate, फिर "Post file"); roll एक-एक असली roll भरें; "Post Opening Stock" (या "Post Cutover Stock") दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: 3. Stock count → "Stock count · any day, month end or period": choose scope (All, Bulk, Rolls, Packing), location, roll form or granule code and count mode (soft freeze, hard freeze, spot count); enter counted quantities; give a reason for each difference of 2% or more; press "Post physical count".
keyActions.hi: 3. Stock count → "Stock count · any day, month end or period": scope (All, Bulk, Rolls, Packing), location, roll form या granule code और count mode (soft freeze, hard freeze, spot count) चुनें; गिनी मात्रा भरें; 2% या ज़्यादा फ़र्क पर कारण दें; "Post physical count" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: 4. Stock count → "Evening packing count": pick the location and date. Rows start filled with the book quantity; change only the items whose count differs (rows left at the book figure do not change stock), add a note, press "Post count". It posts at once with no approval. The difference is booked to the orders that ticked each item that day, or else to that day's orders whose packing plan includes it.
keyActions.hi: 4. Stock count → "Evening packing count": location और तारीख़ चुनें। लाइनें पहले से book मात्रा से भरी आती हैं; सिर्फ़ उन items की गिनती बदलें जो अलग निकलें (book पर छोड़ी लाइन से stock नहीं बदलता), नोट लिखें, "Post count" दबाएँ। यह बिना approval तुरंत post होता है। फ़र्क उस दिन item tick करने वाले order पर चढ़ता है, वरना उस दिन के उन orders पर जिनके packing plan में वह item है।

keyActions.en: 5. Count history: open a sheet to Validate, Submit, Approve and Post drafts, or Cancel; the evening packing proof and ink floor proof for a date are here too.
keyActions.hi: 5. Count history: sheet खोलकर draft को Validate, Submit, Approve और Post करें, या Cancel; किसी तारीख़ का evening packing proof और ink floor proof भी यहीं।

keyActions.en: 6. Month end: lock months in the monthly close tracker, take the month-end snapshot, "View month proof", and drill any material's stock card to its source document.
keyActions.hi: 6. Month end: monthly close tracker में महीने lock करें, month-end snapshot लें, "View month proof", और किसी material का stock card source document तक खोलें।

keyActions.en: 7. Year end: clear the "Annual close blockers", press "Close Financial Year" and confirm "Close FY". The year locks, next year's opening is generated and the year's finished records move to the archive (pick the year in the header to see them).
keyActions.hi: 7. Year end: "Annual close blockers" हटाएँ, "Close Financial Year" दबाएँ और "Close FY" पक्का करें। साल lock होता है, अगले साल की opening बनती है और साल के पूरे हुए record archive में जाते हैं (header में साल चुनकर देखें)।

help.en: Draft / submitted sheets still to finish; shown on the Stock count tab.
help.hi: अधूरी draft / submitted sheet; Stock count tab पर दिखती हैं।

help.en: Soft freeze · allow reviewed movement; Hard freeze · no movement until post; Spot count · selected rows only.
help.hi: Soft freeze · जाँची हुई आवाजाही चलती है; Hard freeze · post तक कोई आवाजाही नहीं; Spot count · सिर्फ़ चुनी लाइनें।

help.en: Only rows you enter post. Reasons: Book vs physical, Found / misplaced, Damage / scrap, Data entry, Other.
help.hi: सिर्फ़ भरी लाइनें post होती हैं। कारण: Book vs physical, Found / misplaced, Damage / scrap, Data entry, Other।

help.en: Delta = closing − book: negative is consumption shared to the day's orders (whole pieces), positive is count excess.
help.hi: Delta = closing − book: minus हो तो उस दिन के order पर खपत (पूरे pieces में) बँटती है, plus हो तो count excess।

help.en: Orders that packed or ticked items on the count date.
help.hi: जिन order ने count की तारीख़ पर pack किया या item tick किए।

help.en: Negative bulk stock, open inter-plant challans, open job-work orders, unresolved critical inventory alerts, draft audit sheets.
help.hi: Negative bulk stock, खुले inter-plant challan, खुले job-work order, unresolved critical alert, draft audit sheet।

help.en: Reporting proof only; it does not lock the year.
help.hi: सिर्फ़ report का proof; साल lock नहीं करता।

error.en: Row … has …% variance; a reason code and note are required.
error.hi: Row … has …% variance; a reason code and note are required.

reason.en: Differences of 2% or more need a reason.
reason.hi: 2% या ज़्यादा फ़र्क पर कारण ज़रूरी।

error.en: Select a location for … before posting the count.
error.hi: Select a location for … before posting the count.

reason.en: Pick the location on that row.
reason.hi: उस लाइन में location चुनें।

error.en: Enter counted quantity for at least one row. Physical count posts only rows you enter.
error.hi: Enter counted quantity for at least one row. Physical count posts only rows you enter.

reason.en: Type at least one count.
reason.hi: कम से कम एक गिनती भरें।

error.en: Maker and checker must be different users.
error.hi: Maker and checker must be different users.

reason.en: A second person approves a sheet you submitted; only an owner may approve their own.
reason.hi: आपकी submit की sheet कोई दूसरा approve करे; अपनी sheet सिर्फ़ owner खुद approve कर सकता है।

error.en: E-OS-05: opening blocked because … movement(s) already exist for this material/location in …
error.hi: E-OS-05: opening blocked because … movement(s) already exist for this material/location in …

reason.en: Stock already moved this year; use a stock count instead of opening stock.
reason.hi: इस साल stock पहले ही हिल चुका है; opening की जगह stock count करें।

error.en: Open this financial year before closing it.
error.hi: Open this financial year before closing it.

reason.en: Press "Open FY" first.
reason.hi: पहले "Open FY" दबाएँ।

error.en: Close … before starting another open period.
error.hi: Close … before starting another open period.

reason.en: Only one open year at a time.
reason.hi: एक समय में एक ही साल खुला रहता है।

error.en: Close blocked
error.hi: Close blocked

reason.en: A blocker is still open; fix it from its page (receive challans, close job work, finish drafts).
reason.hi: कोई blocker बाकी है; उसके पेज से ठीक करें (challan receive, job work close, draft पूरा)।

error.en: FY correction can only be created for a closed financial year. Use Stock Count for an open year.
error.hi: FY correction can only be created for a closed financial year. Use Stock Count for an open year.

reason.en: Use Stock count while the year is open.
reason.hi: साल खुला हो तो Stock count करें।

recoverySteps.en: "Select a plant…" messages: pick the plant at the top first.
recoverySteps.hi: "Select a plant…" संदेश: पहले ऊपर plant चुनें।

recoverySteps.en: A draft sheet blocking close: open it in Count history and Post or Cancel it.
recoverySteps.hi: Close रोकने वाली draft sheet: Count history में खोलकर Post या Cancel करें।

recoverySteps.en: Wrong packing count: check Packing audit → Evening counts before posting another count.
recoverySteps.hi: गलत packing count: दूसरी count से पहले Packing audit → Evening counts देखें।

summary.en: Genealogy, movement trail and current stage for any roll: scan its QR or enter the ERP ID or supplier roll number.
summary.hi: किसी भी roll की वंशावली, आवाजाही और अभी की stage: QR scan करें या ERP ID या supplier roll नंबर लिखें।

purpose.en: Answer "where did this roll come from and what became of it": the parent and child tree, every movement and consumption, and recent physical moves. Used for customer complaints, quality holds and missing rolls.
purpose.hi: "यह roll कहाँ से आया और इसका क्या हुआ" का जवाब: parent-child पेड़, हर movement और consumption, और हाल के असली move। Customer complaint, quality hold और गुम roll के लिए।

prerequisites.en: Inventory view rights.
prerequisites.hi: Inventory view अधिकार।

keyActions.en: 1. Scan the QR or type in "Scan QR, or enter ERP ID / supplier roll number" and press Enter or "Trace Roll".
keyActions.hi: 1. QR scan करें या "Scan QR, or enter ERP ID / supplier roll number" में लिखकर Enter या "Trace Roll" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: 2. Or pick from "Select roll from latest 200".
keyActions.hi: 2. या "Select roll from latest 200" से चुनें।

keyActions.en: 3. If several rolls match, pick the right one from the buttons by checking location and weight.
keyActions.hi: 3. कई roll मिलें तो location और वज़न देखकर बटन से सही चुनें।

keyActions.en: 4. Read the tiles (Current Weight, Original Weight, Lineage Children, Timeline Events, Current Stage), then "Genealogy Tree", "Movement & Consumption Timeline" and "Recent Physical Movements".
keyActions.hi: 4. Tile पढ़ें (Current Weight, Original Weight, Lineage Children, Timeline Events, Current Stage), फिर "Genealogy Tree", "Movement & Consumption Timeline" और "Recent Physical Movements"।

keyActions.en: 5. Reprint the roll label from the roll card if needed.
keyActions.hi: 5. ज़रूरत हो तो roll card से label फिर print करें।

help.en: How the roll was found: id, exact label or a unique reference.
help.hi: Roll कैसे मिला: id, exact label या unique reference।

help.en: Parents and children from slitting, splitting, lamination and conversion.
help.hi: Slitting, split, lamination और conversion से बने parent और child।

help.en: Base, output, remainder, split output or finished; available, reserved, in process, consumed, quarantine.
help.hi: Base, output, remainder, split output या finished; available, reserved, in process, consumed, quarantine।

error.en: More than one roll matches. Select the exact ERP ID after checking supplier reference and location.
error.hi: More than one roll matches. Select the exact ERP ID after checking supplier reference and location.

reason.en: The supplier number is on several rolls; pick one of the offered rolls.
reason.hi: Supplier नंबर कई roll पर है; दिखाए गए roll में से एक चुनें।

error.en: Roll not found for provided query
error.hi: Roll not found for provided query

reason.en: Check the number; try the ERP ID written on the roll.
reason.hi: नंबर जाँचें; roll पर लिखा ERP ID डालें।

recoverySteps.en: Open a roll straight from the Roll workspace with "Trace lineage".
recoverySteps.hi: Roll workspace से "Trace lineage" से सीधे roll खोलें।

summary.en: List of suppliers, job workers and service providers with code, name, type, GST no., payment terms and address; add, edit or delete a vendor.
summary.hi: Supplier, job worker और service provider की सूची — code, name, type, GST no., payment terms और address के साथ; vendor जोड़ें, बदलें या हटाएँ।

purpose.en: Keep the vendors Smart GRN, purchase orders and job work pick from. The type decides use: Raw Material and Hybrid can supply GRNs; Job Worker and Hybrid can take job work.
purpose.hi: Smart GRN, purchase order और job work जिन vendor को चुनते हैं, उन्हें यहाँ रखें। Type से उपयोग तय होता है: Raw Material और Hybrid से GRN; Job Worker और Hybrid को job work।

prerequisites.en: Inventory or procurement rights.
prerequisites.hi: Inventory या procurement अधिकार।

keyActions.en: 1. Read the tiles: Total Partners, Material Suppliers, Job Workers, Service Providers.
keyActions.hi: 1. Tile देखें: Total Partners, Material Suppliers, Job Workers, Service Providers।

keyActions.en: 2. Search in "Search partners...".
keyActions.hi: 2. "Search partners..." में खोजें।

keyActions.en: 3. Press "Onboard Entity": fill Code, Name, Type, GST No, Payment Terms, Lead Time (Days), Address; press "Save Entity".
keyActions.hi: 3. "Onboard Entity" दबाएँ: Code, Name, Type, GST No, Payment Terms, Lead Time (Days), Address भरें; "Save Entity"।

keyActions.en: 4. Edit a row to open "Edit Vendor Profile".
keyActions.hi: 4. लाइन edit करके "Edit Vendor Profile" खोलें।

keyActions.en: 5. Delete only a vendor created by mistake ("Revoke Partnership?" → "Delete Entity").
keyActions.hi: 5. सिर्फ़ गलती से बना vendor हटाएँ ("Revoke Partnership?" → "Delete Entity")।

help.en: Raw Material (RM), Job Worker (JOBWORK), Service Provider (SERVICE), Hybrid (BOTH).
help.hi: Raw Material (RM), Job Worker (JOBWORK), Service Provider (SERVICE), Hybrid (BOTH)।

help.en: Both required; code like VEND-001.
help.hi: दोनों ज़रूरी; code जैसे VEND-001।

help.en: Printed on challans and used for bill checks.
help.hi: Challan पर छपता है और बिल जाँच में काम आता है।

error.en: Code is required / Name is required
error.hi: Code is required / Name is required

reason.en: Fill both before saving.
reason.hi: Save से पहले दोनों भरें।

error.en: GRN vendor must be RM or BOTH type.
error.hi: GRN vendor must be RM or BOTH type.

reason.en: Shown on Smart GRN when the type is wrong; change it here.
reason.hi: Type गलत हो तो Smart GRN पर आता है; यहाँ बदलें।

recoverySteps.en: A vendor that stopped supplying should be set Inactive in Master data → Vendors (/master/vendors) rather than deleted, so history keeps its name. Job-work processes, plants and rate cards are also edited there.
recoverySteps.hi: जो vendor अब माल नहीं देता उसे हटाने की जगह vendor master में inactive करें, ताकि पुराने record में नाम रहे।

summary.en: A read-only overview of dispatch: draft and dispatched challans, inter-plant challans on the road, dispatch weight trend, top customers and the latest challans.
summary.hi: डिस्पैच का केवल देखने वाला सार: ड्राफ्ट और भेजे गए चालान, रास्ते में चल रहे इंटर-प्लांट चालान, डिस्पैच वज़न का ट्रेंड, बड़े ग्राहक और हाल के चालान।

purpose.en: Open it at the start or end of a shift to see how much went out and what is still waiting. Nothing is changed here; for real work press "Open Dispatch Bay". Figures come from the dispatch report and the inter-plant report.
purpose.hi: शिफ्ट की शुरुआत या अंत में खोलें, ताकि पता चले कितना माल गया और कितना बाकी है। यहाँ कुछ बदला नहीं जाता; असली काम के लिए "Open Dispatch Bay" दबाएँ। आँकड़े डिस्पैच रिपोर्ट और इंटर-प्लांट रिपोर्ट से आते हैं।

prerequisites.en: Your role must have the Logistics area (Admin, Owner, Dispatch or an inventory permission).
prerequisites.hi: आपके रोल को Logistics एरिया मिला हो (Admin, Owner, Dispatch या इन्वेंटरी अनुमति)।

prerequisites.en: Challans exist only after slips are created in Dispatch Bay.
prerequisites.hi: चालान तभी दिखते हैं जब Dispatch Bay में स्लिप बन चुकी हों।

keyActions.en: Read the four tiles: "Draft challans", "In transit", "Dispatched challans", "Dispatch weight".
keyActions.hi: चार टाइल पढ़ें: "Draft challans", "In transit", "Dispatched challans", "Dispatch weight"।

keyActions.en: Check "Dispatch weight trend" for the daily kg shipped.
keyActions.hi: "Dispatch weight trend" में हर दिन भेजा गया kg देखें।

keyActions.en: Check "Top dispatch customers" to see who took the most weight.
keyActions.hi: "Top dispatch customers" में देखें किस ग्राहक को सबसे ज़्यादा वज़न गया।

keyActions.en: Scan "Latest challans" (number, customer, status, vehicle) and "Inter-plant live lanes" (from → to plant, kg).
keyActions.hi: "Latest challans" (नंबर, ग्राहक, स्टेटस, गाड़ी) और "Inter-plant live lanes" (किस प्लांट से किस प्लांट, kg) देखें।

keyActions.en: Press "Open Dispatch Bay" to load and send goods, or "Open Transit Board" for the transit page.
keyActions.hi: माल लोड करके भेजने के लिए "Open Dispatch Bay" दबाएँ, या ट्रांज़िट पेज के लिए "Open Transit Board"।

help.en: Slips created but not yet marked dispatched.
help.hi: स्लिप बनी है पर अभी "dispatched" नहीं की गई।

help.en: Inter-plant challans still on the road (not yet received at the other plant).
help.hi: इंटर-प्लांट चालान जो अभी रास्ते में हैं, दूसरे प्लांट पर रिसीव नहीं हुए।

help.en: Customer challans already marked dispatched.
help.hi: ग्राहक के चालान जो dispatched हो चुके हैं।

help.en: Total kg shipped in the report window.
help.hi: रिपोर्ट की अवधि में भेजा गया कुल kg।

help.en: Up to five inter-plant challans with from/to plant, status and dispatched kg.
help.hi: पाँच तक इंटर-प्लांट चालान: किस प्लांट से किस प्लांट, स्टेटस और भेजा गया kg।

error.en: Logistics could not load (retry box)
error.hi: Logistics लोड नहीं हुआ (retry बॉक्स)

reason.en: The dispatch or inter-plant report failed. Press retry; if it repeats, check the connection or tell the admin.
reason.hi: डिस्पैच या इंटर-प्लांट रिपोर्ट नहीं आई। retry दबाएँ; बार-बार हो तो नेटवर्क देखें या एडमिन को बताएँ।

error.en: No challans found for the selected window.
error.hi: No challans found for the selected window.

reason.en: No slip was created in the report period. Slips appear after Create in Dispatch Bay.
reason.hi: उस अवधि में कोई स्लिप नहीं बनी। Dispatch Bay में Create करने के बाद ही स्लिप दिखती है।

recoverySteps.en: Reload the page if tiles show "..." for long.
recoverySteps.hi: टाइल पर देर तक "..." दिखे तो पेज रीलोड करें।

recoverySteps.en: For any action (print, dispatch, POD) go to Dispatch Bay; this page has no buttons that change data.
recoverySteps.hi: कोई भी काम (प्रिंट, डिस्पैच, POD) Dispatch Bay में करें; इस पेज से डेटा नहीं बदलता।

summary.en: Load released rolls and gonnies onto a vehicle, create one dispatch slip per order line, print it on the Epson 10 × 6 in form, mark it dispatched and later confirm proof of delivery (POD).
summary.hi: रिलीज़ हुए रोल और गोनी गाड़ी पर लोड करें, हर ऑर्डर लाइन की अलग डिस्पैच स्लिप बनाएँ, Epson 10 × 6 इंच फ़ॉर्म पर प्रिंट करें, dispatched मार्क करें और बाद में डिलीवरी का सबूत (POD) कन्फ़र्म करें।

purpose.en: Use it when Packing Yard has released units. Only released units appear here. Three tabs: "Ready to dispatch" (board and loading tray), "This load" (slips just created) and "Challans & history". After POD the order can close.
purpose.hi: जब Packing Yard यूनिट रिलीज़ कर दे तब खोलें। यहाँ सिर्फ़ रिलीज़ यूनिट दिखती हैं। तीन टैब: "Ready to dispatch" (बोर्ड और लोडिंग ट्रे), "This load" (अभी बनी स्लिप) और "Challans & history"। POD के बाद ऑर्डर बंद हो सकता है।

prerequisites.en: Units must be released from Packing Yard (sealed gonnies or released rolls).
prerequisites.hi: यूनिट Packing Yard से रिलीज़ हों (सील गोनी या रिलीज़ रोल)।

prerequisites.en: The sales order must not be a draft; a cancelled or completed order or closed line needs the closed-lines tick.
prerequisites.hi: सेल्स ऑर्डर ड्राफ्ट न हो; कैंसल/कम्प्लीट ऑर्डर या बंद लाइन के लिए closed-lines टिक चाहिए।

prerequisites.en: A delivery address on the order, or a dispatch-only location typed in the tray.
prerequisites.hi: ऑर्डर पर डिलीवरी पता हो, या ट्रे में dispatch-only लोकेशन लिखी जाए।

prerequisites.en: For Epson printing on a Windows PC, install "Epson setup" once.
prerequisites.hi: Windows PC पर Epson प्रिंट के लिए एक बार "Epson setup" इंस्टॉल करें।

keyActions.en: On "Ready to dispatch", find the order (search, "Unit type", "Queue status", customer, sort or "Jump to order…").
keyActions.hi: "Ready to dispatch" पर ऑर्डर ढूँढें (search, "Unit type", "Queue status", ग्राहक, sort या "Jump to order…")।

keyActions.en: Tick a line to load all its ready units, or open "Units" and tick single rolls/gonnies for a part load.
keyActions.hi: लाइन टिक करें तो उसकी सारी तैयार यूनिट लोड होंगी; आधा लोड करना हो तो "Units" खोलकर एक-एक रोल/गोनी टिक करें।

keyActions.en: In "Loading tray" fill "Transporter" (required; or tap "Own vehicle", "Customer pickup", "Courier"). "Vehicle no.", driver, LR no., E-way bill and note are optional.
keyActions.hi: "Loading tray" में "Transporter" भरें (ज़रूरी; या "Own vehicle", "Customer pickup", "Courier" दबाएँ)। "Vehicle no.", ड्राइवर, LR no., E-way bill और नोट वैकल्पिक हैं।

keyActions.en: Check "Delivery location" for each order; if a closed line is on the tray tick "Send goods of closed lines".
keyActions.hi: हर ऑर्डर की "Delivery location" देखें; बंद लाइन ट्रे पर हो तो "Send goods of closed lines" टिक करें।

keyActions.en: Press "Create N slips". All slips of the tray are created together or none.
keyActions.hi: "Create N slips" दबाएँ। ट्रे की सारी स्लिप एक साथ बनती हैं, या एक भी नहीं।

keyActions.en: On "This load" check the slip text and press "Print N slips" (or "Print this slip", "A4 PDF", QR sticker).
keyActions.hi: "This load" पर स्लिप का टेक्स्ट देखें और "Print N slips" दबाएँ (या "Print this slip", "A4 PDF", QR स्टिकर)।

keyActions.en: When the vehicle leaves press "Mark dispatched · close".
keyActions.hi: गाड़ी निकलते ही "Mark dispatched · close" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Later, in "Challans & history" → "Awaiting POD", press "Confirm POD", add receiver / reference / notes and confirm.
keyActions.hi: बाद में "Challans & history" → "Awaiting POD" में "Confirm POD" दबाएँ, रिसीवर/रेफ़रेंस/नोट भरें और कन्फ़र्म करें।

help.en: Released gonnies and rolls waiting in the bay.
help.hi: बे में इंतज़ार कर रहे रिलीज़ गोनी और रोल।

help.en: Gross kg of ready units, with net product kg below.
help.hi: तैयार यूनिट का ग्रॉस kg, नीचे नेट प्रोडक्ट kg।

help.en: Orders with ready units, customers count and how many are still in packing.
help.hi: जिन ऑर्डर की यूनिट तैयार हैं, ग्राहकों की गिनती और कितने अभी पैकिंग में हैं।

help.en: Vehicles and slips of today; slips split into dispatched and draft.
help.hi: आज की गाड़ियाँ और स्लिप; स्लिप dispatched और draft में बँटी।

help.en: Dispatched challans without proof of delivery. Opens the history tab.
help.hi: dispatched चालान जिनका POD नहीं हुआ। history टैब खोलता है।

field.en: Line balance (ordered / dispatched / on this load / remaining)
field.hi: लाइन बैलेंस (ordered / dispatched / on this load / remaining)

help.en: Per line; a closed line shows "Order completed" or "Line short-closed" with ordered, closed, made and waiting quantities.
help.hi: हर लाइन के लिए; बंद लाइन पर "Order completed" या "Line short-closed" और ordered, closed, बना हुआ व बाकी मात्रा दिखती है।

help.en: Required. Printed as TRANSPORT NAME on every slip.
help.hi: ज़रूरी। हर स्लिप पर TRANSPORT NAME में छपता है।

help.en: Optional. Saved on the challan; not printed on the slip today.
help.hi: वैकल्पिक। चालान में सेव होता है; अभी स्लिप पर नहीं छपता।

help.en: Taken from the order address; you can override it for these slips only.
help.hi: ऑर्डर के पते से आती है; सिर्फ़ इन स्लिप के लिए बदल सकते हैं।

help.en: Not printed on the slip.
help.hi: स्लिप पर नहीं छपता।

help.en: Per-unit manifest of selected or visible units, on Epson or as A4 PDF.
help.hi: चुनी या दिख रही यूनिट की सूची, Epson पर या A4 PDF में।

help.en: "Drafts", "Awaiting POD", "Delivered", "Cancelled"; date Today / 7 days / All; customer; search by challan, customer, SO, job or vehicle.
help.hi: "Drafts", "Awaiting POD", "Delivered", "Cancelled"; तारीख Today / 7 days / All; ग्राहक; चालान, ग्राहक, SO, job या गाड़ी से search।

error.en: Transporter name is required (printed as TRANSPORT NAME).
error.hi: Transporter name is required (printed as TRANSPORT NAME).

reason.en: The Transporter box is empty. Type it or tap a quick choice.
reason.hi: Transporter खाली है। नाम लिखें या कोई quick choice दबाएँ।

error.en: Delivery location missing for SO-…: enter where it goes.
error.hi: Delivery location missing for SO-…: enter where it goes.

reason.en: The order has no shipping address. Type a dispatch-only location in the tray.
reason.hi: ऑर्डर पर शिपिंग पता नहीं है। ट्रे में dispatch-only लोकेशन लिखें।

error.en: Closed lines on the tray: SO-… L2. Confirm shipping the goods already made for them, or move them to stock.
error.hi: Closed lines on the tray: SO-… L2. Confirm shipping the goods already made for them, or move them to stock.

reason.en: A closed line is loaded without the tick. Tick "Send goods of closed lines", or take the line off and use "Move to stock".
reason.hi: बंद लाइन बिना टिक के लोड है। "Send goods of closed lines" टिक करें, या लाइन हटाकर "Move to stock" करें।

error.en: Sales Order SO-… is DRAFT; a challan cannot be created in this order state.
error.hi: Sales Order SO-… is DRAFT; a challan cannot be created in this order state.

reason.en: A draft order never dispatches. Ask sales to place the order.
reason.hi: ड्राफ्ट ऑर्डर कभी डिस्पैच नहीं होता। सेल्स से ऑर्डर प्लेस करवाएँ।

error.en: Gonny … is not released from Packing Yard. / Roll … is not released to Dispatch Bay yet.
error.hi: Gonny … is not released from Packing Yard. / Roll … is not released to Dispatch Bay yet.

reason.en: The unit was not released. Release it in Packing Yard first.
reason.hi: यूनिट रिलीज़ नहीं हुई। पहले Packing Yard में रिलीज़ करें।

error.en: Batch … is on hold at the packing check … A supervisor must accept it with a reason before dispatch.
error.hi: Batch … is on hold at the packing check … A supervisor must accept it with a reason before dispatch.

reason.en: The packing check found a difference. A supervisor accepts it in Packing Yard → Details → Packing check.
reason.hi: पैकिंग चेक में अंतर मिला। सुपरवाइज़र Packing Yard → Details → Packing check में कारण देकर स्वीकार करे।

error.en: Selected dispatch unit is already reserved or dispatched: …
error.hi: Selected dispatch unit is already reserved or dispatched: …

reason.en: Someone else loaded it on another slip. Press Refresh and load again.
reason.hi: किसी और ने इसे दूसरी स्लिप पर ले लिया। Refresh करके फिर लोड करें।

error.en: POD can only be confirmed for a dispatched challan, not DRAFT
error.hi: POD can only be confirmed for a dispatched challan, not DRAFT

reason.en: Mark the slip dispatched first, then confirm POD.
reason.hi: पहले स्लिप dispatched करें, फिर POD।

error.en: Epson print failed
error.hi: Epson print failed

reason.en: The print job could not be prepared or the PC has no Epson helper. Install "Epson setup" or use "A4 PDF".
reason.hi: प्रिंट जॉब नहीं बना या PC पर Epson helper नहीं है। "Epson setup" इंस्टॉल करें या "A4 PDF" लें।

recoverySteps.en: Press Refresh (top) if a unit you expect is missing; it auto-refreshes every 30 s.
recoverySteps.hi: जो यूनिट दिखनी चाहिए वो न दिखे तो ऊपर Refresh दबाएँ; हर 30 सेकंड में अपने-आप रिफ़्रेश होता है।

recoverySteps.en: If "No orders to ship", the units are still in Packing Yard: release them there.
recoverySteps.hi: "No orders to ship" दिखे तो यूनिट अभी Packing Yard में हैं: वहाँ रिलीज़ करें।

recoverySteps.en: To send goods of a closed line to free stock instead, press "Move to stock" on that line.
recoverySteps.hi: बंद लाइन का माल फ़्री स्टॉक में भेजना हो तो उस लाइन पर "Move to stock" दबाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: A draft slip from earlier is in "Challans & history" → "Drafts"; press "Dispatch" there (a closed line asks "Line closed · send the goods anyway?").
recoverySteps.hi: पुरानी ड्राफ्ट स्लिप "Challans & history" → "Drafts" में है; वहाँ "Dispatch" दबाएँ (बंद लाइन पर "Line closed · send the goods anyway?" पूछेगा)।

recoverySteps.en: From an order page, the link /logistics/dispatch?history=SO-… opens that order's slips.
recoverySteps.hi: ऑर्डर पेज से /logistics/dispatch?history=SO-… लिंक उस ऑर्डर की स्लिप खोलता है।

summary.en: Turn produced pouch batches and rolls into weighed dispatch units: pack pouches into gonnies, weigh and seal them, tick the packing items used, and release each line to Dispatch Bay as its own slip.
summary.hi: बने हुए पाउच बैच और रोल को तौली हुई डिस्पैच यूनिट में बदलें: पाउच गोनी में भरें, तौलकर सील करें, इस्तेमाल हुए पैकिंग आइटम टिक करें, और हर लाइन को अलग स्लिप के लिए Dispatch Bay में रिलीज़ करें।

purpose.en: Open it when machines have logged output for an order. Work comes from the machine terminals (batches and rolls); released units go to Dispatch Bay. Tabs: "Queue · ready to pack", "In progress" (open and sealed gonnies) and "History" (released lines).
purpose.hi: जब मशीन किसी ऑर्डर का आउटपुट दर्ज कर दे तब खोलें। काम मशीन टर्मिनल से आता है (बैच और रोल); रिलीज़ यूनिट Dispatch Bay में जाती हैं। टैब: "Queue · ready to pack", "In progress" (खुली और सील गोनी) और "History" (रिलीज़ लाइनें)।

prerequisites.en: Machine output logged against an order line (batch for pouches, roll for rolls).
prerequisites.hi: ऑर्डर लाइन पर मशीन आउटपुट दर्ज हो (पाउच के लिए बैच, रोल के लिए रोल)।

prerequisites.en: Gonny packaging masters with their weight in Masters › Packaging; other packing items active there.
prerequisites.hi: Masters › Packaging में गोनी मास्टर उनके वज़न के साथ; बाकी पैकिंग आइटम वहाँ active हों।

prerequisites.en: The order's packing plan (inner packs or loose pouches, pouches per pack, inner pouch, gonny).
prerequisites.hi: ऑर्डर का पैकिंग प्लान (inner packs या loose pouches, एक पैक में कितने पाउच, inner pouch, गोनी)।

keyActions.en: In "Queue · ready to pack" use "Packing route" (All / Pouch / Roll / Release), search, customer, sort or "Jump to order…".
keyActions.hi: "Queue · ready to pack" में "Packing route" (All / Pouch / Roll / Release), search, ग्राहक, sort या "Jump to order…" से ऑर्डर ढूँढें।

keyActions.en: Tick the ready lines (one or many orders; "All N ready lines" ticks an order), then press "Pack selected · N". Or press "Pack" / "Release" / "Pack & release" on one line.
keyActions.hi: तैयार लाइनें टिक करें (एक या कई ऑर्डर; "All N ready lines" पूरा ऑर्डर टिक करता है), फिर "Pack selected · N" दबाएँ। या एक लाइन पर "Pack" / "Release" / "Pack & release" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Pouch line, step 1: check the machine figures and tick "Figures checked". Step 2 shows how pouches arrive (the order's choice: "Inner packs" or "Loose pouches").
keyActions.hi: पाउच लाइन, स्टेप 1: मशीन के आँकड़े देखें और "Figures checked" टिक करें। स्टेप 2 बताता है पाउच कैसे आते हैं (ऑर्डर के अनुसार: "Inner packs" या "Loose pouches")।

keyActions.en: Step 3: enter inner packs or pouches in this gonny ("Suggest split" helps), pick "Gonny type · tare", put it on the scale and type "Weighed gross kg". Press "Add gonny · sealed" (or leave gross empty for "Add gonny · open" and weigh it later in the list).
keyActions.hi: स्टेप 3: इस गोनी के inner packs या पाउच भरें ("Suggest split" मदद करता है), "Gonny type · tare" चुनें, तराज़ू पर रखकर "Weighed gross kg" लिखें। "Add gonny · sealed" दबाएँ (या gross खाली छोड़कर "Add gonny · open" और बाद में लिस्ट में तौलें)।

keyActions.en: If the scale differs from expected by more than 2 %, write a variance reason.
keyActions.hi: तराज़ू का वज़न expected से 2 % से ज़्यादा अलग हो तो variance का कारण लिखें।

keyActions.en: Step 4: tick every packing item used (gonny, sheet, putha, box, tape, label, tag, outer bag…). No quantities; inner pouches are not listed.
keyActions.hi: स्टेप 4: इस्तेमाल हुआ हर पैकिंग आइटम टिक करें (गोनी, शीट, पुठा, बॉक्स, टेप, लेबल, टैग, बाहरी बैग…)। मात्रा नहीं; inner pouch लिस्ट में नहीं आता।

keyActions.en: Step 5: press "Release L1 · N gonnies" ("· short" if pouches stay for later). With several tabs ready press "Release all N lines".
keyActions.hi: स्टेप 5: "Release L1 · N gonnies" दबाएँ (कुछ पाउच बाद के लिए बचें तो "· short")। कई टैब तैयार हों तो "Release all N lines"।

keyActions.en: Roll line: tick the rolls ("Select all open"), choose "Packed roll · sheet / wrap" or "Release unpacked roll", tick the items used, then release.
keyActions.hi: रोल लाइन: रोल टिक करें ("Select all open"), "Packed roll · sheet / wrap" या "Release unpacked roll" चुनें, इस्तेमाल हुए आइटम टिक करें, फिर रिलीज़ करें।

keyActions.en: Check "History" (Today / 7 days / All) for who released what, every gonny with weights, the items ticked and the slip.
keyActions.hi: "History" (Today / 7 days / All) में देखें किसने क्या रिलीज़ किया, हर गोनी का वज़न, टिक आइटम और स्लिप।

help.en: Lines with batches or rolls waiting; sub-line shows batches, rolls and pcs.
help.hi: जिन लाइनों के बैच या रोल बाकी हैं; नीचे बैच, रोल और pcs।

help.en: Net kg still to pack: pouches and rolls.
help.hi: अभी पैक होने वाला नेट kg: पाउच और रोल।

help.en: Gonnies packed since midnight, plus rolls released.
help.hi: आधी रात से पैक हुई गोनी, साथ में रिलीज़ रोल।

help.en: Open gonnies to weigh and sealed gonnies to release. Opens "In progress".
help.hi: तौलने वाली खुली गोनी और रिलीज़ होने वाली सील गोनी। "In progress" खोलता है।

help.en: Units released to Dispatch Bay today with net and gross kg. Opens History.
help.hi: आज Dispatch Bay में रिलीज़ यूनिट, नेट और ग्रॉस kg के साथ। History खोलता है।

help.en: Held packing checks plus gonnies more than ±2 % off the expected gross.
help.hi: रुके हुए पैकिंग चेक और वो गोनी जिनका ग्रॉस expected से ±2 % से ज़्यादा अलग है।

help.en: Product net (machine log) + inner pouches + gonny tare.
help.hi: प्रोडक्ट नेट (मशीन लॉग) + inner pouches + गोनी का वज़न।

help.en: Size, layers, pcs or kg, g per pouch, inner packs or loose, machine, ready since, location.
help.hi: साइज़, लेयर, pcs या kg, एक पाउच का ग्राम, inner packs या loose, मशीन, कब से तैयार, लोकेशन।

help.en: Prints the material ready slip; enabled once the order has released units.
help.hi: मटेरियल रेडी स्लिप प्रिंट करता है; रिलीज़ यूनिट होने पर ही चालू।

help.en: Tabs "Units & batches", "Packing check", "Order & links".
help.hi: टैब "Units & batches", "Packing check", "Order & links"।
