purpose.en: Open it before an order needs a new attachment, or when the weight of an add-on is wrong. Product Masters list the add-ons sales may pick; the order BOM uses the weight set here. Saving a changed weight re-calculates every open, unreleased order line that uses the add-on.
purpose.hi: जब किसी order में नया attachment लगना हो या add-on का वज़न गलत हो, तब यह पेज खोलें। Product Master में वही add-on चुने जा सकते हैं जो यहाँ हैं; order का BOM यहीं का वज़न लेता है। वज़न बदलकर save करने पर उस add-on वाली हर खुली, release न हुई order line फिर से गिनी जाती है।

prerequisites.en: Admin/Owner role or master grant.
prerequisites.hi: Admin/Owner रोल या master अधिकार।

prerequisites.en: Know the real weight of the add-on (grams per piece or per mm of length).
prerequisites.hi: Add-on का असली वज़न पता हो (प्रति piece या प्रति mm लंबाई ग्राम)।

keyActions.en: Press "Add Addon".
keyActions.hi: "Add Addon" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Fill "Addon Code" (e.g. ZIP-25) and "Description".
keyActions.hi: "Addon Code" (जैसे ZIP-25) और "Description" भरें।

keyActions.en: Pick "Consumption Mode": "Per Millimeter", "Per Piece" or "Fixed Weight".
keyActions.hi: "Consumption Mode" चुनें: "Per Millimeter", "Per Piece" या "Fixed Weight"।

keyActions.en: Enter the weight in grams. For Per Millimeter also pick "The weight above is given per" 1 mm or 10 mm of applied length.
keyActions.hi: वज़न ग्राम में भरें। Per Millimeter में "The weight above is given per" से 1 mm या 10 mm चुनें।

keyActions.en: Check the box "Check: one piece on a 280 mm wide bag"; the grams per bag must look right.
keyActions.hi: "Check: one piece on a 280 mm wide bag" बॉक्स देखें; प्रति bag ग्राम सही लगना चाहिए।

keyActions.en: Set "Purchasable?" Yes if the store inwards it, and pick "Purchase UOM" (KG, PCS, METER).
keyActions.hi: अगर store इसे inward करता है तो "Purchasable?" Yes करें और "Purchase UOM" (KG, PCS, METER) चुनें।

keyActions.en: Press "Save". On edit, read the toast: it says how many open lines were refreshed and skipped.
keyActions.hi: "Save" दबाएँ। Edit पर toast पढ़ें: कितनी खुली lines refresh हुईं और कितनी skip हुईं।

help.en: Per Millimeter = weight grows with bag width; Per Piece = same grams on every bag; Fixed Weight = one fixed weight.
help.hi: Per Millimeter = bag की चौड़ाई के साथ वज़न बढ़ता है; Per Piece = हर bag पर एक जैसा ग्राम; Fixed Weight = एक तय वज़न।

help.en: Only for Per Millimeter. Say whether the grams you typed are for 1 mm or 10 mm of zipper length.
help.hi: सिर्फ Per Millimeter के लिए। आपने जो ग्राम लिखा वह 1 mm का है या 10 mm का।

help.en: Yes lets the store inward it as bought stock; its stock unit becomes the Purchase UOM. No keeps stock unit KG.
help.hi: Yes से store इसे खरीदा हुआ stock inward कर सकता है; stock unit Purchase UOM बन जाती है। No पर stock unit KG रहती है।

field.en: Columns: Code, Name, Mode, Weight (g), Purchasable, Stock UOM
field.hi: Columns: Code, Name, Mode, Weight (g), Purchasable, Stock UOM

help.en: Table of all add-ons with Edit and Delete per row.
help.hi: सभी add-on की table, हर row पर Edit और Delete।

error.en: Saved, but open lines could not be refreshed: …
error.hi: Saved, but open lines could not be refreshed: …

reason.en: The add-on saved but re-calculating open orders failed. Open the order line or ask the planner; released lines need "Recalculate from masters" on the WC terminal.
reason.hi: Add-on save हो गया पर खुले orders फिर से नहीं गिने गए। Planner को बताएँ; release हो चुकी lines के लिए WC terminal पर "Recalculate from masters" दबाएँ।

error.en: Code is required / Name is required / Value must be positive
error.hi: Code is required / Name is required / Value must be positive

reason.en: Fill code and description and a weight of 0 or more.
reason.hi: Code, description और 0 या उससे ज़्यादा वज़न भरें।

recoverySteps.en: If a released job still shows the old weight, press "Recalculate from masters" on the work-centre terminal.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर release हुए job में पुराना वज़न दिखे, तो work-centre terminal पर "Recalculate from masters" दबाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: Before Delete, make sure no Product Master still allows this add-on.
recoverySteps.hi: Delete से पहले देख लें कि कोई Product Master इस add-on को अब भी allow तो नहीं करता।

summary.en: Read-only view of the one fixed adhesive and one fixed solvent master used for lamination.
summary.hi: Lamination के लिए तय एक adhesive और एक solvent मास्टर को देखने का पेज (बदल नहीं सकते)।

purpose.en: Open it to check the code of the adhesive or solvent that GRN, issue, BOM and variance use. The chemistry is locked: you cannot add or edit records here. Vendor, location, quantity, cost and reference are entered at GRN.
purpose.hi: GRN, issue, BOM और variance में कौन सा adhesive/solvent code लगता है, यह देखने के लिए खोलें। यह lock है: यहाँ नया रिकॉर्ड जोड़ या बदल नहीं सकते। Vendor, location, मात्रा, cost और reference GRN पर भरे जाते हैं।

prerequisites.en: Admin/Owner role or master grant.
prerequisites.hi: Admin/Owner रोल या master अधिकार।

keyActions.en: Check the tiles "Adhesive" and "Solvent": each should show 1 and its code. "Missing" means that master does not exist.
keyActions.hi: "Adhesive" और "Solvent" टाइल देखें: दोनों में 1 और code दिखना चाहिए। "Missing" का मतलब मास्टर नहीं है।

keyActions.en: Read the "Locked chemistry policy" card for the two records.
keyActions.hi: "Locked chemistry policy" कार्ड में दोनों रिकॉर्ड देखें।

keyActions.en: Use "Filter chemistry master..." or the top search to find by name, code or status.
keyActions.hi: "Filter chemistry master..." या ऊपर search से नाम, code या status से खोजें।

keyActions.en: Set adhesive and solvent GSM per product in the Product Master "Adhesive" section, not here.
keyActions.hi: हर product का adhesive और solvent GSM Product Master के "Adhesive" section में भरें, यहाँ नहीं।

help.en: Table columns: ADHESIVE or SOLVENT, its code, name and status.
help.hi: Table के column: ADHESIVE या SOLVENT, code, नाम और status।

help.en: How many records match the current search.
help.hi: Search से मेल खाने वाले रिकॉर्ड की संख्या।

error.en: Adhesive or Solvent tile shows "Missing"
error.hi: Adhesive या Solvent टाइल पर "Missing"

reason.en: The system record is absent. Lamination BOM cannot take chemistry; ask the system admin to restore it.
reason.hi: System रिकॉर्ड नहीं है। Lamination BOM chemistry नहीं ले पाएगा; system admin से ठीक करवाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: To change consumption, edit the GSM on the Product Master, then save it.
recoverySteps.hi: खपत बदलनी हो तो Product Master पर GSM बदलकर save करें।

summary.en: Business-friendly family names (for example PET Printed Laminate) used to group and name stock in the stock explorer, planner and reports.
summary.hi: Business वाले family नाम (जैसे PET Printed Laminate) जिनसे stock explorer, planner और reports में stock का समूह और नाम बनता है।

purpose.en: Open it to add or rename a business family, or to set its default form and reporting group. Film families and film variants can link to a business family so stock reads in plain words.
purpose.hi: नया business family जोड़ने, नाम बदलने या उसका default form और reporting group सेट करने के लिए खोलें। Film family और film variant इससे जुड़ सकते हैं ताकि stock का नाम आसान लगे।

prerequisites.en: Admin/Owner role or master grant.
prerequisites.hi: Admin/Owner रोल या master अधिकार।

keyActions.en: Press "Add Business Family".
keyActions.hi: "Add Business Family" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Fill "Code" (e.g. PET_PRINTED) and "Business Family Name".
keyActions.hi: "Code" (जैसे PET_PRINTED) और "Business Family Name" भरें।

keyActions.en: Pick "Default Form" (Roll or Pouch) and "Reporting Group" (Film, Printed, Laminated, Semi-FG, FG, Packaging, Other).
keyActions.hi: "Default Form" (Roll या Pouch) और "Reporting Group" (Film, Printed, Laminated, Semi-FG, FG, Packaging, Other) चुनें।

keyActions.en: Leave "Active" on; press "Save".
keyActions.hi: "Active" चालू रखें; "Save" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: To change one, press "Edit" on its row; to retire it, switch Active off instead of deleting.
keyActions.hi: बदलने के लिए row पर "Edit" दबाएँ; हटाने की जगह Active बंद करें।

help.en: Inactive families stay in history but drop from new naming.
help.hi: Inactive family इतिहास में रहती है पर नए नामों में नहीं आती।

help.en: How many families default to roll or pouch stock.
help.hi: कितनी family का default roll या pouch है।

help.en: The report bucket the family falls in.
help.hi: Report में family किस समूह में गिनी जाएगी।

error.en: Create failed / Update failed / Delete failed
error.hi: Create failed / Update failed / Delete failed

reason.en: Usually a duplicate code or the family is still linked. Use a new code, or set it Inactive instead of deleting.
reason.hi: अक्सर code दोहराया गया है या family अभी जुड़ी है। नया code दें, या delete की जगह Inactive करें।

recoverySteps.en: Only delete a family when nothing active depends on it (the delete dialog warns about this).
recoverySteps.hi: Family तभी delete करें जब कोई active चीज़ उस पर निर्भर न हो (dialog यही चेतावनी देता है)।

summary.en: Base film materials (LDPE, HDPE, PET…) with their density, which drives weight and yield maths.
summary.hi: Base film material (LDPE, HDPE, PET…) और उनकी density, जिससे वज़न और yield का हिसाब बनता है।

purpose.en: Open it to add a new base film or correct its density. Every film variant belongs to one family, so create the family first.
purpose.hi: नई base film जोड़ने या density ठीक करने के लिए खोलें। हर film variant किसी एक family का होता है, इसलिए पहले family बनाएँ।

prerequisites.en: Admin/Owner role or master grant.
prerequisites.hi: Admin/Owner रोल या master अधिकार।

prerequisites.en: Correct density in g/cm³ from the supplier sheet.
prerequisites.hi: Supplier sheet से सही density (g/cm³)।

keyActions.en: Press "Add Family".
keyActions.hi: "Add Family" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Fill "Family Name" (e.g. LDPE).
keyActions.hi: "Family Name" भरें (जैसे LDPE)।

keyActions.en: Optionally pick a "Business Family" (or "No linked business family").
keyActions.hi: चाहें तो "Business Family" चुनें (या "No linked business family")।

keyActions.en: Enter "Density (g/cm³)", e.g. 0.9200.
keyActions.hi: "Density (g/cm³)" भरें, जैसे 0.9200।

keyActions.en: Press "Save".
keyActions.hi: "Save" दबाएँ।

help.en: Used by the physics layer for weight per area; a wrong value changes every BOM of that film.
help.hi: प्रति area वज़न के हिसाब में लगता है; गलत value से उस film का हर BOM बदल जाता है।

help.en: Average density of the families in view.
help.hi: दिख रही family की औसत density।

help.en: Families that have a business family attached.
help.hi: जिन family से business family जुड़ी है।

error.en: Delete failed
error.hi: Delete failed

reason.en: Variants still use this family. Move or delete those variants first.
reason.hi: अभी variants इस family को इस्तेमाल करते हैं। पहले उन्हें बदलें या हटाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: If weights look wrong across orders, check the density here first.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर सभी orders में वज़न गलत लगे तो सबसे पहले यहाँ density जाँचें।

summary.en: Reusable film identities (for example Standard Transparent) under a film family: whether they are made in-house, bought, or sold as trading goods.
summary.hi: Film family के नीचे दोबारा इस्तेमाल होने वाली film पहचान (जैसे Standard Transparent): घर में बनती है, खरीदी जाती है या trading good के रूप में बिकती है।

purpose.en: Open it to add a film that Product Master layers, recipes and roll inward can pick. Physical grade is not set here; it is chosen on orders, recipes and roll records.
purpose.hi: ऐसी film जोड़ने के लिए खोलें जिसे Product Master layer, recipe और roll inward में चुना जा सके। Physical grade यहाँ नहीं भरते; वह order, recipe और roll पर चुना जाता है।

prerequisites.en: The film family exists.
prerequisites.hi: Film family पहले से बनी हो।

keyActions.en: Press "Add Variant".
keyActions.hi: "Add Variant" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Fill "Variant Code" (e.g. F-101) and "Variant Name".
keyActions.hi: "Variant Code" (जैसे F-101) और "Variant Name" भरें।

keyActions.en: Pick the "Film Family" and, optionally, a "Business Family".
keyActions.hi: "Film Family" और चाहें तो "Business Family" चुनें।

keyActions.en: Tick "Extrudable" if we make it, "Purchasable" if we buy it.
keyActions.hi: अगर हम बनाते हैं तो "Extrudable", खरीदते हैं तो "Purchasable" टिक करें।

keyActions.en: Under "Sales · Trade Orders" tick "Sellable as trading good" and set "Default GST %" if it is resold.
keyActions.hi: अगर दोबारा बेचते हैं तो "Sales · Trade Orders" में "Sellable as trading good" टिक करें और "Default GST %" भरें।

keyActions.en: Press "Save".
keyActions.hi: "Save" दबाएँ।

help.en: Made in-house; needs a recipe to be planned.
help.hi: घर में बनती है; plan करने के लिए recipe चाहिए।

help.en: Allows purchase inward. If also extrudable, GRN asks for the physical roll grade.
help.hi: खरीद inward चालू करता है। अगर extrudable भी है, तो GRN पर roll grade पूछा जाता है।

help.en: "Sellable" or "Production only".
help.hi: "Sellable" या "Production only"।

error.en: Delete failed
error.hi: Delete failed

reason.en: The variant is used by layers, recipes or rolls. Keep it; do not delete used films.
reason.hi: Variant layer, recipe या roll में इस्तेमाल है। इसे रहने दें; इस्तेमाल हुई film delete न करें।

recoverySteps.en: If a Product Master layer cannot find a film, check it exists here and is in the right family.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर Product Master layer में film न मिले तो देखें कि यहाँ बनी है और सही family में है।

summary.en: Granule families used in extrusion recipes, and the internal grade codes the store and WCM use under each family.
summary.hi: Extrusion recipe में लगने वाले granule family, और हर family के अंदर store व WCM के internal grade code।

purpose.en: Open it to add a granule family, or to add the grade codes (for example PPA-703-A) that GRN records and the WCM allocates before machine release.
purpose.hi: नया granule family जोड़ने के लिए, या ऐसे grade code (जैसे PPA-703-A) जोड़ने के लिए खोलें जो GRN पर लिखे जाते हैं और WCM machine release से पहले allocate करता है।

prerequisites.en: Admin/Owner role or master grant.
prerequisites.hi: Admin/Owner रोल या master अधिकार।

keyActions.en: Press "Add Granule"; fill "Granule Code" and "Granule Name"; press "Save".
keyActions.hi: "Add Granule" दबाएँ; "Granule Code" और "Granule Name" भरें; "Save" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: On a row, open "Manage internal grade codes".
keyActions.hi: Row पर "Manage internal grade codes" खोलें।

keyActions.en: Type one "Internal grade/code", pick "Status", add "Notes" and press "Add code".
keyActions.hi: एक "Internal grade/code" लिखें, "Status" चुनें, "Notes" लिखें और "Add code" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: For many codes open "Paste multiple grade codes", paste one per line or comma separated, press "Add all codes".
keyActions.hi: कई code के लिए "Paste multiple grade codes" खोलें, हर line में एक या comma से अलग करके paste करें, "Add all codes" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Edit or delete a code from the table in the same dialog.
keyActions.hi: उसी dialog की table से code edit या delete करें।

keyActions.en: Tick "Sellable as trading good" with "Default GST %" if the granule is resold.
keyActions.hi: अगर granule बेचा जाता है तो "Sellable as trading good" और "Default GST %" भरें।

help.en: Uppercased; stays inside this granule family. Spaces, hyphens and underscores count as the same code.
help.hi: Capital में बदल जाता है; इसी family के अंदर रहता है। Space, hyphen और underscore एक जैसे माने जाते हैं।

help.en: Number of active code options across families.
help.hi: सभी family में active code की संख्या।

help.en: "Sellable" or "Stock use only".
help.hi: "Sellable" या "Stock use only"।

error.en: Equivalent code '…' already exists in this granule family.
error.hi: Equivalent code '…' already exists in this granule family.

reason.en: Same code with different spacing/hyphens already exists. Use the existing code.
reason.hi: वही code अलग space/hyphen के साथ पहले से है। पुराना code इस्तेमाल करें।

error.en: Already present in this family: …
error.hi: Already present in this family: …

reason.en: Some pasted codes exist. Remove them from the paste list and retry.
reason.hi: Paste किए कुछ code पहले से हैं। उन्हें list से हटाकर फिर से करें।

error.en: The pasted list contains equivalent codes.
error.hi: The pasted list contains equivalent codes.

reason.en: Two lines are the same code. Keep one.
reason.hi: दो lines एक ही code हैं। एक रखें।

error.en: Add no more than 100 codes at once.
error.hi: Add no more than 100 codes at once.

reason.en: Split the paste into batches of 100.
reason.hi: 100-100 के हिस्सों में paste करें।

recoverySteps.en: If WCM cannot find a grade code at input issue, add it here under the right family.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर WCM को input issue पर grade code न मिले तो सही family में यहाँ जोड़ें।

recoverySteps.en: Deleting a code keeps history; new inward and issue just stop offering it.
recoverySteps.hi: Code delete करने पर इतिहास रहता है; बस नए inward और issue में नहीं दिखता।

summary.en: Ink master by base (POLY or PET) and colour name, with swatch and mix-ink details.
summary.hi: Base (POLY या PET) और रंग के नाम से ink मास्टर, swatch और mix ink की जानकारी के साथ।

purpose.en: Open it to add a new ink colour before artwork or the ink floor needs it, or to register a returned floor mix as a mix ink.
purpose.hi: Artwork या ink floor को ज़रूरत पड़ने से पहले नया ink रंग जोड़ने, या floor से लौटा mix ink दर्ज करने के लिए खोलें।

prerequisites.en: Admin/Owner role or master grant.
prerequisites.hi: Admin/Owner रोल या master अधिकार।

keyActions.en: Press "Add Ink".
keyActions.hi: "Add Ink" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Pick "Base Substrate": POLY (Polyethylene Base) or PET (Polyester Base).
keyActions.hi: "Base Substrate" चुनें: POLY (Polyethylene Base) या PET (Polyester Base)।

keyActions.en: Type "Color Name" (saved in capitals) and pick the "Exact Swatch" (#RRGGBB).
keyActions.hi: "Color Name" लिखें (capital में save होगा) और "Exact Swatch" (#RRGGBB) चुनें।

keyActions.en: Optionally add "Internal Description".
keyActions.hi: चाहें तो "Internal Description" लिखें।

keyActions.en: For a returned mix tick "Mix Ink" and fill "Mix Family" and "Mix Notes".
keyActions.hi: लौटे mix के लिए "Mix Ink" टिक करें और "Mix Family" व "Mix Notes" भरें।

keyActions.en: Press "Save Ink". The code is made by the system.
keyActions.hi: "Save Ink" दबाएँ। Code system खुद बनाता है।

help.en: Returned mix colour that can be issued like normal ink.
help.hi: लौटा हुआ mix रंग जिसे normal ink की तरह issue कर सकते हैं।

field.en: POLY base / PET base / Mix inks tiles
field.hi: POLY base / PET base / Mix inks टाइल

help.en: Counts by base and mix.
help.hi: Base और mix के हिसाब से गिनती।

error.en: Ink with this Base Type and Color Name already exists.
error.hi: Ink with this Base Type and Color Name already exists.

reason.en: Same colour on the same base exists. Use it or change the name.
reason.hi: उसी base पर यही रंग पहले से है। वही इस्तेमाल करें या नाम बदलें।

error.en: Use a valid #RRGGBB color.
error.hi: Use a valid #RRGGBB color.

reason.en: Swatch must be # plus six hex digits, or use "Clear".
reason.hi: Swatch में # और छह hex अंक हों, या "Clear" दबाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: Do not delete an ink that artworks use; it removes the colour from pickers.
recoverySteps.hi: जिस ink को artwork इस्तेमाल करता है उसे delete न करें।

summary.en: Catalog of every packing item: inner pouches, gonnies, sheets/putha, boxes, outer bags, tape, labels, tags and others, with how each comes off stock.
summary.hi: हर packing item का catalog: inner pouch, gonny, sheet/putha, box, outer bag, tape, label, tag और अन्य, और हर item stock से कैसे घटता है।

purpose.en: Open it to add a packing item, fix its kind or weight, or link an in-house inner pouch or sheet to the Product Master that makes it. The kind decides how the packing yard uses the item: inner pouches are never in the release tick list (in-house ones come off stock at the machine's last pouching step, bought ones are booked by the evening packing count); every other active item is always in the tick list and is booked by the evening packing count.
purpose.hi: नया packing item जोड़ने, उसका kind या वज़न ठीक करने, या घर में बनने वाले inner pouch/sheet को उसे बनाने वाले Product Master से जोड़ने के लिए खोलें। Kind से तय होता है कि packing yard item को कैसे इस्तेमाल करेगा: inner pouch release की tick list में कभी नहीं आता (घर का inner pouch मशीन के आखिरी pouching step पर stock से घटता है, खरीदा हुआ शाम की packing count से book होता है); बाकी हर active item tick list में हमेशा आता है और शाम की packing count से book होता है।

prerequisites.en: Admin/Owner role or master grant.
prerequisites.hi: Admin/Owner रोल या master अधिकार।

prerequisites.en: For bought inner pouches and gonnies, know the weight of one piece in kg.
prerequisites.hi: खरीदे inner pouch और gonny के लिए एक piece का वज़न kg में पता हो।

prerequisites.en: For an in-house item, a PACKAGING Product Master with sizes (use "Build production master").
prerequisites.hi: घर में बने item के लिए sizes वाला PACKAGING Product Master ("Build production master" से)।

keyActions.en: Press "Add Packaging". The "Create Packaging Material" form opens.
keyActions.hi: "Add Packaging" दबाएँ। "Create Packaging Material" form खुलेगा।

keyActions.en: Fill "Code" and "Name".
keyActions.hi: "Code" और "Name" भरें।

keyActions.en: Pick "Kind" ("What is this item?"). There is no default; "Save" stays off until a kind is chosen. Read the line under it: it says how the yard uses the item.
keyActions.hi: "Kind" ("What is this item?") चुनें। कोई default नहीं है; kind चुने बिना "Save" बंद रहता है। नीचे की line पढ़ें: yard इस item को कैसे इस्तेमाल करेगा।

keyActions.en: Pick "Supply Mode": PURCHASED for all kinds; IN_HOUSE or BOTH only for Inner pouch and Sheet · putha · board.
keyActions.hi: "Supply Mode" चुनें: सभी kind के लिए PURCHASED; IN_HOUSE या BOTH सिर्फ Inner pouch और Sheet · putha · board के लिए।

keyActions.en: Pick "Base UOM" (PCS, KG, METER).
keyActions.hi: "Base UOM" (PCS, KG, METER) चुनें।

keyActions.en: For a bought inner pouch or any gonny, enter "Weight of one … (kg)", e.g. 0.012. It goes into each dispatch unit's weight.
keyActions.hi: खरीदे inner pouch या किसी भी gonny के लिए "Weight of one … (kg)" भरें, जैसे 0.012। यह हर dispatch unit के वज़न में जुड़ता है।

keyActions.en: Set "Status" ACTIVE, optional "Brand / Pack Label" and, for inner pouches, "Pouches per inner pouch (default)". Press "Save".
keyActions.hi: "Status" ACTIVE रखें, चाहें तो "Brand / Pack Label" और inner pouch के लिए "Pouches per inner pouch (default)" भरें। "Save" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: For an in-house inner pouch or sheet, press "Link to Product Master" on its card, pick the master and "Size it is made in", press "Link".
keyActions.hi: घर में बने inner pouch या sheet के कार्ड पर "Link to Product Master" दबाएँ, master और "Size it is made in" चुनें, "Link" दबाएँ।

help.en: Inner pouch · Gonny · Sheet · putha · board · Box · carton · Outer bag · packing pouch · Tape · Label · Tag · Other packing item. Only Inner pouch stays out of the release tick list.
help.hi: Inner pouch · Gonny · Sheet · putha · board · Box · carton · Outer bag · packing pouch · Tape · Label · Tag · Other packing item। सिर्फ Inner pouch release tick list से बाहर रहता है।

help.en: Only inner pouches and gonnies carry a weight. In-house pouches take it from the BOM of the linked variant; others show "No weight · counted in PCS".
help.hi: सिर्फ inner pouch और gonny का वज़न होता है। घर के pouch का वज़न जुड़े variant के BOM से आता है; बाकी पर "No weight · counted in PCS" दिखता है।

help.en: Stock says when the item leaves stock (at the machine for in-house inner pouches, or by the evening packing count). Restock says auto demand, by hand from the Stock launcher, or by purchase.
help.hi: Stock बताता है item कब घटता है (घर के inner pouch machine पर, बाकी शाम की packing count से)। Restock बताता है: अपने-आप demand, Stock launcher से हाथ से, या खरीद से।

field.en: PM-backed / Needs PM link / Catalog row
field.hi: PM-backed / Needs PM link / Catalog row

help.en: Linked to a Product Master variant; in-house but not linked (fix it); or a bought row.
help.hi: Product Master variant से जुड़ा; घर का पर जुड़ा नहीं (ठीक करें); या खरीदा हुआ row।

field.en: Tiles: Total SKUs, PM-Backed, Unlinked In-House, Purchased
field.hi: टाइल: Total SKUs, PM-Backed, Unlinked In-House, Purchased

help.en: Counts for the items in view. Unlinked In-House should be 0.
help.hi: दिख रहे items की गिनती। Unlinked In-House 0 होना चाहिए।

help.en: For inner pouches: how many pouches go in one, used when an order line does not say. Set it so orders and the machine always know how many inner pouches to count.
help.hi: Inner pouch के लिए: एक में कितने पाउच जाते हैं, जब ऑर्डर लाइन में न लिखा हो तब यही लिया जाता है। इसे भरें ताकि ऑर्डर और मशीन को हमेशा पता रहे कितने inner pouch गिनने हैं।

error.en: Enter the weight of one pouch/gonny in kg; it goes into the dispatch unit weight.
error.hi: Enter the weight of one pouch/gonny in kg; it goes into the dispatch unit weight.

reason.en: Bought inner pouch or gonny saved without weight. Enter the weight of one piece.
reason.hi: खरीदा inner pouch या gonny बिना वज़न save किया। एक piece का वज़न भरें।

error.en: <KIND> cannot be IN_HOUSE in this phase.
error.hi: <KIND> cannot be IN_HOUSE in this phase.

reason.en: Only Inner pouch and Sheet may be IN_HOUSE or BOTH. Choose PURCHASED.
reason.hi: सिर्फ Inner pouch और Sheet IN_HOUSE या BOTH हो सकते हैं। PURCHASED चुनें।

error.en: packaging_kind is required for packaging materials.
error.hi: packaging_kind is required for packaging materials.

reason.en: Pick a kind before saving.
reason.hi: Save से पहले kind चुनें।

error.en: Item is missing from the release tick list
error.hi: Item release tick list में नहीं दिखता

reason.en: Its kind is Inner pouch or it is INACTIVE. Edit it, set the right kind (e.g. Sheet · putha · board for Putha) and ACTIVE.
reason.hi: उसका kind Inner pouch है या वह INACTIVE है। Edit करके सही kind (जैसे Putha के लिए Sheet · putha · board) और ACTIVE करें।

error.en: Missing. Link it to its packaging Product Master variant
error.hi: Missing. Link it to its packaging Product Master variant

reason.en: In-house inner pouch has no BOM weight. Link it to the master that makes it.
reason.hi: घर के inner pouch का BOM वज़न नहीं है। उसे बनाने वाले master से जोड़ें।

recoverySteps.en: If the link dialog says "No active packaging Product Master yet", use "Create one in Product Master", add sizes, activate, then link.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर link dialog में "No active packaging Product Master yet" आए, तो "Create one in Product Master" से master बनाएँ, sizes जोड़ें, active करें, फिर link करें।

recoverySteps.en: Delete has no confirmation; prefer setting INACTIVE for items that were ever used.
recoverySteps.hi: Delete पर पुष्टि नहीं पूछी जाती; जो item कभी इस्तेमाल हुआ हो उसे INACTIVE करें।

summary.en: Fixed POD roll SKUs (single or double) with height, thickness, panels and density, and the Product Master variant that makes each one.
summary.hi: तय POD roll SKU (single या double) — height, thickness, panel और density के साथ, और हर SKU को बनाने वाला Product Master variant।

purpose.en: Open it to add or correct a POD roll SKU or to link it to its POD Product Master. SKU rows are created only on this page; Product Master variants link here for in-house production and stock tracking.
purpose.hi: POD roll SKU जोड़ने, ठीक करने या उसे POD Product Master से जोड़ने के लिए खोलें। SKU सिर्फ इसी पेज से बनते हैं; घर के उत्पादन और stock के लिए Product Master variant यहाँ link होते हैं।

prerequisites.en: Admin/Owner role or master grant.
prerequisites.hi: Admin/Owner रोल या master अधिकार।

prerequisites.en: A POD Product Master if it is made in-house.
prerequisites.hi: घर में बनता हो तो POD Product Master।

keyActions.en: Press "Add POD Roll".
keyActions.hi: "Add POD Roll" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Fill "Code", "Name", "POD Type" (Single/Double) and "Status".
keyActions.hi: "Code", "Name", "POD Type" (Single/Double) और "Status" भरें।

keyActions.en: Enter "Fixed Height (mm)", "Thickness (micron)", "Panel Count" and "Density (g/cm3)"; all must be above 0.
keyActions.hi: "Fixed Height (mm)", "Thickness (micron)", "Panel Count" और "Density (g/cm3)" भरें; सभी 0 से ज़्यादा हों।

keyActions.en: Tick "In-house capable" if we make it; press "Save".
keyActions.hi: अगर हम बनाते हैं तो "In-house capable" टिक करें; "Save" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: On the card press "Link to Product Master", pick the POD master and size, press "Link".
keyActions.hi: कार्ड पर "Link to Product Master" दबाएँ, POD master और size चुनें, "Link" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Check "POD SKU Variants" on the card shows the variant row.
keyActions.hi: कार्ड पर "POD SKU Variants" में variant row दिखे, यह जाँचें।

help.en: Single or Double film; double defaults to 2 panels.
help.hi: Single या Double; double में default 2 panel।

field.en: Core POD rows (code starts with POD-)
field.hi: Core POD rows (code POD- से शुरू)

help.en: Code cannot be changed and there is no Delete button.
help.hi: Code नहीं बदलता और Delete बटन नहीं होता।

help.en: Linked SKUs and in-house SKUs still without a master link.
help.hi: जुड़े SKU और बिना master link वाले घर के SKU।

error.en: Core POD code cannot be changed.
error.hi: Core POD code cannot be changed.

reason.en: System POD rows keep their code; change only the name or sizes.
reason.hi: System POD row का code नहीं बदलता; सिर्फ नाम या माप बदलें।

error.en: Core POD materials cannot be deleted.
error.hi: Core POD materials cannot be deleted.

reason.en: Set it Inactive instead.
reason.hi: इसके बदले Inactive करें।

error.en: Height must be > 0 / Thickness must be > 0 / Panel count must be > 0 / Density must be > 0
error.hi: Height must be > 0 / Thickness must be > 0 / Panel count must be > 0 / Density must be > 0

reason.en: Enter positive numbers.
reason.hi: 0 से बड़े अंक भरें।

recoverySteps.en: If in-house POD demand does not plan, check the card is PM-linked.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर घर का POD demand plan नहीं हो रहा, तो देखें कार्ड PM-linked है।

summary.en: List of pouch styles: allowed size fields, the child stock-width formula and the film-area formula used for BOM, costing and roll allocation.
summary.hi: Pouch style की list: कौन से माप लगते हैं, child stock-width formula और film-area formula जो BOM, costing और roll allocation में लगता है।

purpose.en: Open it to find a style, see how many sizes use it, or start a new one. Each Product Master pouch size is bound to an approved style.
purpose.hi: कोई style ढूँढने, देखने कि कितने sizes उसे इस्तेमाल करते हैं, या नया शुरू करने के लिए खोलें। Product Master का हर pouch size किसी approved style से जुड़ा होता है।

prerequisites.en: Admin/Owner role with the master.manage grant.
prerequisites.hi: Admin/Owner रोल और master.manage अधिकार।

keyActions.en: Search by code, name or formula.
keyActions.hi: Code, नाम या formula से search करें।

keyActions.en: Read the chips "Styles", "Locked" and "Used by sizes".
keyActions.hi: "Styles", "Locked" और "Used by sizes" chips देखें।

keyActions.en: Press "Open" on a row to view or edit the style.
keyActions.hi: Style देखने या बदलने के लिए row पर "Open" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Press "New pouch style" (or "Build first pouch style" on an empty list) to create one.
keyActions.hi: नया बनाने के लिए "New pouch style" (खाली list पर "Build first pouch style") दबाएँ।

field.en: Columns: Code, Name, Formula, Stock form, Area formula, Slit, Sizes, Status
field.hi: Columns: Code, Name, Formula, Stock form, Area formula, Slit, Sizes, Status

help.en: Slit shows whether WCM may slit wider rolls; Sizes is how many Product Master sizes use it; a lock badge means approved.
help.hi: Slit बताता है WCM चौड़ा roll slit कर सकता है या नहीं; Sizes = कितने Product Master sizes इसे इस्तेमाल करते हैं; lock बैज = approved।

error.en: Style not in the Product Master size picker
error.hi: Style Product Master size picker में नहीं

reason.en: It is a draft or disabled. Open it and press "Save + approve + lock" or "Reactivate".
reason.hi: वह draft या disabled है। खोलकर "Save + approve + lock" या "Reactivate" दबाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: Only the latest revision of each code is listed; older revisions stay linked to old sizes.
recoverySteps.hi: हर code का सिर्फ नया revision दिखता है; पुराने revision पुराने sizes से जुड़े रहते हैं।

summary.en: Edit one pouch style: its fields, width and area formulas, roll axis, stock form, and approve, disable or reactivate it.
summary.hi: एक pouch style बदलने का पेज: माप, width और area formula, roll axis, stock form, और approve, disable या reactivate करना।

purpose.en: Open it from the Pouch styles list ("Open"). Changing an approved style makes a new draft revision; sizes move to it only after approval.
purpose.hi: Pouch styles list में "Open" से खोलें। Approved style बदलने पर नया draft revision बनता है; sizes approve होने के बाद ही उस पर जाते हैं।

prerequisites.en: Admin/Owner role with the master.manage grant.
prerequisites.hi: Admin/Owner रोल और master.manage अधिकार।

prerequisites.en: Know the pouch shape: which size fields it needs and how the roll width is worked out.
prerequisites.hi: Pouch का आकार पता हो: कौन से माप चाहिए और roll width कैसे निकलती है।

keyActions.en: Fill "Code" (fixed for ever), "Name", optional "Emoji", "Sort order" and "Description".
keyActions.hi: "Code" (हमेशा के लिए तय), "Name", चाहें तो "Emoji", "Sort order" और "Description" भरें।

keyActions.en: Under "Allowed input fields" keep Width (W) and Height (H) and use "Add a field" for Gusset, Flap reach, Seal overlap, Bottom factor, Stick factor or Direct roll width.
keyActions.hi: "Allowed input fields" में Width (W) और Height (H) रखें और "Add a field" से Gusset, Flap reach, Seal overlap, Bottom factor, Stick factor या Direct roll width जोड़ें।

keyActions.en: Build the "Child-width formula builder": child stock width = sum of (coefficient × field) + trim. "Quick presets" fill common shapes (Pillow / 3-side, Stand-up · K-bottom, Side gusset, Quad seal, Center seal · H-axis, Stick pack…).
keyActions.hi: "Child-width formula builder" बनाएँ: child stock width = (coefficient × field) का जोड़ + trim। "Quick presets" से आम आकार भरें (Pillow / 3-side, Stand-up · K-bottom, Side gusset, Quad seal, Center seal · H-axis, Stick pack…)।

keyActions.en: Set "Roll axis policy" (web from W-side or H-side), "Default stock form", "Stored width means" (Open-web, Lay-flat, Folded) and "Allocator rule" (Slitting allowed / Exact width only).
keyActions.hi: "Roll axis policy" (W-side या H-side से web), "Default stock form", "Stored width means" (Open-web, Lay-flat, Folded) और "Allocator rule" (Slitting allowed / Exact width only) सेट करें।

keyActions.en: Check the "Live preview": Child stock width, Film area width, Pitch side, Area / pouch.
keyActions.hi: "Live preview" देखें: Child stock width, Film area width, Pitch side, Area / pouch।

keyActions.en: Press "Create draft" / "Save draft", then "Save + approve + lock". Only approved styles appear on Product Master sizes.
keyActions.hi: "Create draft" / "Save draft" दबाएँ, फिर "Save + approve + lock"। सिर्फ approved style ही Product Master sizes में दिखते हैं।

field.en: Approved style · N sizes use it
field.hi: Approved style · N sizes use it

help.en: Saving real changes creates a new draft (next revision). Sizes keep their saved copy until the new draft is approved.
help.hi: असली बदलाव save करने पर नया draft (अगला revision) बनता है। Sizes अपनी पुरानी copy रखते हैं जब तक नया draft approve न हो।

help.en: Hidden from Product Master size pickers until approved.
help.hi: Approve होने तक Product Master size picker में नहीं दिखता।

help.en: Slitting allowed lets WCM slit wider parent rolls; Exact width only demands the exact width.
help.hi: Slitting allowed में WCM चौड़ा parent roll slit कर सकता है; Exact width only में ठीक वही width चाहिए।

help.en: For odd shapes: the width is typed on each size instead of a formula.
help.hi: अजीब आकार के लिए: formula की जगह हर size पर width लिखी जाती है।

help.en: Disable hides the style from pickers but keeps history; Reactivate brings it back.
help.hi: Disable से style picker से छिप जाता है पर इतिहास रहता है; Reactivate से वापस आता है।

error.en: Disabled pouch styles cannot be approved. Reactivate it first.
error.hi: Disabled pouch styles cannot be approved. Reactivate it first.

reason.en: Press "Reactivate", then approve.
reason.hi: "Reactivate" दबाएँ, फिर approve करें।

error.en: Formula consumes width/height … but the declared roll axis is …
error.hi: Formula consumes width/height … but the declared roll axis is …

reason.en: The formula uses the other side. Change "Roll axis policy" to the side named in the message.
reason.hi: Formula दूसरी side इस्तेमाल करता है। "Roll axis policy" को message वाली side पर करें।

error.en: Custom AST mode requires a non-empty AST.
error.hi: Custom AST mode requires a non-empty AST.

reason.en: Add at least one term to the formula.
reason.hi: Formula में कम से कम एक term जोड़ें।

error.en: No changes to save
error.hi: No changes to save

reason.en: The locked style is unchanged; nothing to save.
reason.hi: Locked style में कोई बदलाव नहीं; save करने को कुछ नहीं।

recoverySteps.en: If a size shows the wrong roll width, open its style here and check the live preview with the same W, H and gusset.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर size पर roll width गलत दिखे, यहाँ उसका style खोलकर वही W, H, gusset डालकर live preview देखें।

recoverySteps.en: Lane-up is not set here; it belongs to the web-width policy and the sales order.
recoverySteps.hi: Lane-up यहाँ सेट नहीं होता; वह web-width policy और sales order का काम है।

summary.en: Create a new pouch style as a draft, then approve and lock it so Product Master sizes can use it.
summary.hi: नया pouch style draft के रूप में बनाएँ, फिर approve और lock करें ताकि Product Master sizes उसे इस्तेमाल कर सकें।

purpose.en: Open it from "New pouch style" when a pouch shape is not in the list yet. After approval the style shows in the size editor of every Product Master.
purpose.hi: जब कोई pouch आकार list में न हो तब "New pouch style" से खोलें। Approve होने के बाद style हर Product Master के size editor में दिखता है।

prerequisites.en: Admin/Owner role with the master.manage grant.
prerequisites.hi: Admin/Owner रोल और master.manage अधिकार।

prerequisites.en: Know the pouch shape: which size fields it needs and how the roll width is worked out.
prerequisites.hi: Pouch का आकार पता हो: कौन से माप चाहिए और roll width कैसे निकलती है।

keyActions.hi: "Code" (हमेशा के लिए तय), "Name", चाहें तो "Emoji", "Sort order" और "Description" भरें।

keyActions.hi: "Live preview" देखें: Child stock width, Film area width, Pitch side, Area / pouch।

keyActions.hi: "Create draft" / "Save draft" दबाएँ, फिर "Save + approve + lock"। सिर्फ approved style ही Product Master sizes में दिखते हैं।

field.en: Approved style · N sizes use it
field.hi: Approved style · N sizes use it

help.hi: Approve होने तक Product Master size picker में नहीं दिखता।

help.hi: Slitting allowed में WCM चौड़ा parent roll slit कर सकता है; Exact width only में ठीक वही width चाहिए।

error.hi: Disabled pouch styles cannot be approved. Reactivate it first.

reason.hi: "Reactivate" दबाएँ, फिर approve करें।

error.hi: No changes to save

reason.hi: Locked style में कोई बदलाव नहीं; save करने को कुछ नहीं।

recoverySteps.en: If a size shows the wrong roll width, open its style here and check the live preview with the same W, H and gusset.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर size पर roll width गलत दिखे, यहाँ उसका style खोलकर वही W, H, gusset डालकर live preview देखें।

recoverySteps.en: Lane-up is not set here; it belongs to the web-width policy and the sales order.
recoverySteps.hi: Lane-up यहाँ सेट नहीं होता; वह web-width policy और sales order का काम है।

summary.en: Catalog of everything we can make: pouch, roll, packaging, POD and other masters, with their route, sizes, layers and variants.
summary.hi: हम जो कुछ बना सकते हैं उसका catalog: pouch, roll, packaging, POD और other master — route, sizes, layers और variants के साथ।

purpose.en: Open it to find a master, create a new one, clone one, or disable/restore one. Sales orders take every line from an active Product Master, and the planner and floor follow its route and BOM. The address ?kind=PACKAGING or ?kind=POD opens the list already filtered.
purpose.hi: Master ढूँढने, नया बनाने, clone करने, या disable/restore करने के लिए खोलें। Sales order की हर line किसी active Product Master से बनती है, और planner व floor उसके route और BOM पर चलते हैं। ?kind=PACKAGING या ?kind=POD वाले पते से list पहले से छँटी हुई खुलती है।

prerequisites.en: Admin/Owner role with the master.manage grant (Sales picks products in the order composer without opening masters).
prerequisites.hi: Admin/Owner रोल और master.manage अधिकार (Sales order composer में product चुनता है, master नहीं खोलता)।

prerequisites.en: Live route templates, film variants and approved pouch styles exist.
prerequisites.hi: Live route template, film variant और approved pouch style बने हों।

keyActions.en: Pick "Active catalog" or "Disabled / audit".
keyActions.hi: "Active catalog" या "Disabled / audit" चुनें।

keyActions.en: Use "Filters": search code or name, "Kind" (All, Pouch, Roll, Packaging, POD, Other), "Reporting group", and "Capabilities" (Catalog-linked axes, Print capable, Has overlays). "Clear all" resets.
keyActions.hi: "Filters" इस्तेमाल करें: code या नाम search, "Kind" (All, Pouch, Roll, Packaging, POD, Other), "Reporting group", और "Capabilities" (Catalog-linked axes, Print capable, Has overlays)। "Clear all" से सब हटता है।

keyActions.en: Read each card's "N/N ready" pill and the checks: route, sizes, layers or variants, SKU links.
keyActions.hi: हर कार्ड पर "N/N ready" और जाँच देखें: route, sizes, layers या variants, SKU links।

keyActions.en: Press "Open" to see a master, "Clone" to copy it, "Disable" / "Restore" to retire or bring back.
keyActions.hi: Master देखने के लिए "Open", copy के लिए "Clone", हटाने/वापस लाने के लिए "Disable" / "Restore" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Press "New Product Master": pick the "Product kind", fill "Master code", "Reporting group", "Master name", pick the "Live route" (required) and the "Number of layers".
keyActions.hi: "New Product Master" दबाएँ: "Product kind" चुनें, "Master code", "Reporting group", "Master name" भरें, "Live route" (ज़रूरी) और "Number of layers" चुनें।

keyActions.en: Press "Create & open workspace". The master is created inactive; finish films, sizes and policies in the editor, then activate it.
keyActions.hi: "Create & open workspace" दबाएँ। Master inactive बनता है; editor में films, sizes और policies पूरी करके active करें।

keyActions.en: Press "Show 60 more" to load more cards.
keyActions.hi: और कार्ड के लिए "Show 60 more" दबाएँ।

help.en: Finished pouch, Roll / film, Packaging (inner pouch or sheet/wrap), POD, Other. Packaging and POD masters are production masters: the stock launcher launches them, sales never picks them.
help.hi: Finished pouch, Roll / film, Packaging (inner pouch या sheet/wrap), POD, Other। Packaging और POD production master हैं: stock launcher इन्हें चलाता है, sales नहीं चुनता।

field.en: Tiles: Active, Disabled, Variants 90d, Overlays, Print capable, Catalog-linked axes
field.hi: टाइल: Active, Disabled, Variants 90d, Overlays, Print capable, Catalog-linked axes

help.en: Counts across the catalog.
help.hi: पूरे catalog की गिनती।

help.en: Copies sizes, axes, packing/POD settings; you can change route and layer stack. The replacement option disables the old master; old orders keep their frozen record.
help.hi: Sizes, axes, packing/POD settings copy होते हैं; route और layer बदल सकते हैं। Replacement option पुराना master disable करता है; पुराने orders का रिकॉर्ड वैसा ही रहता है।

field.en: Sizes / Axes / Variants / Overlays or SKU Links
field.hi: Sizes / Axes / Variants / Overlays या SKU Links

help.en: Number strip at the bottom of each card.
help.hi: हर कार्ड के नीचे की गिनती।

error.en: Product Master code already exists. Try a different code.
error.hi: Product Master code already exists. Try a different code.

reason.en: Use a new code.
reason.hi: नया code दें।

error.en: Required: pick the route template this master will use
error.hi: Required: pick the route template this master will use

reason.en: Pick a live route before "Create & open workspace".
reason.hi: "Create & open workspace" से पहले live route चुनें।

error.en: A superseded Product Master revision cannot be restored.
error.hi: A superseded Product Master revision cannot be restored.

reason.en: It was replaced; use the current replacement or clone a new revision.
reason.hi: यह बदल दिया गया है; नया replacement इस्तेमाल करें या clone करें।

recoverySteps.en: A master missing from the order composer is usually inactive or disabled; open it and check "Master active".
recoverySteps.hi: Order composer में master न दिखे तो अक्सर वह inactive या disabled है; खोलकर "Master active" देखें।

recoverySteps.en: Disabled masters stay in "Disabled / audit"; old orders still open them.
recoverySteps.hi: Disabled master "Disabled / audit" में रहते हैं; पुराने orders उन्हें खोल सकते हैं।

summary.en: Read-only view of one Product Master in tabs: Overview, Layer template, Variants, Sizes, Customer overlays, Artworks and Audit trail.
summary.hi: एक Product Master को tabs में देखने का पेज: Overview, Layer template, Variants, Sizes, Customer overlays, Artworks और Audit trail।

purpose.en: Open it to check what a product is made of before quoting or planning, to add a customer overlay, or to start a new variant. Use "Edit" to change the master.
purpose.hi: Quote या plan से पहले product किससे बनता है यह देखने, customer overlay जोड़ने, या नया variant शुरू करने के लिए खोलें। बदलने के लिए "Edit" दबाएँ।

prerequisites.en: Admin/Owner role with the master.manage grant (Sales picks products in the order composer without opening masters).
prerequisites.hi: Admin/Owner रोल और master.manage अधिकार (Sales order composer में product चुनता है, master नहीं खोलता)।

keyActions.en: Read the header: code, name, kind, route, print and size count.
keyActions.hi: Header पढ़ें: code, नाम, kind, route, print और size की गिनती।

keyActions.en: Open "Layer template" for each layer's film, micron and grade, plus adhesive and solvent.
keyActions.hi: हर layer की film, micron, grade और adhesive/solvent के लिए "Layer template" खोलें।

keyActions.en: Open "Sizes" to see every size with web width and inches.
keyActions.hi: हर size, web width और inch के साथ देखने के लिए "Sizes" खोलें।

keyActions.en: Open "Variants" for every shippable configuration; click a cell for the live BOM; press "Create variant" to add one.
keyActions.hi: हर बिकने वाले configuration के लिए "Variants" खोलें; live BOM के लिए cell पर क्लिक करें; नया जोड़ने के लिए "Create variant" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Open "Customer overlays" and press "Add overlay" to set customer-specific defaults for sales entry (not shown for packaging/POD masters).
keyActions.hi: "Customer overlays" खोलकर "Add overlay" से customer के default सेट करें (packaging/POD master पर नहीं दिखता)।

keyActions.en: Use "Edit", "Duplicate" or "Disable" / "Restore" in the header; "Open in Sales create" starts an order with this master.
keyActions.hi: Header में "Edit", "Duplicate" या "Disable" / "Restore" इस्तेमाल करें; "Open in Sales create" से इस master का order शुरू होता है।

help.en: Axis tuples — every shippable configuration; pivot any two axes.
help.hi: हर बिकने वाला configuration; किन्हीं दो axes से table बदल सकते हैं।

help.en: Who the overlay is for and what sales auto-picks for that customer; it still uses the master's engineering BOM.
help.hi: Overlay किस customer के लिए है और उस customer के लिए sales क्या अपने-आप चुनेगा; BOM master का ही रहता है।

help.en: Approved artworks that match this master's print method and form.
help.hi: इस master के print method और form से मेल खाने वाले approved artwork।

help.en: Every change with who, when and the difference.
help.hi: हर बदलाव — किसने, कब और क्या बदला।

error.en: Could not load product master.
error.hi: Could not load product master.

reason.en: Wrong link or no access. Go back to the list and open it again.
reason.hi: गलत link या अधिकार नहीं। List पर लौटकर फिर खोलें।

recoverySteps.en: If the view looks out of date after an edit, refresh the page.
recoverySteps.hi: Edit के बाद view पुराना लगे तो पेज refresh करें।

summary.en: The full editor of one Product Master in three parts: What it is, What is fixed, and What sales choose.
summary.hi: एक Product Master का पूरा editor, तीन हिस्सों में: What it is, What is fixed, और What sales choose।

purpose.en: Open it with "Edit" to set the route, layers, printing rules, adhesive, sales permissions, sizes (by hand or from the Excel size sheet), add-ons and packing. Saving refreshes open order snapshots that use the master.
purpose.hi: "Edit" से खोलें और route, layers, printing नियम, adhesive, sales की अनुमति, sizes (हाथ से या Excel size sheet से), add-on और packing सेट करें। Save करने पर इस master वाले खुले orders का snapshot ताज़ा होता है।

prerequisites.en: Admin/Owner role with the master.manage grant (Sales picks products in the order composer without opening masters).
prerequisites.hi: Admin/Owner रोल और master.manage अधिकार (Sales order composer में product चुनता है, master नहीं खोलता)।

prerequisites.en: Film variants, approved pouch styles, add-ons and packaging items exist.
prerequisites.hi: Film variant, approved pouch style, add-on और packaging item बने हों।

keyActions.en: Use the section list (Basics, Summary, Layers, Printing, Adhesive, What sales can change, Sizes & web width, Add-ons & packing) to jump.
keyActions.hi: Section list (Basics, Summary, Layers, Printing, Adhesive, What sales can change, Sizes & web width, Add-ons & packing) से सीधे जाएँ।

keyActions.en: Basics: check "Master name", "Product kind", "Live route / template"; for packaging pick the "Packing sub-type" (Inner pouch carrier or Sheet / Roll for packing).
keyActions.hi: Basics: "Master name", "Product kind", "Live route / template" देखें; packaging में "Packing sub-type" (Inner pouch carrier या Sheet / Roll for packing) चुनें।

keyActions.en: Layers: "Add layer", pick the default film, μ thickness and grade; use "+ Add allowed film" for approved alternates.
keyActions.hi: Layers: "Add layer" दबाएँ, default film, μ thickness और grade चुनें; दूसरी मंज़ूर film के लिए "+ Add allowed film"।

keyActions.en: Printing: pick "No printing", "Print capable · artwork OPTIONAL" or "Print compulsory · artwork REQUIRED", and the "Allowed print method" (FLEXO or ROTO).
keyActions.hi: Printing: "No printing", "Print capable · artwork OPTIONAL" या "Print compulsory · artwork REQUIRED" चुनें, और "Allowed print method" (FLEXO या ROTO)।

keyActions.en: Adhesive: pick the adhesive and solvent and their GSM.
keyActions.hi: Adhesive: adhesive और solvent और उनका GSM चुनें।

keyActions.en: Sizes & web width: "Add size", or "Excel sheet" to download the .xlsx, fill it, then "Bulk upload" → "Review size import" → "Confirm import". Blank codes and labels are made from the size ("auto from size").
keyActions.hi: Sizes & web width: "Add size", या "Excel sheet" से .xlsx download करें, भरें, फिर "Bulk upload" → "Review size import" → "Confirm import"। खाली code और label size से अपने-आप बनते हैं ("auto from size")।

keyActions.en: Add-ons & packing: allow inner pouches, POD and add-ons; choose "Default inner pouch" and "Pouches per inner".
keyActions.hi: Add-ons & packing: inner pouch, POD और add-on allow करें; "Default inner pouch" और "Pouches per inner" चुनें।

keyActions.en: Check the save checklist (code & name, live route, at least one size and layer, each layer has a film, printing gate) and press "Save master". Nothing in sizes is saved until this press.
keyActions.hi: Save checklist देखें (code & name, live route, कम से कम एक size और layer, हर layer में film, printing gate) और "Save master" दबाएँ। इसे दबाए बिना sizes save नहीं होते।

help.en: Only active masters show to sales and the planner.
help.hi: सिर्फ active master sales और planner को दिखते हैं।

help.en: Whether sales may add a new value (for example a new pouch size) inside this master. Off axes stay blocked.
help.hi: Sales इस master में नया value (जैसे नया pouch size) जोड़ सकता है या नहीं। Off वाले axes बंद रहते हैं।

field.en: Auto-fire in-house stock launcher on shortage
field.hi: Auto-fire in-house stock launcher on shortage

help.en: When on, a short in-house inner pouch or POD raises in-house demand at order confirm.
help.hi: चालू होने पर, घर के inner pouch या POD की कमी पर order confirm के समय demand बनती है।

help.en: Roll: 500 or 500X45; pouch: 140X305 or 140X305G40. Inches are shown beside mm, never typed.
help.hi: Roll: 500 या 500X45; pouch: 140X305 या 140X305G40। Inch mm के साथ दिखते हैं, लिखे नहीं जाते।

help.en: Each pouch size binds an approved pouch style that gives the roll width.
help.hi: हर pouch size एक approved pouch style से जुड़ता है जिससे roll width निकलती है।

help.en: Advanced fallback input roll width for BOM when the order has no size-level override.
help.hi: Advanced: जब order में size का override न हो तब BOM के लिए fallback roll width।

error.en: Layer N must select a valid film variant before the Product Master is active.
error.hi: Layer N must select a valid film variant before the Product Master is active.

reason.en: Pick a film for every layer.
reason.hi: हर layer में film चुनें।

error.en: Layer N grade is required unless the selected film variant is purchasable-only or grade is a per-layer axis.
error.hi: Layer N grade is required unless …

reason.en: Pick a grade for that layer.
reason.hi: उस layer का grade चुनें।

error.en: Size code "680" is already on this master (in use).
error.hi: Size code "680" is already on this master (in use).

reason.en: Search the size list for that code and edit that row instead of adding a new one.
reason.hi: Size list में वह code खोजें और नई row की जगह वही row बदलें।

error.en: Enter the size (width and height, or the roll width) and the code is made from it, or type a code.
error.hi: Enter the size … or type a code.

reason.en: A size row has no dimensions and no code. Fill the size.
reason.hi: Size row में न माप है न code। माप भरें।

error.en: This is not a readable Excel file. Save it as .xlsx and upload again. / The first row must be the column names (download the template). / The sheet is larger than 5 MB.
error.hi: This is not a readable Excel file … / The first row must be the column names … / The sheet is larger than 5 MB.

reason.en: Use the downloaded "Excel sheet" template, keep its header row, save as .xlsx or .csv under 5 MB.
reason.hi: Download किया "Excel sheet" template इस्तेमाल करें, header row रखें, 5 MB से छोटी .xlsx या .csv save करें।

error.en: Product Master code is an internal immutable identity. Update the name instead.
error.hi: Product Master code is an internal immutable identity …

reason.en: The code cannot change; change the name.
reason.hi: Code नहीं बदलता; नाम बदलें।

recoverySteps.en: Imported sizes stay in the draft until "Save master"; if you leave the page they are lost.
recoverySteps.hi: Import हुए sizes "Save master" तक draft में रहते हैं; पेज छोड़ने पर चले जाते हैं।

recoverySteps.en: Removing a size retires it; a new row with the same code brings the retired size back.
recoverySteps.hi: Size हटाने पर वह retire होता है; उसी code की नई row से वह वापस आ जाता है।

recoverySteps.en: If an in-house inner pouch shows "No product master is linked to make this pouch", link it on the Packaging master.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर घर के inner pouch पर "No product master is linked to make this pouch" दिखे तो Packaging master पर link करें।

summary.en: Configure one variant of a Product Master: size and axis values, per-layer thickness, grade and width, add-ons and artwork mode, with a live material breakdown.
summary.hi: Product Master का एक variant बनाने का पेज: size और axis value, हर layer की thickness, grade और width, add-on और artwork mode, live material breakdown के साथ।

purpose.en: Open it from "Create variant" on the master's Variants tab when a stockable or sellable configuration must exist ahead of orders (for example a packaging or POD variant to link to a catalog SKU).
purpose.hi: Master के Variants tab पर "Create variant" से खोलें, जब कोई stock या बिकने वाला configuration order से पहले चाहिए (जैसे catalog SKU से जोड़ने के लिए packaging या POD variant)।

prerequisites.en: Admin/Owner role with the master.manage grant (Sales picks products in the order composer without opening masters).
prerequisites.hi: Admin/Owner रोल और master.manage अधिकार (Sales order composer में product चुनता है, master नहीं खोलता)।

prerequisites.en: The master has sizes and layers saved.
prerequisites.hi: Master में sizes और layers save हों।

keyActions.en: Check "Configuring a variant of" shows the right master.
keyActions.hi: देखें कि "Configuring a variant of" में सही master है।

keyActions.en: Set the "Required axes" (for example Size); the "Variant code (live)" updates.
keyActions.hi: "Required axes" (जैसे Size) भरें; "Variant code (live)" बदलता है।

keyActions.en: Check "Per-layer thicknesses · grades · widths"; defaults come from the master.
keyActions.hi: "Per-layer thicknesses · grades · widths" देखें; default master से आते हैं।

keyActions.en: Pick add-ons and the artwork mode if needed.
keyActions.hi: ज़रूरत हो तो add-on और artwork mode चुनें।

keyActions.en: Read "Material breakdown" (per 1,000 kg) and "Stock match preview".
keyActions.hi: "Material breakdown" (प्रति 1,000 kg) और "Stock match preview" पढ़ें।

keyActions.en: Press "Save variant" (or "Save as preset").
keyActions.hi: "Save variant" (या "Save as preset") दबाएँ।

help.en: Built from the axis values; VALID · NEW means it does not exist yet.
help.hi: Axis value से बनता है; VALID · NEW का मतलब अभी मौजूद नहीं।

help.en: Customer overlay prices for reference only.
help.hi: Customer overlay की कीमत, सिर्फ देखने के लिए।

error.en: Could not save variant
error.hi: Could not save variant

reason.en: A required axis is empty or the tuple already exists. Fill the axes or open the existing variant.
reason.hi: कोई ज़रूरी axis खाली है या यही variant पहले से है। Axis भरें या पुराना variant खोलें।

recoverySteps.en: Press "Back to master" to cancel without saving.
recoverySteps.hi: बिना save लौटने के लिए "Back to master" दबाएँ।

summary.en: Granule-family formulations for extruded film, one per film variant + grade + thickness range, with revision history.
summary.hi: Extrusion film के लिए granule family का formula, हर film variant + grade + thickness range का एक, revision इतिहास के साथ।

purpose.en: Open it to create the recipe a new extruded film needs, or to publish a new revision of percentages. Saving refreshes open BOMs and planner queues; released jobs stay on their old formulation.
purpose.hi: नई extrusion film के लिए recipe बनाने या प्रतिशत का नया revision publish करने के लिए खोलें। Save करने पर खुले BOM और planner queue ताज़ा होते हैं; release हो चुके job पुराने formula पर रहते हैं।

prerequisites.en: Extrudable film variant, grade (Grade Master) and granule families exist.
prerequisites.hi: Extrudable film variant, grade (Grade Master) और granule family बने हों।

keyActions.en: Press "Add Recipe".
keyActions.hi: "Add Recipe" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Pick "Film Variant" and "Grade" (add grades with "Grade Master"), and "Min Thickness (μ)" / "Max Thickness (μ)".
keyActions.hi: "Film Variant", "Grade" (grade "Grade Master" से जोड़ें), और "Min Thickness (μ)" / "Max Thickness (μ)" चुनें।

keyActions.en: Under "Family formulation" press "Add family row", pick each "Granule family" and its "Recipe %".
keyActions.hi: "Family formulation" में "Add family row" दबाएँ, हर "Granule family" और उसका "Recipe %" भरें।

keyActions.en: Use "Balance to 100%" until the total is 100.00%.
keyActions.hi: कुल 100.00% होने तक "Balance to 100%" इस्तेमाल करें।

keyActions.en: Press "Save family recipe". For an edit, write a "Revision reason" and press "Publish revision vN".
keyActions.hi: "Save family recipe" दबाएँ। Edit में "Revision reason" लिखें और "Publish revision vN" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Read the result card: Open BOMs refreshed, Queues rebuilt, Frozen history, Needs review.
keyActions.hi: Result card पढ़ें: Open BOMs refreshed, Queues rebuilt, Frozen history, Needs review।

help.en: Variant + grade + thickness range; locked after creation.
help.hi: Variant + grade + thickness range; बनने के बाद lock।

field.en: Matching lines / Will refresh / Stay frozen / Released
field.hi: Matching lines / Will refresh / Stay frozen / Released

help.en: Impact of an edit on order lines.
help.hi: Edit का order lines पर असर।

help.en: Stops new orders resolving this contract; history and released jobs stay.
help.hi: नए orders में यह contract नहीं लगेगा; इतिहास और released job रहते हैं।

error.en: Total percentage must be 100.00%.
error.hi: Total percentage must be 100.00%.

reason.en: Use "Balance to 100%".
reason.hi: "Balance to 100%" इस्तेमाल करें।

error.en: An active recipe already exists for … / Thickness range overlaps with active recipe …
error.hi: An active recipe already exists … / Thickness range overlaps …

reason.en: Edit that recipe, or disable it before creating a new range.
reason.hi: वही recipe बदलें, या नई range से पहले उसे disable करें।

error.en: Recipe identity is locked after creation …
error.hi: Recipe identity is locked after creation …

reason.en: To change variant, grade or thickness, disable and create a new recipe.
reason.hi: Variant, grade या thickness बदलने के लिए disable करके नई recipe बनाएँ।

error.en: Each granule can be used only once in a recipe.
error.hi: Each granule can be used only once in a recipe.

reason.en: Merge duplicate rows.
reason.hi: दोहराई rows मिलाएँ।

error.en: Recipes are production history and cannot be deleted. Disable the recipe instead.
error.hi: Recipes are production history and cannot be deleted …

reason.en: Use "Disable".
reason.hi: "Disable" इस्तेमाल करें।

recoverySteps.en: If "Needs review" is above zero, tell the planner: some open lines could not be refreshed.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर "Needs review" शून्य से ज़्यादा हो तो planner को बताएँ: कुछ खुली lines ताज़ा नहीं हुईं।

summary.en: List of trading goods with stock, sale rate and GST per item.
summary.hi: Trading goods की list, हर item का stock, sale rate और GST।

purpose.en: Open it to find or add an item that is sold through Trade Orders without being made in the plant.
purpose.hi: Plant में बनाए बिना Trade Order से बिकने वाला item ढूँढने या जोड़ने के लिए खोलें।

prerequisites.en: Admin/Owner role or master grant.
prerequisites.hi: Admin/Owner रोल या master अधिकार।

keyActions.en: Search by code, name or HSN.
keyActions.hi: Code, नाम या HSN से search करें।

keyActions.en: Read the chips Total, Active and Stock units.
keyActions.hi: Total, Active और Stock units chips देखें।

keyActions.en: Click a card to edit it.
keyActions.hi: Edit के लिए कार्ड पर क्लिक करें।

keyActions.en: Press "New trading good" (or "Add first trading good") to create one.
keyActions.hi: नया बनाने के लिए "New trading good" (या "Add first trading good") दबाएँ।

help.en: Current stock in base UOM, default sale rate and GST; badge shows active/inactive, trade form and HSN.
help.hi: Base UOM में stock, default sale rate और GST; बैज में active/inactive, trade form और HSN।

error.en: No trading goods yet
error.hi: No trading goods yet

reason.en: Nothing created; add the first item.
reason.hi: कुछ नहीं बना; पहला item जोड़ें।

recoverySteps.en: Inactive items still show here but not in trade order pickers.
recoverySteps.hi: Inactive item यहाँ दिखते हैं पर trade order picker में नहीं।

summary.en: Edit one trading good's identity, pricing defaults and status, and see its stock by plant.
summary.hi: एक trading good की पहचान, कीमत के default और status बदलें, और plant-wise stock देखें।

purpose.en: Trading goods are items we resell as they are (ready pouches, ready rolls, packing items, raw material). They have their own stock pool and are sold through Trade Orders. Stock is changed only by Stock Adjustments, not here.
purpose.hi: Trading goods वे items हैं जिन्हें हम जैसे हैं वैसे बेचते हैं (ready pouch, ready roll, packing item, raw material)। इनका stock अलग है और ये Trade Orders से बिकते हैं। Stock सिर्फ Stock Adjustment से बदलता है, यहाँ से नहीं।

prerequisites.en: Admin/Owner role or master grant.
prerequisites.hi: Admin/Owner रोल या master अधिकार।

keyActions.en: Fill "Code *" and "Name *" (both required).
keyActions.hi: "Code *" और "Name *" भरें (दोनों ज़रूरी)।

keyActions.en: Pick "Base UOM" (Pieces, Kilograms, Meters, Rolls, Boxes) and "Trade form" (Ready pouch, Ready roll, Packing item, Raw material, Other).
keyActions.hi: "Base UOM" (Pieces, Kilograms, Meters, Rolls, Boxes) और "Trade form" (Ready pouch, Ready roll, Packing item, Raw material, Other) चुनें।

keyActions.en: Add "HSN code" and "Description".
keyActions.hi: "HSN code" और "Description" भरें।

keyActions.en: Under "Pricing defaults" set "Default GST %", "Default sale rate (₹)", "Default buy rate (₹)"; they prefill Trade Order lines.
keyActions.hi: "Pricing defaults" में "Default GST %", "Default sale rate (₹)", "Default buy rate (₹)" भरें; ये Trade Order lines में पहले से भरते हैं।

keyActions.en: Keep "Status" Active (toggle off to retire) and press "Create trading good" / "Save changes".
keyActions.hi: "Status" Active रखें (हटाने के लिए बंद करें) और "Create trading good" / "Save changes" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: On an existing item read "Stock by plant"; to change stock press "Open Stock Adjustments →".
keyActions.hi: पुराने item पर "Stock by plant" देखें; stock बदलने के लिए "Open Stock Adjustments →" दबाएँ।

help.en: Inactive items are hidden from trade order pickers.
help.hi: Inactive item trade order picker में नहीं दिखते।

help.en: Read-only: Plant, Qty, Avg cost, Updated.
help.hi: सिर्फ देखने के लिए: Plant, Qty, Avg cost, Updated।

error.en: Missing fields: Code and name are required
error.hi: Missing fields: Code and name are required

reason.en: Fill both before saving.
reason.hi: Save से पहले दोनों भरें।

error.en: Save failed
error.hi: Save failed

reason.en: Often a duplicate code. Use another code.
reason.hi: अक्सर code दोहराया गया है। दूसरा code दें।

error.en: No stock recorded yet
error.hi: No stock recorded yet

reason.en: Seed opening stock with a Stock Adjustment.
reason.hi: Opening stock Stock Adjustment से डालें।

recoverySteps.en: Press "Back to list" to leave without saving.
recoverySteps.hi: बिना save लौटने के लिए "Back to list" दबाएँ।

summary.en: Create a new trading good: code, name, unit, trade form, HSN and pricing defaults.
summary.hi: नया trading good बनाएँ: code, नाम, unit, trade form, HSN और कीमत के default।

purpose.en: Trading goods are items we resell as they are (ready pouches, ready rolls, packing items, raw material). They have their own stock pool and are sold through Trade Orders. Stock is changed only by Stock Adjustments, not here.
purpose.hi: Trading goods वे items हैं जिन्हें हम जैसे हैं वैसे बेचते हैं (ready pouch, ready roll, packing item, raw material)। इनका stock अलग है और ये Trade Orders से बिकते हैं। Stock सिर्फ Stock Adjustment से बदलता है, यहाँ से नहीं।

prerequisites.en: Admin/Owner role or master grant.
prerequisites.hi: Admin/Owner रोल या master अधिकार।

keyActions.en: Fill "Code *" and "Name *" (both required).
keyActions.hi: "Code *" और "Name *" भरें (दोनों ज़रूरी)।

keyActions.en: Pick "Base UOM" (Pieces, Kilograms, Meters, Rolls, Boxes) and "Trade form" (Ready pouch, Ready roll, Packing item, Raw material, Other).
keyActions.hi: "Base UOM" (Pieces, Kilograms, Meters, Rolls, Boxes) और "Trade form" (Ready pouch, Ready roll, Packing item, Raw material, Other) चुनें।

keyActions.en: Add "HSN code" and "Description".
keyActions.hi: "HSN code" और "Description" भरें।

keyActions.en: Under "Pricing defaults" set "Default GST %", "Default sale rate (₹)", "Default buy rate (₹)"; they prefill Trade Order lines.
keyActions.hi: "Pricing defaults" में "Default GST %", "Default sale rate (₹)", "Default buy rate (₹)" भरें; ये Trade Order lines में पहले से भरते हैं।

keyActions.en: Keep "Status" Active (toggle off to retire) and press "Create trading good" / "Save changes".
keyActions.hi: "Status" Active रखें (हटाने के लिए बंद करें) और "Create trading good" / "Save changes" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: On an existing item read "Stock by plant"; to change stock press "Open Stock Adjustments →".
keyActions.hi: पुराने item पर "Stock by plant" देखें; stock बदलने के लिए "Open Stock Adjustments →" दबाएँ।

help.en: Inactive items are hidden from trade order pickers.
help.hi: Inactive item trade order picker में नहीं दिखते।

help.en: Read-only: Plant, Qty, Avg cost, Updated.
help.hi: सिर्फ देखने के लिए: Plant, Qty, Avg cost, Updated।

error.en: Missing fields: Code and name are required
error.hi: Missing fields: Code and name are required

reason.en: Fill both before saving.
reason.hi: Save से पहले दोनों भरें।

error.en: Save failed
error.hi: Save failed

reason.en: Often a duplicate code. Use another code.
reason.hi: अक्सर code दोहराया गया है। दूसरा code दें।

error.en: No stock recorded yet
error.hi: No stock recorded yet

reason.en: Seed opening stock with a Stock Adjustment.
reason.hi: Opening stock Stock Adjustment से डालें।

recoverySteps.en: Press "Back to list" to leave without saving.
recoverySteps.hi: बिना save लौटने के लिए "Back to list" दबाएँ।

summary.en: Supplier, job-worker and service-provider master used by GRN, purchase orders and job work.
summary.hi: Supplier, job worker और service provider का मास्टर, जो GRN, purchase order और job work में लगता है।

purpose.en: Open it to add or edit a vendor, its tax, contact, addresses, payment terms and job-work rate card. Store staff use the same vendors from Stock → Vendors (/inventory/vendors).
purpose.hi: Vendor जोड़ने या बदलने, उसके tax, contact, पते, payment terms और job-work rate card के लिए खोलें। Store वाले यही vendors Stock → Vendors (/inventory/vendors) से इस्तेमाल करते हैं।

prerequisites.en: Admin/Owner role or master grant.
prerequisites.hi: Admin/Owner रोल या master अधिकार।

keyActions.en: Press "Add Vendor".
keyActions.hi: "Add Vendor" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Fill "Vendor Code", "Vendor Name", "Type" (Raw Material Supplier, Job Worker, Service Provider, Both (Supplier & JW)) and "Status".
keyActions.hi: "Vendor Code", "Vendor Name", "Type" (Raw Material Supplier, Job Worker, Service Provider, Both (Supplier & JW)) और "Status" भरें।

keyActions.en: Add GST No, PAN No, Contact Person, Email, Phone and "Lead Time (Days)".
keyActions.hi: GST No, PAN No, Contact Person, Email, Phone और "Lead Time (Days)" भरें।

keyActions.en: Fill "Primary Mailing Address"; add branches under "Additional Mailing Details".
keyActions.hi: "Primary Mailing Address" भरें; branch पते "Additional Mailing Details" में जोड़ें।

keyActions.en: Set "Credit Period (Days)", "Payment Terms", "Bank Details", TDS/TCS switches.
keyActions.hi: "Credit Period (Days)", "Payment Terms", "Bank Details", TDS/TCS switch सेट करें।

keyActions.en: For job workers fill "Jobwork controls" and the "Job-work rate card" (process code, rate ₹, unit per piece/kg/metre/roll).
keyActions.hi: Job worker के लिए "Jobwork controls" और "Job-work rate card" (process code, rate ₹, unit per piece/kg/metre/roll) भरें।

keyActions.en: Press "Update Vendor" / save.
keyActions.hi: "Update Vendor" / save दबाएँ।

help.en: Active, Inactive or Blacklisted.
help.hi: Active, Inactive या Blacklisted।

help.en: Job-work returns stay blocked for QC when on.
help.hi: चालू होने पर job-work से लौटा माल QC तक रुका रहता है।

help.en: Agreed labour rate per process excluding GST; new job-work orders use it and bills are checked against it.
help.hi: हर process की तय मज़दूरी (GST के बिना); नए job-work order इसे लेते हैं और bill इससे जाँचे जाते हैं।

field.en: Tiles: Partners, Active, Jobwork ready, QC required
field.hi: टाइल: Partners, Active, Jobwork ready, QC required

help.en: Vendor counts by state.
help.hi: स्थिति के हिसाब से vendor गिनती।

error.en: Name is required / Code is required
error.hi: Name is required / Code is required

reason.en: Fill both.
reason.hi: दोनों भरें।

error.en: This process and unit already has a rate
error.hi: This process and unit already has a rate

reason.en: Keep one rate per process and unit.
reason.hi: हर process और unit का एक ही rate रखें।

error.en: Failed to delete
error.hi: Failed to delete

reason.en: The vendor is linked to stock or documents. Set it Inactive instead.
reason.hi: Vendor stock या documents से जुड़ा है। Inactive करें।

recoverySteps.en: Delete cannot be undone; prefer Inactive or Blacklisted.
recoverySteps.hi: Delete वापस नहीं होता; Inactive या Blacklisted बेहतर है।

summary.en: List of web-width policies: allowed lane counts, how child width becomes parent web width, and how WCM treats slit remainders.
summary.hi: Web-width policy की list: कितने lanes allowed हैं, child width से parent web width कैसे बनती है, और WCM slit के बचे हिस्से का क्या करता है।

purpose.en: Sales-order lines use the effective policy to check lane-up and work out the planned parent width; WCM uses it for remainder keep/scrap. Open it to see which policy is default or to open one.
purpose.hi: Sales order lines इसी policy से lane-up जाँचती हैं और planned parent width निकालती हैं; WCM इससे बचे हिस्से को रखने/scrap का फैसला करता है। Default policy देखने या कोई policy खोलने के लिए यह पेज खोलें।

prerequisites.en: Admin, Owner or Planner role.
prerequisites.hi: Admin, Owner या Planner रोल।

keyActions.en: Read the chips Policies and Default.
keyActions.hi: Policies और Default chips देखें।

keyActions.en: Search by code, name or description.
keyActions.hi: Code, नाम या विवरण से search करें।

keyActions.en: Compare the "440 mm sample" column: std width selected or calculated parent.
keyActions.hi: "440 mm sample" column देखें: std width selected या calculated parent।

keyActions.en: Press "Open" on a row, or "New policy" to add one.
keyActions.hi: Row पर "Open" या नया जोड़ने के लिए "New policy" दबाएँ।

field.en: Columns: Code, Name, Scope, Lanes, Parent strategy, 440 mm sample, Remainder, Status
field.hi: Columns: Code, Name, Scope, Lanes, Parent strategy, 440 mm sample, Remainder, Status

help.en: Summary of each policy with a worked example for a 440 mm child.
help.hi: हर policy का सार, 440 mm child का उदाहरण।

error.en: No policies match.
error.hi: No policies match.

reason.en: Clear the search.
reason.hi: Search हटाएँ।

error.en: No web-width policy configured yet.
error.hi: No web-width policy configured yet.

reason.en: Create a Global fallback default policy.
reason.hi: Global fallback default policy बनाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: Keep exactly one Default policy as the global fallback.
recoverySteps.hi: Global fallback के लिए ठीक एक Default policy रखें।

summary.en: Edit one lane-up and parent-web policy, preview it, or delete it.
summary.hi: एक lane-up और parent-web policy बदलें, preview देखें, या delete करें।

purpose.en: Open it from the policy list. Changes apply to new sales-order line calculations and WCM remainder decisions. "Delete" asks "Delete this policy?" first.
purpose.hi: Policy list से खोलें। बदलाव नई sales order line की गणना और WCM के remainder फैसलों पर लगते हैं। "Delete" पहले "Delete this policy?" पूछता है।

prerequisites.en: Admin, Owner or Planner role.
prerequisites.hi: Admin, Owner या Planner रोल।

keyActions.en: Fill "Code (unique)", "Name", "Description"; tick "Default policy" only for the plant-wide default.
keyActions.hi: "Code (unique)", "Name", "Description" भरें; "Default policy" सिर्फ plant के default के लिए टिक करें।

keyActions.en: Pick "Scope" (Global fallback, Product kind, Product master, Pouch style, Process, Machine) and its "Scope ref".
keyActions.hi: "Scope" (Global fallback, Product kind, Product master, Pouch style, Process, Machine) और "Scope ref" चुनें।

keyActions.en: Tick "Allowed lane counts" (1–12); the sales-order lane picker shows only these.
keyActions.hi: "Allowed lane counts" (1–12) टिक करें; sales order का lane picker सिर्फ यही दिखाता है।

keyActions.en: Pick the "Strategy": Calculated width, Nearest standard parent, or Require standard parent; set Min/Max parent width and "Standard parent widths" (e.g. 880, 1320, 1500).
keyActions.hi: "Strategy" चुनें: Calculated width, Nearest standard parent, या Require standard parent; Min/Max parent width और "Standard parent widths" (जैसे 880, 1320, 1500) भरें।

keyActions.en: Set the "Slitting trim rule": Inter-cut trim, Edge trim and Formula (PER_CUT, PER_LANE, FIXED).
keyActions.hi: "Slitting trim rule" भरें: Inter-cut trim, Edge trim और Formula (PER_CUT, PER_LANE, FIXED)।

keyActions.en: Set "Min remainder to keep (mm)" and "Prefer remainders first".
keyActions.hi: "Min remainder to keep (mm)" और "Prefer remainders first" सेट करें।

keyActions.en: Check the "Live preview" with a child width and lane, then press "Create policy" / "Save changes".
keyActions.hi: Child width और lane डालकर "Live preview" देखें, फिर "Create policy" / "Save changes" दबाएँ।

help.en: Calculated keeps exact maths; Nearest standard snaps to the next configured width; Require standard blocks the order if no configured width fits.
help.hi: Calculated में सटीक हिसाब; Nearest standard अगली तय width पर जाता है; Require standard में कोई width फिट न हो तो order रुकता है।

help.en: Remainders narrower than this go to scrap.
help.hi: इससे पतला बचा हिस्सा scrap में जाता है।

error.en: Lane count must be between 1 and 12.
error.hi: Lane count must be between 1 and 12.

reason.en: Pick lanes 1–12.
reason.hi: 1–12 lanes चुनें।

error.en: Scope reference is required for non-global policies.
error.hi: Scope reference is required for non-global policies.

reason.en: Pick the Scope ref.
reason.hi: Scope ref चुनें।

error.en: Strict standard mode needs at least one parent width.
error.hi: Strict standard mode needs at least one parent width.

reason.en: Add a standard width or change the strategy.
reason.hi: Standard width जोड़ें या strategy बदलें।

error.en: Max parent width must be greater than min parent width.
error.hi: Max parent width must be greater than min parent width.

reason.en: Fix the min/max.
reason.hi: Min/max ठीक करें।

recoverySteps.en: If an order line refuses a lane count, check which policy applies to its product and add the lane here.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर order line कोई lane count न ले, तो देखें कौन सी policy लगती है और यहाँ lane जोड़ें।

summary.en: Create a lane-up and parent-web policy for a scope.
summary.hi: किसी scope के लिए lane-up और parent-web policy बनाएँ।

purpose.en: Open it from "New policy" when a product kind, master, pouch style, process or machine needs its own lane or parent-width rule.
purpose.hi: जब किसी product kind, master, pouch style, process या machine को अलग lane या parent-width नियम चाहिए तब "New policy" से खोलें।

prerequisites.en: Admin, Owner or Planner role.
prerequisites.hi: Admin, Owner या Planner रोल।

keyActions.en: Fill "Code (unique)", "Name", "Description"; tick "Default policy" only for the plant-wide default.
keyActions.hi: "Code (unique)", "Name", "Description" भरें; "Default policy" सिर्फ plant के default के लिए टिक करें।

keyActions.en: Pick "Scope" (Global fallback, Product kind, Product master, Pouch style, Process, Machine) and its "Scope ref".
keyActions.hi: "Scope" (Global fallback, Product kind, Product master, Pouch style, Process, Machine) और "Scope ref" चुनें।

keyActions.en: Tick "Allowed lane counts" (1–12); the sales-order lane picker shows only these.
keyActions.hi: "Allowed lane counts" (1–12) टिक करें; sales order का lane picker सिर्फ यही दिखाता है।

keyActions.en: Pick the "Strategy": Calculated width, Nearest standard parent, or Require standard parent; set Min/Max parent width and "Standard parent widths" (e.g. 880, 1320, 1500).
