keyActions.hi: "Strategy" चुनें: Calculated width, Nearest standard parent, या Require standard parent; Min/Max parent width और "Standard parent widths" (जैसे 880, 1320, 1500) भरें।

keyActions.en: Set the "Slitting trim rule": Inter-cut trim, Edge trim and Formula (PER_CUT, PER_LANE, FIXED).
keyActions.hi: "Slitting trim rule" भरें: Inter-cut trim, Edge trim और Formula (PER_CUT, PER_LANE, FIXED)।

keyActions.en: Set "Min remainder to keep (mm)" and "Prefer remainders first".
keyActions.hi: "Min remainder to keep (mm)" और "Prefer remainders first" सेट करें।

keyActions.en: Check the "Live preview" with a child width and lane, then press "Create policy" / "Save changes".
keyActions.hi: Child width और lane डालकर "Live preview" देखें, फिर "Create policy" / "Save changes" दबाएँ।

help.en: Calculated keeps exact maths; Nearest standard snaps to the next configured width; Require standard blocks the order if no configured width fits.
help.hi: Calculated में सटीक हिसाब; Nearest standard अगली तय width पर जाता है; Require standard में कोई width फिट न हो तो order रुकता है।

help.en: Remainders narrower than this go to scrap.
help.hi: इससे पतला बचा हिस्सा scrap में जाता है।

error.en: Lane count must be between 1 and 12.
error.hi: Lane count must be between 1 and 12.

reason.en: Pick lanes 1–12.
reason.hi: 1–12 lanes चुनें।

error.en: Scope reference is required for non-global policies.
error.hi: Scope reference is required for non-global policies.

reason.en: Pick the Scope ref.
reason.hi: Scope ref चुनें।

error.en: Strict standard mode needs at least one parent width.
error.hi: Strict standard mode needs at least one parent width.

reason.en: Add a standard width or change the strategy.
reason.hi: Standard width जोड़ें या strategy बदलें।

error.en: Max parent width must be greater than min parent width.
error.hi: Max parent width must be greater than min parent width.

reason.en: Fix the min/max.
reason.hi: Min/max ठीक करें।

recoverySteps.en: If an order line refuses a lane count, check which policy applies to its product and add the lane here.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर order line कोई lane count न ले, तो देखें कौन सी policy लगती है और यहाँ lane जोड़ें।

summary.en: This address has no screen of its own. It opens the Artwork Library (/engineering/artworks) straight away.
summary.hi: इस पते की अपनी कोई स्क्रीन नहीं है। यह सीधे Artwork Library (/engineering/artworks) खोल देता है।

purpose.en: Use it as a short link into engineering. Templates, routes and dispatch are under the Products workspace tabs "Templates", "Routing studio" and "Route dispatch"; print items under "Artworks", "Cylinders" and "Tool room".
purpose.hi: इसे इंजीनियरिंग का छोटा रास्ता समझें। Template, route और dispatch, Products workspace के "Templates", "Routing studio" और "Route dispatch" tab में हैं; print का काम "Artworks", "Cylinders" और "Tool room" में है।

prerequisites.en: Engineering view permission (Admin, Owner, Plant Manager or Planner).
prerequisites.hi: इंजीनियरिंग देखने की अनुमति (Admin, Owner, Plant Manager या Planner)।

keyActions.en: Open /engineering — you land on "Artwork Library".
keyActions.hi: /engineering खोलें — आप "Artwork Library" पर पहुँच जाएँगे।

keyActions.en: Use the Products workspace tabs to go to "Templates", "Routing studio", "Route dispatch", "Cylinders" or "Tool room".
keyActions.hi: Products workspace के tab से "Templates", "Routing studio", "Route dispatch", "Cylinders" या "Tool room" पर जाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: If the artwork page does not open, your role may not have engineering view rights; ask the admin.
recoverySteps.hi: अगर artwork पेज नहीं खुलता तो आपके role को engineering देखने की अनुमति नहीं है; admin से पूछें।

summary.en: A review queue of templates that are in ENGINEERING review. Each row shows the template, its route and an "Approve" button.
summary.hi: ENGINEERING review में पड़े templates की सूची। हर लाइन में template, उसका route और "Approve" बटन है।

purpose.en: Open it when a template has been sent for review from Template Studio ("Send for review"). Approve it here or press "Review" to check it in Template Studio. After approval the template still has to be published with "Publish LIVE" in Template Studio before sales and the planner can use it.
purpose.hi: जब Template Studio से कोई template "Send for review" किया गया हो तब यह पेज खोलें। यहीं "Approve" करें या "Review" दबाकर Template Studio में देखें। Approve के बाद भी template को Template Studio में "Publish LIVE" करना पड़ता है, तभी sales और planner उसे इस्तेमाल कर सकते हैं।

prerequisites.en: Template status ENGINEERING (sent for review from Template Studio).
prerequisites.hi: Template का status ENGINEERING हो (Template Studio से review के लिए भेजा गया)।

prerequisites.en: A routing rule linked and route stages synced, else approval is blocked.
prerequisites.hi: Routing rule जुड़ा हो और route stages sync हों, वरना approval रुक जाएगा।

keyActions.en: Read the "Review Queue". Use "Search pending..." to find a template by name.
keyActions.hi: "Review Queue" देखें। नाम से ढूँढने के लिए "Search pending..." में लिखें।

keyActions.en: Check "Route & Integrity": "Route Bound" means a route is linked; "No Routing Rule" in red means it is not.
keyActions.hi: "Route & Integrity" देखें: "Route Bound" मतलब route जुड़ा है; लाल "No Routing Rule" मतलब नहीं जुड़ा।

keyActions.en: Press "Review" to open the template in Template Studio and check stages, dispatch and materials.
keyActions.hi: "Review" दबाएँ — template Template Studio में खुलेगा, वहाँ stages, dispatch और material देखें।

keyActions.en: Press "Approve" (shows "Signing..." while saving). The toast "Approved" confirms it.
keyActions.hi: "Approve" दबाएँ (save होते समय "Signing..." दिखेगा)। "Approved" संदेश आने पर काम पूरा।

keyActions.en: Open the template in Template Studio and press "Publish LIVE" to make it usable.
keyActions.hi: फिर Template Studio में template खोलकर "Publish LIVE" दबाएँ ताकि वह इस्तेमाल हो सके।

help.en: Template name, FG type (POUCH or ROLL), linked route name (or "Unassigned") and the first 8 characters of the template id.
help.hi: Template का नाम, FG type (POUCH या ROLL), जुड़े route का नाम (या "Unassigned") और template id के पहले 8 अक्षर।

help.en: "Route Bound" / "Routing Info" when a route is linked; "No Route" / "No Routing Rule" when not. Material mapping and roll policy are kept in Template Studio, not here.
help.hi: Route जुड़ा हो तो "Route Bound" / "Routing Info"; न हो तो "No Route" / "No Routing Rule"। Material mapping और roll policy Template Studio में रहती है, यहाँ नहीं।

help.en: "Review" opens Template Studio; "Approve" moves the template from ENGINEERING to APPROVED.
help.hi: "Review" Template Studio खोलता है; "Approve" template को ENGINEERING से APPROVED करता है।

error.en: Approval Failed — Templates cannot be approved or published without a Routing Rule.
error.hi: Approval Failed — Templates cannot be approved or published without a Routing Rule.

reason.en: No route is linked. Open "Review", choose a "Routing rule", press "Save basics" and "Sync route stages", then approve.
reason.hi: Route नहीं जुड़ा है। "Review" खोलें, "Routing rule" चुनें, "Save basics" और "Sync route stages" दबाएँ, फिर approve करें।

error.en: Approval Failed — Template must be in ENGINEERING review before approval.
error.hi: Approval Failed — Template must be in ENGINEERING review before approval.

reason.en: Someone already approved or changed it. Refresh the page; the row will disappear when it is no longer in review.
reason.hi: किसी ने पहले ही approve या बदल दिया है। पेज refresh करें; review से बाहर होते ही लाइन हट जाएगी।

error.en: Approval Failed — Step N …: no capable work center is mapped for …
error.hi: Approval Failed — Step N …: no capable work center is mapped for …

reason.en: A route stage has no machine/work center that can run its process. Add the capability in Factory setup, or fix dispatch in Template Studio section "4. Template route dispatch".
reason.hi: किसी route stage का process चलाने वाला work center नहीं है। Factory setup में capability जोड़ें, या Template Studio के "4. Template route dispatch" में सुधारें।

recoverySteps.en: If "No pending approvals" shows but you expect a template, it is still in DRAFT; open it in Template Studio and press "Send for review".
recoverySteps.hi: "No pending approvals" दिखे पर template आना चाहिए था, तो वह अभी DRAFT में है; Template Studio में खोलकर "Send for review" दबाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: Approving does not make it LIVE. Use "Publish LIVE" in Template Studio.
recoverySteps.hi: Approve करने से template LIVE नहीं होता। Template Studio में "Publish LIVE" दबाएँ।

summary.en: An old review screen. It now only says "Approval Console Retired" and gives a button "Open Template Studio".
summary.hi: पुरानी review स्क्रीन। अब यह सिर्फ "Approval Console Retired" दिखाती है और "Open Template Studio" बटन देती है।

purpose.en: Old links still lead here. Technical approval is no longer separate; templates now hold only route, step category mapping and roll policy. Continue the work in Template Studio.
purpose.hi: पुराने link अब भी यहाँ आते हैं। अलग technical approval अब नहीं होता; template में अब सिर्फ route, step category mapping और roll policy रहती है। काम Template Studio में करें।

prerequisites.en: A valid template id in the address.
prerequisites.hi: पते में सही template id हो।

keyActions.en: Read the card "Approval Console Retired".
keyActions.hi: "Approval Console Retired" कार्ड पढ़ें।

keyActions.en: Press "Open Template Studio" to continue on /engineering/templates/[id].
keyActions.hi: "Open Template Studio" दबाकर /engineering/templates/[id] पर काम जारी रखें।

keyActions.en: Use the back arrow to return to where you came from.
keyActions.hi: वापस जाने के लिए back arrow दबाएँ।

help.en: Shows the template name and its FG type.
help.hi: Template का नाम और FG type दिखाता है।

error.en: Template Not Found
error.hi: Template Not Found

reason.en: The id is wrong or the template was deleted. Press "Go back" and open it from Template Studio.
reason.hi: id गलत है या template हटाया गया है। "Go back" दबाकर Template Studio से खोलें।

recoverySteps.en: Always approve from Pending Approvals or from Template Studio, not from this page.
recoverySteps.hi: Approve हमेशा Pending Approvals या Template Studio से करें, इस पेज से नहीं।

summary.en: Gallery of print artworks with thumbnails, front/back colours, print type, film type, ink GSM and cylinder readiness. Upload, revise and approve artworks here.
summary.hi: Print artwork की gallery — thumbnail, front/back colour, print type, film type, ink GSM और cylinder की तैयारी। यहीं artwork upload, बदलाव और approve होता है।

purpose.en: Open it when a new design comes in or a design changes. Only APPROVED artwork is valid for production. For ROTO print, cylinders for each colour slot are generated here and finished in the Cylinder Catalog before approval.
purpose.hi: नया design आए या design बदले तब यह पेज खोलें। Production में सिर्फ APPROVED artwork चलता है। ROTO print में हर colour slot का cylinder यहीं बनता है और approve से पहले Cylinder Catalog में पूरा किया जाता है।

prerequisites.en: The production file: JPG, PNG or PDF (max 3 files).
prerequisites.hi: Production file: JPG, PNG या PDF (ज़्यादा से ज़्यादा 3)।

prerequisites.en: Colour list per side and total ink GSM.
prerequisites.hi: हर side की colour list और कुल ink GSM।

prerequisites.en: For ROTO: cylinder repeat (circumference) and length; engraving vendors and TOOLING storage locations in masters.
prerequisites.hi: ROTO के लिए: cylinder repeat (circumference) और length; masters में engraving vendor और TOOLING storage location।

keyActions.en: Press "Upload Artwork" (or click a card to revise it).
keyActions.hi: "Upload Artwork" दबाएँ (या बदलने के लिए कार्ड पर click करें)।

keyActions.en: Fill "Code" (e.g. ART-101) and "Name". Pick files under "Artwork Images (max 3)".
keyActions.hi: "Code" (जैसे ART-101) और "Name" भरें। "Artwork Images (max 3)" में file चुनें।

keyActions.en: Choose "Print Type" (FLEXO, ROTO, DIGITAL) and "Film Type" (SHEET = front only, TUBING = front and back).
keyActions.hi: "Print Type" (FLEXO, ROTO, DIGITAL) और "Film Type" (SHEET = सिर्फ front, TUBING = front और back) चुनें।

keyActions.en: Add colours with "Add Front Color" / "Add Back Color". Counts are set automatically.
keyActions.hi: "Add Front Color" / "Add Back Color" से colour जोड़ें। गिनती अपने आप बनती है।

keyActions.en: Enter "Total ink GSM".
keyActions.hi: "Total ink GSM" भरें।

keyActions.en: ROTO only: enter "Circumference / repeat (mm)" and "Cylinder length (mm)", then press "Generate FRONT 1", "Generate FRONT 2" … for each colour slot.
keyActions.hi: सिर्फ ROTO: "Circumference / repeat (mm)" और "Cylinder length (mm)" भरें, फिर हर colour slot के लिए "Generate FRONT 1", "Generate FRONT 2" … दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Press "Save Draft". For ROTO, finish the generated drafts in Cylinder Catalog (vendor, location, Finalize).
keyActions.hi: "Save Draft" दबाएँ। ROTO में बने draft cylinder को Cylinder Catalog में पूरा करें (vendor, location, Finalize)।

keyActions.en: Reopen the card. When "Approval Blockers" is empty, press "Approve". The toast "Artwork Approved" confirms it.
keyActions.hi: कार्ड फिर खोलें। "Approval Blockers" खाली हो तो "Approve" दबाएँ। "Artwork Approved" संदेश आने पर पूरा।

field.en: Total Assets / Approved / Pending / Cylinder Ready
field.hi: Total Assets / Approved / Pending / Cylinder Ready

help.en: Counts for the artworks shown after search. "Cylinder Ready" = every colour slot has a finalized cylinder.
help.hi: Search के बाद दिख रहे artwork की गिनती। "Cylinder Ready" = हर colour slot का cylinder finalize है।

help.en: Matches design code, artwork name, print type, film type or status.
help.hi: Design code, नाम, print type, film type या status से ढूँढता है।

help.en: Status (APPROVED, PENDING APPROVAL, …) and "Cylinder mapped" or "Mapping pending".
help.hi: Status (APPROVED, PENDING APPROVAL, …) और "Cylinder mapped" या "Mapping pending"।

help.en: Number of colours per side, e.g. F4 / B1.
help.hi: हर side के colour, जैसे F4 / B1।

help.en: Print type and film type (SHEET or TUBING).
help.hi: Print type और film type (SHEET या TUBING)।

help.en: First 6 colour names of the artwork.
help.hi: Artwork के पहले 6 colour के नाम।

help.en: Total ink laydown for the whole artwork; used for the theory BOM. Must be more than 0 to approve.
help.hi: पूरे artwork का कुल ink laydown; theory BOM में लगता है। Approve के लिए 0 से ज़्यादा होना चाहिए।

help.en: ROTO only. One repeat and one length for the artwork. Reusing a cylinder needs both to match.
help.hi: सिर्फ ROTO। पूरे artwork के लिए एक repeat और एक length। पुराना cylinder तभी लगेगा जब दोनों मिलें।

help.en: PASS/BLOCK lines: file uploaded, colours, ink GSM, repeat, length, colour counts, finalized front/back slots, technical details.
help.hi: PASS/BLOCK लाइनें: file, colour, ink GSM, repeat, length, colour गिनती, finalize front/back slot, technical details।

help.en: One button per colour slot. A covered slot shows "Covered" and cannot make another cylinder.
help.hi: हर colour slot का एक बटन। जो slot भर चुका वह "Covered" दिखाता है, दूसरा cylinder नहीं बनता।

help.en: Editing an approved or in-use artwork saves a NEW draft revision (badge "NEW DRAFT"); old orders keep the old revision.
help.hi: Approved या इस्तेमाल हो रहे artwork को बदलने पर नया draft revision बनता है (badge "NEW DRAFT"); पुराने order पुराना revision रखते हैं।

error.en: Approval Failed (ARTWORK_APPROVAL_BLOCKED) — Cannot approve artwork without an uploaded file/image asset.
error.hi: Approval Failed (ARTWORK_APPROVAL_BLOCKED) — Cannot approve artwork without an uploaded file/image asset.

reason.en: No file attached. Pick a JPG, PNG or PDF, press "Save Draft", then approve.
reason.hi: File नहीं लगी। JPG, PNG या PDF चुनें, "Save Draft" करें, फिर approve करें।

error.en: Artwork: total ink GSM must be greater than zero.
error.hi: Artwork: total ink GSM must be greater than zero.

reason.en: Enter "Total ink GSM" before approval.
reason.hi: Approve से पहले "Total ink GSM" भरें।

error.en: Artwork: sheet film supports front colors only.
error.hi: Artwork: sheet film supports front colors only.

reason.en: Back colours were set on SHEET film. Use TUBING or remove back colours.
reason.hi: SHEET film पर back colour डाले गए। TUBING चुनें या back colour हटाएँ।

error.en: ROTO approval blocked: finalized front cylinders missing for slots [..].
error.hi: ROTO approval blocked: finalized front cylinders missing for slots [..].

reason.en: Some colour slots have no finalized cylinder. Generate or reuse them and press "Finalize this cylinder" in Cylinder Catalog → "Manage Slots".
reason.hi: कुछ colour slot का cylinder finalize नहीं है। Cylinder Catalog → "Manage Slots" में बनाएँ या reuse करें और "Finalize this cylinder" दबाएँ।

error.en: ROTO approval blocked: cylinder circumference must match artwork repeat for slots [..].
error.hi: ROTO approval blocked: cylinder circumference must match artwork repeat for slots [..].

reason.en: A cylinder's repeat differs from the artwork repeat (0.01 mm tolerance). Fix the spec or use a matching cylinder.
reason.hi: किसी cylinder का repeat artwork के repeat से अलग है (0.01 mm छूट)। Spec ठीक करें या मिलता cylinder लगाएँ।

error.en: Cylinder generation failed — Enter artwork cylinder circumference before generating cylinders.
error.hi: Cylinder generation failed — Enter artwork cylinder circumference before generating cylinders.

reason.en: Fill repeat and length first.
reason.hi: पहले repeat और length भरें।

error.en: Upload a maximum of 3 artwork images. / Only 3 images kept
error.hi: Upload a maximum of 3 artwork images. / Only 3 images kept

reason.en: Only the first 3 files are kept.
reason.hi: सिर्फ पहली 3 file रखी जाती हैं।

recoverySteps.en: If the "Approve" button is grey, read the red "Approval Blockers" list and fix each line.
recoverySteps.hi: "Approve" बटन grey हो तो लाल "Approval Blockers" सूची पढ़ें और हर लाइन ठीक करें।

recoverySteps.en: If a thumbnail shows only an icon, the image could not load; open the card and re-upload under "Replace artwork assets".
recoverySteps.hi: Thumbnail में सिर्फ icon दिखे तो image नहीं खुली; कार्ड खोलकर "Replace artwork assets" से फिर upload करें।

recoverySteps.en: Use the refresh icon ("Force Refresh") in the dialog if cylinder status looks old.
recoverySteps.hi: Cylinder की स्थिति पुरानी लगे तो dialog में refresh icon ("Force Refresh") दबाएँ।

summary.en: ROTO print cylinders grouped by artwork. Each artwork card shows its colour slots, how many are covered, draft and ready counts, and reused cylinders.
summary.hi: ROTO print cylinder, artwork के हिसाब से। हर artwork कार्ड में colour slot, कितने भरे, draft और ready गिनती, और reuse वाले cylinder दिखते हैं।

purpose.en: Open it after generating draft cylinders on an artwork, or to reuse an existing cylinder for a new design. Each slot must have a finalized cylinder (vendor + storage location) before the ROTO artwork can be approved.
purpose.hi: Artwork पर draft cylinder बनाने के बाद, या नए design में पुराना cylinder लगाने के लिए यह पेज खोलें। ROTO artwork approve होने से पहले हर slot का cylinder finalize (vendor + storage location) होना चाहिए।

prerequisites.en: Artwork saved with colours, repeat and length.
prerequisites.hi: Artwork colour, repeat और length के साथ save हो।

prerequisites.en: Vendors in master data and storage locations of type TOOLING.
prerequisites.hi: Master में vendor और TOOLING type की storage location।

keyActions.en: Search the artwork (code, name, colour, cylinder code) and press "Manage Slots" on its card.
keyActions.hi: Artwork ढूँढें (code, नाम, colour, cylinder code) और कार्ड पर "Manage Slots" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: In "1. Artwork cylinder spec" check "Circumference / repeat" and "Cylinder length".
keyActions.hi: "1. Artwork cylinder spec" में "Circumference / repeat" और "Cylinder length" जाँचें।

keyActions.en: For an empty slot either press "Generate new for this color", or pick from "Reuse matching cylinder" and press "Use".
keyActions.hi: खाली slot के लिए "Generate new for this color" दबाएँ, या "Reuse matching cylinder" से चुनकर "Use" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: In "2. Finish generated drafts" select engraving vendor, storage location and status (ACTIVE / MAINTENANCE / SCRAP); diameter and cell depth if known.
keyActions.hi: "2. Finish generated drafts" में engraving vendor, storage location और status (ACTIVE / MAINTENANCE / SCRAP) चुनें; diameter और cell depth पता हो तो भरें।

keyActions.en: On each draft slot press "Finalize this cylinder". The slot turns "Ready" and shows "Slot complete".
keyActions.hi: हर draft slot पर "Finalize this cylinder" दबाएँ। Slot "Ready" होकर "Slot complete" दिखाएगा।

keyActions.en: Go back to Artwork Library and press "Approve" on the artwork.
keyActions.hi: Artwork Library में जाकर artwork पर "Approve" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: To change one cylinder later, press "Edit cylinder" (or "New Cylinder" for a loose one) and press "Update" / "Create".
keyActions.hi: बाद में किसी cylinder को बदलने के लिए "Edit cylinder" (या अलग cylinder के लिए "New Cylinder") दबाकर "Update" / "Create" करें।

field.en: Total Cylinders / Draft / Production Ready / Service Focus
field.hi: Total Cylinders / Draft / Production Ready / Service Focus

help.en: Slot counts for shown artworks; Service Focus = cylinders in MAINTENANCE or RE_CHROME.
help.hi: दिख रहे artwork के slot की गिनती; Service Focus = MAINTENANCE या RE_CHROME वाले cylinder।

help.en: Slots with any cylinder out of all colour slots.
help.hi: कुल colour slot में से कितनों पर cylinder लगा है।

help.en: Reuse = slots using a cylinder that belongs to another artwork.
help.hi: Reuse = वे slot जो दूसरे artwork का cylinder इस्तेमाल करते हैं।

help.en: "Empty slot", "Draft generated", "Ready" or "Reused ready".
help.hi: "Empty slot", "Draft generated", "Ready" या "Reused ready"।

help.en: Finalized, active cylinders with vendor and location whose repeat and length match within 0.01 mm. Vendor can be any.
help.hi: Finalize, active cylinder जिनमें vendor और location हो और repeat व length 0.01 mm के अंदर मिलें। Vendor कोई भी हो सकता है।

field.en: Lifecycle Mode / Lifecycle Status / Operational Status
field.hi: Lifecycle Mode / Lifecycle Status / Operational Status

help.en: In the cylinder dialog: DRAFT or PRODUCTION; final status ACTIVE, MAINTENANCE or SCRAP.
help.hi: Cylinder dialog में: DRAFT या PRODUCTION; अंतिम status ACTIVE, MAINTENANCE या SCRAP।

help.en: FRONT or BACK and the colour position. Cannot be more than the artwork's colour count for that side.
help.hi: FRONT या BACK और colour की जगह। उस side के colour की गिनती से ज़्यादा नहीं हो सकता।

error.en: Finalization blocked — Select engraving vendor before finalizing. / Select storage location before finalizing.
error.hi: Finalization blocked — Select engraving vendor before finalizing. / Select storage location before finalizing.

reason.en: Choose both in "2. Finish generated drafts" first.
reason.hi: पहले "2. Finish generated drafts" में दोनों चुनें।

error.en: Enter circumference / repeat before using cylinder slots.
error.hi: Enter circumference / repeat before using cylinder slots.

reason.en: Repeat and length are needed before generate, reuse or finalize.
reason.hi: Generate, reuse या finalize से पहले repeat और length चाहिए।

error.en: Reuse failed — Reusable cylinder circumference must match the artwork repeat (… mm).
error.hi: Reuse failed — Reusable cylinder circumference must match the artwork repeat (… mm).

reason.en: Pick a cylinder of the same repeat and length.
reason.hi: उसी repeat और length का cylinder चुनें।

error.en: Only finalized cylinders can be reused for artwork slots.
error.hi: Only finalized cylinders can be reused for artwork slots.

reason.en: A draft cylinder cannot be reused; finalize it on its own artwork first.
reason.hi: Draft cylinder reuse नहीं होता; पहले उसके artwork पर finalize करें।

error.en: Finalize cylinder blocked: artwork already has a finalized cylinder for FRONT-n.
error.hi: Finalize cylinder blocked: artwork already has a finalized cylinder for FRONT-n.

reason.en: That slot is already covered. Edit the existing cylinder instead.
reason.hi: वह slot पहले से भरा है। मौजूदा cylinder बदलें।

error.en: Storage location must be a TOOLING location.
error.hi: Storage location must be a TOOLING location.

reason.en: Only TOOLING-type locations are allowed; create one in location master.
reason.hi: सिर्फ TOOLING type location चलती है; location master में बनाएँ।

error.en: Requested FRONT-n exceeds artwork color slots.
error.hi: Requested FRONT-n exceeds artwork color slots.

reason.en: The artwork has fewer colours. Fix colours on the artwork.
reason.hi: Artwork में colour कम हैं। Artwork पर colour ठीक करें।

recoverySteps.en: If "Finalize this cylinder" is grey, vendor or location or repeat/length is missing.
recoverySteps.hi: "Finalize this cylinder" grey हो तो vendor, location या repeat/length नहीं भरा।

recoverySteps.en: If the reuse list is empty, no finalized cylinder has the same repeat × length; generate a new one.
recoverySteps.hi: Reuse सूची खाली हो तो उसी repeat × length का कोई finalize cylinder नहीं है; नया बनाएँ।

title.hi: Template के हिसाब से Work-center setup (Route dispatch)

summary.en: Audit of every template route step: which work centers may run it, the default center and the release rule. Shows steps that need setup.
summary.hi: हर template के route step की जाँच: कौन से work center चला सकते हैं, default center और release rule। जिन step में setup बाकी है वे दिखते हैं।

purpose.en: Use it to find steps the planner cannot release (no capability, no default, invalid center). New templates and correction drafts are best set in Template Studio section "4. Template route dispatch"; this page is an audit and legacy backfill view. Live templates are locked here — use "Edit safely".
purpose.hi: इससे वे step ढूँढें जिन्हें planner release नहीं कर सकता (capability नहीं, default नहीं, गलत center)। नए template और correction draft Template Studio के "4. Template route dispatch" में सेट करना बेहतर है; यह पेज जाँच और पुराना backfill के लिए है। LIVE template यहाँ lock हैं — "Edit safely" इस्तेमाल करें।

prerequisites.en: Templates with synced route steps.
prerequisites.hi: Route steps sync वाले template।

prerequisites.en: Machines/work centers with process capability set in Factory.
prerequisites.hi: Factory में process capability वाले machine/work center।

keyActions.en: Read the tiles "Templates", "Route steps", "Need setup", "No capability".
keyActions.hi: "Templates", "Route steps", "Need setup", "No capability" tile देखें।

keyActions.en: Filter with "Search template, process, or route step...", the status list (e.g. "Needs decision", "No capability") and the process list. "Clear filters" resets.
keyActions.hi: "Search template, process, or route step...", status सूची (जैसे "Needs decision", "No capability") और process सूची से छाँटें। "Clear filters" से हटाएँ।

keyActions.en: Optionally press "Backfill missing steps" to auto-fill steps that have only one possible center.
keyActions.hi: चाहें तो "Backfill missing steps" दबाएँ — जिन step का एक ही center है वे अपने आप भर जाएँगे।

keyActions.en: For a LIVE template press "Edit safely" — a correction draft opens in Template Studio.
keyActions.hi: LIVE template के लिए "Edit safely" दबाएँ — Template Studio में correction draft खुलेगा।

keyActions.en: For a draft template: tick allowed centers (or "Allow all"), pick "Default work center", choose "Release rule".
keyActions.hi: Draft template में: allowed center tick करें (या "Allow all"), "Default work center" चुनें, "Release rule" चुनें।

keyActions.en: Set "Planner optional" or "WCM skip after output" if the process allows it.
keyActions.hi: Process अनुमति दे तो "Planner optional" या "WCM skip after output" चालू करें।

keyActions.en: Press "Save step". The toast "Route step saved" confirms it.
keyActions.hi: "Save step" दबाएँ। "Route step saved" संदेश आने पर पूरा।

help.en: "Ready", "Auto ready", "Planner chooses", "Choose center", "No capability", "Invalid allowed", "Invalid default".
help.hi: "Ready", "Auto ready", "Planner chooses", "Choose center", "No capability", "Invalid allowed", "Invalid default"।

help.en: Capable centers ticked for this step. All ticked = every capable center is allowed.
help.hi: इस step के लिए tick किए capable center। सब tick = हर capable center चलेगा।

help.en: Center used at release when the rule is "Always use default".
help.hi: Rule "Always use default" होने पर release में यही center लगेगा।

help.en: "Auto when only one", "Always use default", or "Planner chooses at release".
help.hi: "Auto when only one", "Always use default" या "Planner chooses at release"।

help.en: Shows a skip choice when the planner releases or replans. Only if the Process Master allows it.
help.hi: Planner release या replan करते समय skip का विकल्प दिखता है। सिर्फ जब Process Master अनुमति दे।

help.en: Lets the work-center manager skip this step for one produced batch after prior output.
help.hi: पिछले output के बाद WCM एक batch के लिए यह step skip कर सकता है।

help.en: Edit safely creates a correction draft of a LIVE template. Disable hides the template from all live selectors (asks to confirm).
help.hi: Edit safely LIVE template का correction draft बनाता है। Disable template को सब selector से छिपा देता है (पुष्टि माँगता है)।

error.en: Allowed work center is not capable for <process>: …
error.hi: Allowed work center is not capable for <process>: …

reason.en: A ticked center cannot run this process. Untick it or add capability in Factory.
reason.hi: Tick किया center यह process नहीं चला सकता। Untick करें या Factory में capability जोड़ें।

error.en: Default work center cannot run <process>.
error.hi: Default work center cannot run <process>.

reason.en: Choose a capable center as default.
reason.hi: Default में capable center चुनें।

error.en: <process> is not planner-optional-capable in Process Master.
error.hi: <process> is not planner-optional-capable in Process Master.

reason.en: Turn on that option in the Process Master first.
reason.hi: पहले Process Master में यह विकल्प चालू करें।

error.en: No work center currently has capability for this process.
error.hi: No work center currently has capability for this process.

reason.en: Map the process to a machine in Factory setup, then come back.
reason.hi: Factory setup में process को machine से जोड़ें, फिर लौटें।

error.en: This template is live and locked.
error.hi: This template is live and locked.

reason.en: Press "Edit safely" to create a correction draft.
reason.hi: "Edit safely" दबाकर correction draft बनाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: "Save step" shows "Saved" and stays grey until you change something.
recoverySteps.hi: कुछ बदले बिना "Save step" grey रहकर "Saved" दिखाता है।

recoverySteps.en: If "Route dispatch setup could not be loaded." appears, refresh; if it repeats tell the admin.
recoverySteps.hi: "Route dispatch setup could not be loaded." दिखे तो refresh करें; बार-बार हो तो admin को बताएँ।

summary.en: Defines how production moves: the ordered process steps, steps that run together (parallel + branches) and joins. Nothing about batches or materials.
summary.hi: Production कैसे चलेगा यह तय करता है: process steps का क्रम, साथ चलने वाले step (parallel + branch) और join। Batch या material यहाँ नहीं।

purpose.en: Create a route before building a template. A template picks one route. Once a route is used by a current template or by production history, its steps are locked; disable it and make a new one instead.
purpose.hi: Template बनाने से पहले route बनाएँ। Template एक route चुनता है। Route किसी चालू template या production history में लग जाए तो उसके step lock हो जाते हैं; तब उसे disable करके नया route बनाएँ।

prerequisites.en: Processes in the Process Master (Factory → Processes).
prerequisites.hi: Process Master में process (Factory → Processes)।

prerequisites.en: Routing or template manage permission to create, edit, disable or delete.
prerequisites.hi: बनाने, बदलने, disable या delete के लिए routing या template manage अनुमति।

keyActions.en: Press "New Route".
keyActions.hi: "New Route" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Enter "Route Name" (e.g. Standard 3-Layer PE) and "Description".
keyActions.hi: "Route Name" (जैसे Standard 3-Layer PE) और "Description" भरें।

keyActions.en: In "1. Route steps" press "Add Step" and select each process in order; use the arrows to move.
keyActions.hi: "1. Route steps" में "Add Step" दबाकर हर process क्रम से चुनें; arrow से ऊपर-नीचे करें।

keyActions.en: In the flow builder, for a step that runs at the same time as the one before, press "↓ Starts after previous" so it turns "+ Runs together".
keyActions.hi: Flow builder में जो step पिछले के साथ चलता है, उस पर "↓ Starts after previous" दबाएँ ताकि वह "+ Runs together" बने।

keyActions.en: Check the preview: Stage 1, Stage 2 … with "+ parallel" rows. The next stage waits for every process in a parallel row.
keyActions.hi: Preview देखें: Stage 1, Stage 2 … और "+ parallel" वाली लाइनें। अगला stage parallel लाइन के हर process का इंतज़ार करता है।

keyActions.en: Set "Interplant Logistics?" if the route moves between plants; keep "Active Status" on.
keyActions.hi: Route plant के बीच जाए तो "Interplant Logistics?" चालू करें; "Active Status" चालू रखें।

keyActions.en: Press "Save Routing Rule". Toast "Routing Rule created."
keyActions.hi: "Save Routing Rule" दबाएँ। "Routing Rule created." संदेश आएगा।

keyActions.en: Use the ⋯ menu on a card for "Edit", "Disable" or "Delete".
keyActions.hi: कार्ड के ⋯ menu से "Edit", "Disable" या "Delete" करें।

help.en: Filter buttons with counts.
help.hi: गिनती के साथ filter बटन।

help.en: Search by route, process or description.
help.hi: Route, process या description से ढूँढें।

help.en: "Inactive", "Interplant", stage count, "n + branches" or "straight flow", "flow only".
help.hi: "Inactive", "Interplant", stage गिनती, "n + branches" या "straight flow", "flow only"।

help.en: Puts a step in the same stage as the one before (parallel) or in the next stage.
help.hi: Step को पिछले वाले के साथ उसी stage (parallel) में या अगले stage में रखता है।

help.en: Marks routes that need movement between plants.
help.hi: Plant के बीच movement वाले route पर निशान।

help.en: Off = hidden from new template selectors.
help.hi: बंद = नए template के चुनाव में नहीं दिखेगा।

error.en: Routing sequence and graph are locked by current templates or production history.
error.hi: Routing sequence and graph are locked by current templates or production history.

reason.en: Steps cannot change once used. Disable the old route/template and create a corrected route and template revision.
reason.hi: इस्तेमाल के बाद step नहीं बदलते। पुराना route/template disable करें और सुधरा route व template revision बनाएँ।

error.en: Disable linked templates or create a corrected route first: …
error.hi: Disable linked templates or create a corrected route first: …

reason.en: Delete is blocked while current templates use the route. Disable those templates or use "Disable" on the route.
reason.hi: चालू template route इस्तेमाल कर रहे हैं तो delete नहीं होगा। उन template को disable करें या route पर "Disable" करें।

error.en: Mark the routing rule inactive instead, or move dependent templates to another route first.
error.hi: Mark the routing rule inactive instead, or move dependent templates to another route first.

reason.en: Jobs or old templates still refer to it; use "Disable".
reason.hi: Job या पुराने template अभी भी इसे इस्तेमाल करते हैं; "Disable" करें।

error.en: Unknown Process code(s): … Create or select the Process Master before saving the route.
error.hi: Unknown Process code(s): … Create or select the Process Master before saving the route.

reason.en: Create the process in Factory → Processes first.
reason.hi: पहले Factory → Processes में process बनाएँ।

error.en: Routing or template manage permission is required …
error.hi: Routing or template manage permission is required …

reason.en: Your role cannot change routes; ask the admin.
reason.hi: आपका role route नहीं बदल सकता; admin से कहें।

recoverySteps.en: If "No routing rules in this view." shows, switch to "All" or clear the search.
recoverySteps.hi: "No routing rules in this view." दिखे तो "All" चुनें या search हटाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: Batch size, lot prefix and release rules are not here; set them in Template Studio.
recoverySteps.hi: Batch size, lot prefix और release rule यहाँ नहीं; Template Studio में सेट करें।

summary.en: List of route templates (LIVE or Disabled) with type, business family and status. Create a new template and open it in the studio.
summary.hi: Route template की सूची (LIVE या Disabled) — type, business family और status के साथ। नया template बनाएँ और studio में खोलें।

purpose.en: A template ties a product type (POUCH or ROLL) to a route, stage material rules, roll handling and batch rules. Only the current LIVE revision can be chosen in sales, planner and Product Master. Work starts here, continues in Template Studio, and ends with "Publish LIVE".
purpose.hi: Template एक product type (POUCH या ROLL) को route, stage material rule, roll handling और batch rule से जोड़ता है। Sales, planner और Product Master में सिर्फ चालू LIVE revision चुना जा सकता है। काम यहाँ शुरू होता है, Template Studio में चलता है और "Publish LIVE" से पूरा होता है।

prerequisites.en: A routing rule (Routing Studio).
prerequisites.hi: Routing rule (Routing Studio)।

prerequisites.en: Templates manage permission to create or clean drafts.
prerequisites.hi: Template बनाने या draft साफ करने के लिए templates manage अनुमति।

keyActions.en: Press "New Template".
keyActions.hi: "New Template" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: In "Create Route Template" enter "Template Name" (e.g. Pouch Route) and choose "FG Type" POUCH or ROLL.
keyActions.hi: "Create Route Template" में "Template Name" (जैसे Pouch Route) भरें और "FG Type" POUCH या ROLL चुनें।

keyActions.en: For POUCH choose "Pouch Style" (Three Side Seal, Pillow, Stand Up, Side Gusset, Quad Seal, Flat Bottom, Spout, Shaped).
keyActions.hi: POUCH में "Pouch Style" चुनें (Three Side Seal, Pillow, Stand Up, Side Gusset, Quad Seal, Flat Bottom, Spout, Shaped)।

keyActions.en: Optionally choose "Business Family" and "Routing Rule".
keyActions.hi: चाहें तो "Business Family" और "Routing Rule" चुनें।

keyActions.en: Press "Create & Open Studio" — the new draft opens in Template Studio.
keyActions.hi: "Create & Open Studio" दबाएँ — नया draft Template Studio में खुलेगा।

keyActions.en: To open an existing one, search by name or id and press "Studio".
keyActions.hi: पुराना खोलने के लिए नाम या id से ढूँढें और "Studio" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Use "Clean drafts" to delete unused draft/review templates (asks to confirm).
keyActions.hi: "Clean drafts" से बेकार draft/review template हटाएँ (पुष्टि माँगता है)।

help.en: Counts of templates and routing rules.
help.hi: Template और routing rule की गिनती।

help.en: Shows LIVE templates or disabled (OBSOLETE) ones.
help.hi: LIVE या disabled (OBSOLETE) template दिखाता है।

help.en: Name, short id and linked route ("not linked" if none).
help.hi: नाम, छोटा id और जुड़ा route (न हो तो "not linked")।

help.en: POUCH or ROLL; family alias; Draft, Engineering, Approved, Live, Disabled or Correction draft.
help.hi: POUCH या ROLL; family; Draft, Engineering, Approved, Live, Disabled या Correction draft।

help.en: Shown when the server's template tables are out of date; tell the admin.
help.hi: Server की template table पुरानी हों तब दिखता है; admin को बताएँ।

error.en: Create failed — Template name is required.
error.hi: Create failed — Template name is required.

reason.en: Type a name before pressing "Create & Open Studio".
reason.hi: "Create & Open Studio" से पहले नाम लिखें।

error.en: Pouch templates must declare a pouch style.
error.hi: Pouch templates must declare a pouch style.

reason.en: Choose a "Pouch Style" for POUCH.
reason.hi: POUCH के लिए "Pouch Style" चुनें।

error.en: Template registry could not load.
error.hi: Template registry could not load.

reason.en: Server or schema problem; refresh, then tell the admin with the message shown.
reason.hi: Server या schema की दिक्कत; refresh करें, फिर दिखा संदेश admin को बताएँ।

recoverySteps.en: Drafts are not listed here. Find a draft through Pending Approvals or by the link you were sent, or create a new one.
recoverySteps.hi: Draft यहाँ नहीं दिखते। Draft Pending Approvals से या भेजे link से खोलें, या नया बनाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: Only the first matches are shown; narrow with search if the list says "Showing first …".
recoverySteps.hi: सिर्फ पहले कुछ दिखते हैं; "Showing first …" लिखा हो तो search से छोटा करें।

summary.en: Builds one template: route binding, batch and lot rules, route stages and lamination lanes, work-center dispatch, step material rules, then review and make LIVE.
summary.hi: एक template पूरा बनाता है: route जोड़ना, batch और lot rule, route stage और lamination lane, work-center dispatch, step material rule, फिर review और LIVE।

purpose.en: Open it from the registry, from Pending Approvals or right after creating a template. The lifecycle is DRAFT → ENGINEERING → APPROVED → LIVE → OBSOLETE. LIVE templates are locked; "Edit safely" opens a correction draft, and existing orders and jobs stay on the old revision until the draft is published.
purpose.hi: इसे सूची से, Pending Approvals से या template बनाते ही खोलें। Lifecycle: DRAFT → ENGINEERING → APPROVED → LIVE → OBSOLETE। LIVE template lock होते हैं; "Edit safely" correction draft खोलता है और पुराने order व job draft publish होने तक पुराने revision पर रहते हैं।

prerequisites.en: A routing rule with valid processes.
prerequisites.hi: सही process वाला routing rule।

prerequisites.en: Work centers with capability for every route process.
prerequisites.hi: हर route process के लिए capable work center।

prerequisites.en: Material categories in masters (GRANULE, ADHESIVE, SOLVENT, ADDON, POD).
prerequisites.hi: Masters में material category (GRANULE, ADHESIVE, SOLVENT, ADDON, POD)।

keyActions.en: "1. Basics and route binding": choose "Routing rule" and "Business family", press "Save basics", then "Sync route stages".
keyActions.hi: "1. Basics and route binding": "Routing rule" और "Business family" चुनें, "Save basics" दबाएँ, फिर "Sync route stages"।

keyActions.en: "2. Batch and lot execution": fill "Batch size KG", "Batch size PCS", "Lot prefix" and the release switches; press "Save template execution".
keyActions.hi: "2. Batch and lot execution": "Batch size KG", "Batch size PCS", "Lot prefix" और release switch भरें; "Save template execution" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: "3. Route stages": check each stage and lamination Lane A / Lane B.
keyActions.hi: "3. Route stages": हर stage और lamination Lane A / Lane B जाँचें।

keyActions.en: "4. Template route dispatch": per stage set allowed centers, "Release rule", "Default work center", optional "Dispatch note"; press "Save dispatch setup".
keyActions.hi: "4. Template route dispatch": हर stage के allowed center, "Release rule", "Default work center", चाहें तो "Dispatch note"; "Save dispatch setup" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: "5. Step material rules": map each material category to a stage and set Basis, Formula, Issue, Value and Close.
keyActions.hi: "5. Step material rules": हर material category को stage से जोड़ें और Basis, Formula, Issue, Value, Close सेट करें।

keyActions.en: Check "Template readiness" and "Review gate"; fix every "Fix:" line.
keyActions.hi: "Template readiness" और "Review gate" देखें; हर "Fix:" लाइन ठीक करें।

keyActions.en: "6. Review and make live": press "Send for review", then "Approve", then "Publish LIVE" (the button label changes with status).
keyActions.hi: "6. Review and make live": "Send for review", फिर "Approve", फिर "Publish LIVE" दबाएँ (बटन का नाम status के साथ बदलता है)।

keyActions.en: To change a LIVE template press "Edit safely"; to copy press "Duplicate" / "Create working copy"; to retire press "Disable" (confirm).
keyActions.hi: LIVE template बदलने के लिए "Edit safely"; copy के लिए "Duplicate" / "Create working copy"; बंद करने के लिए "Disable" (पुष्टि करें)।

help.en: Percent of stages with material policy, pills "Basics saved", route, stage count, "Ready for live" / "Review needed".
help.hi: Material policy वाले stage का प्रतिशत, और "Basics saved", route, stage गिनती, "Ready for live" / "Review needed"।

help.en: DRAFT (Editable), ENGINEERING (Peer checks rules), APPROVED (Locked for publish), LIVE (Used by planner), OBSOLETE (Retired).
help.hi: DRAFT (बदल सकते), ENGINEERING (जाँच), APPROVED (publish के लिए lock), LIVE (planner इस्तेमाल करता), OBSOLETE (बंद)।

field.en: Batch size KG / PCS, Lot prefix
field.hi: Batch size KG / PCS, Lot prefix

help.en: Default batch size for new releases and the lot number prefix (AUTO if empty).
help.hi: नए release का default batch size और lot number prefix (खाली हो तो AUTO)।

help.en: Create live production batches when the planner releases the line.
help.hi: Planner line release करे तब production batch अपने आप बनें।

help.en: Part of a batch can move on while the balance stays open.
help.hi: Batch का कुछ हिस्सा आगे जा सकता है, बाकी खुला रहता है।

help.en: Starts parallel branches without a second manual release.
help.hi: Parallel branch बिना दोबारा release के साथ शुरू होते हैं।

help.en: A join stage waits until every input branch is complete.
help.hi: Join stage तब तक रुकता है जब तक हर input branch पूरा न हो।

help.en: "Auto when one center", "Use selected default", "Planner chooses at release".
help.hi: "Auto when one center", "Use selected default", "Planner chooses at release"।

field.en: Planner may skip at release / WCM may skip after previous output
field.hi: Planner may skip at release / WCM may skip after previous output

help.en: Optional-step switches, only when the Process Master allows.
help.hi: Step छोड़ने के switch, सिर्फ जब Process Master अनुमति दे।

help.en: Thickness: Inherit input, Sum inputs, Fixed, Template default. Capture: Process default, Single roll, Multi roll, Split grid, Discrete only, Bulk KG + PCS, Bulk KG only. Width comes from order size.
help.hi: Thickness: Inherit input, Sum inputs, Fixed, Template default। Capture: Process default, Single roll, Multi roll, Split grid, Discrete only, Bulk KG + PCS, Bulk KG only। Width order size से आती है।

help.en: Basis: Snapshot GSM, Master formula, Fixed KG, Fixed PCS. Issue: No uplift, percent over theory, Fixed extra kg, Minimum issue kg. Close: Auto from output, Estimate + confirm, Operator required. Ink theory comes from artwork GSM.
help.hi: Basis: Snapshot GSM, Master formula, Fixed KG, Fixed PCS। Issue: No uplift, theory से प्रतिशत ज़्यादा, Fixed extra kg, Minimum issue kg। Close: Auto from output, Estimate + confirm, Operator required। Ink theory artwork GSM से आती है।

error.en: Sync workflow first. A LIVE template must contain at least one active route step.
error.hi: Sync workflow first. A LIVE template must contain at least one active route step.

reason.en: Press "Sync route stages" after choosing the route.
reason.hi: Route चुनने के बाद "Sync route stages" दबाएँ।

error.en: Cannot change routing on a LIVE template.
error.hi: Cannot change routing on a LIVE template.

reason.en: Use "Edit safely" to get a correction draft.
reason.hi: "Edit safely" से correction draft लें।

error.en: Template must be APPROVED before it can be published LIVE.
error.hi: Template must be APPROVED before it can be published LIVE.

reason.en: Send for review and approve first.
reason.hi: पहले review भेजें और approve करें।

error.en: LIVE templates are read-only. Clone a new revision first.
error.hi: LIVE templates are read-only. Clone a new revision first.

reason.en: Use "Edit safely".
reason.hi: "Edit safely" इस्तेमाल करें।

error.en: Step N …: choose a default work center or set Planner chooses at release.
error.hi: Step N …: choose a default work center or set Planner chooses at release.

reason.en: More than one capable center and no decision. Fix in section 4.
reason.hi: एक से ज़्यादा capable center हैं और फैसला नहीं हुआ। Section 4 में ठीक करें।

error.en: Step N …: lamination needs two input lanes.
error.hi: Step N …: lamination needs two input lanes.

reason.en: Set Input lanes to 2 in the lamination stage.
reason.hi: Lamination stage में Input lanes 2 करें।

error.en: Routing Rule contains missing Process code(s): … Route steps were not changed.
error.hi: Routing Rule contains missing Process code(s): … Route steps were not changed.

reason.en: The route uses a process that no longer exists; fix the route or Process Master.
reason.hi: Route में ऐसा process है जो अब नहीं है; route या Process Master ठीक करें।

error.en: ADDON category must use CATEGORY_FORMULA. / POD category must use CATEGORY_FORMULA.
error.hi: ADDON category must use CATEGORY_FORMULA. / POD category must use CATEGORY_FORMULA.

reason.en: For ADDON and POD pick Basis "Master formula" with formula "Addon master" / "POD profile".
reason.hi: ADDON और POD में Basis "Master formula" और formula "Addon master" / "POD profile" चुनें।

recoverySteps.en: All inputs grey and "Live / locked"? Press "Edit safely".
recoverySteps.hi: सब field grey और "Live / locked"? "Edit safely" दबाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: "No route stages yet"? Choose a routing rule, "Save basics", then "Sync route stages".
recoverySteps.hi: "No route stages yet"? Routing rule चुनें, "Save basics", फिर "Sync route stages"।

recoverySteps.en: A correction draft replaces the live template only after "Publish LIVE"; old orders keep the original.
recoverySteps.hi: Correction draft "Publish LIVE" के बाद ही LIVE template की जगह लेता है; पुराने order पुराना रखते हैं।

summary.en: Register of plant tools other than cylinders: anilox, sleeves, cutting dies, sealing jaws, core shafts, mounting adapters and others, with rack/slot, vendor and service due date.
summary.hi: Cylinder के अलावा plant के tool की सूची: anilox, sleeve, cutting die, sealing jaw, core shaft, mounting adapter आदि — rack/slot, vendor और service की तारीख के साथ।

purpose.en: Use it to know where a tool is kept and when it needs service. It is a register only; it does not block production.
purpose.hi: Tool कहाँ रखा है और service कब है, यह जानने के लिए। यह सिर्फ सूची है; production को नहीं रोकती।

prerequisites.en: Plant set up; a TOOLING storage location for the tool room (optional).
prerequisites.hi: Plant बना हो; tool room के लिए TOOLING storage location (वैकल्पिक)।

keyActions.en: Press "Add Tool".
keyActions.hi: "Add Tool" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: In "Create Tool Asset" pick "Plant" and "Asset Type", fill "Code" and "Name", choose "Status".
keyActions.hi: "Create Tool Asset" में "Plant" और "Asset Type" चुनें, "Code" और "Name" भरें, "Status" चुनें।

keyActions.en: Fill "Rack" (e.g. Rack-A) and "Slot" (e.g. S-04), "Storage Location" and "Vendor".
keyActions.hi: "Rack" (जैसे Rack-A), "Slot" (जैसे S-04), "Storage Location" और "Vendor" भरें।

keyActions.en: Set "Service Due" date and "Notes"; press "Save".
keyActions.hi: "Service Due" तारीख और "Notes" भरें; "Save" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Use "Edit" on a card to update; "Delete" removes it.
keyActions.hi: बदलने के लिए कार्ड पर "Edit"; "Delete" से हटाएँ।

field.en: Tracked Tools / Ready / Service Due / Retired
field.hi: Tracked Tools / Ready / Service Due / Retired

help.en: Counts by status.
help.hi: Status के हिसाब से गिनती।

help.en: ANILOX, SLEEVE, CUTTING_DIE, SEALING_JAW, CORE_SHAFT, MOUNTING_ADAPTER, TOOLING_OTHER.
help.hi: ANILOX, SLEEVE, CUTTING_DIE, SEALING_JAW, CORE_SHAFT, MOUNTING_ADAPTER, TOOLING_OTHER।

help.en: READY, IN_USE, SERVICE_DUE, MAINTENANCE, RETIRED.
help.hi: READY, IN_USE, SERVICE_DUE, MAINTENANCE, RETIRED।

help.en: Where the tool sits.
help.hi: Tool कहाँ रखा है।

help.en: Next service date (reminder only).
help.hi: अगली service की तारीख (सिर्फ याद के लिए)।

error.en: Storage location must belong to the same plant.
error.hi: Storage location must belong to the same plant.

reason.en: Pick a location of the selected plant.
reason.hi: चुने plant की location लें।

error.en: Storage location must be a TOOLING location.
error.hi: Storage location must be a TOOLING location.

reason.en: Only TOOLING-type locations are allowed.
reason.hi: सिर्फ TOOLING type location चलती है।

recoverySteps.en: "Delete" has no confirmation; prefer status RETIRED to keep history.
recoverySteps.hi: "Delete" पुष्टि नहीं माँगता; history रखने के लिए status RETIRED करें।

summary.en: The maintenance board: five numbers (Due today, Overdue, Open faults, Awaiting repair, Awaiting verification) and the list behind each. Refreshes every minute.
summary.hi: Maintenance board: पाँच गिनती (Due today, Overdue, Open faults, Awaiting repair, Awaiting verification) और हर गिनती के पीछे की सूची। हर मिनट अपने आप ताज़ा होता है।

purpose.en: Start the shift here. See what is due, what is late, which machines are down, and sign off finished work. Report a fault from any machine.
purpose.hi: Shift की शुरुआत यहीं से करें। क्या due है, क्या late है, कौन सी machine बंद है देखें, और पूरा काम sign off करें। किसी भी machine की खराबी यहीं से दर्ज करें।

prerequisites.en: Machines in Factory; maintenance schedules for due jobs.
prerequisites.hi: Factory में machine; due job के लिए maintenance schedule।

prerequisites.en: Verify needs maintenance manage rights (supervisor / plant manager).
prerequisites.hi: Verify के लिए maintenance manage अनुमति (supervisor / plant manager)।

keyActions.en: Pick the plant, or keep "All plants".
keyActions.hi: Plant चुनें, या "All plants" रखें।

keyActions.en: Tap a number tile to see its list.
keyActions.hi: सूची देखने के लिए गिनती वाले tile पर tap करें।

keyActions.en: Tap a job to open its record and work on it.
keyActions.hi: Job पर tap करके record खोलें और काम दर्ज करें।

keyActions.en: In "Awaiting verification", tap a job, read checks, and press "Verified" — or write a note and press "Send back".
keyActions.hi: "Awaiting verification" में job पर tap करें, checks पढ़ें, और "Verified" दबाएँ — या note लिखकर "Send back" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Press "Report a fault" to raise a breakdown.
keyActions.hi: खराबी दर्ज करने के लिए "Report a fault" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Press "All jobs" for the full job list.
keyActions.hi: पूरी job सूची के लिए "All jobs" दबाएँ।

help.en: Jobs planned for today.
help.hi: आज के planned job।

help.en: Open jobs whose planned date has passed.
help.hi: खुले job जिनकी planned तारीख निकल गई।

help.en: Faults not yet resolved; red when the machine is stopped. "Open" link goes to the fault.
help.hi: जो खराबी अभी ठीक नहीं हुई; machine बंद हो तो लाल। "Open" link fault पर ले जाता है।

help.en: Machines down; "History" opens the machine history.
help.hi: बंद machine; "History" machine का इतिहास खोलता है।

help.en: Completed jobs waiting for supervisor sign-off.
help.hi: पूरे job जिनकी supervisor जाँच बाकी है।

help.en: Required when pressing "Send back".
help.hi: "Send back" दबाने पर ज़रूरी।

error.en: Could not verify — Only completed work awaiting verification can be verified.
error.hi: Could not verify — Only completed work awaiting verification can be verified.

reason.en: Someone already verified or the job changed; the list refreshes within a minute.
reason.hi: किसी ने पहले verify कर दिया या job बदला; सूची एक मिनट में ताज़ा होगी।

error.en: "Send back" button grey
error.hi: "Send back" बटन grey

reason.en: Write a verification note first.
reason.hi: पहले verification note लिखें।

recoverySteps.en: Without manage rights, tapping a waiting job opens the record instead of the verify box.
recoverySteps.hi: Manage अनुमति के बिना waiting job पर tap करने से verify box नहीं, record खुलता है।

recoverySteps.en: Numbers show "–" while loading; wait or refresh.
recoverySteps.hi: Load होते समय "–" दिखता है; रुकें या refresh करें।

summary.en: All machine faults reported from the floor. Assigning a fault creates the repair job; resolving brings a stopped machine back to active.
summary.hi: Floor से दर्ज सभी machine खराबी। Fault assign करने पर repair job बनता है; resolve करने पर बंद machine फिर active हो जाती है।

purpose.en: Operators report here; supervisors assign; technicians mark "In repair" and "Resolved"; supervisors close.
purpose.hi: Operator यहाँ दर्ज करते हैं; supervisor assign करते हैं; technician "In repair" और "Resolved" करते हैं; supervisor close करते हैं।

prerequisites.en: Fault reporting right (maintenance log/work/manage).
prerequisites.hi: खराबी दर्ज करने की अनुमति (maintenance log/work/manage)।

keyActions.en: Press "Report a fault", choose "Machine", write "What is wrong?", details, severity LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL.
keyActions.hi: "Report a fault" दबाएँ, "Machine" चुनें, "What is wrong?" लिखें, details और severity LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL।

keyActions.en: Tick "Machine has stopped" if it is down, then press "Report". The running step is paused as a breakdown.
keyActions.hi: Machine बंद हो तो "Machine has stopped" tick करें, फिर "Report" दबाएँ। चल रहा step breakdown के रूप में रुक जाता है।

keyActions.en: Supervisor: tap the fault, choose "Assign to", press "Assign and create repair job".
keyActions.hi: Supervisor: fault पर tap करें, "Assign to" चुनें, "Assign and create repair job" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Add photos with the photo button; "Open repair job" opens the job.
keyActions.hi: Photo बटन से photo जोड़ें; "Open repair job" से job खोलें।

keyActions.en: Technician: press "In repair"; when fixed write "What was done" and press "Resolved".
keyActions.hi: Technician: "In repair" दबाएँ; ठीक होने पर "What was done" लिखकर "Resolved" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Supervisor: press "Close fault" on a resolved fault, or "Dismiss" (with note) for a false report.
keyActions.hi: Supervisor: resolved fault पर "Close fault" दबाएँ, या गलत रिपोर्ट पर (note के साथ) "Dismiss"।

help.en: Open faults, open faults with machine stopped, and rows in the list.
help.hi: खुली खराबी, बंद machine वाली खुली खराबी, और सूची की लाइनें।

help.en: Filter: only OPEN/ASSIGNED/IN_REPAIR, or every fault.
help.hi: Filter: सिर्फ OPEN/ASSIGNED/IN_REPAIR, या सब।

help.en: Open, Assigned, In repair, Resolved, Closed, Dismissed.
help.hi: Open, Assigned, In repair, Resolved, Closed, Dismissed।

help.en: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL. HIGH and CRITICAL repair jobs need verification.
help.hi: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL। HIGH और CRITICAL के repair job की जाँच ज़रूरी।

help.en: Required to resolve or dismiss.
help.hi: Resolve या dismiss के लिए ज़रूरी।

error.en: Could not report — You cannot report faults.
error.hi: Could not report — You cannot report faults.

reason.en: Your role lacks maintenance log rights; ask the admin.
reason.hi: आपके role को maintenance log अनुमति नहीं; admin से कहें।

error.en: Only maintenance staff can change repair status.
error.hi: Only maintenance staff can change repair status.

reason.en: Operators can report but not repair; ask a technician.
reason.hi: Operator दर्ज कर सकते हैं, repair नहीं; technician से कहें।

error.en: File is larger than 8 MB. / Only photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC) and PDF are accepted.
error.hi: File is larger than 8 MB. / Only photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC) and PDF are accepted.

reason.en: Use a smaller photo or a PDF.
reason.hi: छोटी photo या PDF लगाएँ।

recoverySteps.en: "Report" stays grey until a machine and a title are filled.
recoverySteps.hi: Machine और title भरे बिना "Report" grey रहता है।

recoverySteps.en: If a repair job already exists, assigning does not create a second one.
recoverySteps.hi: Repair job पहले से हो तो assign करने पर दूसरा नहीं बनता।

summary.en: All maintenance jobs (scheduled checks, technician services, repair jobs). Technicians see "My maintenance jobs" by default.
summary.hi: सभी maintenance job (schedule वाले check, technician service, repair job)। Technician को पहले "My maintenance jobs" दिखता है।

purpose.en: Tap a job to record the work: checks, readings, spares used, time and outcome. Supervisors can add one-off jobs.
purpose.hi: Job पर tap करके काम दर्ज करें: checks, reading, लगे पुर्ज़े, समय और नतीजा। Supervisor अलग से job जोड़ सकते हैं।

prerequisites.en: maintenance work or manage rights.
prerequisites.hi: maintenance work या manage अनुमति।

keyActions.en: Pick a filter: "Mine", "Open", "Overdue", "To verify", "Done", "All"; and a machine.
keyActions.hi: Filter चुनें: "Mine", "Open", "Overdue", "To verify", "Done", "All"; और machine।

keyActions.en: Tap a job; press "Start".
keyActions.hi: Job पर tap करें; "Start" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Answer each check: "OK", "Issue" or "Can't check"; type readings.
keyActions.hi: हर check का जवाब: "OK", "Issue" या "Can't check"; reading भरें।

keyActions.en: Add spares ("Add spare"), "Time taken", photos ("Add photo") and a note.
keyActions.hi: पुर्ज़े ("Add spare"), "Time taken", photo ("Add photo") और note भरें।

keyActions.en: Choose outcome "Completed", "Issue found" or "Unable" (reason needed for the last two).
keyActions.hi: नतीजा चुनें: "Completed", "Issue found" या "Unable" (आखिरी दो में कारण ज़रूरी)।

keyActions.en: Press "Save record" or "Submit for verification".
keyActions.hi: "Save record" या "Submit for verification" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Supervisor: "Add job" → machine, "What needs doing", date, kind, notes, "Needs supervisor verification" → "Add".
keyActions.hi: Supervisor: "Add job" → machine, "What needs doing", तारीख, kind, notes, "Needs supervisor verification" → "Add"।

help.en: Counts for the current filter.
help.hi: चुने filter की गिनती।

help.en: Due, In progress, Done, Awaiting verification, Verified, Issue found, Could not complete, Cancelled; red "overdue" tag.
help.hi: Due, In progress, Done, Awaiting verification, Verified, Issue found, Could not complete, Cancelled; लाल "overdue" निशान।

help.en: "Technician service" or "Operator check".
help.hi: "Technician service" या "Operator check"।

help.en: Out of the min–max range sets the check to Issue automatically.
help.hi: min–max से बाहर हो तो check अपने आप Issue हो जाता है।

help.en: Item, qty and ₹ cost; a note only — no stock is issued.
help.hi: पुर्ज़ा, मात्रा और ₹ लागत; सिर्फ note — stock से नहीं घटता।

error.en: Job is DONE; only due work can be started.
error.hi: Job is DONE; only due work can be started.

reason.en: The job is already closed.
reason.hi: Job पहले ही बंद है।

error.en: A reason is required when the work is not completed cleanly.
error.hi: A reason is required when the work is not completed cleanly.

reason.en: Write the reason for Issue found / Unable.
reason.hi: Issue found / Unable का कारण लिखें।

error.en: Only maintenance staff can add jobs by hand.
error.hi: Only maintenance staff can add jobs by hand.

reason.en: Ask a supervisor to add it.
reason.hi: Supervisor से जुड़वाएँ।

error.en: n check(s) marked "Issue". Choose "Issue found" …
error.hi: n check(s) marked "Issue". Choose "Issue found" …

reason.en: Pick "Issue found" so a fault is raised, or correct the check.
reason.hi: "Issue found" चुनें ताकि fault बने, या check ठीक करें।

recoverySteps.en: "Save record" stays grey until all checks are answered (for Completed) or a reason is written.
recoverySteps.hi: Completed में सब check का जवाब या बाकी में कारण लिखे बिना "Save record" grey रहता है।

summary.en: Full-page record of one maintenance job; the phone lands here after scanning a machine QR. Same record as the job dialog, plus "Edit history".
summary.hi: एक maintenance job का पूरा पेज; machine QR scan करने पर phone यहीं आता है। Job dialog जैसा ही record, साथ में "Edit history"।

purpose.en: Work the job on the floor and close it with an outcome. Closed jobs show read only.
purpose.hi: Floor पर job का काम करें और नतीजे के साथ बंद करें। बंद job सिर्फ पढ़ने के लिए दिखता है।

prerequisites.en: A job id (from a list, link or QR scan).
prerequisites.hi: Job id (सूची, link या QR scan से)।

keyActions.en: Press "Start".
keyActions.hi: "Start" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: Answer "Checks" with "OK" / "Issue" / "Can't check"; enter readings.
keyActions.hi: "Checks" में "OK" / "Issue" / "Can't check" चुनें; reading भरें।

keyActions.en: Fill spares, "Time taken", "Add photo", "Note".
keyActions.hi: पुर्ज़े, "Time taken", "Add photo", "Note" भरें।

keyActions.en: Choose "Completed", "Issue found" (fault name, severity, "Machine has stopped") or "Unable".
keyActions.hi: "Completed", "Issue found" (fault का नाम, severity, "Machine has stopped") या "Unable" चुनें।

keyActions.en: Press "Save record" / "Submit for verification".
keyActions.hi: "Save record" / "Submit for verification" दबाएँ।

keyActions.en: "Machine card" opens the machine's scan card.
keyActions.hi: "Machine card" machine का scan card खोलता है।

help.en: Time, person and action for every change.
help.hi: हर बदलाव का समय, व्यक्ति और काम।

help.en: With "Issue found": the running production step is paused as a breakdown.
help.hi: "Issue found" के साथ: चल रहा production step breakdown बनकर रुकता है।

help.en: "Waiting for a supervisor to verify.", "Verified …" or "Closed." when not editable.
help.hi: बदल नहीं सकते तब "Waiting for a supervisor to verify.", "Verified …" या "Closed."।

error.en: Job is already DONE.
error.hi: Job is already DONE.

reason.en: Someone closed it; reload.
reason.hi: किसी ने बंद कर दिया; reload करें।

error.en: You cannot start maintenance work.
error.hi: You cannot start maintenance work.

reason.en: Your role cannot start this kind of job.
reason.hi: आपका role यह job शुरू नहीं कर सकता।

recoverySteps.en: If the title stays "Loading…" or "Job", the id is wrong; open from the jobs list.
recoverySteps.hi: Title "Loading…" या "Job" ही रहे तो id गलत है; jobs सूची से खोलें।

summary.en: Everything done on one machine in date order: jobs, faults and downtime, with totals.
summary.hi: एक machine पर हुआ सब कुछ तारीख के क्रम में: job, खराबी और downtime, कुल के साथ।

purpose.en: Open it from "History" on the board to see a machine's record before a repair or a decision.
purpose.hi: Repair या फैसले से पहले machine का रिकॉर्ड देखने के लिए board के "History" से खोलें।

prerequisites.en: A machine id.
prerequisites.hi: Machine id।

keyActions.en: Read tiles "Jobs", "Faults", "Downtime events", "Spares noted".
keyActions.hi: "Jobs", "Faults", "Downtime events", "Spares noted" tile पढ़ें।

keyActions.en: Scroll the "Timeline"; tap a job title to open it.
keyActions.hi: "Timeline" देखें; job के नाम पर tap करके खोलें।

keyActions.en: Press "Machine card" for the scan card.
keyActions.hi: Scan card के लिए "Machine card" दबाएँ।

help.en: ₹ total of spares noted on jobs.
help.hi: Job में लिखे पुर्ज़ों का कुल ₹।

help.en: Reason, hours, job number; "from terminal pause" when logged by a pause.
help.hi: कारण, घंटे, job number; pause से आए तो "from terminal pause"।

recoverySteps.en: Empty timeline means nothing has been logged for this machine yet.
recoverySteps.hi: Timeline खाली है तो इस machine पर अभी कुछ दर्ज नहीं।

title.en: QR codes for machines and locations
title.hi: Machine और location के QR code

summary.en: Printable QR posters for every machine and stock location.
summary.hi: हर machine और stock location के print होने वाले QR poster।

purpose.en: Print, laminate and stick one on each machine and location. Anyone signed in scans it from the ERP header and lands on that machine or location with the panels for their role.
purpose.hi: Print करें, laminate करें और हर machine व location पर लगाएँ। Login किया कोई भी व्यक्ति ERP header से scan करके उस machine या location पर अपने role के panel के साथ पहुँचता है।

prerequisites.en: Machines and locations in Factory setup.
prerequisites.hi: Factory setup में machine और location।

keyActions.en: Choose the plant.
keyActions.hi: Plant चुनें।

keyActions.en: Tap "Machines", "Locations" or "All".
keyActions.hi: "Machines", "Locations" या "All" पर tap करें।

keyActions.en: Press "Print N posters", or "Print just this one" on a single poster.
keyActions.hi: "Print N posters" दबाएँ, या एक poster पर "Print just this one"।

keyActions.en: "← Show all" returns to the full list.
keyActions.hi: "← Show all" से पूरी सूची पर लौटें।

help.en: Counts and filter.
help.hi: गिनती और filter।

recoverySteps.en: If a poster is missing, check that the machine or location exists in the chosen plant.
recoverySteps.hi: Poster न दिखे तो देखें कि machine या location उस plant में बनी है।

summary.en: Compliance per month, breakdowns and downtime, recurring faults (90 days), spares and time, and technician workload.
summary.hi: महीने के हिसाब से compliance, breakdown और downtime, बार-बार की खराबी (90 दिन), पुर्ज़े और समय, और technician का काम।

purpose.en: Review maintenance performance weekly or monthly and find machines that keep failing.
purpose.hi: हफ्ते या महीने में maintenance का प्रदर्शन देखें और बार-बार खराब होने वाली machine पहचानें।

prerequisites.en: Closed jobs and downtime logs.
prerequisites.hi: बंद job और downtime log।

keyActions.en: Choose the plant.
keyActions.hi: Plant चुनें।

keyActions.en: Read "Done on time", "Scheduled jobs closed", "Breakdowns", "Breakdown hours".
keyActions.hi: "Done on time", "Scheduled jobs closed", "Breakdowns", "Breakdown hours" पढ़ें।

keyActions.en: Switch tabs: "Compliance", "Breakdowns & downtime", "Recurring faults", "Spares & time", "Technician workload".
keyActions.hi: Tab बदलें: "Compliance", "Breakdowns & downtime", "Recurring faults", "Spares & time", "Technician workload"।

help.en: Month, Scheduled, On time, Late, Missed, Open, On-time %.
help.hi: Month, Scheduled, On time, Late, Missed, Open, On-time %।

help.en: From the production downtime log: breakdowns, breakdown h, maintenance h, other stops h, events.
help.hi: Production downtime log से: breakdowns, breakdown h, maintenance h, other stops h, events।

help.en: Fault, times, stopped machine, last.
help.hi: Fault, कितनी बार, machine रुकी, आखिरी बार।

help.en: Person, open, overdue, done (30 d), avg hours to close.
help.hi: व्यक्ति, open, overdue, done (30 d), बंद करने में औसत घंटे।

recoverySteps.en: Empty tables mean nothing in the period (e.g. "No downtime recorded in the period.").
recoverySteps.hi: Table खाली = उस अवधि में कुछ नहीं (जैसे "No downtime recorded in the period.")।

summary.en: Planned maintenance per machine: daily, weekly, monthly or running-hour intervals with a checklist. Due jobs are created every morning at 05:30.
summary.hi: हर machine का planned maintenance: रोज़, हफ्ते, महीने या running-hour के अंतराल पर checklist के साथ। Due job हर सुबह 05:30 पर बनते हैं।

purpose.en: Set up once per machine. Fixed-calendar schedules never drift when work is late; interval schedules count from the last completion.
purpose.hi: हर machine के लिए एक बार सेट करें। Fixed-calendar schedule late होने पर भी नहीं खिसकता; interval schedule आखिरी काम से गिनता है।

prerequisites.en: Machines in Factory; maintenance manage rights.
prerequisites.hi: Factory में machine; maintenance manage अनुमति।

keyActions.en: Press "New schedule" (or tap an existing row).
keyActions.hi: "New schedule" दबाएँ (या मौजूदा लाइन पर tap करें)।

keyActions.en: Pick "Machine" and kind: "Operator check (short, on the machine)" or "Technician service (detailed job)".
keyActions.hi: "Machine" और kind चुनें: "Operator check (short, on the machine)" या "Technician service (detailed job)"।

keyActions.en: Enter name (e.g. Daily start-up check) and Hindi name.
keyActions.hi: नाम (जैसे Daily start-up check) और Hindi नाम भरें।

keyActions.en: Set interval ("Every N days/weeks/months/running hours") and N; choose the due rule; set "First due date".
keyActions.hi: अंतराल ("Every N days/weeks/months/running hours") और N; due rule; "First due date" भरें।

keyActions.en: Choose responsible person or "Anyone in the role"; tick "Critical (always verified)", "Supervisor verifies", "Needs a production stop"; set "Est. minutes".
keyActions.hi: ज़िम्मेदार व्यक्ति या "Anyone in the role" चुनें; "Critical (always verified)", "Supervisor verifies", "Needs a production stop" tick करें; "Est. minutes" भरें।

keyActions.en: Build the checklist: "Use starter checks" or "Add check" (OK / Issue or Reading with unit, min, max).
keyActions.hi: Checklist बनाएँ: "Use starter checks" या "Add check" (OK / Issue या Reading — unit, min, max)।

keyActions.en: Press "Save". Use "Create due jobs now" to generate today's jobs immediately; "Switch off" stops a schedule.
keyActions.hi: "Save" दबाएँ। आज के job तुरंत बनाने के लिए "Create due jobs now"; schedule बंद करने के लिए "Switch off"।

help.en: "Fixed calendar (late work does not move the next date)" or "Interval after the last completion".
help.hi: "Fixed calendar (late work does not move the next date)" या "Interval after the last completion"।

help.en: Kind, interval, rule, next due, last done, number of checks.
help.hi: Kind, अंतराल, rule, अगली due, आखिरी काम, checks की गिनती।

help.en: Oil level, Unusual noise or vibration, Leaks, Safety guards in place.
help.hi: Oil level, Unusual noise or vibration, Leaks, Safety guards in place।

error.en: Could not save
error.hi: Could not save

reason.en: Check machine, name and first due date; read the message shown.
reason.hi: Machine, नाम और first due date जाँचें; दिखा संदेश पढ़ें।

recoverySteps.en: "Save" is grey until machine, name and first due date are filled.
recoverySteps.hi: Machine, नाम और first due date भरे बिना "Save" grey रहता है।

recoverySteps.en: If a due job did not appear, press "Create due jobs now".
recoverySteps.hi: Due job न दिखे तो "Create due jobs now" दबाएँ।

summary.en: Live headline numbers for the whole plant (OEE, scrap rate, availability, efficiency, booked order value, output), roll reuse pools, POD stock, trends and the list of reports you may open.
summary.hi: पूरे प्लांट के मुख्य आँकड़े एक जगह: OEE, scrap rate, availability, efficiency, बुक हुए order की कीमत और output। साथ में roll reuse pool, POD stock, ट्रेंड और आपकी खुलने वाली रिपोर्टों की सूची।

purpose.en: Open it at the start of the day or before a review meeting to see if the plant is healthy, then jump into the report that needs attention. Admins and owners also generate and check the daily report pack here.
purpose.hi: दिन की शुरुआत में या review meeting से पहले खोलें। देखें प्लांट ठीक चल रहा है या नहीं, फिर जिस रिपोर्ट पर ध्यान चाहिए उसमें जाएँ। Admin और Owner यहीं से daily report pack बनाते और जाँचते हैं।

prerequisites.en: Production must be logged on the work-center terminals (output, scrap, downtime); otherwise OEE, scrap and efficiency show "Pending".
prerequisites.hi: Work-center terminal पर output, scrap और downtime दर्ज होना चाहिए, वरना OEE, scrap और efficiency में "Pending" दिखेगा।

prerequisites.en: Your role needs the Reports Hub permission (page.analytics.home.view).
prerequisites.hi: आपके role को Reports Hub की अनुमति (page.analytics.home.view) चाहिए।

prerequisites.en: Daily report packs are configured by an admin in Report Center (/system/report-center).
prerequisites.hi: Daily report pack की सेटिंग Admin, Report Center (/system/report-center) में करता है।

keyActions.en: Read the six cards at the top: "OEE", "Scrap Rate", "Availability", "Efficiency", "Revenue", "Output".
keyActions.hi: ऊपर के छह कार्ड पढ़ें: "OEE", "Scrap Rate", "Availability", "Efficiency", "Revenue", "Output"।

keyActions.en: Check "Operational KPI Pulse": each bar shows the value against its target (OEE 85, Availability 90, Efficiency 92, Scrap 2.5 or less).
keyActions.hi: "Operational KPI Pulse" देखें: हर पट्टी अपने target के सामने है (OEE 85, Availability 90, Efficiency 92, Scrap 2.5 या कम)।

keyActions.en: Look at "Live Trendboard" for the last 7 days of production and the sales trend.
keyActions.hi: "Live Trendboard" में पिछले 7 दिन का production और sales ट्रेंड देखें।

keyActions.en: Look at "Reuse and Exception Signals" and "SKU and Customer Leaders" for open risks and top products and customers.
keyActions.hi: "Reuse and Exception Signals" और "SKU and Customer Leaders" में खुले जोखिम और top product/customer देखें।

keyActions.en: Under "Available Reports" click a report card to open it.
keyActions.hi: "Available Reports" में किसी रिपोर्ट कार्ड पर क्लिक करके उसे खोलें।

keyActions.en: Admin/Owner: in "Report Generation Control" press "Generate <pack name> now" to archive today's pack; check it in "Run History Snapshot".
keyActions.hi: Admin/Owner: "Report Generation Control" में "Generate <pack name> now" दबाकर आज का pack बनाएँ; "Run History Snapshot" में जाँचें।

keyActions.en: Press "Refresh" (top right) to reload; the page also refreshes itself every 2 minutes.
keyActions.hi: दोबारा लोड करने के लिए ऊपर दाईं ओर "Refresh" दबाएँ; पेज हर 2 मिनट में खुद भी ताज़ा होता है।

help.en: Quick plant-wide estimate = Availability × quality ÷ 100. Quality = 100 − scrap rate. It is not the same as the machine-by-machine OEE in the OEE Deep Dive report.
help.hi: पूरे प्लांट का जल्दी वाला अनुमान = Availability × quality ÷ 100। Quality = 100 − scrap rate। यह OEE Deep Dive रिपोर्ट के मशीन-वार OEE जैसा नहीं है।

help.en: Scrap ÷ (good output + scrap) × 100, using today's logs; if nothing was logged today it uses the last 7 days.
help.hi: Scrap ÷ (अच्छा output + scrap) × 100। आज के log से; आज कुछ दर्ज नहीं हुआ तो पिछले 7 दिन से।

help.en: Average over all machines of (24 h × 7 days − downtime) ÷ (24 h × 7 days). Counts calendar hours, not shift hours.
help.hi: सभी मशीनों का औसत: (24 घंटे × 7 दिन − downtime) ÷ (24 घंटे × 7 दिन)। यह कैलेंडर घंटे गिनता है, shift घंटे नहीं।

help.en: Score = 0.6 × OEE + 0.4 × quality.
help.hi: Score = 0.6 × OEE + 0.4 × quality।

help.en: Booked order value: total of sales-order line amounts of the last 30 days (not invoiced revenue).
help.hi: बुक हुए order की कीमत: पिछले 30 दिन की sales order lines की कुल राशि (invoice वाली कमाई नहीं)।

help.en: Production output in KG for the last 30 days.
help.hi: पिछले 30 दिन का production output (KG में)।

help.en: Shown when there is no production evidence or the source could not be read. The page never shows a fake zero.
help.hi: जब production का कोई सबूत न हो या डेटा न पढ़ा जा सके तब दिखता है। पेज कभी झूठा शून्य नहीं दिखाता।

field.en: Final Roll Pool / Invariant Pool / Upstream Pool
field.hi: स्क्रीन पर: "Final Roll Pool / Invariant Pool / Upstream Pool"

help.en: Roll stock (KG) the planner can reuse: rolls ready as finished goods, matching intermediate rolls, and upstream rolls that can still go down the route.
help.hi: Planner जो roll stock (KG) दोबारा इस्तेमाल कर सकता है: सीधे FG बनने लायक roll, मेल खाते बीच के roll, और ऊपर के stage के roll जो आगे route में जा सकते हैं।

field.en: POD Stock Target / Active POD SKUs
field.hi: स्क्रीन पर: "POD Stock Target / Active POD SKUs"

help.en: Planned POD stock orders with their target KG, and how many POD SKUs and variants are active.
help.hi: योजना वाले POD stock order और उनका target KG, और कितने POD SKU व variant चालू हैं।

help.en: Latest daily report packs that were generated (admin/owner only).
help.hi: हाल में बने daily report pack (केवल admin/owner)।

error.en: Reports Hub could not load live analytics.
error.hi: संदेश: "Reports Hub could not load live analytics."

reason.en: The summary request failed. Cards are paused instead of showing zeros. Press "Refresh"; if it stays, tell the admin.
reason.hi: Summary request फेल हुआ। कार्ड शून्य दिखाने के बजाय रोक दिए गए हैं। "Refresh" दबाएँ; फिर भी रहे तो admin को बताएँ।

error.en: Report catalog data could not be loaded.
error.hi: संदेश: "Report catalog data could not be loaded."

reason.en: The list of reports did not load. Refresh the page.
reason.hi: रिपोर्टों की सूची लोड नहीं हुई। पेज refresh करें।

error.en: Report activity degraded
error.hi: संदेश: "Report activity degraded"

reason.en: Report runs or pack settings could not load (often because your role is not admin/owner). Live numbers above still work.
reason.hi: Report runs या pack की सेटिंग लोड नहीं हुई (अक्सर role admin/owner नहीं होने से)। ऊपर के live आँकड़े फिर भी चलते हैं।

error.en: No execution telemetry is recorded for the current window.
error.hi: संदेश: "No execution telemetry is recorded for the current window."

reason.en: No output was logged on the machines in the period. Ask work centers to log output on the terminal.
